title.rendered: GTA 6 weapon wheel and inventory system explained

content.rendered:
If you’re planning to take on Leonida’s criminal underworld, you’ll need a reliable arsenal to survive the chaos in GTA 6. Rockstar Games has revamped the weapon wheel and inventory system, making weapon selection and loadout management more important than ever.

Unlike GTA 5, you can’t carry your entire collection of firearms and switch between them whenever you want. GTA 6 limits the number of weapons you can carry, introduces a separate Items tab, and lets you store extra weapons in your personal vehicle or an Ammu-Nation Weapon Locker.

Wondering how these changes work? Here’s everything you need to know about the GTA 6 weapon wheel, inventory slots, weapon storage, and customization options.

How Does the GTA 6 Weapon Wheel Work?

The weapon wheel returns in GTA 6, but it works differently from the one in GTA 5. Instead of giving you immediate access to every firearm you own, it displays the weapons and equipment currently assigned to your loadout.

To open the weapon wheel, hold LB on Xbox Series X|S or L1 on PS5. You can then use the right stick to highlight a weapon or item and select it using the on-screen control prompt.

The Weapons tab includes slots for:

  • Two sidearms: Carry two handguns.
  • Two longarms: Carry two long guns, with one visible in your character’s hands and the other on their back.
  • Melee weapons: Access close-range weapons.
  • Explosives and equipment: Carry additional combat equipment.

The wheel also has a separate Items tab. Press RB on Xbox or R1 on PS5 while the wheel is open to switch between Weapons and Items. This tab includes categories for items such as masks, headwear, outfits, bags, gear, eyewear, and smokes.

The biggest change is that you must decide which weapons and equipment to carry before heading into a mission. You can’t simply access your entire collection through the wheel anymore.

How to store weapons in your car in GTA 6?

Since GTA 6 doesn’t let you expand your inventory to carry more firearms, you’ll need to store your extra weapons in a Weapon Locker inside Ammu-Nation stores, or in your personal vehicle’s trunk.

In order to access your car’s storage, simply walk to the rear of your vehicle and press Triangle on PS5 or Y on Xbox to open the trunk.

Once it’s open, you get the option to manage your loadout, store any weapons you’re not currently using, or swap them out based on your preference. This gives you the flexibility to prepare for different scenarios and missions.

Can You Customise Weapons in GTA 6?

GTA 6 lets you customize your firearms to suit your preferred combat style. Visit an Ammu-Nation store to purchase weapons and explore the available upgrades.

Depending on the firearm, customization options include:

  • Magazines: Change your weapon’s ammunition capacity.
  • Grips: Improve handling.
  • Optics: Add sights for better aiming.
  • Suppressors: Reduce the noise produced by your weapon.
  • Paint jobs and wraps: Change your firearm’s appearance.

These upgrades let you adjust your weapons for different combat situations. You can also manage your owned firearms through the Weapon Locker rather than carrying everything at once.

GTA 6 Inventory System vs. GTA 5: What’s Different?

The biggest difference between GTA 5 and GTA 6 is how the games handle weapon ownership and carrying capacity. GTA 5 lets you access a much larger collection directly through its weapon wheel, while GTA 6 separates your owned weapons from your active loadout.

Tips for managing weapons and inventory in GTA 6

Since GTA 6 puts a limit on the number of weapons you can carry, managing your inventory becomes extremely important. You’ll need to plan your loadout carefully and make the most of the available storage. Here are a few tips to help you manage your weapons and inventory:

1. Choose weapons based on your mission

Before starting a mission, think about the type of combat you’ll face. A shotgun can be useful in close-quarters encounters, while an assault rifle offers more flexibility in different situations. If you’re expecting to engage enemies from a distance, consider taking a suitable long-range weapon.

Avoid carrying firearms that serve the same purpose. A balanced loadout gives you more options when a mission doesn’t go as planned.

2. Keep more weapons in your vehicle trunk

Your personal vehicle’s trunk gives you access to additional weapons without having to return to an Ammu-Nation store. Keep a few useful firearms stored there so you can change your loadout when necessary.

For example, you can leave a long-range weapon in the trunk when you don’t need it and swap it for a shotgun before entering a close-quarters mission.

3. Keep your Items tab organized

The Items tab is just as important as the Weapons tab. It gives you access to additional equipment, including masks, headwear, outfits, bags, gear, eyewear, and smokes.

Check the available items before starting a mission and carry the equipment you actually need. This makes it easier to access essential gear without cluttering your preparation.

Wrapping up

Rockstar Games has made weapon management more deliberate in GTA 6. Instead of carrying your entire arsenal, you have to choose two sidearms and two longarms while managing additional weapons through your personal vehicle and Ammu-Nation Weapon Lockers.

The separate Items tab also gives you a dedicated place for equipment and other useful gear. These changes make preparation an important part of combat, encouraging you to choose weapons that suit the mission rather than relying on unlimited access to your collection.

If you want to make combat easier, you can also check out our guide to GTA 6 cheats and how to unlock them.

FAQs

How do you open the weapon wheel in GTA 6?

Hold LB on Xbox Series X|S or L1 on PS5 to open the weapon wheel. Use the right stick to highlight a weapon and follow the on-screen prompt to equip it.

Can you carry all your weapons at once in GTA 6?

No. GTA 6 limits your active firearm loadout to two sidearms and two longarms. You also have separate slots for melee weapons and other equipment.

Can you store weapons in your car in GTA 6?

Yes. You can store and swap weapons through the trunk of your personal vehicle. This lets you keep additional firearms available without carrying them all at once.

Do Jason and Lucia have separate weapon inventories in GTA 6?

Both Jason and Lucia have separate weapon loadouts in GTA 6. Each protagonist can carry and manage their own weapons.

Can you customize weapons in GTA 6?

GTA 6 allows you to customise weapons with different attachments and wraps.

title.rendered: How to use the phone in GTA 6: All apps and features explained

content.rendered:
Your phone in GTA 6 isn’t just for checking social media. It lets you message contacts, manage your money, book rides, scan vehicles, take pictures, and access other useful features across Leonida. You can even use it while driving or enter cheat codes through it.

Opening your phone is simple: press Up on the D-pad on your PS5 or Xbox controller. However, there’s more to explore beyond the basics. Here’s how to use your phone in GTA 6, what each app does, and the features you should know about.

How to open the phone in GTA 6

To pull out your phone in GTA 6, you need to press Up on the D-Pad of your Xbox or PS5 controller. This will switch you to a first-person view as Jason or Lucia takes out their phone. Make use of the D-Pad to navigate through the available apps, and once you have selected the one you want, press A on Xbox or X on PlayStation to open it.

You can also customise your phone in GTA 6 by changing its wallpaper and ringtone. Head to Settings, where you can choose from 25 wallpapers and 11 different ringtones to give it a personal touch. One of GTA 6’s exclusive features on PS5 allows players to hear their phone’s ringtone directly through the DualSense controller’s built-in speaker.

All phone apps in GTA 6

Now that you know how to use the phone in GTA 6, let’s take a look at all the applications you can use on it and what purpose they serve in the game:

How to use the phone while driving in GTA 6

You can pull out your phone while driving in GTA 6 without automatically pausing the game. Press Up on the D-pad to open it and navigate through its apps.

The camera switches to a first-person view inside the vehicle, letting you see more of the car’s interior while using your phone. However, browsing while driving makes the vehicle harder to control, so be careful when using it on the road.

How to customize your phone in GTA 6

You don’t have to stick with the default phone appearance in GTA 6. You can change its wallpaper and ringtone to give it a more personal look and sound.

Follow these steps:

  1. Press Up on the D-Pad to open your phone.
  2. Navigate to the Settings app.
  3. Select the wallpaper option to change your phone’s background.
  4. Open the ringtone option to choose a different sound for incoming calls.
  5. Confirm your selection and return to the home screen.

You can revisit these settings whenever you want to change your phone’s appearance or ringtone.

Can you use the phone to enter cheat codes in GTA 6?

Yes. You can use your in-game phone to activate cheat codes in GTA 6. However, you need to enter a directional button combination rather than dial a traditional phone number.

Once you’ve unlocked a cheat, open your phone and follow these steps:

  1. Press Up on the D-pad to open your phone.
  2. On PS5, hold L1 and press R1. On Xbox Series X/S, hold LB and press RB.
  3. Enter the required directional sequence using the D-pad.
  4. Wait for the game to confirm that the cheat has been activated.

Remember that cheats become available after completing the main story, and individual cheats may have additional unlock requirements. Using cheats can also disable saving and trophy or achievement progress for the session, so create a save before experimenting.

For the complete list of codes and unlock requirements, check our GTA 6 cheats guide.

How to request your personal vehicle using Scooter Bros

If you’ve left your vehicle somewhere else, you don’t necessarily have to travel back to get it. The Scooter Bros app lets you request the delivery of your personal vehicle to your current location.

Open the app on your phone and follow the available prompts to request your car or bike. The service can charge a fee depending on factors such as the distance and condition of your vehicle.

It’s a useful option when you want to continue exploring Leonida with your preferred vehicle without making the journey back to where you left it.

Jason vs Lucia: does each character have a different phone?

Jason and Lucia each have their own phone in GTA 6. You use the phone while playing as either character, and its apps provide access to messaging, banking, transportation, and other features.

You can also customise the phone’s appearance through its wallpaper and ringtone settings. This gives you a way to personalise the phone rather than treating it as just another menu.

Wrapping up!

The phone in GTA 6 is much more than a communication device. It gives Jason and Lucia access to 14 apps for messaging, banking, transportation, photography, vehicle scanning, and other activities.

To open it, simply press Up on your controller’s D-pad. You can browse its apps on foot or while driving, customise its appearance, and even use it to enter cheat codes after unlocking them.

FAQs

How do you open the phone in GTA 6?

Press Up on the D-Pad of your Xbox or PS5 controller to open up the phone in GTA 6.

Can you use the internet on your phone in GTA 6?

You can browse the internet on your phone in GTA 6. The in-game browser lets you explore various websites, check social media, and discover more.

Can you call other characters in GTA 6?

You can call other characters in GTA 6 with your in-game phone and even drop them messages.

Does GTA 6 have social media apps?

GTA 6 has social media apps that let you browse posts, photos, videos, and updates from people in Leonida.

Can you use your phone while driving in GTA 6?

You can use your phone while driving in GTA 6.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Punch Walls To Escape Codes on November 20, 2026

Punch Walls To Escape is a Roblox game where you smash through walls, sell the rubble, and upgrade your fists to escape all five floors. You can also smash vaults to earn Gems, which help you progress faster. If you want a head start, redeem the latest Punch Walls To Escape codes for free rewards, including Gems, crates, pets, and cosmetics.

The developers usually release new codes alongside chapters or game updates. Check the working codes below and redeem them before they expire.

All working Punch Walls To Escape codes

  • YUSIW: 75 Gems (NEW)
  • CORAMIXW: Redeem this code for 75 Gems
  • SPACEBEE: Redeem this code for 1 Space Bee Crate (250 Gems, a Voxel Bee pet, and a random cosmetic)

Expired Punch Walls To Escape codes

BREAKOUT, IRONBRASS

How to redeem Punch Walls To Escape codes

You redeem codes through the in-game Codes menu. Keep the code ready to copy so you can enter it without accidentally missing a letter.

  1. Launch Punch Walls To Escape on Roblox.
  2. Select the Codes button on the left side of the screen.
  3. Enter your code in the text box exactly as shown in the list above.
  4. Submit the code to claim your reward.

Why your Punch Walls To Escape code is not working

If a code doesn’t work, check for these common issues before trying again:

  • The code has expired: Developers can deactivate codes without notice. Check the working list for the latest available codes.
  • You entered the code incorrectly: Copy and paste the code to avoid missing or changing any characters.
  • You already redeemed it: Most Roblox game codes can only be redeemed once per account.

Where to find more Punch Walls To Escape codes

Check the game’s official Roblox page for announcements when a new chapter or update arrives. The game description is a useful place to look for new code announcements.

You can also bookmark this page, as we’ll update the list when more Punch Walls To Escape codes become available.

title.rendered: The Mimic codes (November 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest The Mimic codes on November 20, 2026

The Mimic is a Roblox horror survival game from CTStudio, inspired by Japanese history and urban legends. It takes players through four unsettling stories filled with monsters, puzzles, and jump scares. You can redeem codes for free Spirits and Revive Credits, which can help you get more out of your experience.

There are currently no confirmed working codes for The Mimic. However, a few recently shared codes have conflicting status reports, so we’ve included them separately for you to try. Check back after game updates, as CTStudio may release new codes during events and milestones.

All working The Mimic codes

  • HAPPYHALLOWEEN: 500 Spirits (NEW)

Expired and unverified The Mimic codes

4FREELIVES, CHENOORETURNS, HOFDELAY, NETAMOPOSSESSEDME, RAGERELEASE, SORRYFORWAIT, SPOOKYMONTH, THANKYOUFORBEINGPATIENT

How to redeem The Mimic codes

The redemption point is in the lobby, so enter your codes before heading into a story. Look for the Codes circle, then follow these steps:

  1. Launch The Mimic on Roblox.
  2. Walk to the Codes circle in the lobby.
  3. Press E to open the code entry box.
  4. Enter your code in the text box exactly as written.

Why your The Mimic code is not working

If a code doesn’t work, it doesn’t always mean you’ve entered it incorrectly. Check these common reasons before trying again:

  • The code has expired: Developers can deactivate codes after events or updates. Check the status lists above before redeeming an older code.
  • The code is case-sensitive: Enter each code exactly as shown. Avoid changing uppercase and lowercase letters.
  • You’ve already redeemed it: Codes are generally limited to one redemption per account, so you can’t claim the same reward twice.
  • The code is unverified: Some codes appear on third-party lists without confirmation from the developers. They may not work on your account.

Where to find more The Mimic codes

Follow CTStudio’s announcements on Discord and in its Roblox group to keep up with new updates, events, and code releases. Developers may share new codes during special occasions or game milestones.

You can also bookmark this page to check for new codes. We’ll update the working and expired lists as their status changes.

If you like The Mimic, check out our Martial Arts World codes and Punch Walls To Escape codes, or browse our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: I compared Apple HomeView and Amazon Echo Show 8. Here’s which smart display I’d buy

content.rendered:
A smart display should do more than show the weather or respond to voice commands. It should make everyday tasks easier, help manage connected devices, and give everyone in the household quick access to useful information.

That’s what makes Apple’s new HomeView interesting. It combines a touchscreen, Siri AI, FaceTime, and Apple Home controls in a compact device designed for shared spaces. However, Amazon’s Echo Show 8 (4th Gen) already offers many of the same features, along with Alexa+, a larger screen, and broader smart home connectivity.

HomeView starts at $299, while the Echo Show 8 launched at around $179.99 in the US. That leaves Apple with a sizeable price disadvantage. So, what does its more expensive smart display actually offer, and is it worth paying extra?

Here’s how Apple HomeView and Amazon Echo Show 8 compare across design, display, voice assistants, smart home features, privacy, and entertainment.

Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Specifications at a glance

Here’s how the two smart displays compare on paper.

The specifications reveal two different priorities. Apple focuses on display sharpness, personalisation, and ecosystem integration, while Amazon offers a larger screen and more extensive smart home connectivity.

Design and build: Apple’s premium look vs Amazon’s practical design

Apple HomeView has a more distinctive appearance. Its 7-inch square touchscreen sits on a domed aluminium speaker base connected through a stainless-steel hinge. I like its adjustable display, which lets me change the viewing angle as needed. Apple also offers a wall-mounted model.

Amazon takes a more familiar approach. The Echo Show 8 has a larger landscape display attached to a rounded, fabric-covered speaker base. Its screen lacks the adjustable hinge mechanism as HomeView, though Amazon sells a separate adjustable stand.

Therefore, HomeView has a more compact footprint and weighs slightly less, making it easier to fit on a bedside table or smaller counter.

My pick: Apple HomeView. Its aluminium construction, adjustable screen, and wall-mounting option make it more versatile. However, Echo Show 8’s larger landscape display makes more sense for watching videos and following recipes.

Display quality: Is Apple’s smaller screen actually better?

This is where the comparison gets interesting. HomeView has a smaller 7-inch square display, while Amazon gives me an 8.7-inch landscape touchscreen.

Apple’s Liquid Retina display has a resolution of 1,088 × 1,088 pixels and a pixel density of 220 PPI. It also supports True Tone, which adjusts the screen’s colour temperature according to the surrounding lighting. You can add playful faces like Snoopy, plus options like Calendar, Weather, and more.

On the other hand, Echo Show 8 has an HD panel with a resolution of 800 × 1,340 pixels and a lower pixel density of 179 PPI. That means HomeView should offer sharper text and interface elements.

My pick: It depends on how you use it. I’d choose HomeView for checking widgets, photos, everyday information and smart home controls. But if you regularly watch videos or follow recipes on a smart display, the Echo Show 8 is better. It gives more room to view information without scrolling or switching between screens.

Siri AI vs Alexa+: Which voice assistant is more useful?

A smart display becomes much more useful when I can interact with it naturally instead of remembering specific commands.

Instead of adding standard Siri, which uses basic voice commands, HomeView integrates the new Siri AI. The Apple Intelligence-powered assistant can understand follow-up requests, use personal context for relevant answers, and help manage everyday activities through natural conversation.

Amazon’s Alexa+ is also powered by generative AI and goes beyond traditional voice commands. It can hold more natural conversations with follow-ups, remember preferences to suggest content and recipes, manage schedules, play music, and connect with supported services like booking tickets, shopping, etc.

The best part is Alexa+ can use the camera to identify objects, recognise items, and provide useful information. Currently, HomeView can only recognize up to six household members. It lacks advanced on-device visual intelligence features.

My take: I prefer Siri AI as I already use Apple’s ecosystem. Its integration with personal information and smart home controls makes HomeView a more useful household assistant. However, Alexa+ remains appealing because it works with more smart home brands.

Smart home compatibility: Apple Home vs Amazon Alexa

This is probably the most important consideration before buying either display.

HomeView integrates with Apple’s Home app and supports HomeKit-compatible accessories, Matter, and Thread. That makes it a natural choice if I’ve already invested in Apple’s smart home ecosystem and already manage compatible accessories through Apple Home.

The Echo Show 8 supports Alexa, Matter, Thread, and Zigbee. Its built-in Thread border router and established Alexa integrations give it an advantage when connecting accessories from different manufacturers. For example, someone who already owns Ring products will probably find the Echo Show 8 more convenient.

I also really like Amazon’s Omnisense technology, which combines the camera, ultrasound, Wi-Fi radar, and temperature sensing to understand what’s happening around the device. This allows Alexa to trigger smart home routines based on activity or presence, such as turning on compatible lights when someone enters a room.

Amazon wins this category for me because Alexa supports a wider range of smart home products and makes home automation feel more proactive.

Privacy: Which smart display gives more control?

Privacy matters when a camera- and microphone-equipped device stays connected in a shared living space.

Apple takes an interesting approach with HomeView. Its A18 chip uses Secure Enclaves to process camera and microphone data in a protected environment. Apple says the audio and visual information used for face and voice recognition isn’t accessible to Apple or other apps and isn’t recorded or stored.

HomeView can also recognise up to six household members, giving each person a separate profile with access to Messages, Calendar, and personal playlists. However, personal information appears only when the device recognises the person and their paired iPhone or iPad is nearby, connected to the same Wi-Fi network, and recently unlocked.

Amazon takes a more traditional approach. The Echo Show 8 has a physical button that disables its camera and microphones. I can also disable the camera separately and review or delete voice recordings through the Alexa app or directly on the device.

My pick: Apple HomeView. Its individual profiles are a meaningful advantage for a shared family display. Yet, Amazon should be praised for user-friendly physical control of the camera and microphone.

Camera, video calling, and entertainment

Both displays have capable cameras, but they rely on different calling platforms.

HomeView features a 12MP Center Stage camera that automatically adjusts framing during FaceTime calls. You can send messages from HomeView. The Echo Show 8 has a 13MP camera with auto-framing and supports Alexa Calling and Zoom.

I’d choose HomeView if most of my family uses Apple devices. FaceTime integration makes it a convenient option for that household. Echo Show 8 makes more sense if you prefer Alexa Calling or Zoom.

Entertainment is a different story, though.

HomeView has a capable speaker setup with two full-range drivers, a down-firing woofer, dual passive radiators, Dolby Atmos Spatial Audio, and AirPlay support. The wall-mounted version has a simpler two-driver configuration. You can enjoy music, podcasts, audiobooks, TV, and more via native apps.

The Echo Show 8 uses a 2.8-inch woofer and two full-range drivers for spatial audio. Its biggest advantage is video streaming. The device works with Netflix and Prime Video services, whereas HomeView does not have standalone video streaming apps yet.

My pick: Echo Show 8 for entertainment. HomeView has interesting audio hardware, but Amazon’s streaming support makes its display more versatile.

Price and value: Is Apple HomeView worth the extra $100?

Apple HomeView starts at $299, compared with $199.99 for the Echo Show 8. That’s a considerable difference for devices that share many basic functions.

HomeView’s higher price buys a premium design, A18 processor, sharper display, FaceTime, deeper Apple Home integration, and individual household profiles.

But those features won’t matter equally to everyone. If you mainly want to control lights, set timers, listen to music, and watch videos, the Echo Show 8 already covers those needs for less money.

My take: Echo Show 8 offers better value, while HomeView offers a more premium experience.

Apple HomeView vs Echo Show 8: Which one would I buy?

If I had to choose between these two smart displays, I’d buy the Apple HomeView for an Apple-focused household. Its design, individual profiles, FaceTime integration, and wall-mounting option make it a more interesting addition to an Apple-powered home.

However, I wouldn’t recommend spending $299 simply because it’s an Apple product.

The Echo Show 8 is the more practical all-round purchase for someone who wants a larger screen, better entertainment options, wider smart home compatibility, and a lower price. It also makes more sense if the household already uses Alexa or Ring products. It’s ideal for most people, especially first-time smart display buyers.

Which smart display do you think is a better household assistant? Let us know in the comments below!

title.rendered: GTA 6 cheats: All the codes and how to unlock them

content.rendered:
Cheat codes have always been a big part of the Grand Theft Auto experience, letting players spawn vehicles, get weapons, change the weather, and cause chaos without following the usual rules. GTA 6 continues that tradition, but finding and using cheats works differently this time.

There are 61 reported cheats across five categories: Player, Combat, Spawn Vehicle, Environment, and Screen Filter. However, you can’t use them as soon as you start the game. You must finish the main story first and complete individual challenges to unlock most cheats. Not every button combination has been discovered yet, so we’ve marked unavailable codes as Not found yet rather than guessing.

Here’s the complete GTA 6 cheat list, including known codes, effects, and unlock requirements.

All GTA 6 cheats at a glance

GTA 6 has 61 cheats divided into five categories. The list below includes their reported effects and unlock requirements, along with every button combination currently published by the sources consulted.

Player cheats

Player cheats affect your character’s abilities, wanted level, equipment, and vehicle performance.

Combat cheats

Combat cheats modify weapons, ammunition, and the impact of attacks. Some require you to complete shooting-range challenges or perform specific combat activities.

Spawn vehicle cheats

Vehicle cheats let you spawn cars, bikes, aircraft, boats, and other vehicles. Several require completing challenges or discovering specific vehicles.

Screen filter cheats

Screen filter cheats change the appearance of the game world with different visual effects, color treatments, and camera filters.

Enviormental cheats

Environment cheats change the time of day or weather conditions around Leonida.

How to enter cheat codes in GTA 6

Once you’ve unlocked a cheat, you can activate it using your character’s in-game phone and a directional button combination. The process is similar on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

  1. Press Up on the D-pad to open your in-game phone.
  2. On PS5, hold L1 and press R1. On Xbox, hold LB and press RB.
  3. Enter the cheat’s directional sequence using the D-pad.
  4. Wait for the confirmation notification to appear.

The directional combinations are the same on both consoles. Only the shoulder buttons used to access the cheat input differ.

How to unlock cheat codes in GTA 6?

Unlike previous Grand Theft Auto games, GTA 6 doesn’t let you use cheats from the beginning. You must first complete Jason and Lucia’s main story campaign, which consists of 91 missions.

After finishing the story, a Cheats section becomes available under the Progress menu. It shows the available cheats and their individual unlock requirements. You’ll then need to complete the relevant challenge before using each cheat.

For example, the Body Armor cheat requires 100 workouts, while the Parachute cheat requires 50 skydives or base jumps from 300 feet or higher. Other cheats involve shooting-range medals, vehicle challenges, collectibles, and combat activities.

You don’t necessarily have to start every challenge after finishing the story. Progress you’ve already made can count toward the corresponding unlock requirement.

Important: Using a cheat disables saving and trophies or achievements for that session. Make a separate save before experimenting with cheats, and don’t rely on them to complete missions or challenges.

Do GTA 6 cheats work in online mode?

Rockstar Games hasn’t revealed much about GTA 6 Online yet, including its release date, features or whether players will be able to use cheat codes. However, based on how the online modes in previous Grand Theft Auto games have worked, we don’t expect GTA 6 cheats to be available in the online component.

Can you use GTA 6 cheats during missions?

You can’t use GTA 6 cheat codes during missions. Since these codes only unlock after completing the main-story missions, you won’t be able to use them to gain an edge over your enemies during missions. Cheats have been designed for free-roam gameplay after you’re done with everything.

Are GTA 6 cheats available on PC?

GTA 6 hasn’t made its way to PC just yet, but rumours suggest that Rockstar could bring the game to the platform sometime in early 2027. Once it does, we expect players to have access to the same cheat codes available on consoles, at least in the single-player mode. Until then, make sure to check out our guide on the best GTA 6 settings, so you’re ready to jump into Vice City when the PC version arrives.

Wrapping up

GTA 6 gives you 61 reported cheats to experiment with after completing the main story. You can change your character’s abilities, spawn vehicles, modify combat, adjust the weather, and apply unusual screen filters.

However, finishing the campaign is only the first step, as most cheats also require you to complete a specific challenge before they become available.. And if you still haven’t picked up the game, don’t forget to check out KICK’s GTA 6 Ultimate Edition giveaway for a chance to grab a copy completely free!

FAQs

How many cheat codes are there in GTA 6?

GTA 6 features 61 cheat codes for players to use, and each of them has a different effect in the game.

How do you unlock cheats in GTA 6?

You can unlock cheats in GTA 6 by completing the main storyline, which includes 91 missions.

Is there a money cheat in GTA 6?

Using the $250,000 cheat will give you money instantly in GTA 6.

Can you get unlimited ammo in GTA 6?

You can get unlimited ammo in GTA 6 by using the Infinite Ammo cheat code.

title.rendered: Apple faces a Paris trial over alleged iPhone repair blocks in June 2027

content.rendered:
French prosecutors are taking Apple to the Paris criminal court over alleged software and parts-pairing practices that block repairs outside Apple’s approved channels, including repairs with genuine parts. The first hearing, which sets the schedule, is on February 25, 2027. Arguments are expected over several days in June 2027.

The complaint came from HOP, Halte à l’Obsolescence Programmée, a French group against planned obsolescence. It was filed on December 7, 2022. The prosecutor’s decision followed four years of investigation. The charge is obstructing repair and refurbishment, which French law treats as an offense tied to planned obsolescence.

HOP alleges genuine parts still fail outside Apple’s channels

Parts pairing sits at the center of the case. HOP describes a system that ties each part’s serial number to one iPhone and flags when that part is replaced. HOP says the phone can malfunction when an unapproved repair happens, even with an identical, original part. The parts it names are screens, batteries and cameras, and the complaint covers 24 iPhone models.

Apple’s repair prices for the iPhone 17 show what is at stake for owners. At the 2025 launch, the base iPhone 17 battery cost $99, and a Pro Max screen cost $379. At those prices, a repair that works outside Apple’s channels matters to owners.

Apple disputes the claims and has expanded repair options

Apple strongly contests the allegations, calling them unfounded, and argues that pairing protects the privacy, security and safety of iPhone.

Apple has also expanded its repair options. In April 2024, it set out a plan for customers and independent repair providers to use used genuine Apple parts in repairs, starting with select iPhone models that fall. Calibration for genuine parts, new or used, would happen on the device after installation. Apple also extended Activation Lock to parts, so calibration is restricted for a part taken from a device with Activation Lock or Lost Mode enabled. Apple’s own Self Service Repair program supported 40 products in 33 countries and regions in 2024.

Apple’s own changes since 2022 limited serialization on new iPhones and let third parties validate some repairs, but HOP says those changes still need to be confirmed over time. The 2024 changes came more than a year after HOP filed its complaint.

The case has not reached a verdict, and the February 25 hearing only sets the schedule. An Unknown label means Apple cannot verify the part. It does not automatically prove the part is fake. After any screen or battery repair, open Settings > General > About and check Parts and Service History.

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Apple Black Friday deals 2026: Free iPhone 18 Pro + $850 off

content.rendered:
The biggest shopping event of the year is here again! With Black Friday scheduled for November 27, 2026, many popular retailers have already launched attractive deals on Apple products. Hence, it’s high time to get your new Apple devices or find the best gifts for your loved ones at reduced prices.

To save you time and effort, I’ve put together a list of top-notch Apple Black Friday deals. From the latest iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo to powerful M6 MacBooks, iPads, AirPods, and Apple accessories, this guide features some of the most compelling offers available right now. So, let’s get started!

When does the Black Friday Sale 2026 start?

The official date for Black Friday 2026 is Friday, November 27, the day after the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday. Most major retailers have already started their early Black Friday promotions, with more coming up throughout November. The main shopping event will continue through the weekend, followed by Cyber Monday on November 30.

However, you don’t necessarily have to wait until November 27 to grab a bargain. Retailers such as Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, and B&H Photo have already announced their early Black Friday deals on popular Apple products.

Apple has also officially announced its Black Friday 2026 shopping event, giving shoppers another way to save on eligible devices. From November 27 through November 30, you can get an Apple Gift Card worth up to $300 when you purchase an eligible product from Apple’s online store. The gift-card value depends on the product category, as shown later in the post.

Best Black Friday deals on Apple products in 2026

Here, I’ve listed the discounts and offers by product categories so you can find the one you’re looking for quickly.

Note: I’ve shared products that currently have significant discounts or are available at some of their lowest recorded prices. Carrier offers are listed separately because they often require eligible trade-ins, new lines, or specific unlimited plans. Keep checking this guide as retailers introduce additional Black Friday deals!

Best Black Friday iPhone deals

Every year, top cellular carriers offer lucrative discounts on the newest iPhone lineup during the holiday season. And this year is no exception!

The iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and Apple’s new iPhone Duo are among the biggest attractions this Black Friday. While direct unlocked discounts on the latest flagships are limited, carriers are offering substantial savings through trade-in promotions and qualifying plans.

Here are some of the most compelling deals available.

AT&T

  • iPhone 18 Pro: Get it for free with an eligible trade-in of $230 or more and a qualifying AT&T plan.
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: Save up to $1,200 with an eligible trade-in.
  • iPhone Duo: Save up to $1,200 with an eligible trade-in and qualifying plan.
  • Switching bonus: AT&T will cover up to $800 of your existing phone balance when you switch from another carrier.
  • Online bonus: Save an additional $200 per line when ordering eligible smartphones online.

AT&T’s iPhone trade-in promotion has different savings depending on your plan and trade-in value:

  • Up to $1,200 off with the Premium 2.0 plan or higher and a trade-in worth at least $230.
  • Up to $930 off with the Extra 2.0 plan or higher and a trade-in worth at least $130.
  • Up to $500 off with the Value 2.0 plan and an eligible trade-in worth at least $130.
  • Up to $350 off with an eligible unlimited plan and a trade-in worth $35–$129.

The savings are distributed as bill credits over 36 months. Along with these deals, AT&T is offering a brand-new iPhone 17 at no cost with an eligible trade-in. 

Verizon

Verizon is another carrier worth checking if you’re planning to upgrade to a new iPhone this Black Friday.

  • iPhone 18 Pro: Up to $1,200 off with a new or upgraded smartphone line on the Simplicity Plan with Simplicity Pro. Also, get a free Apple Watch SE 3 and AirPods 5.
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: Free with a new or upgraded smartphone line on the Simplicity Pro plan, plus a free Apple Watch and AirPods bundle. No trade-in required.
  • iPhone Duo: Up to $1,200 off with a new or upgraded smartphone line on the Simplicity Plan with Simplicity Pro, plus a free Apple Watch and AirPods bundle.

You can also check Best Buy for Verizon activation promotions, where eligible iPhone purchases may qualify for the same carrier-based discounts.

T-Mobile

T-Mobile is offering some of the most attractive early Black Friday promotions on Apple’s latest smartphones.

  • iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max: Get at $0/month with qualifying 5 picks T-Mix plan. Get up to $1,400 back via 36 monthly bill credits.
  • iPhone Duo: Get at $0/month with qualifying 7-picks T-Mix plan. Get up to $2,100 back via 36 monthly bill credits.
  • iPhone Duo (other plans): Get up to $1,200 off with a trade-in when you activate a new line on the T-Mix plan.

Like other carriers, T-Mobile also offers no-cost deals on the iPhone Air, iPhone 17 series, iPhone 16 series, and iPhone 15 with eligible trade-in and the Experience More plan. Moreover, they offer up to $800 rebate when switching from a different carrier.

T-Mobile also accepts eligible trade-ins in any condition for certain promotions. However, you must meet the qualifying plan requirements to receive the maximum savings.

Best Buy

You don’t necessarily have to purchase directly from a cellular carrier to take advantage of iPhone discounts.

Best Buy is also offering substantial savings on the latest iPhone lineup through carrier activation promotions. You can save up to $1,200 with qualified activation and an eligible trade-in when you buy the new iPhone 18 Pro, 18 Pro Max, or iPhone Duo.

Best Buy supports eligible carrier activations, including AT&T and Verizon. This is especially useful if you prefer to buy your new iPhone from a retailer rather than directly from your carrier.

What to be careful of

All these deals look extremely good at first glance, but there’s a catch:

  • Many of the biggest discounts, especially offers advertising a free iPhone, require you to trade in an older device. Some promotions accept damaged or older phones, while others require a minimum trade-in value.
  • Some offers require you to switch carriers, add a new line, or sign up for a specific unlimited plan.
  • Deals that say “up to $1,200 off” mean you’ll get the maximum discount only if you meet all conditions, including the required trade-in value and plan eligibility.
  • Carriers often distribute discounts as monthly bill credits over 36 months or 48 months. If you end the service or switch out of the qualifying plan before that period, you might lose these credits.
  • Check the device’s unlocking policy and other service-related commitments before buying it.

MacBook Black Friday deals

Apple’s M5-powered MacBook lineup is already receiving some great early discounts this Black Friday. Whether you want a lightweight MacBook Air for everyday work or a powerful MacBook Pro for professional tasks, several offers are worth exploring.

The newer MacBook Air M5 models are getting discounts of up to $250, while selected higher MacBook Pro configurations are also available below their original prices, saving up to $850.

Here are some of the best Mac and MacBook deals available right now:

  • 13-inch MacBook Neo (256GB SSD): $699 $649 (7% off): The best entry-level MacBook for students and everyday users.
  • 13-inch MacBook Air M5 (512GB SSD): $1,299 $1,049 (19% off): A lightweight everyday laptop for professionals and casual users.
  • 13-inch MacBook Air M5 (1TB SSD): $1,599 $1,349 (16% off): More storage for users who work with larger files and applications.
  • 15-inch MacBook Air M5 (512GB SSD): $1,499 $1,249 (17% off): A larger display for multitasking, entertainment, and productivity.
  • 15-inch MacBook Air M5 (1TB SSD): $1,799 $1,549 (14% off): A great choice if you want a bigger screen and additional storage.
  • 14-inch MacBook Pro M6 (1TB SSD): $1,999 $1,849 (9% off): The latest M6 model for demanding workloads. All configurations have a flat $150 discount.
  • 16-inch MacBook Pro M5 Pro (1TB SSD): $2,999 $2,740 (9% off): Designed for professionals who need additional processing power.
  • 16-inch MacBook Pro M5 Max (2TB SSD): $4,399 $3,899 (11% off): A high-performance machine for demanding video editing, 3D work, and professional applications. The 48GB RAM & 2TB SSD model saves $850.
  • 16-inch PROLED XDR MacBook Pro (48GB/1TB): $3,999 $3,799 (5% off): Apple’s new touchscreen laptop with powerful M5 Pro chip.
  • 16-inch PROLED XDR MacBook Pro (32GB/2TB): $4,799 $4,549 (5% off): High-end touchscreen model with M5 Max chip, ideal for creative professionals.
  • M6 Mac mini (256GB SSD): $899 $779 (13% off): A compact desktop Mac for home and office setups. Higher configurations also have similar discounts.
  • M5 Pro Mac mini (24GB RAM, 512GB SSD): $1,699 $1,549 (9% off): Extra performance in Apple’s compact desktop form factor.
  • M5 Max Mac Studio: $2,499 $2,299 (8% off): A powerful desktop for creative professionals and demanding workflows.

These are some of the best Mac deals available during the early Black Friday period. The MacBook Air M5 is particularly attractive with its $250 discount, while the Mac mini and Mac Studio offer good savings for desktop users.

Amazon has also taken $200 off all Apple Studio Display models, now starting at $1,399. The premium Studio Display XDR is also available for $2,899, $300 off the original price.

Also read: Which MacBook Air to Get: 15-inch vs 13-inch?

Discount on Apple iPads

Apple’s versatile iPad lineup also has some discounts, making it the perfect time to upgrade your tablet or grab a gift.

This year’s early Black Friday sale includes savings on the standard iPad, iPad mini, iPad Air, and iPad Pro. The M4 iPad Air and M5 iPad Pro are especially worth considering if you want a tablet for productivity, entertainment, and creativity.

Here are some of the best iPad deals currently available:

  • 11-inch iPad (128GB): $449 $399.99 (11% off): A solid all-rounder for streaming, note-taking, browsing, and everyday work. The 256GB model is also discounted.
  • iPad mini A17 Pro (128GB): $599 $569 (5% off): A compact tablet for reading, gaming, and on-the-go productivity.
  • 11-inch iPad Air M4 (128GB): $749 $649.99 (13% off): A great balance of performance and portability. Higher configurations and cellular models are also available at a lower price.
  • 13-inch iPad Air M4 (128GB): $949 $849.99 (10% off): A larger display for multitasking, drawing, and productivity. The 256GB and 512GB models have $100 off.
  • 11-inch iPad Pro M5 (256GB): $1,199 $1,099.99 (8% off): A premium tablet for professional creative workflows. The 1TB model has a massive $300 off.
  • 13-inch iPad Pro M5 (256GB): $1,499 $1,399.99 (7% off): Apple’s high-end tablet with a large display and powerful performance.

The rest of the high-end iPads with more storage, Wi-Fi + cellular, or nano-texture glass are $100-$150 off as well, making them worth considering.

Also read: Which iPad to Buy in 2026?

Apple Watch deals

Black Friday 2026 brings discounts across Apple’s smartwatch lineup, from fitness-friendly models to premium adventure-ready options.

The latest Apple Watch Ultra 4 are already seeing early discounts, while the previous-generation Ultra 3 is available at an even lower price at selected retailers. All Series 12 models have $70 off.

Here are some of the best Apple Watch deals:

  • Apple Watch Series 12 (42mm GPS): $399 $329 (18% off): Apple’s latest smartwatch with Siri AI for everyday users.
  • Apple Watch Series 12 (42mm GPS + Cellular): $499 $429 (14% off): Cellular model for outdoor goers.
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: $799 $699.99 (12% off): Apple’s premium rugged smartwatch, designed for outdoor adventures and demanding workouts.
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 [Medium]: $899 $649 (31% off): A previous-generation premium smartwatch at a substantial discount.

The Apple Watch Ultra 3 deals are particularly attractive if you don’t need the newest generation. However, if you want the latest hardware, the Ultra 4’s $99 discount is worth considering.

Also read: Which Apple Watch Should You Consider in 2026?

Deals on Apple accessories

It’s not just Macs and iPads; Apple’s accessories are getting impressive Black Friday markdowns, too.

Whether you want noise-cancelling earbuds, over-ear headphones, Bluetooth trackers, or accessories for your iPad, there are several offers worth checking.

Here are some of the best Apple accessory deals:

  • AirPods Pro 3: $249 $179 (28% off): Excellent wireless earbuds with Active Noise Cancellation and advanced audio features.
  • AirPods Max 2: $549 $429 (22% off): Premium over-ear headphones for immersive listening and noise cancellation.
  • AirTag 2 (1-Pack): $29 $23 (21% off): Keep track of your keys, bags, and other essentials with Apple’s updated Bluetooth tracker.
  • AirTag 2 (4-Pack): $99 $69.99 (29% off): A better-value option if you need multiple trackers.
  • Beats Solo 4: $199.95 $129 (35% off): Lightweight wireless headphones with long battery life.
  • Beats 360 Over-Ear Headphones: $349.99 $249 (29% off): Hi-Fi noise-cancelling headphones for workouts and running.
  • Apple Pencil Pro: $129 $99 (23% off): Ideal for creatives and students, now more precise and affordable.
  • Apple Crossbody Strap: $59 $26.99 (54% off): A convenient accessory for carrying a compatible iPhone.

Apple’s official TechWoven case for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max also has a $10-$15 discount.

You can also explore third-party accessories for the iPhone Duo, including protective cases and screen protectors from brands such as Spigen, ZAGG, OtterBox, Speck, and ESR.

These accessory deals offer excellent value, especially for anyone looking to complete their Apple ecosystem without breaking the bank.

Does Apple do a Black Friday sale?

Yes. Apple has officially confirmed its Black Friday 2026 shopping event, but it works differently from a typical sale. Rather than taking money off the product price, Apple gives customers an Apple Gift Card when they buy an eligible product.

The 2026 event runs from November 27 through November 30. Depending on the product category, you can receive an Apple Gift Card worth up to $300.

Here’s the maximum Gift Card value Apple advertises for each category:

Keep in mind that these are maximum Gift Card values, not guaranteed amounts for every model or configuration. Only eligible products qualify, and the exact offer can vary by item.

If your priority is the lowest upfront price, compare Apple’s Gift Card offer with discounts from retailers such as Amazon and Best Buy. If you plan to buy directly from Apple and can use the Gift Card toward a future purchase, the official event is still worth considering.

So, which Apple gadget did you add to your cart? Let me know in the comments below!

title.rendered: Apple Support Community closes today, putting years of answers at risk

content.rendered:
Apple’s user-to-user support forum is closing today, and anyone relying on an old discussion to fix a device should save a copy while it is still available. Apple says the Support Community will permanently close on November 20, 2026.

The forum is already read-only. You can still browse the site, but you cannot post a new question or reply to an existing discussion. New posts stopped on November 10, so today’s closure follows ten days in which members could read answers without adding to them.

Apple’s notice directs visitors to its official Support site and thanks the people who contributed their time and expertise. It gives no plan for keeping the community’s existing answers accessible. Losing a place to ask questions is frustrating enough; losing the answers people have already written would make the shutdown harder to justify.

Save useful discussions while they still load

Apple has not said in the notice whether old posts will remain visible after the closing date. There is no promised archive or timetable for removing individual threads, so a bookmark alone is a poor backup.

If a discussion contains a fix you need, open it and save the relevant replies. On iPhone or iPad, you can save a webpage as a PDF through Safari’s Share menu. On a Mac, choose Print and use the PDF menu to save a local copy. Check that the saved file includes the answer itself, especially if the discussion spans several pages.

Apple’s other support channels remain available

You can still contact Apple Support by phone or chat. The Apple Support app also offers help and lets you arrange service. For a problem that needs an in-person visit, you can book a Genius Bar appointment.

Those channels provide a route to Apple staff. The community offered something different: other owners could compare symptoms and leave an answer for the next person with the same problem. If one of those answers is still useful to you, save it today.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Siri AI is why Apple HomeView is not for sale in the European Union

content.rendered:
Apple’s new HomeView smart display is still not available for sale in the European Union. Apple’s November 13 update gives the reason: Siri AI is currently unavailable in iOS in the EU. The restriction was also in the October launch announcement; Apple has not announced a new ban today.

Apple’s June 8 statement cites the Digital Markets Act (DMA), an EU law aimed at large tech platforms. Apple says the DMA means it cannot ship Siri AI in the EU with iOS 27 and iPadOS 27.

In Apple’s account, EU regulators did not accept any of Apple’s proposed solutions for bringing Siri AI to the EU while safely supporting other virtual assistants. One is an intermediary called Trusted System Agent, which would let other assistants safely access the same features as Siri AI on EU devices. Apple also proposed launching Siri AI in the EU while phasing in that intermediary over 18 months. Apple says the European Commission agreed to none of those proposals.

Apple objects to how EU regulators read the rule. In Apple’s description, that reading would force Apple to give any virtual assistant direct access to users’ private data and the ability to control other installed apps, as soon as Siri AI reaches the EU. Apple argues those powers would come without the protections needed to keep users safe.

The June statement describes a delay, and it does not mention HomeView.

Apple sells HomeView directly in Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, the UK, and the U.S. Both the tabletop and wall-mounted models start at $299 in the U.S. and have a 7-inch Liquid Retina display. HomeView recognizes up to six people by face. Check the full HomeView specs before you buy.

Siri AI is in beta on HomeView software version 27.2. Without an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, it still brings broad world knowledge. Personal context, such as Calendar and Messages, needs a paired Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad with Siri AI turned on. Siri AI on Apple TV 4K also needs a nearby Apple Intelligence iPhone or iPad.

There is still no EU date for Siri AI on iPhone or iPad

The June statement gives no timeline for Siri AI on iOS and iPadOS in the EU. The November update adds that Apple is working constructively with the EU to find a path forward.

EU users can use Siri AI on macOS 27 and visionOS 27. They will not have it on iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch.

The November update does not explain why HomeView sales depend on Siri AI in iOS, even though HomeView runs its own software, version 27.2. For now, EU buyers cannot order HomeView from Apple. Watch for an EU date for Siri AI on iPhone and iPad, because Apple ties HomeView’s EU sales to Siri AI in iOS.

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: How to change distance and measurement units in GTA 6

content.rendered:
Wondering how to change measurement units in GTA 6? Whether you’re checking distances while travelling across Leonida or keeping an eye on the weather, you might prefer using the Imperial or Metric units.

Changing between the two is quite simple, as you need to pause the game, head to Settings, open the UI tab, and look for the Units of Measurement option. From there, you can switch to your preferred system of units. However, if you’re still unsure how to do it, here’s a complete guide to changing distance and measurement units in GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X, along with a bunch of other important details.

How to change units in GTA 6 (quick steps)

Here’s a step-by-step method on how you can change measurement and distance units in GTA 6:

  1. Press Options (PS5) or Menu (Xbox) to pause GTA 6.
  2. Select Settings at the end of the pause menu.
  3. Use L1/R1 (PS5) or (LB/RB) to move to the UI tab.
  4. Find Units of Measurement under Activities.
  5. Set Distance, Weight, Temperature and Clock Format.

Once you’re done setting the units, back out of the menu, and the changes will be automatically applied to your current save.

What each unit setting changes in GTA 6

If you choose Metric, distances use metres and kilometres, weight uses kilograms, and temperatures appear in Celsius. The 24-hour clock option also removes the need to read time using AM and PM.

The Weather app is one of several tools on Jason and Lucia’s phones. See our guide to GTA 6’s phone apps and features.

Is GTA 6 metric or imperial by default?

GTA 6 starts with the Imperial system enabled by default. This means you’ll see distances in miles, weight in pounds, and temperatures in Fahrenheit. The clock also uses the 12-hour format.

However, you don’t have to keep these defaults. Open Settings > UI > Units of Measurement and choose Metric, Kilograms, Celsius, or the 24-hour clock individually. You can mix and match the options based on your preferences.

GTA 6 vs GTA 5 and RDR2: how unit settings changed

Units not changing? Try these fixes

Still having trouble changing the measurement units in GTA 6? Don’t worry! Here are a few quick fixes you can try to resolve this issue and get everything working as intended:

  1. Pause the menu and check if you’ve changed the right row and settings.
  2. Reload your current save or try switching between the protagonists.
  3. Update your game to the latest patch if there’s any available.
  4. Restart your game and console.

More GTA 6 settings worth changing

Changing distance and measurement units in GTA 6 isn’t the only tweak worth making. Before jumping into the game, check out our guide to the best GTA 6 settings for a perfect start.

We’d recommend switching to the Classic control scheme if you’re a returning player, lowering Motion blur, enabling subtitles, and setting the Minimap to Always On. If you’re using a compatible display, don’t forget to calibrate HDR for the best possible visuals of Leonida.

Wrapping up

As you follow Jason and Lucia through Leonida’s sprawling criminal underworld, you’ll want all the in-game information to be easy to understand, especially when tracking targets or preparing to pull the gun.

If you’re more familiar with the Metric system, switching to it will allow you to view distances in kilometres, temperatures in Celsius, and weights in kilograms without having to convert them from miles, Fahrenheit, or pounds. Make sure to use your preferred measurement system to make tracking long journeys, checking weather conditions, and travelling through Leonida much easier.

FAQs

Can you change units in GTA 6?

GTA 6 allows you to switch between Metric and Imperial measurement units. This can be done by pausing the game, heading into Settings, finding UI options and then choosing Units of Measurement.

Does GTA 6 show km/h?

As GTA 6 supports the metric system, you can see kilometres for distance measurements.

Does changing units affect GTA 6 Online?

As GTA 6 Online still hasn’t been released, it’s unknown whether or not changing measurement units in the story mode will also affect it.

Is there a PC version to change units on?

Currently, there is no GTA 6 PC version to change units on.

Can I switch to a 24-hour clock?

GTA 6 allows you to switch to a 24-hour clock. You need to head to the Units of Measurement tab under UI in Settings to make the change.

title.rendered: Martial Arts World codes (November 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Martial Arts World Codes on November 20, 2026

Martial Arts World is a Roblox action RPG from Tayara Studios. You can redeem codes for free rewards, including Silver, Bloodline Rolls, Stat Resets, and summon talismans. These rewards can help you progress faster, so make sure to claim every available code.

New codes may stop working after an update, so redeem them as soon as possible. Here’s the latest list of working and expired Martial Arts World codes.

All working Martial Arts World codes

  • HAIRBROKE: 10 bloodline rolls, 5000 Silver (NEW)
  • ABEGIFT: 10 bloodline rolls, 1000 Silver, 1 free stat reroll (NEW)
  • 1300CCU: 13 bloodline rolls, 13,000 Silver, 3 free stat rerolls (NEW)
  • QUICKFIX2: 5 bloodline rolls, 1000 Silver
  • HOTFIXUPDATE1: 10 bloodline rolls, 5000 Silver, 1 free stat rerolls

Expired and unverified Martial Arts World codes

700CCU, FIXES, FREEPET, PREREGION3, PREUPDATEFIX, QUICKFIX1, REGIONTHREE, RIFTFIX

How to redeem Martial Arts World codes

Use the codes window on the starting screen before jumping into the game. Copy one code at a time so you can keep track of which entries you’ve tried.

  1. Launch Martial Arts World on Roblox.
  2. Open the codes window on the starting screen.
  3. Enter your code in the text box exactly as shown in the list above.
  4. Select Redeem to submit the code.

Why your Martial Arts World code is not working

A failed redemption doesn’t always mean you’ve typed the code incorrectly. Check these three things before giving up on it:

  • The code has expired. Check the list above first.
  • Typos fail. Codes are case-sensitive, so type them exactly as shown.
  • You already redeemed it. A code that’s already on your account won’t work again.

Where to find more Martial Arts World codes

Check Tayara Studios’ Roblox group after patches, milestones, bug fixes, and events. When you find a code in an older announcement, check its date before trying it, since codes here can stop working after an update.

If you like Martial Arts World, check out our Roll a Barber RNG codes and Grow a Plant codes, or browse our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: Best GTA 6 settings to change before playing

content.rendered:
Just started your journey in GTA 6? Before exploring Leonida, take a few minutes to adjust the game’s settings. Small changes to controls, subtitles, camera movement, and the minimap can make a noticeable difference to your experience.

I’d recommend trying the Classic control scheme if you’re a returning GTA player, lowering Motion Blur, enabling subtitles, and keeping the Minimap Always On. You should also calibrate HDR if you’re using a compatible display.

Wondering why these changes are worth making? In this guide, we’ll go through the best GTA 6 settings and explain what each one does and why you should change it.

Can you change graphics or FPS in GTA 6?

Let’s get one thing straight: GTA 6 doesn’t let you change graphics or FPS settings. The game is targeting 30 FPS on the PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X/S, with all the current-generation consoles rendering it at an internal resolution of 1440p.

According to Digital Foundry, the base PS5 even struggles to maintain consistent 30 FPS, with frame rates dropping to 23 FPS during intense explosions and demanding scenes. Although the PS5 Pro offers better image clarity through PSSR and ray-traced shadows, it’s still locked at 30 FPS.

If you’re playing GTA 6 on Xbox One through cloud gaming, you can expect the visual quality to be comparable to the Xbox Series S version.

Settings to set on the first-boot screen

Once you’ve downloaded GTA 6 versions on your console and booted it up for the very first time, you’ll be greeted with a series of startup screens asking you to configure a few settings before jumping into the game.

Here are all the options and what each one is about:

  1. Screen Narration: This accessibility feature reads supported menu text and interface (UI) options aloud as you navigate them. It’s off by default, so enable it only if you need spoken menu assistance.
  2. Navigation Experience: You can choose between Minimap (Dynamic), Minimap Always On, and Minimap & Compass (Dynamic). The Dynamic options display navigation information according to the game’s behavior, while Minimap Always On keeps the minimap visible throughout gameplay.
  3. UI Text Size: This setting lets you choose the size of text in the interface. Small is the default, but you can also select Medium, Large, and X-Large. I’d recommend Medium if you play on a television from a distance.
  4. Subtitles: You can choose the subtitle size during the initial setup. Turn them on if you don’t want to miss conversations, and customize additional subtitle and caption options later in Settings.
  5. HDR Calibration: If your display supports HDR, use the calibration screen to adjust the image. Press R1/RB to cycle through the test images and follow the on-screen instructions to calibrate brightness and contrast for your display.

Quick picks table (default vs our pick)

The 15 GTA 6 settings to change first

Now that you’ve finally managed to boot up the game, there are a few more GTA 6 settings worth changing to make your experience smoother and more enjoyable. Here are 15 GTA 6 settings we’ll recommend changing, along with what each one does and why it’s worth adjusting:

1. Control Scheme

  • Recommended Setting: Classic
  • How to change: Settings > Control Scheme

GTA 6 uses L3 to run and sprint by default. If you’re a returning GTA player, try the Classic control scheme to see whether its button layout feels more familiar.

The game lets you customize controller layouts for different activities, including on-foot movement, aiming, melee combat, and vehicles. Check the on-screen control preview before settling on a layout, as you may prefer different schemes for different activities.

2. Targeting and Aim Assist

  • Recommended Setting: Lock-On for beginners
  • How to change: Gameplay > Combat

GTA 6 offers three targeting modes: Lock-On, Partial, and Free Aim. If you’re new to the game, Lock-On is a good starting point because it makes targeting enemies easier.

Partial provides a balance between assistance and manual aiming, while Free Aim gives you greater control over targeting. I’d recommend starting with Lock-On and switching to Partial or Free Aim once you’re comfortable with the combat mechanics.

3. Lower Look and Aim Sensitivity

  • Recommended Setting: Aim Sensitivity 5-6
  • How to change: Settings > Controller

If the camera moves too quickly while you’re aiming, try lowering the horizontal and vertical Aim Sensitivity to around 5–6.

You can also experiment with the Aim Response Curve. Linear is worth trying if you prefer a more direct response to stick movement. However, the best combination depends on your controller habits, so adjust these values gradually.

4. Movement Speed

  • Recommended Setting: Jog
  • How to Change: Settings > Gameplay > Movement

Exploring Leonida on foot can be fun, but walking everywhere isn’t always practical. Switching your preferred movement speed from Walk to Jog can make getting around faster.

You can always switch back if you prefer a slower pace while exploring or interacting with the environment.

5. Keep the Minimap Always On

  • Recommended Setting: Minimap Always On
  • How to Change: Settings > UI > Navigation

Leonida is a massive place to explore, and keeping the minimap visible can make navigation easier.

The Dynamic option displays the minimap according to the game’s navigation behavior, while Always On keeps it visible throughout gameplay. I’d recommend the latter if you frequently check roads, objectives, and nearby locations.

Want GPS distances in kilometres instead of miles? Learn how to change distance and measurement units in GTA 6.

6. Enable Subtitles for All Dialogue

  • Recommended Setting: All Dialogue, Background On.
  • How to Change: Settings > UI > Subtitles & Captions

GTA 6 follows Jason and Lucia through missions, conversations, and encounters with different characters. With so much dialogue throughout the game, subtitles can help you follow the story without missing important details.

Turn them on if you prefer reading conversations or sometimes play with the volume low. You can also adjust their size and appearance in the same section.

7. Increase the UI Text Size

  • Recommended Setting: Medium or Large
  • How to Change: Settings > UI

The default text size might feel too small, particularly if you play on a television from a distance.

Increasing the UI text size can make menus, notifications, and other interface elements easier to read. Try Medium first, then switch to Large if you still struggle to read on-screen information.

8. Turn Motion Blur Down to 0-1

  • Recommended setting: 0-1
  • How to change: Settings > Display > Visual Effects

The default Motion Blur Strength is 3. If you prefer a sharper image, try lowering it to 0 or 1.

This can make the image look clearer when you’re moving the camera or driving at high speeds. Keep in mind that this is a visual preference, not a guaranteed way to improve FPS.

9. Adjust Camera Bob and Shake

  • Recommended Setting: Camera Bob 3-5, Camera Shake Off
  • How to Change: Settings > Camera

Too much camera movement can become distracting, especially during longer gaming sessions.

Try reducing Camera Bob and turning Camera Shake off if you prefer a steadier view. You can also reduce the frequency of cinematic crash cameras and kill shots under the Camera settings.

10. Calibrate HDR for Better Visuals

  • Recommended Setting: Calibrate HDR according to your display
  • How to Change: Display Settings and your console’s HDR calibration menu

If you’re playing the game on an HDR-compatible display, make sure to calibrate your HDR settings. This will get you the right balance of contrast, brightness, and highlights.

11. Reduce Hit and Player Status Effects

  • Recommended Setting: 2-3
  • How to Change: Settings > Display

GTA 6 allows you to change the visual settings associated with combat and player status. Adjust them to 2-3 if you find screen effects a little too distracting. You can also enable a Persistent Center Dot under Reticle settings if you experience motion sickness.

12. Adjust Haptics and Adaptive Triggers

  • Recommended Setting: Lower Adaptive Trigger Resistance to your preference
  • How to Change: Settings > Controller

GTA 6 brings tons of exclusive PS5 features, and one of them is using the DualSense’s haptic feedback and adaptive triggers. Although they add immersion, trigger resistance can become tiring during longer sessions. We’d recommend lowering Adaptive Trigger Resistance to make longer sessions comfortable.

13. Fine-Tune Audio Settings

  • Recommended Settings: Dialogue High, Music/SFX 7-8
  • How to Change: Settings > Audio

Experiment with Audio and change whatever matches your preferences. We’ll recommend keeping the Dialogue volume high and setting Music and SFX around 7-8. You can also enable Mute Licensed music if you’re streaming your gameplay.

14. Adjust Gore and Dismemberment Effects

  • Recommended Settings: Choose the bloody intensity and dismemberment options according to your choice
  • How to Change: Settings > Display > Visual Effects

Don’t want a gory experience? Well, make sure to adjust the blood effects and dismemberment settings. There are three blood intensity levels and a dismemberment toggle.

15. Switch Hold Controls to Toggle

  • Recommended Setting: Toggle for Aiming, Interact and Nitrous / Enable Tap Assist
  • How to Change: Settings > Gameplay and Accessibility

Holding buttons repeatedly can become uncomfortable during longer gaming sessions. GTA 6 includes accessibility options that can make certain actions easier to perform.

Check the available hold and toggle controls for actions such as aiming and interacting. You can also enable Tap Assist to make button-pressing sequences more manageable.

Is there an easy mode in GTA 6?

GTA 6 doesn’t feature an Easy mode or any selectable difficulty levels. Like all Rockstar titles, the game has a fixed campaign difficulty. However, you can make your gameplay experience much more manageable by changing a few settings.

This includes features such as Reduced Vehicle Damage, Accessible Combat and Simplified Mini-Games to make certain missions easier, especially if you don’t want to play like a sweat.

Best GTA 6 setting presets by player type

Settings you can’t change (yet)

GTA 6 currently doesn’t offer a Performance mode, Quality mode, or selectable 60 FPS option on consoles. You also can’t manually choose the game’s rendering resolution through the in-game settings menu.

Players have also noticed a vignette effect that darkens the edges of the screen. If you find an effect distracting but can’t locate a corresponding toggle in the Display or Camera settings, there may not be a separate option to disable it.

Rockstar could introduce additional options through future updates, but there’s no guarantee. We’ll update this guide if new graphics, performance, or accessibility settings become available.

Wrapping up

Jumping into GTA 6 without adjusting the right settings can make a bigger difference than you think.
