title.rendered: MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR vs mini-LED: Is the touchscreen worth an extra $400?

content.rendered:
Apple’s new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR is an interesting upgrade. It brings tandem OLED technology, touchscreen support, Dynamic Island, a redesigned body, and several smaller improvements. However, there’s one detail that makes the upgrade harder to recommend: both models use the same M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.

Therefore, what exactly does this $400 additional cost bring? For starters, a nicer display, touchscreen, and a lighter design. That’s a considerable premium for a laptop that does not provide faster performance or more battery life.

I’ve broken down the differences to help you decide whether the PROLED XDR MacBook Pro is worth buying or whether the standard model is the smarter choice.

MacBook Pro PROLED XDR vs Standard mini-LED: What’s the difference?

Both MacBook Pro models share Apple’s M5 Pro and M5 Max processors, but their displays, designs, and a few hardware features set them apart.

Here’s a quick comparison:

Display: Is tandem OLED really worth upgrading from mini-LED?

The display is arguably the strongest reason to consider the PROLED XDR MacBook Pro. Apple says it is “the world’s best laptop display.”

The new model brings tandem OLED technology with a dedicated display engine. Unlike mini-LED, which uses a backlight and local dimming zones, OLED controls each pixel individually. This allows it to produce deeper blacks and better contrast. For movies, HDR content, and creative work, I noticed a more true-to-life color palette.

Apple has also increased peak brightness from 1,600 nits to 2,000 nits. Another important addition is Adobe RGB support and professional reference modes. Photographers and designers working on color-sensitive projects may appreciate the extra flexibility.

Then there’s Dynamic Island. Apple replaces the traditional notch with an interactive cutout to show Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI. Of course, the major improvement is the touchscreen itself. The new MacBook Pro lets you interact directly with the display, with macOS 27 introducing touch optimizations.

However, don’t expect it to replace your iPad. It’s still a traditional MacBook where the keyboard and trackpad play the key role in its operation. If you prefer using your fingers to navigate the screen, then it is going to be useful. Otherwise, you might rarely use it.

Design and portability: The PROLED XDR MacBook Pro is thinner and lighter

Apple has also redesigned the MacBook Pro’s chassis, making it thinner and lighter. The design overhaul was long overdue since 2021.

The 14-inch model loses half a pound, while the 16-inch version is 0.7 pounds lighter. That’s a meaningful improvement if you regularly carry your MacBook to work or travel with it.

The redesigned hinge adds stability, while the return of the glowing Apple logo gives the laptop a nostalgic touch. Personally, I’d value the reduced weight more than the cosmetic changes. A lighter laptop makes a difference every time you put it in your backpack.

Performance: Do you get more power for your extra $400?

Here’s where the PROLED XDR model becomes harder to recommend.

Both versions use the same M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, so the extra $400 doesn’t buy you a faster processor or additional graphics performance on paper. The memory configurations are also identical across both models.

The M5 Pro starts with 24GB of unified memory, with options to upgrade to 48GB or 64GB. The M5 Max starts at 36GB and offers 48GB, 64GB, and 128GB options. This gives buyers plenty of flexibility for any workload.

The redesigned chassis includes a new thermal architecture that redirects warm air away from the display. It could also influence sustained performance.

If performance is your primary reason for buying a MacBook Pro, I’d save the extra $400. You’re essentially paying for a better display, touchscreen, and design rather than a more powerful computer.

Storage, battery life, and charging: Are there any meaningful changes?

Storage is one area where the PROLED XDR model has a genuine advantage. The new M5 Max configuration supports up to 16TB of internal storage, double the standard model’s 8TB maximum.

With the M5 Pro, you get 1TB of storage as the starting configuration, with options to upgrade to 2TB or 4TB. The M5 Max starts at 2TB and offers 4TB, 8TB, and 16TB options.

That’s useful for professionals working with large video libraries, high-resolution footage, and extensive project files. Most everyday users, however, probably won’t need that much internal storage.

Battery life remains unchanged.

Despite the switch to tandem OLED and the thinner chassis, Apple hasn’t increased its advertised battery life. Both models also support fast charging, reaching up to 50% in approximately 30 minutes. However, Apple recommends a minimum of 94W charging for the 16-inch M5 Max PROLED model, compared to 70W for the standard one.

So, if you’re hoping the more expensive MacBook Pro will last longer between charges, there’s little reason to upgrade.

Camera and speakers: Small upgrades that improve the experience

Apple hasn’t changed everything with the PROLED XDR MacBook Pro. Both models feature the same 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View support, 1080p HD video recording, and an advanced image signal processor with computational video.

However, the touchscreen model gets one additional camera feature: Advanced Video Stabilization. Since you can now touch the display for inputs, Advanced Video Stabilization helps account for those interactions and keeps the video experience stable.

The speakers also get an upgrade. Apple has redesigned the six-speaker system with new woofers and tweeters, claiming 50% deeper bass and improved sound clarity. There’s also dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use, which should benefit people who connect their MacBook to an external monitor.

These are welcome improvements, particularly if you often use your MacBook to attend meetings, watch movies or create content on the go. However, the standard model already offers excellent speakers, so I wouldn’t upgrade just for better audio.

Ports and connectivity: Almost everything stays the same

Apple hasn’t sacrificed connectivity to make the new MacBook Pro thinner.

Both models retain:

  • Three Thunderbolt 5 (USB-C) ports
  • MagSafe 3 charging
  • HDMI
  • SDXC card slot
  • 3.5mm headphone jack

Additionally, the PROLED XDR model adds Genlock support through Thunderbolt 5, which is particularly useful for professional video production workflows. Apple also upgraded the external display refresh rate to 165Hz.

For everyday users, connectivity stays largely the same. In my opinion, it is nice that Apple has kept the HDMI and SD card slots. A professional laptop shouldn’t require a docking station or adapters just to connect basic accessories.

MacBook Pro PROLED XDR vs Mini-LED: Is the $400 price difference justified?

The PROLED XDR MacBook Pro is clearly the more advanced model, but that doesn’t automatically make it the better purchase.

Here’s the current pricing for both models:

I’d recommend spending the extra $400 if you:

  • Want a touchscreen MacBook and will actually use it.
  • Work with photographs, video, or color-sensitive content.
  • Prefer OLED’s deeper blacks and higher contrast.
  • Regularly work with HDR content.
  • Want a thinner and lighter laptop for everyday carry.
  • Need the new 16TB storage option.

However, I’d stick with the standard Liquid Retina XDR MacBook Pro if you:

  • Primarily write, browse, code, or handle everyday productivity tasks.
  • Don’t care about touchscreen functionality.
  • Are already happy with display quality.
  • Prioritize processing power over display improvements.
  • Don’t need more than 8TB of internal storage.

The distinction is simple: the PROLED XDR model improves the overall experience, while the standard model delivers the same core performance for less money.

Which MacBook Pro I’d buy

If I were spending my own money, I’d choose the standard Liquid Retina XDR MacBook Pro. Paying $400 extra $400 when both models offer the same M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, memory options, and advertised battery life is hard to justify.

I like what Apple has done with the PROLED XDR model. Tandem OLED, touchscreen support, Dynamic Island, better speakers, and the lighter chassis make it a more exciting laptop.

For creative professionals who can benefit from the improved display, higher storage option, or genlock support, the extra cost is worth it. Buyers upgrading from an M1-, M2-, or M3-generation MacBook Pro can also consider it.

But the standard mini-LED model is the smarter buy for most people. If you want to buy now, look for discounts and put the extra money toward more RAM or a better chip configuration.

What matters more to you in your next MacBook Pro: a better display and touchscreen or more performance for your money? Let me know in the comments below!

title.rendered: How to change Google Maps voice on iPhone and Android

content.rendered:
By default, Google Maps uses your phone’s language, which is often U.S. English, for navigation and search. But if you prefer hearing directions or using voice search in another language, like Spanish, Hindi or French, you can easily change it in just a few taps.

This quick guide shows you how to change the Google Maps voice on your iPhone or Android, plus what to do if the new voice doesn’t apply right away.

How to change the Google Maps voice language on iPhone or Android

Follow these steps to switch the voice search language in Google Maps:

  1. Open the Google Maps app on your iPhone or Android.
  2. Tap your profile picture at the top right of the screen.
  3. Select Settings from the menu.
  4. Tap App & display and go to Voice Search.
  5. Choose your preferred language from the list, such as English (Australia) or Français (Canada).

Once you select a new voice language, Google Maps will use it for voice commands and search queries.

Note: If you don’t see the Voice Search option, make sure the app is updated to the latest version from the App Store or Google Play Store.

How to change the Google Maps navigation voice (spoken directions)

The steps above change the voice search language, not the navigation voice you hear during turn-by-turn directions. On iPhone, Google Maps doesn’t have an in-app voice picker for spoken directions. Instead, the navigation voice follows the app language you set in your iPhone’s Settings.

On iPhone:

  1. Go to Settings, scroll down, and tap Apps.
  2. Select Google Maps and tap Language.
  3. Choose your preferred language.
  4. Reopen Google Maps, and the interface will switch to your selected language. Start navigation and you’ll hear spoken directions in that language while driving.

On iOS 17 or earlier, skip the Apps step and tap Google Maps directly in Settings.

On Android: you can still change it inside the app. Go to Profile picture → Settings → Navigation settings, tap Voice selection under Sound & voice, and pick a language.

Troubleshooting: Voice language not changing?

If Google Maps still uses the old voice, try these quick fixes:

  • Update Google Maps to the latest version.
  • Restart your Phone after changing the language.
  • Check your Google Account: Go to myaccount.google.com/language and choose your preferred language.
  • Reinstall Google Maps if the voice or language doesn’t refresh.

Why change the Google Maps voice?

Changing the Google Maps voice can make navigation more comfortable and personal.

  • Better Comprehension and Clarity: If English isn’t your first language, hearing directions in your native tongue can significantly reduce confusion on the road.
  • Consistency with voice search: When you set the same language for both navigation and voice search, Google Maps recognizes your commands more accurately.
  • Localized pronunciations: Choosing the right accent helps make sure street names and landmarks are pronounced correctly. This is especially useful when traveling in multilingual regions.
  • Accessibility and inclusivity: For users with visual impairments or reading difficulties, the right voice and accent can make instructions easier to follow.

Wrapping up

The option to change the default voice search language is very helpful for non-English speakers. It lets you search for any location in your preferred language quickly and accurately. We hope you were able to get it sorted out on your iPhone or Android.

Still facing issues with Google Maps? Drop your question in the comments, and we’ll help you resolve it quickly.

FAQs

Can I change the Google Maps navigation voice accent?

Yes! For supported languages, Google Maps lets you switch between regional voices and accents, such as English (US), English (UK) or English (Australia). On iPhone, go to Settings → Apps → Google Maps → Language. On Android, go to Navigation settings → Voice selection in the app.

Does changing the Google Maps voice also change Siri’s voice?

No. Changing the voice in Google Maps doesn’t affect Siri’s voice or your iPhone’s system voice. Siri and Google Maps use separate voice settings.

title.rendered: Fortnite Treasure Hunters: All Map Fragment locations so far

content.rendered:
Map Fragments were introduced in Fortnite as a new collectible when the Treasure Hunters mini-season rolled out on November 1. These items are exclusively available in Battle Royale modes, namely Unranked Build, Ranked Build, Unranked Zero Build, and Ranked Zero Build.

These map collectibles in Fortnite Treasure Hunters follow a staggered release pattern, where each week, on Captain’s Day, a new Map Fragment is released. Once a Fragment is out in the game, it will stay on the Crossbones Isle until the end of the season on December 5.

All Fortnite Map Fragment locations and unlock dates

Map Fragment 1: The $.$. Rocky (A$AP Rocky)

The first Map Fragment is aboard The $.$. Rocky, A$AP Rocky’s battleship POI. Follow these steps to find it:

  1. Board The $.$. Rocky.
  2. Find the stairs and head down to the lowest level of the ship.
  3. Search the lower deck near the northern end. Look for an exclamation mark that indicates the Fragment’s location.

Interact with the collectible when you find it to complete the first part of the quest.

Map Fragment 2: Lil’ Uzi’s Stronghold (Lil Uzi Vert)

The second Map Fragment is inside a small shack near the southeastern edge of Lil’ Uzi’s Stronghold. Here’s how to find it:

  1. In the Lil’ Uzi Vert-related POI, head towards the southeastern corner and start searching it.
  2. Find the shack that is right opposite a tower structure and enter it.
  3. Search its interior, and you should see a Map Fragment highlighted by an exclamation mark.

You don’t need to search the entire Stronghold. Focus on the small building near the tower to find the collectible.

Map Fragment 3: Friendship Villa (Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto)

For the third Map Fragment, you won’t have to enter any shack or ship as this one can be found simply lying in the open in Friendship Villa. Head down to this POI and do as follows:

  1. Head to the southwestern part of Friendship Villa.
  2. Look for a fenced area and a tree nearby.
  3. Search beneath the tree for the Map Fragment. An exclamation mark will help you spot it when you’re close.

Collect it to add the third Fragment to your quest progress.

When do Map Fragments 4, 5, and 6 unlock?

Oscar is expected to arrive with the fourth Fragment on November 22. The captain and POI for the fifth and sixth Fragments have not been confirmed, so we’ll update this guide as soon as their locations become available.

What do you get for collecting all Map Fragments?

Collecting all six Map Fragments in Fortnite Treasure Hunters unlocks the X Marks the Zero Point Silver loading screen. This is an exclusive cosmetic reward that you can add to your Locker by completing the collection quest.

You don’t need to purchase the Battle Pass to collect the Fragments or unlock the reward. Just make sure you collect all six before the mini-season ends.

How to track Map Fragments in Fortnite

You can check how many Map Fragments you’ve collected through the Quests tab. Follow these steps:

  1. Open Fortnite and head to the Quests tab.
  2. Scroll down to the Treasure Hunt section.
  3. Under Bonus Goal, look for the Collect Map Fragments progress bar. It shows how many collectibles you’ve picked up so far.

Author’s note

On top of Wanted Posters in Fortnite, Map Fragments are yet another way Fortnite has incorporated the treasure map trope from pirate stories into its gameplay. It is in line with the multiplayer title’s ongoing One Piece-themed season.

While not an absolute necessity, completing the Map Fragments quest is an easy way to eventually get a free Fortnite cosmetic. Hence, I’d recommend that players go through this small effort for a nice freebie.

FAQs

How many Map Fragments are in Fortnite Treasure Hunters?

There are a total of 6 Map Fragments in the game, but they have a staggered release pattern where one Fragment is released every week throughout the season.

Are Map Fragments marked on the map?

Map Fragments are not marked on the map, but they appear marked in the game’s environment as soon as you are near enough.

Do you need the Battle Pass for collecting Map Fragments?

No, the Battle Pass is not required for collecting Map Fragments or for unlocking the associated reward.

Can you still get earlier Map Fragments?

Yes, Map Fragments once released are available to grab in matches throughout the duration of the ongoing mini-season.

title.rendered: Leak says Apple is developing two designs for the 20th anniversary iPhone

content.rendered:
Leaker Ice Universe, posting on Weibo on November 18, says Apple is developing four 20th anniversary iPhone models in two designs. Apple has not confirmed any of it. Treat every design detail below as a leak.

Two models reportedly curve on all four edges, with 1mm bezels

Two of the four models reportedly have flat front glass. The other two have curved glass around the edges, bending along all four sides. Those curved versions reportedly have bezels, the thin border around a screen, of about 1mm. At that width, the front would look nearly borderless. If thin borders matter to you, the curved models are the ones to watch.

The report says Apple has prototyped the four-sided curved glass for about three years, through several revisions. That is a long time to work on one design. The earliest versions curved more sharply, and that curvature was later reduced. The shape has already changed at least once, so treat the current curve as a work in progress.

The curved idea has been around for a while. In June 2025, reported plans described a curved, nearly wraparound iPhone 20 built from one piece of glass. Another leak said the phone would have no physical buttons. That leak also described solid-state haptic controls and a glass-like design, and said the phone was set for 2027 to celebrate the 20th anniversary.

Taken together, the earlier leaks point to a phone with a glass-like design and no physical buttons. That fits the curved-glass claims here, but it is still leak-based and unconfirmed. Not every report agrees on how far the glass goes, either. In August 2026, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reported that Apple dropped an earlier, more glass-heavy design in favor of curved front and back glass separated by a thin metal band.

Launch is expected in fall 2027, but the lineup is still unclear

The models are expected to launch in fall 2027. Leakers have called them “iPhone 20 Pro,” but the report says Apple’s naming plans remain unclear. Until Apple confirms a name, “iPhone 20 Pro” is only the leakers’ label.

The leak does not say which of the four models gets which design. That gap matters more than the glass itself. A buyer cannot pick a design without knowing which models carry it.

The fall 2027 date is a long way off. A leak like this should not change a purchase you need to make before then.

Before you decide whether to wait, watch for Apple’s own confirmation of the designs, the number of models it makes, and the final name.

  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)

content.rendered:
The redesigned Apple Maps is rolling out in India from November 18, 2026. Apple says the update brings faster navigation, fuller map detail, India-specific guidance, and new language labels. If you drive, take transit, walk, or cycle with Maps, you will see changes on the map and in what the app tells you along the way.

Roads, buildings, parks, and shopping centres get fuller views, and the map adds more than 300 three-dimensional landmarks. Look Around, Apple’s street-level imagery, is now available in India, with high-resolution 3D street-level views.

Maps gives directions by landmark and adds transit and trip tools

For driving, the bigger change is Natural Language Guidance, now enhanced for India. Directions can refer to landmarks such as pillars and petrol pumps, including at turns on roads without names.

The rest of the list covers everyday trips: AR Walking Directions, lane guidance, cycling directions, and Share ETA. Share ETA now gives updated arrival estimates when there are significant delays. Trip planning for certain electric vehicles includes charging stops.

Multi-stop routing supports up to 15 stops, and routes sync from Mac and iPad to iPhone. You can also report incidents hands-free through Siri, covering accidents, hazards, and speed checks, or report that an incident has cleared.

Preferred Routes learns your commute on the device.

Transit planning covers Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, and Pune, plus Indian Railways. It helps you find nearby stations, plan journeys, save favourite routes, and get alerts when it is time to get off. If you take the train in one of those eight cities, test the get-off alert first.

Max Muller, Apple’s vice president of Apple Maps, says “Apple Maps is the best way to explore and navigate the world.” He says the India map was designed for the country’s specific navigation needs. That quote is promotional language. The features above are what you can check on your own phone.

No separate availability date beyond November 18, 2026 has been given. The release also does not say which of the listed features reach every Indian city on day one. For the wider Maps changes in iOS 27, see what changed in Apple Maps in iOS 27.

Dual-language labels need iOS 27.2 or later

Dual-language labels show place names in English and a local language. The 12 supported languages are English, Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Punjabi, Odia, and Urdu. Which labels you see depends on your device language and the local language of the region.

Dual-language labels and enhanced Natural Language Guidance require iOS 27.2, iPadOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2, or macOS 27.2 or later. Devices on older software can’t use either one.

Check your software version first, then open Apple Maps on a route you know well and look for the new labels.

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

mainEntity.name: How do you open the weapon wheel in GTA 6?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hold LB on Xbox Series X|S or L1 on PS5 to open the weapon wheel. Use the right stick to highlight a weapon and follow the on-screen prompt to equip it.

title.rendered: 2026 App Store Awards name 45 finalists, with winners due in coming weeks

content.rendered:
Apple announced 45 finalists for the 2026 App Store Awards across 13 categories on November 18, 2026. It says winners will be announced “in the coming weeks,” so for now the list is a starting point.

Eleven of the 13 categories have three finalists each. Cultural Impact App and Cultural Impact Game have six each, which brings the total to 45. Those two are the only categories with more than three finalists. The categories cover iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Apple Arcade, and Cultural Impact.

iPhone, Mac, and Arcade finalists are the ones to check now

On iPhone, the App of the Year finalists are ElevenReader, (Not Boring) Camera, and Raylie. The Game of the Year finalists are BALL x PIT, DAVE THE DIVER, and Gambonanza.

On Mac, the App of the Year finalists are Paste, Things 3, and Ulysses. The Game of the Year finalists are Big Walk, Blue Prince, and Crimson Desert.

The Apple Arcade Game of the Year finalists are Perchang World, PowerWash Simulator, and Pusheen’s Place.

If you mostly use an iPhone, start with the iPhone picks. If you work mostly on a Mac, start with the Mac apps and games. Either way, pick one or two from your own platform instead of trying every list. Apple’s announcement has the finalists for the other categories.

A finalist has made the shortlist and has not won yet

A finalist is an app or game that made the shortlist for its category. That doesn’t mean it has won, and Apple hasn’t named any winners yet.

Last year’s list also started with 45 finalists, so this year’s count is familiar. Apple named the 17 winners on December 4, 2025, and Tiimo won iPhone App of the Year.

Carson Oliver, Apple’s vice president of App Store, says “these developers are redefining how we connect, create, and experience the world.” That line names no app, so it doesn’t help you choose between finalists.

Watch for the winner list in the coming weeks, and check it against the finalists above.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

As an Amazon Associate, iGeeksBlog earns from qualifying purchases.

title.rendered: 10 best Minecraft shaders to download in November 2026

content.rendered:
Looking for the best Minecraft shaders to enhance your gameplay experience? We’ve got you covered! Shaders are visual modifications that transform the look of your Minecraft world by improving lighting, shadows, reflections, water, and environmental effects.

From realistic sun rays and dynamic lighting to detailed shadows, reflective water, and atmospheric skies, these shader packs can make even the simplest Minecraft worlds look stunning. The best part is that you don’t necessarily need a high-end gaming PC to use them. Some shaders prioritize performance, while others focus on delivering the most immersive visuals possible.

Whether you’re running Minecraft on a basic laptop or a powerful gaming PC, there’s something worth trying. Here are the 10 best Minecraft shaders to download in November 2026.

10 best Minecraft shaders at a glance

10 best Minecraft shaders to try in November 2026

1. MakeUp – Ultra Fast

It’s safe to say that MakeUp – UltraFast is one of the best Minecraft shaders when it comes to balancing performance and visuals. It adds dynamic shadows to blocks, trees, and other objects alongside detailed clouds that completely transform the skies of your world.

You also get water reflections, motion blur, and tons of other visual effects. If that’s not enough, the shader also lets you experiment with different colour palettes to customise the look of your world. It’s designed to run on even the lower-end hardware, which makes it a fantastic choice for anyone who wants Minecraft shaders without giving up FPS.

Best for: Players with low-end or mid-range PCs who want customizable visual improvements.

Download link: MakeUp-Ultra Fast

2. Complementary Reimagined

Complementary Reimagined is easily one of the best all-rounder shaders for Minecraft. It not only looks fantastic but also delivers solid performance on most systems. What really sets it apart is the sheer number of customisation options available. You can tweak almost anything about the game and give it a realistic vanilla look, a more styled appearance, or even something in between.

There’s plenty of control over lighting, allowing you to adjust contrast, brightness, and saturation to match your preferences. If you’re primarily playing Minecraft in Survival Mode, Complementary Reimagined is definitely worth trying.

Best for: Players looking for a balanced combination of visual quality, customization, and performance.

Download link: Complementary Reimagined

3. Eclipse

During our Minecraft shader testing, Eclipse was one shader we kept coming back to. What’s great about this shader is the fact that it’s compatible with popular mods, including the likes of Distant Horizons, Voxy and physics mods. The lighting is warm with cinematic tones that make the entire scene feel alive and vibrant.

Then there’s the shader’s vegetation. Its tall, detailed grass completely changes the landscape around you, which will make exploring mines and caves feel even more immersive. Honestly, there’s nothing to complain about with this mod. Although Eclipse looks great right out of the box, if you want to get the most out of it, spend some time experimenting with its settings until you find the perfect look.

Best for: Players who enjoy cinematic lighting, detailed vegetation, and modded Minecraft worlds.

Download link: Eclipse

4. IternationT

IternationT tends to bend towards realism compared to most Minecraft shaders, but it brings all of those visuals without tanking your system’s performance. Unlike Eclipse, its lighting felt more natural to us, and the entire world had a sharper and more lifelike appearance.

The water reflections in this shader take the spotlight, especially during sunrise and sunset, when the changing light makes the surroundings look even better. If you want a realistic shader that’s playable, IterationT is a solid choice.

Best for: Players who want natural lighting, realistic water reflections, and a sharper visual style.

Download link: IterationT

5. NostalgiaVX

NostalgiaVX takes a different route compared to the shaders we’ve mentioned in this list. It doesn’t completely overhaul the basic Minecraft aesthetic, and preserves the classic vanilla look but still improves everything around it. You get softer lighting, enhanced skies, subtle shadows, and tons of other upgrades without losing that familiar feel.

It’s also quite lightweight, runs smoothly, and doesn’t demand much from your system. So, if you want to make Minecraft look better without changing its core visual identity, NostalgiaVX is a great shader to try.

Best for: Players who want improved visuals without losing Minecraft’s original style.

Download link: NostalgiaVX

6. YoFPS

YoFPS offers the best performance out of all shaders we’ve covered on this list. Although it doesn’t offer shadows, it makes up for it with decent lighting and plenty of other visual improvements. You get realistic animations for leaves, wheat, flowers, and other plants alongside raindrop effects and atmospheric weather changes that make the world feel more alive.

The shader isn’t perfect by any means. The leaves can sometimes look too saturated, and the colours in other dimensions can feel a bit overdone. However, when it comes to getting the most FPS while still making the vanilla world look better, YoFPS is hard to beat.

Best for: Players with low-end PCs who want lightweight visual improvements.

Download link: YoFPS

7. DrDestens

DrDestens is another excellent Minecraft shader that strikes a great balance between visuals and performance. It introduces realistic lighting, reflections, and atmosphere effects while supporting Physically Based Rendering (PBR). This helps improve block textures, adding more realistic material details through normal and specular mapping.

When using this shader, we’d recommend sticking with the Medium preset. The Low preset can have visual issues, and the High preset adds just depth of field. It’s a great feature when capturing screenshots, but it can be distracting during regular gameplay.

Best for: Players who want realistic material details, reflections, and PBR support.

Download link: DrDestens

8. PyvtronVX

PyvtronVX is a Minecraft shader that takes everything to the next level. It focuses heavily on voxel-based lighting, which makes everything feel way more dynamic. You will see light actually interacting with the world properly. This will be especially noticeable at night or when you’re exploring the caves, where the lighting effects add another level of immersion.

However, there’s one important thing to keep in mind: this is an extremely demanding shader. You’ll need a powerful PC to get the most out of it. But if your system can handle the workload, PyvtronVX is one of the most immersive shaders you can get in Minecraft.

Best for: Players with powerful PCs who want advanced lighting and immersive nighttime visuals.

Download link: PyvtronVX

9. Super Duper Vanilla

Don’t let the name fool you here. Super Duper Vanilla is anything but a basic Minecraft shader. It offers a stylised visual overhaul while still delivering impressive performance across its Potato, Low and Medium presets, but the shadow quality will depend on each one.

Regardless of the preset, you still get beautiful water effects and decent reflections without too much strain on your system. The shader also adds animated foliage and other subtle environmental details that make the world feel alive. This is a shader you can’t go wrong with.

Best for: Players who want stylized visuals and multiple presets for different hardware configurations.

Download link: Super Duper Vanilla

10. Bliss

And the final pick for our best Minecraft shaders list is Bliss. This is a base for a lot of modern shaders, including Eclipse. It’s clean, highly customisable and works perfectly with mods. Lightning in the world feels soft, natural and immersive. It doesn’t try to change everything about Minecraft, and that’s exactly what makes Bliss so good.

Best for: Players who enjoy natural lighting, atmospheric visuals, and extensive customization.

Download link: Bliss

How to download and install shaders in Minecraft Java Edition

Now that you know which Minecraft shaders are worth trying, let’s take a look at how you can install them. The process is quite simple, but you’ll first need to download and install Iris shaders.

This acts as a shader loader for Minecraft, and once that’s done, follow these steps:

  1. Download and install Iris for the Minecraft version you want to play. Make sure you select the correct game version.
  2. Launch Minecraft using the newly created Iris profile.
  3. Open Options and navigate to Video Settings.
  4. Select Shader Packs.
  5. Click Open Shader Pack Folder.
  6. Download your preferred shader pack from one of the links above and place its .zip file inside the shader-pack folder. Don’t extract the ZIP file.
  7. Return to Minecraft. Your downloaded shader should appear in the Shader Packs list.
  8. Select the shader and click Apply or the equivalent confirmation option to activate it.

That’s it! Your selected shader should now be active in your Minecraft world. If you notice a significant FPS drop, try switching to a lower preset or disabling demanding effects such as shadows and depth of field.

Wrapping up

Minecraft shaders can completely transform the look of your world, whether you want realistic lighting, beautiful water reflections, cinematic shadows, or a simple visual upgrade. The 10 shader packs in this list offer options for different playstyles and PC configurations.

If you want the best balance of visuals and customization, Complementary Reimagined is a great starting point. For better performance on a low-end PC, try MakeUp – Ultra Fast or YoFPS. Ultimately, choose a shader that matches your system’s capabilities so you can enjoy better graphics without sacrificing smooth gameplay.

FAQs

What is the best shader for Minecraft in November 2026?

Complementary Reimagined is the best all-rounder shader for Minecraft in November 2026, as it offers a good mix of visuals, performance and customisation.

Which Minecraft shaders are best for low-end PCs?

YoFPS is the best Minecraft shader if you’re running a low-end PC. It’s designed to bring visual improvements without putting too much strain on your hardware.

Do Minecraft shaders reduce FPS?

Minecraft shaders can reduce FPS as they add demanding visual effects such as dynamic lighting, shadow reflections, and realistic water.

Can you use shaders in Minecraft Bedrock Edition?

You can use shaders in Minecraft Bedrock Edition, but the options are more limited compared to the Java Edition.

Are Minecraft shaders free to download?

Most of the Minecraft shaders are completely free to download and use. You can find these shaders on websites like Modrinth, CurseForge, and GitHub.

title.rendered: GTA 6 wildlife: What animals, birds and fish have been revealed so far?

content.rendered:
Just take a look at all the GTA 6 Extended Look footage. Aside from the beautiful views of Vice City, beaches, strip clubs, cool cars, and Jason and Lucia, one thing that’s bound to catch your eye is the sheer variety of animals in the game.

Rockstar told Game Informer that Leonida is home to more than 170 animal species, including over 60 bird species, more than 30 land mammals, and numerous fish, reptiles, and other creatures. You’ll also be able to visit an in-game zoo to check out some of the wildlife up close. With that said, let’s take a look at the complete GTA 6 animal list so you have a better idea of what you’ll encounter in Leonida.

GTA 6 wildlife at a glance

Every animal revealed in GTA 6 so far

Rockstar Games hasn’t officially revealed the full GTA 6 animals list yet, so we’ll have to wait until the game launches on November 19, 2026 to find out exactly what wildlife Leonida has to offer. However, through the Extended Look and leaked gameplay footage, we have a good idea of the animals players will be able to encounter in the game. Here’s a look at some of the wildlife spotted so far:

Land Animals

  • Beavers
  • Boars
  • Bobcats
  • Cane Toads
  • Cats
  • Cougar
  • Deer
  • Dogs
  • Iguanas
  • Monkeys
  • Nine-banded armadillos
  • Otters
  • Raccoons
  • Snakes
  • Squirrels

Birds

  • Ducks
  • Eagles
  • Flamingos
  • Cranes
  • Pigeons
  • Pelicans
  • Seagulls
  • Spoonbills
  • Storks
  • Woodpeckers

Aquatic Animals

  • Alligators
  • Dolphins
  • Eels
  • Fish
  • Jellyfish
  • Manatees
  • Sea Turtle
  • Sharks
  • Whales

Beyond the animals we’ve listed above, GTA 6 will feature plenty of other wildlife for players to discover across Leonida. Each animal will come with its own animations, fur and hair system, and unique behavioral quirks, making the game’s wildlife feel more lifelike. Rockstar has also confirmed that some animals fall into Rare, Discoverable and Legendary categories, so there are more than a few surprises waiting for players to discover.

Where can you find wildlife in GTA 6?

You won’t find every animal in GTA 6 roaming around the same part of the map. Rockstar has spread the wildlife across Leonida’s diverse regions, and each area has its own range of animals based on its environment.

For instance, Grassrivers (Leonida’s take on the Everglades) and the surrounding swamps are expected to feature American alligators, Burmese pythons, snapping turtles, herons and manatees. If you head towards Mount Kalaga National Park, you’ll encounter a completely different ecosystem populated by black bears, wild turkeys, eagles, and cougars.

On the other hand, the coastal regions and the Leonida Keys will have their own share of wildlife, particularly marine species. Players will be able to spot tiger sharks, hammerhead sharks, sea turtles, manatees, pelicans, and seagulls around these areas. This variety should make exploring Leonida much more interesting, as you’ll have different animals to discover depending on where you go.

Can you hunt, fish, and pet animals in GTA 6?

In an interview with YouTuber TGG, Rockstar North’s Rob Nelson revealed that hunting and fishing will be side activities in GTA 6. Hunting will be introduced through a character Jason already knows, and lets players track down wildlife and earn money from hunting animals. Fishing, on the other hand, will use a catch-and-release system. Why is this the case? Well, Nelson says keeping the fish you catch didn’t fit the GTA 6 experience, unlike in Red Dead Redemption 2. Fishing will also feed into collectibles and tons of fishing-related challenges.

The GTA 6 Extended Look also confirmed that petting animals is a feature. In one scene, Jason approaches a dog, and multiple options appear on screen: Study, Pet and Scold. Clearly, interacting with animals will play a major role in the game. What Rockstar hasn’t confirmed yet is whether players will also be able to pet cats, or if dogs and cats can be adopted and brought home as companions throughout the story.

GTA 6’s wildlife compared to Red Dead Redemption 2

It’s fair to say that Rockstar’s last major release, Red Dead Redemption 2, set an incredibly high standard when it came to wildlife. Seriously, the game featured 178 animal species, including the likes of bears, snakes, wolves, alligators, and plenty of others. Each animal had its own behavior, interactions, and natural habitat, which made the Wild West feel like a living world even though it was a video game.

Based on the official interviews and gameplay footage released so far, it’s clear that GTA 6 is taking a similar approach to its wildlife. Even before launch, Rockstar has confirmed that Leonida will be home to more than 170 animal species. Sure, that falls just short of Red Dead Redemption 2’s count, but it’s worth remembering that GTA 6 offers far more coastal and marine wildlife. Players will be able to encounter sharks, dolphins, and tons of bird species.

Rockstar is also bringing back a number of wildlife-related side activities from Red Dead Redemption 2. As we mentioned above, GTA 6 will feature both hunting and fishing, which gives players even more reasons to interact with the animals they come across. They’re among the things you can do in GTA 6 that you couldn’t in GTA 5. We’ll have to wait until the game’s release to see the full extent of its ecosystems, discover all the animal species, and find out how its wildlife systems compare to those in Red Dead Redemption 2.

Wrapping up!

Leonida’s beauty isn’t limited to its impressive skylines, beaches, and amusement parks. Its diverse wildlife is another major part of what makes the world so interesting. Although Rockstar hasn’t revealed the full GTA 6 animals list or exactly how each species will interact with its surroundings, everything we’ve seen so far suggests that the wildlife will play a major role in making the game’s world feel more alive than ever.

GTA 6 launches on November 19, 2026, so now is a good time to consider pre-ordering the game if you haven’t already. Pre-orders placed before November 20 include the Vintage Vice City Pack. However, if you don’t want to spend $79.99 on the game, you can also check out KICK’s GTA 6 Ultimate Edition giveaway for a chance to get your hands on it.

FAQs

How many animals will be in GTA 6?

GTA 6 is packed with more than 170 animal species. This includes over 60 bird species, more than 30 land mammals, and a wide variety of fish, reptiles and aquatic animals.

Will GTA 6 have more animals than GTA 5?

Yes, GTA 6 has far more animals than GTA 5. For instance, GTA 5 had only 28 animal species across San Andreas, while GTA 6 will feature more than 170 species.

Can you hunt animals in GTA 6?

GTA 6 will feature hunting as a side activity. Players will be able to hunt wildlife and earn money, which can be used to progress in the game.

Can you pet dogs in GTA 6?

Players can interact with and pet dogs in GTA 6. In the Extended Look, Jason can be seen approaching a dog with a Pet option on screen, which confirms the mechanic.

title.rendered: Who plays Lucia in GTA 6? Manni L. Perez, and what we know

content.rendered:
So, who plays Lucia in GTA 6? We’re sure that’s been on every gamer’s mind ever since Rockstar Games dropped the first trailer for the game back in December 2023. Seriously, the community has scoured the internet looking for actors who even remotely resemble the character.

We all thought the developer would reveal Lucia’s actor once the game goes live on November 19, 2026, but The Game Awards 2026 nominations, announced on November 17, have finally given us the answer: it’s Manni L. Perez. So, here’s everything you need to know about the actor behind one of GTA 6’s main protagonists.

Lucia’s role in GTA 6 at a glance

Who plays Lucia in GTA 6?

Lucia in GTA 6 is played by Manni L. Perez. If you’ve been following the game’s development, this won’t come as a surprise, since fans have speculated for years that she was playing the protagonist. Manni’s involvement in the game was finally confirmed through The Game Awards 2026 nominee list, where she received a Best Performance nomination for her work in GTA 6. That effectively confirms her as Lucia Caminos.

Interestingly, this isn’t Manni’s first time working on the Grand Theft Auto franchise. She previously voiced the Latina blackjack dealers introduced with The Diamond Casino & Resort update (2019) in GTA Online. Outside of gaming, she’s also had roles in TV shows like Law & Order: Special Victims Unit, Chicago P.D., Jessica Jones, The Blacklist and several others.

What is Lucia’s role in GTA 6?

Lucia Caminos is one of the two playable protagonists in GTA 6, alongside Jason Duval. What’s interesting is that she’s the first female lead of a modern mainline GTA story.

Based on what we’ve seen in the trailers and the GTA 6 Extended Look footage, Lucia is no stranger to fighting and knows how to handle herself. Her family’s roots are in Liberty City, and her father taught her to fight from an early age. She has always been determined to turn her life around and give her family a better future.

Lucia’s journey eventually lands her in Leonida Penitentiary. After she gets out, she teams up with Jason Duval, ready to take matters into her own hands. She’s at the heart of GTA 6’s story, with the trailers setting the duo up as a modern-day Bonnie and Clyde.

Who plays Jason in GTA 6?

Rockstar Games hasn’t yet revealed who plays Jason in GTA 6. However, the community has long speculated that Dylan Rourke is the face and voice behind the character.

Fans correctly predicted Manni’s involvement as Lucia, so there’s a good chance the theories surrounding Rourke are also on the right track. However, until Rockstar makes an official announcement, we’ll have to take these theories with a grain of salt.

Wrapping up!

The Game Awards 2026 nominations have finally put an end to the speculation about who plays Lucia in GTA 6, and it’s none other than Manni L. Perez bringing the character to life. She’s an experienced television actor who has also previously voiced a blackjack dealer in GTA Online.

However, Rockstar has yet to reveal the actor behind Jason Duval. We’ll likely have to wait until GTA 6 finally releases on November 19 to find out who’s playing the other half of the game’s central duo. So, keep an eye out for the game’s release time in your region. And if you haven’t purchased a copy yet, be sure to check out KICK’s GTA 6 Ultimate Edition giveaway.

FAQs

Who is the voice actress for Lucia in GTA 6?

The actress behind Lucia Caminos in GTA 6 is Manni L. Perez. She is an American actress who has previously appeared in television productions and voiced a blackjack dealer in GTA Online.

Is Lucia the main character in GTA 6?

Lucia Caminos is one of the two main protagonists in GTA 6, alongside Jason Duval.

Is Lucia based on a real person?

There’s no confirmation that Lucia Caminos in GTA 6 is based on a real person. She’s a fictional character created by Rockstar Games.

Is Lucia and Jason’s story inspired by Bonnie and Clyde?

Lucia and Jason’s relationship in GTA 6 appears to take inspiration from the criminal duo Bonnie and Clyde.

Does Lucia have special abilities in GTA 6?

It’s still unknown whether Lucia in GTA 6 will have any special abilities.

title.rendered: Google Wallet comes to iPhone, but Apple Pay still handles store payments

content.rendered:
Google Wallet has arrived on iPhone for U.S. users, but Apple Pay still handles store payments. Google announced Google Wallet for iPhone in the United States on Nov. 17, 2026, with passes, loyalty cards, receipts, and online checkout. Tap-to-pay is not supported on iOS, so Google Wallet cannot replace Apple Pay at the register.

Google Wallet focuses on passes and Google account data

That makes Google Wallet more of an organizer for Google-linked passes and receipts than a store payment app. It syncs with Gmail and other Google apps for package tracking, digital boarding passes, concert tickets, and receipts. You can also scan loyalty cards and gym memberships into the app. For someone who already relies on Gmail, that is the practical gain: travel details and purchase records gathered in one place.

Payment cards can be used for online checkout across Google and anywhere Google Pay is accepted. That covers online buying, not the tap at a store. Google also says Wallet will be a hub for managing agentic purchases made across Google, including those made with Gemini.

There is plenty of overlap with Apple’s app. Apple Wallet and Google Wallet already overlap on passes and cards, so Google Wallet may suit you if you rely on Google’s apps or want Gmail receipts and travel details in one place. Custom passes are a separate case, and iPhone users can already keep custom passes in Apple Wallet.

Apple Pay still handles checkout at the register

For in-store contactless payment, Apple Pay remains the way to tap an iPhone at participating U.S. stores. Google has not said whether or when tap-to-pay may come to iOS, so do not count on Google Wallet for store payments.

The launch is limited to U.S. iPhone users. If you already rely on Gmail, Wallet can gather the tickets and receipts that arrive there. A Google account can also keep supported passes available across iPhone and Android. If your goal is to pay at a register, Apple Pay remains the one to open.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: WhatsApp rolls out its own iPhone chat backup option in limited beta

content.rendered:
WhatsApp has begun letting some iPhone beta users back up chats to its own servers instead of iCloud, with 2 GB of free storage. WABetaInfo spotted the new option in WhatsApp’s iOS beta, version 26.45.10.71 on TestFlight. The rollout is gradual and will reach more accounts over the coming weeks, so installing the beta does not guarantee you will see the option yet.

WhatsApp’s free backup starts at 2 GB

The appeal is straightforward. The new option could keep your WhatsApp backup data separate from iCloud’s shared storage. In WhatsApp Settings > Chats > Chat Backup, users can choose iCloud or WhatsApp as the backup provider. The WhatsApp-hosted free tier offers 2 GB. That should help people with smaller chat histories, but anyone who saves years of photos and videos may outgrow it quickly.

For more space, WABetaInfo reports that WhatsApp Plus subscribers get 100 GB and Meta One plans offer up to 4 TB.

The feature first appeared in an earlier beta, version 26.28.10.16, in July. Now the option is showing up for some testers, which makes this an active rollout rather than a code find. Anyone dealing with iCloud backup problems may welcome another place to store backups, though the free allowance still caps out at 2 GB.

Backups require encryption and cannot move across platforms

The choice applies to backups only. Active conversations are not affected, and iCloud remains an option, so people who do not need the extra space can keep their current setup.

WhatsApp requires end-to-end encryption for backups stored on its own servers. Users can set a passkey, which is the default, or use a 64-digit encryption key. Requiring end-to-end encryption is the right call, but it also puts more weight on the setup. A lost passkey or key could make a backup difficult or impossible to restore.

WhatsApp-hosted backups cannot yet be used to restore chats on the other mobile platform. To move from iPhone to Android or vice versa, use WhatsApp’s chat transfer tool. Before you change phones, review WhatsApp’s current backup and restore process.

For now, this beta feature is available to some iPhone beta accounts, and WhatsApp has not announced a general release date. The 2 GB free tier may ease iCloud pressure for some users, but it does not make cross-platform moves any simpler.

title.rendered: How to use Snow Blocks and Snow Layers in Minecraft 26.4

content.rendered:
Want to give your Minecraft builds a winter makeover this holiday season? Whether you’re building a snow-covered mansion, an igloo or an entire snow village, you’ll definitely need Snow Blocks and Snow Layers!

Snow Blocks are solid white decorative blocks, which makes them perfect for creating snowy structures. You can craft one from 4 Snowballs. Snow Layers, on the other hand, are thin layers of snow that naturally cover blocks in snowy biomes, and you can also place them on top of other blocks. So how do you get these blocks and use them? Here’s a complete guide to Minecraft Snow Blocks and Snow Layers.

Minecraft 26.4, which Mojang has now named The Deep Freeze, is still in snapshot testing and doesn’t have a release date yet. These recipes work the same way in the current version of the game.

Snow Blocks and Snow Layers in Minecraft 26.4 at a glance

How to get Snow Blocks in Minecraft 26.4

Getting Snow Blocks in Minecraft 26.4 is quite simple, and there are two ways to do it. Here’s what you’ll need for each method:

1. Craft with Snowballs

The easiest way to get Snow Blocks is to craft them with Snowballs. For this, you’ll need x4 Snowballs and a crafting table (your inventory’s 2×2 crafting grid works too). You can get Snowballs with Minecraft commands, or head to any snowy biome and use a shovel to break Snow Blocks or Snow Layers and collect the Snowballs they drop. Once you have the materials, follow these steps:

  1. Open your crafting table or inventory
  2. Place x4 Snowballs in a 2×2 pattern
  3. Collect your Snow Block

2. Collect natural Snow Blocks

Don’t feel like crafting Snow Blocks? You can also find them naturally generated across different snowy biomes in Minecraft. Head to these areas, look for Snow Blocks, and collect them with a shovel that has the Silk Touch enchantment. Silk Touch lets you pick up the block itself instead of breaking it into Snowballs.

How to get Snow Layers in Minecraft 26.4

There are two methods that work best for getting Snow Layers in Minecraft 26.4:

1. Collect natural Snow Layers

Once again, you’ll need a shovel enchanted with Silk Touch. Head over to any snowy biome and explore until you come across naturally generated Snow Layers. Equip your Silk Touch shovel and break the layers to collect them directly.

2. Craft with Snow Blocks

To craft Snow Layers, you’ll need Snow Blocks. This is a convenient method if you have plenty of Snow Blocks in your inventory. Here’s what you need to do:

  1. Open your crafting table
  2. Place x3 Snow Blocks in a horizontal row
  3. Collect x6 Snow Layers

Best ways to use Snow Blocks and Snow Layers in Minecraft

Now that you have both Snow Blocks and Snow Layers in your inventory, it’s time to put them to good use. These decorative blocks have tons of uses, and here are a few worth considering:

  1. Snow houses and igloos: The best way to use Snow Blocks is to build igloos, winter houses and cabins. Their bright white look makes them perfect for structures that blend into snowy surroundings. You can take things a step further and combine them with Dark Oak or Spruce wood to add contrast and give your builds a natural winter look.
  2. Snow-covered roofs: Snow Layers work best when you already have a structure and want to give it a winter-themed look. Place them on rooftops and other exposed surfaces to make it seem as if snow has gradually piled up over time. You can also stack multiple Snow Layers to create thicker snow coverage.
  3. Winter landscapes: Use Snow Blocks and Snow Layers together to turn ordinary terrain into a winter wonderland. Snow Blocks can cover larger areas, while Snow Layers can add detail to trees, gardens, rocks and hills.

New in the 26.4 snapshots: The Deep Freeze also adds Snow Bricks, crafted from 4 Snow Blocks in a 2×2 grid, with matching slabs, stairs and walls. They’re another option for winter builds and, unlike Snow Layers, they don’t melt.

Wrapping up!

Snow Blocks and Snow Layers are excellent decorative blocks for adding a winter touch to your Minecraft builds. You can collect them with a Silk Touch shovel or craft them from Snowballs. So gather your resources, get creative, and build the perfect holiday house with your friends.

FAQs

How do you make Snow Blocks in Minecraft 26.4?

You can make a Snow Block in Minecraft 26.4 with 4 Snowballs in a 2×2 crafting grid, either in your inventory or on a crafting table. You don’t need any other resources.

How many Snow Layers make one Snow Block?

You can stack 8 Snow Layers on top of each other to fill a full block. In Java Edition, breaking that full stack with a Silk Touch shovel gives you a single Snow Block.

Can Snow Blocks melt in Minecraft?

No. Snow Blocks don’t melt in Minecraft, no matter what light sources are nearby or what time of day it is. Snow Layers are different: they melt near bright light sources like torches.

How do you collect Snow Layers without breaking them?

You can collect Snow Layers without breaking them with a shovel that’s enchanted with Silk Touch.

title.rendered: Leekcapper in Fortnite: What it is and how to find it

content.rendered:
A brand-new Fortnite weapon called the Leekcapper has started appearing in matches. It gives you an edge in movement as well as combat, so quite a few players have been picking it up.

The Leekcapper was added to all Fortnite Battle Royale modes on November 15, when Week 3’s Captain’s Day kicked off. It spawns randomly in chests and as floor loot. Below, you can learn all about this item, from what it does to how you can find it.

What is the Leekcapper in Fortnite?

The Leekcapper is a stick-like melee weapon in Fortnite inspired by Hatsune Miku, the Week 3 Captain. It bears a strong resemblance to the leek that internet memes have long linked to the virtual singer.

An item of Epic rarity, the Leekcapper is yet another short-range weapon in the Treasure Hunters mini-season with a theme tied to an anime character. The other one in this category is the One Piece-themed Zoro’s Three Sword Style, another Epic-tier weapon that was added at the start of the season on November 1, 2026.

Where to find the Leekcapper?

You can find the Leekcapper in eligible Fortnite modes, which include both Ranked and Unranked versions of Build and Zero Build matches. It is also expected to stay in the game until the Treasure Hunters mini-season ends on December 5, 2026.

Some celeb-inspired weapons, such as Lil Uzi Vert’s personalized SMG, drop when you defeat the character they’re tied to. The Leekcapper doesn’t work that way, even though it’s clearly linked to Hatsune Miku. The virtual singer appears as a friendly NPC at the Friendship Villa POI, and you can easily get the Mini Miku Sprite from her.

To get the Leekcapper, though, you will have to search the map yourself. It spawns randomly, so finding one takes persistence and some luck. The different ways you may come across the Leekcapper are:

  • It commonly spawns in chests, including Treasure Chests and Rare Chests.
  • Rare Chests inside Vaults are reported to always contain one.
  • It can sometimes be found lying on the ground.
  • It may appear in the loot dropped by an eliminated player.

The Hatsune Miku-inspired Leekcapper also stays in your inventory only for the match in which you find it. Like almost any weapon in the chest loot pool, it can’t be carried over to the next match.

Why couldn’t I find it on release day?

Some Fortnite players reported that they couldn’t find the Leekcapper at all in the first few hours after the Week 3 update went live on Sunday. Other reports say it was only available in Vaults during that window. This was unexpected, because the melee item had already been found in the game’s files and was essentially a guaranteed new addition.

The Leekcapper did eventually arrive in Fortnite the same day. According to multiple popular leakers, such as HYPEX, its absence was an accident that Epic Games later noticed and promptly fixed.

Hatsune Miku’s Leekcapper is now in-game It was bugged for the past 2 hours https://t.co/2yPSJmRBFQ

— HYPEX (@HYPEX) November 15, 2026

Leekcapper stats, durability and abilities

The Leekcapper is a powerful melee weapon, and it makes you move faster too. Simply equipping it gives you:

  • Improved sprinting: faster speed and a longer-lasting sprint gauge
  • Improved jumping: a higher maximum jump height

With the Leekcapper equipped, target an enemy and press the fire button for its primary attack, which deals 25 damage on the first hit of its combo. The more powerful secondary attack is done by holding and then releasing the alt-fire button. It can deal up to 95 damage and knock the enemy back, depending on how long you hold the button to fill the hit meter.

The weapon has a durability gauge of 200, which you can see whenever you equip it. The gauge drains as you use the weapon, and the Leekcapper breaks when it hits zero.

How to board a ship with the Leekcapper

As soon as you find a Leekcapper, you can tick off a simple Fortnite quest: board a ship with the melee item equipped to earn a significant 20,000 XP. There is a small catch, though. Not every ship or vessel on or near Crossbones Isle counts toward this quest.

Ships known to work for the “Board a ship with the Leekcapper” quest include:

  • The pair of ships at Plunder Port (South of the map)
  • The shipwreck just west of Plunder Port
  • The Duck Yacht at Friendship Villa (north-east)
  • The ship at Busy Bay (south-east)

How to use the Leekcapper (tips)

Here are a few ways the Leekcapper can help you in Fortnite:

  1. Since it also boosts your movement, you can combine quick maneuvers with multiple primary attacks to overwhelm an opponent.
  2. When you want to put some distance between you and an enemy, use the more powerful secondary attack to knock them back.
  3. You can also use the Leekcapper to clear obstacles in your way, which comes in handy when you need to improvise an escape route. A fully charged secondary strike works best for this.

Leekcapper vs Kneecapper

As the community has noted, the Leekcapper is basically a Hatsune Miku-themed take on the Kneecapper, a baseball bat that was added to Fortnite in February 2025 during Chapter 6 Season 2. As a result, the two melee items have nearly identical abilities and damage. However, the Kneecapper later also got a Mythic-tier variant called the Blitz Kneecapper, while the Leekcapper has no such variant.

My take on the Leekcapper

From its looks and how it plays, the Leekcapper is definitely worth checking out, much like the Kneecapper. For Hatsune Miku fans, it’s a good way to show their interest while also carrying an item that hits hard.

For everyone else, I recommend picking it up when you find it and using it as a secondary weapon. Even if you don’t like melee weapons, it’s worth finding and equipping it at least once to complete the ship quest mentioned above. The XP will help with your Battle Pass progress in Fortnite Treasure Hunters.

FAQs

Is the Leekcapper Mythic?

No, the Leekcapper in Fortnite is an Epic-tier item.

Can you get the Leekcapper from Hatsune Miku?

No, you can’t get the Leekcapper directly from the Hatsune Miku NPC in Fortnite.

Does the Leekcapper break?

Yes, it breaks once its durability runs out.

Is the Leekcapper in Reload?

No. It is only available in Fortnite Battle Royale modes.

Which ship counts for the Leekcapper quest?

The ships at the Friendship Villa, Plunder Port and Busy Bay POIs count for this quest, along with the shipwreck just west of Plunder Port.

Is the Leekcapper just the Kneecapper?

Yes, the Leekcapper is more or less a Hatsune Miku-themed Kneecapper.

title.rendered: Upcoming Apple products in 2027: iPhone 20, Macs, iPads & more

content.rendered:
Apple’s 2027 product lineup could be one of its biggest in years. After introducing a foldable iPhone, a new HomeView smart display, and several major Mac and iPad upgrades in 2026, Apple is reportedly preparing another wave of hardware releases for next year.

The biggest highlight could be the iPhone 20 Pro, marking the 20th anniversary. Apple is also expected to refresh the MacBook with M7-powered chips and bring OLED displays to more iPads. Rumors also point to Apple’s first smart glasses, camera-equipped AirPods Pro, and more advanced smart-home devices.

According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman and reports from other reliable sources, Apple could launch more than 15 new products in 2027. I’ve organized the upcoming Apple products so you can quickly see which might arrive first and which are worth waiting for.

Keep in mind that Apple hasn’t officially confirmed these products or their release dates. The timeline below is based on current reports and could change as development progresses.

All upcoming Apple products expected in 2027: At a glance

Before we get into the details, here’s a quick overview of Apple’s rumored 2027 product lineup.

Spring 2027: New iPhones, iPads, and Mac refreshes

Apple could start 2027 with several updates across its affordable iPhone and iPad lineup.

According to rumors, instead of launching all iPhones during its annual September event, Apple plans to split its launch schedule. The standard iPhone 18 might debut in spring, with more premium models coming in fall.

iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e

Apple could introduce the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e in spring 2027.

Both models are rumored to feature Apple’s next-generation 2nm-built A20 chip, potentially bringing better performance, improved power efficiency, and longer battery life.

The iPhone 18 is expected to be an incremental upgrade rather than a major redesign. Apple could retain the existing design while upgrading RAM to 12GB.

The iPhone 18e, meanwhile, should remain the more affordable option. It may feature an upgraded 24MP selfie camera, a similar rear camera and the standard 60Hz display.

iPhone Air 2

Apple’s second-generation iPhone Air could also arrive in the first half of 2027.

The original iPhone Air focused on an exceptionally thin and lightweight design. However, its camera and battery compromises could leave room for improvement.

The iPhone Air 2 is rumored to feature an additional Ultra Wide camera, improved battery life, and a smaller Dynamic Island. Apple could also equip it with the A20 Pro chip and its next-generation C2 modem along with iPhone 17 Pro cooling features.

iPad 12th generation with Apple Intelligence

The 12th-generation iPad is rumored to have either an A18 or A19 chip, which could enable Apple Intelligence features, Stage Manager 2, and better multitasking.

Other expected improvements include upgraded 8GB of RAM, Apple’s N1 wireless networking chip, Wi-Fi 7 support, and the C1X modem in cellular models. The overall design may remain the same: an 11-inch Liquid Retina display, 12MP cameras, and Touch ID.

For students and everyday users, the processor and connectivity upgrades could make this a worthwhile update even without a major design change.

iPad Air with OLED display

The next iPad Air could receive one of its biggest display upgrades yet.

Apple is reportedly considering an OLED display for the next-generation iPad Air. This would bring deeper blacks, better contrast, and more vibrant colors compared with the current LCD panel.

The tablet could also feature an M5 chip and a thinner, lighter design. Another possibility is Apple’s Acoustic Display technology, which debuted with the OLED iPad mini in 2026.

iPad Pro with vapor chamber cooling

Apple is reportedly preparing another iPad Pro upgrade for 2027, potentially featuring an M6 or M7 chip and a vapor chamber cooling system.

Vapor chamber cooling could help the tablet manage heat more effectively during demanding workloads. This may be particularly useful for professional applications, video editing, gaming, and AI-powered tasks.

MacBook Air with M6

Apple could bring its next-generation M6 chip to the MacBook Air in 2027.

Following the M6-powered Mac releases in 2026, an M6 MacBook Air would be a natural next step in Apple’s laptop lineup. It could make the laptop more capable of handling multitasking, creative applications, and on-device AI features.

I expect the main focus to be performance and power efficiency rather than a complete design overhaul. The MacBook Air’s thin-and-light design is already one of its biggest strengths.

MacBook Neo refresh

Apple’s affordable MacBook Neo could also receive an upgrade in 2027.

The next model is rumored to feature an A19 Pro chip, potentially paired with 12GB of RAM. Apple could also introduce new color options.

The MacBook Neo occupies an important position in Apple’s laptop lineup because it targets students and everyday users who don’t need the performance of a MacBook Pro.

Summer 2027: WWDC and mid-year Apple releases

June is usually an important month for Apple because of its Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC). While the event primarily focuses on software, Apple could use WWDC 2027 to introduce a new hardware category.

The strongest possibility is Apple’s long-rumored smart glasses.

Apple Smart Glasses

Apple’s first smart glasses, code-named N50, could finally make their debut at WWDC 2027.

Unlike the Vision Pro, these glasses are expected to have a more familiar everyday design with distinct styles. They could compete directly with products such as Meta’s Ray-Ban smart glasses.

As the first model is rumored to skip AR display, Apple may integrate cameras, microphones, and speakers. So that users can interact with Siri AI to get answers about surrondings like identifying buildings, suggesting meals from fridge ingredients, translating signs, etc.

Some expected features include:

  • Making phone calls and sending messages.
  • Playing music through built-in speakers.
  • Receiving and announcing notifications.
  • Getting navigation directions and contextual information.
  • Guidance on health and fitness
  • Smart home controls

According to recent reports, Apple is targeting a WWDC 2027 announcement, with availability potentially following later in the year.

MacBook Pro with M7

Apple is reportedly preparing another round of entry-level MacBook Pro upgrades in 2027.

Rumors point at a standard 14-inch MacBook Pro with an M7 chip, skipping M6 Pro and M6 Max processors. The processor is expected to focus more on internal improvements, including faster processing, graphics performance, and AI capabilities.

The update could also follow the thinner design, Dynamic Island, and glowing Apple logo introduced in the MacBook Pro with PROLED display in 2026.

Recent reports also suggest Apple could launch the second-generation touchscreen MacBook Pro with M7 Pro and M7 Max chips at the end of 2027.

Fall 2027: Apple’s biggest iPhone launches

September is traditionally Apple’s biggest hardware launch period, and 2027 could be particularly important because of the iPhone’s 20th anniversary.

The company is reportedly preparing a redesigned Pro lineup alongside the next generation of its foldable iPhone.

iPhone 20 Pro and iPhone 20 Pro Max: 20th-anniversary iPhones

Apple introduced the original iPhone in 2007, making 2027 its 20th anniversary. To celebrate the milestone, Apple could introduce a major redesign with the iPhone 20 Pro and iPhone 20 Pro Max.

According to current reports, it could feature curved glass around the edges and corners, and significantly reduce the display bezels for a more seamless appearance. Moreover, Apple is reportedly exploring under-display technology that could eventually eliminate visible display cutouts.

Both models are expected to feature Apple’s next-generation A21 Pro chip, no physical buttons, and a new main camera sensor.

There is also speculation about Apple’s naming strategy. The company could skip the iPhone 19 branding and jump directly to iPhone 20, similar to how it introduced the iPhone X for the iPhone’s tenth anniversary.

iPhone Duo 2

After introducing its first foldable iPhone in 2026, Apple could follow it up with the second-generation iPhone Duo in 2027.

The next model may focus on refining the foldable experience rather than completely changing the design. Apple has reportedly tested Face ID for the device, although it’s unclear whether the feature will be ready for the final product.

Other possible improvements include refinements to the camera system and a more versatile Camera Control button that could potentially double as an Action button.

Apple Watch Series 13

Apple could introduce the Apple Watch Series 13 in fall 2027, potentially with a more significant design change than a typical annual refresh.

According to a Weibo post from Instant Digital, Apple is exploring a new band attachment mechanism. If implemented, this could change how users attach and replace Apple Watch bands.

Other possible improvements include a next-generation OLED display, faster processor, updated health features, and better battery efficiency.

Apple Watch Ultra 5

Apple may also introduce the Apple Watch Ultra 5 in 2027.

There aren’t many reliable specifications available yet, but a new Ultra model would likely focus on performance, battery life, outdoor tracking, and health monitoring.

Apple doesn’t update the Ultra lineup every year, so its arrival in 2027 isn’t guaranteed.

Late 2027 or early 2028: More AI-powered Apple products

Beyond iPhones, Macs, and iPads, Apple is reportedly working on new hardware designed to make its AI ecosystem more useful.

Some of these products could arrive toward the end of 2027, while others may slip into 2028.

AirPods Pro with built-in cameras

Apple is reportedly developing a new version of AirPods Pro with built-in cameras.

However, these cameras aren’t expected to work like ordinary cameras used for shooting pictures and videos. Instead, they may use camera sensors to support Siri AI and Visual Intelligence, gesture recognition, and context-aware audio adjustments.

A leaked video found in macOS Tahoe 26.7 appears to demonstrate the technology, showing a user looking at a book while Siri uses Visual Intelligence to recognize and remember it.

HomeView Max

After introducing its first HomeView smart display in 2026, Apple could expand the lineup with a more advanced version.

Currently referred to as HomeView Max or HomeView Ultra, the device, codenamed J595, could feature a 9-inch display mounted on a motorized arm. So this could rotate up to 360 degrees and automatically turn toward whoever is speaking.

The device may also include more advanced AI capabilities, cameras, and environmental sensors. For example, it could recognize when someone enters a room and respond by adjusting connected smart-home accessories.

A report from The Information points out that the starting price could be around $1000 in the US, making it a considerably more premium smart-home product.

HomePod 3

Apple is reportedly preparing a new full-sized HomePod, potentially called the HomePod 3, after updating the smaller HomePod mini in 2026.

The next-generation speaker could feature a faster processor to support Apple’s more advanced Siri and Apple Intelligence features. Apple may also improve sound quality, wireless connectivity, and smart-home integration.

The current full-sized HomePod hasn’t received a major hardware refresh since 2023, making an upgrade particularly interesting for users invested in Apple’s smart-home ecosystem.

Why 2027 could be a big year for Apple?

Apple’s 2027 roadmap looks particularly interesting because it goes beyond routine processor upgrades.

The 20th-anniversary iPhone could introduce a major design change, while the iPhone Duo 2 would help Apple develop its foldable smartphone category. OLED technology could also reach more affordable iPads, and M7-powered Macs could bring another performance boost to Apple’s laptop lineup.

But I’m most interested in Apple’s AI hardware plans. Smart glasses, camera-equipped AirPods, and more advanced HomeView devices could show how Apple wants users to interact with Siri and Apple Intelligence beyond the iPhone and Mac.

Of course, these products are based on reports and rumors, not official announcements. Some could arrive later than expected, while others may never reach the market.

Bookmark this article; we’ll keep it updated as more rumors and confirmations roll in. Got a favorite from the list? Let us know in the comments!
