title.rendered: Apple adds a front-camera unlock to iPhone Duo in the iOS 27.3 beta

content.rendered:
Apple’s iOS 27.3 beta adds a way to unlock iPhone Duo while the phone is closed. The option arrived in iOS 27.3 beta 2 on November 16 and is called Unlock with Front Camera. The front camera on the outer display, the screen you see when the phone is closed, recognizes your face. When it does, the face unlock opens the phone without Touch ID. It is less secure than Face ID, Touch ID, or a passcode.

The phone’s Settings screen describes the feature as a way to “quickly unlock iPhone Duo when it’s closed.” The Settings text also says: “Face recognition data never leaves your device.”

The feature suits owners who want to open a closed iPhone Duo without Touch ID. It only unlocks the phone. Apple Pay, passwords, and app sign-ins still need Touch ID or the passcode, so the face unlock does not replace Touch ID for payments or logins. It also does not work when the phone is unfolded, so unlocking the open phone still needs Touch ID or the passcode.

After 45 minutes without an unlock, the face feature turns off until you use Touch ID or the passcode. That means a phone you set down for a while will need one of them when you pick it up.

The beta’s second change is a setting under Display & Brightness, and it is separate from the face unlock. It locks the phone when you close it, instead of moving what you were doing from the inner screen to the outer one. The inner screen is the one you use when the phone is open. Many users had asked for this change.

The first iPhone Duo uses Touch ID in the side button and does not have Face ID. Anyone who wants Face ID should know that before buying, and this beta does not change that for the first model. Apple is reportedly testing under-display Face ID for a second iPhone Duo, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. It reportedly has not decided whether the feature will ship on that model.

The first iOS 27.3 beta was released on November 3. Apple has not given a public release date for the feature, though reports point to December for iOS 27.3. Using it now means running beta software on your phone. After you update to iOS 27.3, turn it on in Settings > Touch ID & Passcode > Unlock with Front Camera.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: iOS 27.3 beta 2: Siri AI health answers, iPhone Duo unlock

content.rendered:
The second iOS 27.3 beta adds Siri AI health answers, a Calendar redesign, and several changes to iPhone Duo. It is a developer beta only.

The iOS 27.3 betas first became available on November 3. Apple says Siri AI is in beta in iOS 27.3. It works across apps including Calendar, Journal, Mail, Messages, Music, Photos, and Safari. It can also carry out tasks inside apps.

The second beta adds Siri AI health answers and iPhone Duo face unlock

Siri AI can respond to health-related questions and, with your permission, use your Health data. Apple has not described which health questions it handles or how it answers them. Early testers report that it can total your steps from the past week and give a daily average. Siri AI changes what the phone does, so it matters more than the Calendar, Apple TV, and Puzzles items, which are interface or regional changes.

The front camera on the outer display recognizes your face and unlocks the phone while it is closed. Turn it on in Settings > Touch ID & Passcode after you update to iOS 27.3. This is not Face ID, and it is less secure than Face ID, Touch ID, or a passcode.

The feature only unlocks the phone. Apple Pay, passwords, and app sign-ins still need Touch ID or the passcode. After about 45 minutes of inactivity, it turns off until you use Touch ID or the passcode. It does not work when the phone is unfolded. The Settings text says the feature is there “to quickly unlock iPhone Duo when it’s closed.”

The first iPhone Duo does not have Face ID. Reports say Apple is testing Face ID for a second model, but Apple has not confirmed that model.

A new Close to Lock setting in Display & Brightness locks the phone when you close it from an unfolded state. The Calendar app’s search and add-event controls move to the bottom of the screen. The Apple TV app adds a video podcasts section and supports vertical video. Siri AI arrives on second- and third-generation Apple TV 4K models in tvOS 27.3 beta 2.

Apple News+ Puzzles is expanding to Australia, French Canada, and the UK, and availability varies by region. In Safari, Siri AI can use a full webpage as context, including content outside the visible area. Reports say the beta also adds daily limits for server-side Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features, with higher limits on larger iCloud+ plans.

One change is Mac-only. It arrived in macOS 27.3 beta 2 on November 16. Device Control and Data Access are split into System & App Protection Override and Accessibility. Full Disk Access and System & App Protection Override now guide users to grant access only to the apps or folders a workflow needs.

Apple has confirmed that Siri AI is in this beta and that Calendar and Safari are among its apps. The other second-beta items still need Apple’s confirmation before readers rely on them.

First-beta features are still on the list, from the Health app to Music

These items were part of the first iOS 27.3 beta and are still on the list of changes. The redesigned Health app will “roll out to users as a free software update later this year.” Apple Watch Audio Intelligence, with Siri Recap and Live Rewind, is in the watchOS 27.3 beta and needs iOS 27.3 on the paired iPhone. Fitness+ Gym Strength is a four-week workout plan. Safari vertical tabs, available on iPhone Duo’s inner display, can be turned on in Safari settings, and Adaptive Dark Mode is on the list too. Siri AI languages include Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese, Turkish, and Norwegian.

On iPhone Duo, Reachability works when you swipe in from the left or right edge of the outer display. Turn it on under Settings > Accessibility > Touch.

For iPadOS 27.3, the list includes Siri Mode in Camera and Visual Intelligence with Apple Pencil support. StandBy on other iPhones has been revamped to work more like iPhone Duo’s StandBy, with customizable clock faces, multiple configurations, colors, and complications. Siri AI app actions cover tasks inside apps such as Calendar, Journal, Messages, and Music. Apple Music has a splash screen that highlights AutoMix, reworked Artist Pages, and Concerts For You.

The first iOS 27.3 public beta arrived on November 5, but beta 2 has not reached public testers yet. Apple’s China page says iOS 27.3 launches in December, with no exact date given.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Fortnite x Lil Uzi Vert collab: How to get the Icon Series skins and bundles

content.rendered:
Popular hip-hop artist Lil Uzi Vert has made his debut in Fortnite, spawning three different Icon skins modeled around him and multiple relevant cosmetics in the game. In doing so, the American rapper has joined an illustrious catalog of celebs, such as Eminem, Ariana Grande, and Lady Gaga, who have had their likeness incorporated into the online live-service title.

The Lil Uzi Vert Bundle and its items went on sale in Fortnite’s Item Shop on November 13 and will be up for grabs until December 12, 8 PM ET or December 13, 5:30 AM IST. This means the collab is set to last over a week beyond the end of the ongoing One Piece-themed Treasure Hunters mini-season.

All Lil Uzi Vert skins in Fortnite at a glance

How to buy the Lil Uzi Vert skins in the Item Shop

You can purchase the regular Lil Uzi Vert outfits directly from the Item Shop. The outfits and associated cosmetics are listed in the Item Shop until December 12, 2026, according to Epic’s offer listing. Check the in-game Shop for the final availability time in your region.

Follow these steps:

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab.
  2. Scroll down to the Lil Uzi Vert section and select the desired skin.
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to confirm your decision.

Lil Uzi Vert bundle price and every item in the set

All the items listed here are part of the Lil Uzi Vert Bundle, priced at 3,200 V-Bucks, in Fortnite’s Item Shop. Almost each of these cosmetics is also available as a separate purchase, as mentioned below.

1. Lil Uzi Vert skin

  • Individual item price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Bonus freebie with skin: Uzi’s Wings back bling

2. Pink Star Lil Uzi Vert skin

  • Individual item price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Bonus freebie with skin: Lil Uzi Star back bling

3. Uzi’s Wings back bling

  • Individual item price: 400 V-Bucks

4. Lil Uzi Star back bling

  • Individual item price: 500 V-Bucks

5. Picco-Axe pickaxe

  • Individual item price: 800 V-Bucks

6. Uzi’s Tour Guitar back bling and pickaxe

  • Individual item price: 800 V-Bucks

7. XO Tour Llif3 emote

  • Individual item price: 500 V-Bucks

8. What You Saying emote

  • Individual item price: 500 V-Bucks

9. Vans x Lil Uzi Vert LX Old Skool 36 kicks

  • Individual item price: 1,000 V-Bucks

10. Uzi On Tour wrap

  • Individual item price: 500 V-Bucks

Lil Uzi Vert Jam Tracks and the Jam Bundle

Apart from the main bundle, there is a second bundle inspired by Lil Uzi Vert, which consists entirely of his songs that are available in the form of jam tracks in Fortnite. Sold as the Lil Uzi Vert Jam Bundle and priced at 1,100 V-Bucks, it contains the first three songs from the list below. Moreover, it is scheduled to leave the Shop on November 26, 8 PM ET or November 27, 5:30 AM IST.

1. What You Saying

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks

2. Say It Was

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks

3. XO Tour Llif3

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks

4. Poured

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks

5. The Way Life Goes

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks

How to get the Solid Gold Lil Uzi Vert skin for free

Unlike the other two Lil Uzi Vert skins, which are also part of the namesake bundle, Solid Gold Lil Uzi Vert isn’t something players can buy using V-Bucks. Contrastingly, it was one of the rewards in Fortnite’s Treasure Chest pool for Week 2 and required to be earned through scouring the map for chests to open.

Given that we have already entered Week 3 of Fortnite Treasure Hunters, since November 15, Hatsune Miku cosmetics have replaced Lil Uzi Vert cosmetics (including the Solid Gold Lil Uzi Vert skin), and the latter category of items is no longer available among the Treasure Chest rewards.

Can you get the Lil Uzi Vert Bundle free with Pirate Shop Access?

Yes, you can easily grab the Lil Uzi Vert Bundle from the Item Shop without spending anything by using the Pirate Shop Access. For the uninitiated, this highly prized item, which is also known as the Pirate Shop token, is one of the rewards in the Treasure Chest pool. It is extremely difficult to obtain and basically requires sheer hard work as well as favorable luck.

When you have this item, you will get two tokens that will make virtually everything in the Shop free. While one token (Pirate Shop Access 2026) is to be used by December 15, 2026, the other (Pirate Shop Access 2027) is for use between January 1, 2027 and December 31, 2027. It’s worth noting that you must activate the token from the Shop tab in order for it to come into force. Once activated, it will make nearly all Shop cosmetics free for 14 days.

Lil Uzi Vert in Treasure Hunters: Boss, Lil’ SMG and Sprite

The Fortnite x Lil Uzi Vert collab didn’t just bring new cosmetics and bundles into the fray but also introduced the singer as an in-game boss, complete with a dedicated POI in the Battle Royale map, his own signature weapon, and a sprite inspired by him. The latter two, namely Lil Uzi Vert’s Lil’ SMG and Lil Uzi Vert Sprite, can normally only be obtained after emerging victorious from the associated boss fight.

If you want to face off with this boss and get your hands on the aforementioned weapons, follow the steps given below.

  1. Enter a Battle Royale match and head to Lil’ Uzi’s Stronghold on Crossbones Isle.
  2. Explore the Stronghold and approach Lil Uzi Vert to trigger the boss fight.
  3. Defeat the boss to claim his themed loot, including the Lil’ SMG and Lil’ Uzi Vert Jr. Sprite.

Watch out for free Lil Uzi Vert skin code scams

With the arrival of another marquee name, some Fortnite players have been reporting scams that reportedly promise a code that unlocks Lil Uzi Vert skins. However, just as any other time, these codes and hacks do not work and are usually malicious campaigns aimed at extracting your sensitive information, such as credit card details, and at infecting your device with malware.

Hence, you should steer clear of any such fake codes that look too good to be true. This basic rule-of-thumb is surprisingly overlooked by quite a few players but can actually save you from the data theft or malware hassle that could follow later. So, it becomes imperative to always be mindful of these scams and scammers.

Wrapping up

Following in the footsteps of A$AP Rocky, another noteworthy musician, Lil Uzi Vert, has finally made his way into Fortnite. Most recently, virtual singer Hatsune Miku has been the latest Captain to join the lineup in Fortnite Treasure Hunters. With over a couple of weeks still left, it will be interesting to see how the forthcoming Captains are received by the fans and also how the race for grabbing the Pirate Shop token before the season’s end takes shape.

FAQs

Is Lil Uzi Vert in the Battle Pass?

No, Lil Uzi Vert is not in the Battle Pass but in the Item Shop.

How much is the Lil Uzi Vert skin?

The Lil Uzi Vert skin sells for 1,500 V-Bucks.

Can you still get Solid Gold Lil Uzi Vert after November 15?

No, you can’t get the Solid Gold Lil Uzi Vert skin after November 15, because it was exclusively a part of the Treasure Chest rewards pool for Week 2, which ended on the same day.

Does Pink Star Lil Uzi Vert come with a back bling?

Yes, it comes with the Lil Uzi Star back bling as a bonus item for free.

Will the Lil Uzi Vert skin come back?

Judging by how similar Icon Series skins are treated by Fortnite devs, players can expect to see Lil Uzi Vert skins and cosmetics come back for a second spell in the Item Shop later at some point.

  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

author.description: Priye brings with him a deeply entrenched love for video games, alongside an experience of producing write-ups and videos for popular Indian and overseas publications. Having seen gaming grow tremendously over the years, he believes video games are the most comprehensive form of entertainment and considers them to be art. On the odd days when he’s not slaying a boss or obsessively hunting for collectibles in his virtual worlds, he may be found watching football or superhero flicks.

title.rendered: Leak says iPhone 20 Pro will get a new main camera sensor next year

content.rendered:
The leaker Ice Universe says the iPhone 20 Pro will get a new sensor for its main camera next year, meaning 2027. The leak’s only technical detail is a single sentence naming a new sensor made on a “17nm logic process.” Nothing else in the leak is specific about the camera.

What the leak says about the iPhone 20 Pro’s new sensor

The leak gives no sensor size, no megapixel count and no supplier. It also does not explain what the change would mean for the photos you take. Without those numbers, the leak cannot tell you whether the new sensor will make a visible difference.

The “17nm logic process” describes how the sensor’s logic layer is made. That says little about how photos will look in practice. Light capture depends on sensor size and pixel size, and the leak gives neither. A buyer comparing cameras needs those numbers before the process name means anything.

Samsung has reportedly been developing a 17nm process for image sensor logic circuits, but the leak does not say who would make Apple’s sensor.

Apple has not announced the iPhone 20 Pro, has not commented on the leak, and has not confirmed the sensor details. Until it does, the 17nm figure is the leaker’s claim, and nothing else confirms it. The sensor size, pixel count, and timing are all still open.

How this fits with earlier iPhone 20 leaks

The “20 Pro” name is widely expected, possibly because the phone is tied to Apple’s 20th anniversary. The leak uses that name, but the name says nothing about the camera.

Apple’s 20th-anniversary iPhone is still expected in 2027, and a new leak says Apple is testing four models across two designs. Read about the latest 20th-anniversary iPhone design leak.

Earlier camera leaks pointed to a larger sensor, but only for the telephoto lens, at 200MP, with timing in 2027 or 2028. The 2027 part of that window matches the leak’s year. This leak is about the main camera and says nothing about 200MP.

Should you wait for the iPhone 20 Pro?

Treat this as an early heads-up on a phone Apple has not announced, based on one sentence with no specs.

If you are deciding whether to wait for the 20 Pro, the leak gives you no spec to weigh. Waiting on this leak would mean waiting on a claim with no sensor size attached.

Apple has not announced specs for the 20 Pro, including sensor size and pixel count. The leak’s only timing is “next year,” which is too thin to plan a purchase around. The iPhone 18 Pro, released in September 2026 at $1,199, is the current Pro model.

  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)

title.rendered: Snapchat Planets Guide 2026. Meanings, Order & Rankings

content.rendered:
Regular Snapchat users know that the app automatically creates a Best Friends list based on how often you interact with friends. Your number one best friend is the one you interact with most, followed by up to seven others. While you can easily see your own list, finding your position on someone else’s list isn’t as simple. This is where Snapchat Planets helps.

Exclusive to Snapchat Plus users, it assigns a planet to each of your top eight friends. By checking which planet you are in someone’s Snapchat solar system, you can find your place on their Best Friends list.

This post and the video below detail everything you need to know about Snapchat Planets.

What do the planets mean on snapchat?

Let’s start with the basics. Snapchat Planets, sometimes called the Friend Solar System, is a premium feature for Snapchat Plus members on iPhone. It’s available in more than 25 countries (including the US, UK, France, Canada, India, and more). I keep it toggled on, because I like peeking at my little orbit after a busy weekend. 

Here’s how it works: 

  • You are the Sun in your own Snapchat universe. 
  • Your top 8 friends become planets, from Mercury to Neptune, based on how much you interact with each person. 

The closer a friend’s planet sits to your Sun, the more you snap and chat with them. And yes, this universe is totally private, only you can see where your friends’ “orbit” you. It updates often, so the order can shift as your friendships and activity change. I’ve watched mine shuffle after a streak streaks out, then comes back the next day. 

How does the snapchat planets system work?

Once Friend Solar System is turned on in Snapchat Plus, Snapchat quietly tracks snaps, chats, and streaks in the background. Based on that activity, it assigns each of your top eight friends a planet, from Mercury, closest, to Neptune, farthest. 

  • You are always the Sun in your solar system. 
  • Mercury goes to your number one bestie; the person you interact with the most. 
  • The rest, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, follow in order based on your interactions. 
  • The arrangement can shift as your habits change. 

A fun twist, your place in someone else’s solar system might be completely different. You could be their Mercury, while they sit as your Jupiter. That is just how the universe spins.

Snapchat planets order and meanings

The planets stay in the same order as our actual solar system, only with a playful digital twist built for Snapchat. Here’s what each planet means, and what that placement says about your friendship rankings in this feature.

What snapchat planets in order reveals about your best friends?

Snapchat’s Friend Solar System is more than a label for a list. Think of it as a tiny space map that reflects closeness. Each planet icon in this system carries meaning. It hints at how often you two chat or swap snaps, the strength of the bond, and the general vibe between you. Not just a picture. A signal. 

In your Snapchat world, you are always the Sun. Everything centers on that. The eight closest friends appear as planets orbiting around you, each with its own emoji. The nearer a planet sits, the tighter the connection in daily use, chats, snaps, and streaks. The ranking shifts as habits change, so a burst of late-night chats can pull someone closer, while quiet weeks can nudge them outward. It maps activity, but it also mirrors the feeling of friendship, not only the count. 

Here is what each planet means for your top friends, both in how it looks and what it suggests about your relationship: 

Mercury: your #1 best friend

  • Meaning: Mercury sits closest to the Sun, so it marks the friend you interact with the most through snaps and chats. The absolute top spot.
  • Visual Representation: A red planet with several red hearts, sometimes tiny stars or sparkles.
  • What It Says About Your Friendship: Daily snaps, long streaks, quick replies. This is your ride or die on Snapchat, the friend who shows up in stories and DMs all the time.

Venus: your second closest friend

  • Meaning: Venus goes to the second most active connection in your list. Strong activity, just a step behind Mercury.
  • Visual Representation: A light brown or golden planet surrounded by colorful hearts, often pink, yellow, and blue. 
  • What It Says About Your Friendship: Consistent energy. Regular snaps and chats, steady rhythm, only a touch lighter than your top spot. 

Earth: your third closest friend

  • Meaning: Earth lands on the third position in your Friend Solar System. 
  • Visual Representation: Blue and green planet with a moon, stars, and red hearts orbiting. 
  • What It Says About Your Friendship: Reliable and loyal. You two interact often, and the connection feels balanced and supportive.

Mars: your fourth closest friend

  • Meaning: Mars tags the fourth most interactive friend. 
  • Visual Representation: A red or reddish orange planet, often with purple and blue hearts plus stars. 
  • What It Says About Your Friendship: Plenty of spark. Maybe not every day, yet the chats feel lively when they happen.

Jupiter: your fifth closest friend

  • Meaning: Jupiter marks the fifth friend in your ranking. 
  • Visual Representation: A large reddish orange planet with darker bands and stars. 
  • What It Says About Your Friendship: Big presence, upbeat tone. Interactions lean fun, even if the frequency dips here and there. 

Saturn: your sixth closest friend

  • Meaning: Saturn represents the sixth spot in your lineup. 
  • Visual Representation: An orange planet with a ring and stars. Easy to spot. 
  • What It Says About Your Friendship: This is a steady, supportive friend. You may not chat every day, but you can count on them for meaningful conversations and advice.

Uranus: your seventh closest friend

  • Meaning: Uranus is assigned to the seventh most active friend. 
  • Visual Representation: A green planet, usually without hearts. Clean look. 
  • What It Says About Your Friendship: Less frequent pings, but the topics hit different. Always an interesting angle when a chat starts.

Neptune: your eighth closest friend

  • Meaning: Neptune anchors the last slot in the set, the eighth closest friend. 
  • Visual Representation: A blue planet, often shown as cool or distant, with minimal decoration. 
  • What It Says About Your Friendship: Rare activity, still a real link. Think old friend, occasional check ins, or a streak that drifts in and out. 

Key Points to Remember:

  • The order can shift as your interactions change over time. 
  • The planet art makes it easy to scan and spot who ranks where. 
  • It is a lighthearted way to see who orbits closest to your Sun, and who has drifted toward Neptune. 

How does snapchat decide your planet ranking?

Snapchat does not randomly assign planets. There is a method behind it, and once you know what actually moves the needle, you can understand why someone shows up as your Mercury one week and slides to Mars the next.

Here are the five factors Snapchat weighs when building your Friend Solar System, roughly in order of importance:

  • Snap frequency (highest weight): Sending and receiving snaps back and forth is still the single biggest factor in your planet ranking. Photo or video, quick or long — it all counts. The more snaps you exchange with someone in a given period, the closer their planet sits to your Sun. I have noticed that even a few days of heavy snapping can pull someone up two or three spots on my own list.
  • Chat consistency: Snaps alone will not get you to Mercury. Snapchat also tracks how often and how long you two are actually chatting. Short, regular check-ins count. So do longer conversations. What matters most is that they happen consistently, not just in one big burst.
  • Story replies and reactions: Viewing a story silently does nothing for your ranking. But replying to it or reacting with an emoji does. Snapchat counts these as meaningful interactions, and over time they add up. If you want to move up in someone’s solar system without sending a direct snap, engaging with their stories is one of the quieter ways to do it.
  • Streak maintenance: The longer your streak with someone, the more Snapchat treats that relationship as an active one. Streaks that have been running for months carry more weight than a streak you started last Tuesday. Letting a streak break does not immediately drop you off the planet list, but a consistent streak signals ongoing closeness.
  • Two-way engagement: This one trips people up. Snapchat is looking for mutual interaction, not one-sided effort. If you snap someone constantly but they rarely snap back, your ranking in their solar system will stay low regardless of how active you are. The planet positions are based on the interaction between both users, not just your own output.

The ranking updates regularly, so positions can shift day to day depending on who you have been most active with recently.

How to interpret the planet emojis in your friendships

  • Always moving: Rankings are not fixed. Activity rises and dips, so a friend can slide from Mercury to Mars, then bounce back the next day. That movement is part of the fun, and yes, sometimes the drama. Late replies, weekend trips, or a streak that breaks at midnight can nudge positions fast. 
  • Personal and private: Only you can see planet positions inside your solar system, and your spot in someone else’s orbit can look completely different. The view lives in your account, so it stays personal, only if you choose to show it to someone does it become shared. Quiet, a little mysterious, and meant for you. 
  • Emotional impact: A tiny thrill, or a tiny sting, when status shifts. Most changes reflect recent activity, not the full history or depth of a friendship. One quiet week can push someone outward. A streak revival can pull them closer. If emotions spike, iOS Focus or a short notification break can help reset the vibe. 
  • A playful metaphor: Planets act like a gamified shortcut for interaction volume. It reflects how much you two connect, not the true worth of the relationship. Treat it like a scoreboard you glance at, not a judge of real life. Keep it light and enjoy the visual. 

How to enable or disable the friend solar system in snapchat

Here is the key part. Snapchat Planets sits behind Snapchat Plus, the premium subscription with extra insights and cosmetic touches.

To enable:

  1. Subscribe to Snapchat Plus.
  2. Open Snapchat on iPhone and tap your profile icon in the top left. 
  3. Scroll to the Snapchat+ section.
  4. Find the “Friend Solar System” option and toggle it ON. The badge appears on profiles when this switch is active.

To disable:

  • Repeat the same steps and toggle the feature OFF. The badges disappear right away.

Note: The feature starts OFF for new subscribers, so you stay in control from the first day. On my iPhone, I see the toggle near other Snapchat+ switches.

How to check your position in a friend’s snapchat solar system

Ready to check your cosmic status? Here is the quick path to see your planet in a friend’s universe: 

  1. Open a friend’s profile: Go to your friend list and select the friend you want to check. You can also tap the chat header to jump into their profile card. 
  2. Find the “Best Friends” or “Friends” badge: 
    • Best Friends badge, you both sit in each other’s top 8. 
    • Friends badge, you are in their top 8, but they are not in yours. 
  3. Tap the badge: The screen reveals which planet you represent in their solar system, from Mercury through Neptune. 

Note: Only you can see the planets in your own universe. They can see their view of you by checking your profile, and only if both of you use Snapchat Plus. If either account is not on Plus, the planet view stays hidden. 

Tips to improve your planet position

Aiming for Mercury, or just trying to move up a couple of spots? The good news is that the ranking system responds to real behaviour, so consistent effort in the right areas actually works. Here is what to focus on:

  • Send snaps daily, not in one big batch: Snap frequency matters most, and daily activity is weighted higher than sending twenty snaps in one afternoon. Keep it casual. A quick photo or a ten-second video of something you saw on the way to work is enough. The goal is regularity.
  • Reply to their stories instead of just viewing them: This is one of the most underrated moves. A quick reaction or a one-line reply counts as an interaction and costs you almost no effort. I started doing this more intentionally and noticed faster movement in my own solar system within a week.
  • Keep the chat going, even briefly: You do not need hour-long conversations. Even a short exchange, a few messages back and forth, counts toward your chat consistency score. Check in after a story you reacted to, or send a follow-up to a snap. Small touchpoints add up.
  • Do not let your streak lapse: If you already have a streak with someone, protect it. Long streaks can help in the ranking, and once they break, you lose that accumulated signal. Set a reminder if you need one. A streak that has been going for six months is doing quiet work in your ranking even on days you are not very active.
  • Be consistent over time, not intense for a week: The biggest mistake people make is going all-in for a few days then going quiet. Snapchat’s system rewards steady, ongoing interaction more than short bursts of activity. Think of it less like sprinting and more like showing up regularly.

If you do all five of these things with a specific person, expect to see noticeable movement in your planet position within two to three weeks.

Privacy and user concerns about snapchat planets

The feature adds a fun, competitive edge to social time. It also raises a few things worth thinking through: 

  • Personal rankings are private: Only you can view planet positions in your solar system. You can only see your own place in someone else’s system by checking their profile, and only if both of you have Snapchat Plus. 
  • Opt in and control: Friend Solar System starts off. You enable it in settings, and you can turn it off at any moment if visible rankings feel uncomfortable. The choice stays with you. 
  • Emotional impact: Some people feel anxious or competitive around rankings. If it starts to affect mood or relationships, switch it off or shift attention back to real world chats and plans. 
  • No manual adjustment: You cannot set or move planets yourself. Rankings come from Snapchat’s algorithm and your interaction patterns, which means the system moves with your behavior. 
  • Data use: Snap and chat activity informs rankings, but details are not shared publicly outside your private solar view. The screenshots you share are your call, not the app’s. 

Snapchat plus pricing and subscription guide 2026

Snapchat Planets are exclusive to Snapchat Plus subscribers.

  • A free trial (usually 7 days) is often available.
  • Prices may vary by region and are subject to change.

How to subscribe for snapchat plus

  1. Download Snapchat.
  2. Sign up or log in.
  3. Go to your profile.
  4. Tap Snapchat+.
  5. Choose your plan and activate your free trial if available.
  6. Add your payment method and confirm.

Final thoughts

Snapchat Planets turns your friend list into a playful little universe, a view that makes close connections feel visible and just a bit competitive. If you use Snapchat Plus, explore your own system and see who is nearest. Just remember, real friendships are bigger than snaps, streaks, or rankings. 

Whether you are aiming for Mercury or just curious about your orbit, enjoy the ride and keep your circle in the loop with snaps. React to stories, send a quick note, share moments that matter. Check the planets, smile, then live your day. Your universe is yours to shape.

FAQs

Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

How often do Snapchat Planets update?

Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site. 

Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time. 

Can I use Snapchat Planets without Snapchat Plus?

No. Friend Solar System is exclusive to Snapchat Plus subscribers.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

step.text: You’re always the Sun in your solar system.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Minecraft Curse of Vanishing: Effects, uses, and how to keep items

content.rendered:
Minecraft has plenty of useful enchantments for swords and armour that can give you a serious boost. However, not every enchantment is designed to help you, and the Curse of Vanishing is a perfect example.

This rather mischievous enchantment can make your valuable gear disappear under specific circumstances. But what exactly does Curse of Vanishing do in Minecraft, how can you get it, and is there a way to remove it? Here’s everything you need to know.

What does Curse of Vanishing do in Minecraft?

The Curse of Vanishing is an enchantment in Minecraft that makes any item carrying it disappear permanently when you die. That’s right! Instead of dropping your enchanted weapon, armor, or tool on the ground for you to retrieve later, the item will vanish entirely and won’t be available when you respawn.

This enchantment can be applied to swords, pickaxes, armor, and several other valuable items in the game. Since Java Edition 26.1, the enchantment also works on armour stands. However, keep in mind that the Curse of Vanishing only takes effect if you die while carrying the enchanted item. If you make use of Minecraft commands and enable the Keep Inventory rule, the curse won’t work.

Curse of Vanishing at a glance: Java vs. Bedrock

The Curse of Vanishing functions similarly in Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition, although there are a few differences in its loot sources and identification. Here’s a quick comparison of how the enchantment works in both editions:

How to get Curse of Vanishing in Minecraft

Curse of Vanishing cannot be obtained through a regular enchanting table. However, there are several other ways to get your hands on this enchantment in Minecraft:

  1. Loot chests: Make sure to search chests in Ancient Cities, Dungeons, Desert Pyramids, Strongholds, and Woodland Mansions, as they can contain enchanted books with Curse of Vanishing.
  2. Trading with Librarians: Librarian villagers can offer enchanted books with Curse of Vanishing in exchange for Emeralds. Keep checking their trades until you find the enchantment.
  3. Fishing: You have a small chance of catching an enchanted book with Curse of Vanishing while fishing. Using the Luck of the Sea enchantment can improve your chance of finding treasure.
  4. Raid drops: Rain-related drops in Bedrock Edition can allow you to obtain enchanted equipment with Curse of Vanishing.

After you’ve managed to find an enchanted Curse of Vanishing, all you need to do is use an anvil and combine it with your desired weapon, tool, or armour piece.

Can you remove Curse of Vanishing?

Unfortunately, you cannot remove Curse of Vanishing from an enchanted weapon, tool, or armor piece through normal survival gameplay.

Neither a Grindstone nor an Anvil can remove the curse. A Grindstone can remove other enchantments, but curses remain on the item.

Your best option is to protect the cursed item before entering dangerous areas. Store it safely when you don’t need it, or use one of the methods below to prevent it from disappearing when you die.

How to keep items with Curse of Vanishing when you die

As we’ve said, Curse of Vanishing will automatically delete your items from the world when you die. However, there are still a few ways to save your gear:

  1. Store in containers: If you have a sword, armour, pickaxe, or any other gear enchanted with Curse of Vanishing, make sure to store it in an Ender Chest, Shulker box, or Bundle before you head into a dangerous area.
  2. Enable Keep Inventory: Make use of Minecraft commands and enable the Keep Inventory rule.
  3. Totem of Undying: A Totem of Undying can save you from death by preventing a fatal hit and restoring some health. Since you don’t actually die when the totem activates, your cursed equipment won’t disappear either.

What is Curse of Vanishing useful for?

Curse of Vanishing can be useful in multiplayer Minecraft servers, particularly when you don’t want other players to collect your valuable gear after killing you.

For example, if you’re carrying a powerful sword or enchanted armor during PvP, the curse prevents your opponent from picking up that equipment after your death. It can also make looted gear less useful to other players.

However, it’s generally a poor choice for regular survival and PvE gameplay. Losing a valuable weapon, tool, or armor piece permanently can be frustrating, especially if you’ve spent hours upgrading it.

Unless you have a specific multiplayer strategy in mind, it’s better to avoid applying Curse of Vanishing to your best equipment.

Wrapping up

Curse of Vanishing can be useful in multiplayer PvP if you don’t want opponents to collect your valuable gear after defeating you. However, for regular survival gameplay, I recommend avoiding this enchantment on your best weapons, tools, and armor. The risk of permanently losing upgraded equipment simply isn’t worth it for most players.

If you already own a cursed item, keep it in an Ender Chest or Shulker Box whenever you don’t need it. My recommendation is to use Curse of Vanishing only when preventing other players from obtaining your gear matters more than keeping the item yourself.

FAQs

Does Curse of Vanishing work in an Ender Chest?

Curse of Vanishing does not affect items stored inside an Ender Chest. The enchantment only works when you die while carrying the cursed item in your inventory or equipped slots.

Is it worth keeping a cursed Mending pickaxe?

Even if your Mending pickaxe is cursed, it’s worth keeping it. Mending allows your pickaxe to repair itself using XP orbs, which will make it last longer

Does Keep Inventory stop it?

Enabling the Keep Inventory game rule prevents the Curse of Vanishing from activating when you die. This means you will retain all of your enchanted tools, weapons, and armor.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

title.rendered: How to make and use Tinted Glass in Minecraft

content.rendered:
Building a new mansion or designing your dream house in Minecraft? Regular glass is a reliable choice, but there’s another block worth considering: Tinted Glass. It looks like dark glass and has one major advantage: it blocks light from passing through while still allowing you to see what’s on the other side.

This makes it useful for decorative builds, dark rooms, and certain mob farm designs. If you want to add it to your inventory, here’s everything you need to know about finding the materials, crafting Tinted Glass, and using it in Minecraft.

What is tinted glass in Minecraft?

As we’ve explained above, tinted glass is a unique, see-through block in Minecraft that prevents light from passing through it. The block was added in the Caves & Cliffs Part 1 update and has a darker appearance. The tinted glass is incredibly useful when building dark rooms, mob farms, or structures where you want visibility without letting light through.

What you need to craft tinted glass

Before you begin crafting tinted glass in Minecraft, you’ll need to head out in the wild and gather a few essential materials. The recipe for this block is quite simple, and it just needs two items in particular:

  • x4 Amethyst Shards
  • x2 Glass Blocks

Of course, you’ll also need to set up a crafting table to put everything together. Keep in mind that each tinted glass block consumes 1 glass block and 2 amethyst shards. So, if you’re planning to craft 32 tinted glass blocks, you will need 32 glass blocks and 64 amethyst shards.

How to get amethyst shards

In order to get amethyst shards in Minecraft, you’ll first need to find an amethyst geode. These tend to generate underground in the Overworld, usually between Y-level -58 and 30. Once you find one, dig through the outer layers of smooth basalt and calcite to reach the amethyst crystals.

Look for a fully grown amethyst cluster attached to the blocks. Pull out your pickaxe and start mining these clusters to collect shards. Each fully grown cluster drops four shards when mined with a regular pickaxe. However, if you use a pickaxe enchanted with Fortune II, you can collect up to eight shards from a single cluster.

How to make glass

Making glass in Minecraft is quite easy. You’ll need some sand, a furnace, and fuel to get started. Once you’ve gathered everything, follow these steps:

  1. Open the furnace and place coal, charcoal, or wood in the bottom slot as fuel.
  2. Place your sand blocks in the top slot.
  3. Wait for the smelting process to finish.
  4. Once smelted, move the glass blocks from the furnace to your inventory.

How to craft tinted glass (step by step)

Have you collected all the required materials? It’s time to craft tinted glass. Just follow these steps:

  1. Open a Crafting Table to access the 3×3 crafting grid.
  2. Place one Glass block in the center slot.
  3. Place one Amethyst Shard directly above, below, to the left, and to the right of the Glass block.
  4. Collect the 2 Tinted Glass blocks that appear in the result slot.
  5. Move the crafted blocks into your inventory.

That’s it! You can repeat the recipe as many times as needed, provided you have enough Glass blocks and Amethyst Shards.

Tinted glass vs glass vs stained glass

Best ways to use Tinted Glass in Minecraft

So, now you finally know how to craft tinted glass in Minecraft. However, how are you supposed to use it? Well, after experimenting with the block for hundreds of hours, here are some uses we’ve come up with –

  1. Build aquariums – If you’re building an aquarium or underwater base, you should use tinted glass. This will allow you to look at surrounding water and aquatic mobs while giving your structures inside a darker appearance.
  2. Mob farms – As tinted glass blocks light, you can use it to build mob farms. The mobs will continue to spawn inside, and you can still keep an eye on them inside.
  3. Secret rooms – Tinted glass helps with creating viewing panels in secret rooms without making them glow from the outside.

Wrapping up

In our opinion, tinted glass is one of the best decorative blocks in Minecraft, as it not only looks cool but also offers practical uses for your builds. It doesn’t matter if you’re building a modern mansion, creating hidden rooms, or setting up mob farms; its ability to block all light while remaining completely see-through makes it a fantastic addition to any inventory.

The glass block is easy to craft, so gather your materials, head to a crafting table, and start experimenting in your next Minecraft build. Don’t want to put in the effort to make tinted glass? Well, it’s time to make use of Minecraft commands and switch to creative mode for easy access.

FAQs

Is tinted glass craftable in Bedrock?

Tinted glass is craftable in both Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition. The crafting recipe is exactly the same in both versions, where you need x1 glass block and x2 amethyst shards using a crafting table.

Do you need Silk Touch for tinted glass?

Unlike regular glass, tinted glass does not need the Silk Touch enchantment to be collected. You can break it using any tool or even your bare hands.

Can mobs spawn on tinted glass?

No. Tinted Glass is not a valid spawning surface for ordinary hostile mobs. You can use it as part of a mob farm’s viewing walls, but make sure the actual spawning platforms meet the required conditions.

Can you see through Tinted Glass in Minecraft?

Yes. Tinted Glass is transparent, so you can see through it. However, it has a darker appearance than regular Glass and blocks light from passing through.

Does Tinted Glass stop a beacon beam?

Yes. Tinted Glass blocks beacon beams from passing through it. If you want your beacon to activate, make sure there are no Tinted Glass blocks obstructing the beam above it.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

mainEntity.name: Is tinted glass craftable in Bedrock?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tinted glass is craftable in both Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition. The crafting recipe is exactly the same in both versions, where you need x1 glass block and x2 amethyst shards using a crafting table.

mainEntity.name: Do you need Silk Touch for tinted glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlike regular glass, tinted glass does not need the Silk Touch enchantment to be collected. You can break it using any tool or even your bare hands.

mainEntity.name: Can mobs spawn on tinted glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Tinted Glass is not a valid spawning surface for ordinary hostile mobs. You can use it as part of a mob farm's viewing walls, but make sure the actual spawning platforms meet the required conditions.

mainEntity.name: Can you see through Tinted Glass in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tinted Glass is transparent, so you can see through it. However, it has a darker appearance than regular Glass and blocks light from passing through.

mainEntity.name: Does Tinted Glass stop a beacon beam?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tinted Glass blocks beacon beams from passing through it. If you want your beacon to activate, make sure there are no Tinted Glass blocks obstructing the beam above it.

title.rendered: Grok Bot vs ChatGPT Dots vs Claude Duet: Which can you use today?

content.rendered:
As of November 2026, Grok Bot is the easiest to start: it’s out of beta, and its $30 Premium plan includes it. ChatGPT Dots need a $100-plus Pro plan and skip Pro users in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland. Claude Duet is a US-only waitlist for Pro, Max, and Ultra.

However, choosing between them is not just about which one has the most features. Subscription requirements, regional availability, integrations, usage limits, and approval controls can make a significant difference.

Here’s how Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots, and Claude Duet compare.

Quick answer: which AI agent can you use today?

Grok Bot is the only one you can sign up for today without a waitlist, and xAI’s page names no country limit for it. Dots need Pro or Business Premium. Duet needs a Pro, Max, or Ultra plan, a US account, and a waitlist invite.

You can’t use Claude Duet in India or the UK. Duet is US-only during the research preview. Dots Pro is closed in the UK, Switzerland, and the EEA, but OpenAI’s docs don’t exclude India.

Grok Bot vs Dots vs Claude Duet at a glance

Dots lives inside ChatGPT and reaches into Slack and Teams, and you can watch its browser. Duet has the clearest approval rules, but it’s US-only and runs on a model you can’t change.

What is each agent?

Grok Bot

Grok Bot runs bots on its own cloud computers. You give a bot a task by chat in the Grok Bot app, and it signs into your tools and works through the steps. The app is the most finished part of the product. It’s clean on desktop and iOS, and you can create several bots, so work and personal tasks don’t have to share one bot.

xAI’s page says it works on desktop, iOS, Slack, and Teams. Team Bots are a separate public beta for Teams and Enterprise plans.

The password box stands out. You paste a password or access token into a secure box, and the bot can use it without seeing it. xAI’s Grok Bot page doesn’t describe this box, so confirm it before you rely on it.

ChatGPT Dots

A dot is OpenAI’s always-on agent. Each one gets its own cloud computer and browser, so it can keep working when your computer is off. You can watch the browser or take over whenever you want. In Slack, you DM it or mention it in a channel. Adding it to a channel doesn’t make it watch that channel, so you need to tell it which channels and events to watch. It uses the plugins you’ve turned on.

Claude Duet

Claude Duet is a personal agent you message like a person. It checks your connected accounts every few hours, sends you a morning summary of your email and calendar, and asks before it sends a message, makes a payment, signs a document, or deletes anything.

Which models and connectors do you get?

Duet runs on Opus 5.5, and you can’t switch it. Dots run on GPT-6.1 Terra, according to OpenAI’s docs. GPT-6 Astra appears only as the source of the safeguards Terra uses. OpenAI’s docs don’t mention a model picker for Dots, and xAI doesn’t name Grok Bot’s model or say whether you can choose one.

Connectors are where the three reach into your work. Grok Bot’s page names only two examples, Gmail and LinkedIn. xAI says its bots sign into tools that have no clean API or MCP, but it doesn’t list them. Dots use the plugins you turn on. OpenAI’s docs name Gmail, Google Drive, and GitHub, and launch coverage says more than 4,000 apps. Anthropic claims more than 6,000 connectors for Duet and names Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Slack, QuickBooks, HubSpot, DocuSign, and Calendly. Duet doesn’t support Microsoft 365 yet.

How much does each cost?

Your allowance is where the three differ most day to day. Grok Bot runs on a weekly allowance, and extra usage is billed at token cost. Dot chats don’t count toward ChatGPT limits. Duet uses your Claude plan’s limits, including the background checks and the morning brief. Until you’ve checked your own usage, treat Grok Bot as the tightest of the three.

Are ChatGPT Dots free? No. Dots come with Pro and Business Premium. Launch coverage says the first dot is included at no extra cost on those plans.

Is Grok Bot free? No. The cheapest plan on xAI’s page is Premium at $30 a month, and the page doesn’t list a free trial.

If you’re weighing ChatGPT Plus against Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus vs. Claude Pro covers that choice.

How to get access to each AI agent

How to access Grok Bot

  1. Choose Premium, Super, or Ultra on grok.com.
  2. If you already have an eligible plan, Grok Bot is included, so sign in with that plan.
  3. On a Mac, use the “Download for macOS” button.

Teams and Enterprise work differently. Enterprise needs a sales contact. Once you’re set up, see Best Grok Bot plugins and skills to add tools.

How to access ChatGPT Dots

Dots are rolling out gradually, so availability varies. Pro is open to users 18 and older outside the EEA, the UK, and Switzerland.

  1. Get Pro or Business Premium.
  2. In the ChatGPT mobile app, desktop app, or desktop browser, create your dot.
  3. Name it and pick its look. The name also sets its handle.
  4. Optional: connect your computer from the dot’s profile. Your computer needs to stay on with the ChatGPT app open.

On a phone, use the latest ChatGPT mobile app. You can name the dot, customize it, and connect plugins there. Mobile web isn’t supported.

How to access Claude Duet

Claude Duet focuses on proactive assistance rather than simply responding to individual requests.

  1. Open the Claude Duet page at claude.com/product/claude-duet and select “Join the waitlist.”
  2. Enter your name and the email on your Claude account, choose your plan and phone type, and submit.
  3. Wait for the invitation email. Invites go out in waves, and joining doesn’t guarantee a date.
  4. Install Duet on iPhone or Android from the invitation.

What can they actually do?

Morning brief from Gmail and Calendar

  • Duet sends a morning summary of your email and calendar.
  • Dots can reach Gmail through the plugins you turn on.
  • Grok Bot’s material doesn’t describe a morning brief.

Inbox cleanup

  • Duet can send emails from connected accounts, after your approval.
  • Dots can find relevant email through its Gmail plugin.
  • Grok Bot’s example is processing invoices that arrive in Gmail.

Booking or web form

  • Duet can pay with Shop Pay or Link in the US, and each payment needs your approval first.
  • Dots has a visible browser, and you can take over any step.
  • Grok Bot signs into websites, including ones with no API. xAI doesn’t explain how.

Duet is the most specific about what it will and won’t do. Dots shows you its work. Grok Bot’s page gives the fewest specifics.

Safety, approvals and limits

Approvals are where the three behave most differently, so read them before you connect a payment or email account.

Duet asks before it sends, pays, signs, or deletes. It won’t trade securities or move money between accounts, even if you approve. Shop Pay and Link use one-time cards limited to the approved amount. Duet can see the card type, last four digits, nickname, expiry date, and shipping addresses, but not the full card number. Both payment options are US only. For a website that asks for a password, you type it into a separate form on your device, and the browser is designed to keep it out of your chat with Duet.

Dots sorts each step into one of three buckets: allowed, needs your approval, or handed back to you. Its background research is read-only. Sensitive steps, such as changing a password, stay with you. Custom rules let you set your own limits for each action, but they can’t override OpenAI’s built-in safeguards.

Grok Bot’s bots come back to you when something needs approval. xAI doesn’t say which actions count. For an agent that signs into your accounts, that gap matters, so don’t give it client email or money access until xAI explains it.

Which one I’d pick

Grok Bot is the one I’d try first. It’s the only one you can sign up for today without a waitlist, and the app is the most polished of the three. The model is the catch. You can’t choose it, and xAI doesn’t say what runs underneath. Plan around the weekly allowance.

Duet is the one I’d pick if you’re a US professional already on Claude Pro, Max, or Ultra. Its approval rules are the clearest of the three, and there’s no extra charge during the research preview. Daily use still feels less refined than Grok Bot.

Dots is the one I’d pick if your team already lives in Slack or Teams and you’re on Pro or Business Premium. You can watch its browser and take over any step, which matters when an agent is clicking through your tools. Daily use still feels rougher than Grok Bot too.

If you don’t pay for any of them yet, wait. None has a free tier, and none is worth a new subscription on its own. Before you connect a payment or email account to any of them, read its approval rules.

FAQs

Can I use Claude Duet in India?

No. Duet is US-only during the research preview, and it needs a Pro, Max, or Ultra plan and a waitlist invitation.

Is Grok Bot still in beta?

No. xAI’s Grok Bot page says it’s out of beta.

Does Claude Duet cost extra?

Not during the research preview. It uses your plan’s limits, including background checks and the morning brief.

Do Dots count against my ChatGPT limits?

Dot chats don’t, on Pro and Business Premium. Tasks a dot starts in Work or Codex do count.

Can I choose the AI model?

Not in Duet, which runs on Opus 5.5. OpenAI’s docs don’t mention a model picker for Dots, and xAI doesn’t say whether Grok Bot lets you choose one.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

mainEntity.name: Do you need Silk Touch for tinted glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlike regular glass, tinted glass does not need the Silk Touch enchantment to be collected. You can break it using any tool or even your bare hands.

mainEntity.name: Can mobs spawn on tinted glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Tinted Glass is not a valid spawning surface for ordinary hostile mobs. You can use it as part of a mob farm's viewing walls, but make sure the actual spawning platforms meet the required conditions.

mainEntity.name: Can you see through Tinted Glass in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tinted Glass is transparent, so you can see through it. However, it has a darker appearance than regular Glass and blocks light from passing through.

mainEntity.name: Does Tinted Glass stop a beacon beam?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tinted Glass blocks beacon beams from passing through it. If you want your beacon to activate, make sure there are no Tinted Glass blocks obstructing the beam above it.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Claude Duet in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Duet is US-only during the research preview, and it needs a Pro, Max, or Ultra plan and a waitlist invitation.

mainEntity.name: Is Grok Bot still in beta?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. xAI's Grok Bot page says it's out of beta.

mainEntity.name: Does Claude Duet cost extra?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not during the research preview. It uses your plan's limits, including background checks and the morning brief.

mainEntity.name: Do Dots count against my ChatGPT limits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dot chats don't, on Pro and Business Premium. Tasks a dot starts in Work or Codex do count.

mainEntity.name: Can I choose the AI model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not in Duet, which runs on Opus 5.5. OpenAI's docs don't mention a model picker for Dots, and xAI doesn't say whether Grok Bot lets you choose one.
