title.rendered: How to get the One Piece-themed IShowSpeed skin in Fortnite

content.rendered:
Popular streamer IShowSpeed has returned to Fortnite with a new outfit inspired by the One Piece universe. Released on November 14 as part of the Treasure Hunters mini-season, the Pirate Speedy skin quickly gained attention in the Fortnite Item Shop.

You can purchase the Pirate Speedy outfit for 1,500 V-Bucks or get the complete Pirate Speedy Bundle for 1,800 V-Bucks. The bundle includes additional cosmetics inspired by IShowSpeed, including a back bling, pickaxe, and emote.

The cosmetics are available in the Item Shop until November 20 at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET, according to the current listing details. Here’s how to get the outfit, what’s included in the bundle, and whether you can unlock it for free.

How to get the IShowSpeed Pirate Speedy skin in Fortnite

You can purchase IShowSpeed’s Pirate Speedy outfit directly from the Fortnite Item Shop.

Follow these steps:

  1. In Fortnite, navigate to the Shop tab.
  2. Next, scroll down to the IShowSpeed section and select Pirate Speedy.
  3. Lastly, press and hold the Purchase button to finalize the transaction.

Once the purchase is successful, the cosmetics will be added to your locker.

IShowSpeed’s Pirate Speedy Bundle: All items and their prices

1. Pirate Speedy outfit

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Bonus item: Speed’s Coin back bling
  • Skin also included in: Pirate Speedy Bundle

2. Speed’s Coin back bling

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Skin also included in: Pirate Speedy Bundle

3. Speed’s Pirate Blade pickaxe

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Skin also included in: Pirate Speedy Bundle

4. IShowFlip emote

  • Price: 400 V-Bucks
  • Skin also included in: Pirate Speedy Bundle

Can you get the IShowSpeed One Piece skin for free?

Yes, but there is only one way. To get the Pirate Speedy skin and nearly everything else in the Item Shop for free, you need to be lucky enough to obtain the Pirate Shop Access, aka Pirate Shop token.

This item is an extremely rare find available in the Treasure Chest loot pool in Fortnite. Once found from a chest, it must be activated in the Item Shop, after which it makes essentially every cosmetic item free for a span of 14 days.

Notably, there are two Pirate Shop tokens, one for 2026 and one for 2027. While the former can be activated at any point by December 15, 2026, the latter can be used anytime between January 1, 2026 and December 15, 2027.

What does the Pirate Speedy skin look like?

The new IShowSpeed skin’s art style borrows noticeably from anime and reimagines the American internet celeb in the form of a One Piece pirate. The outfit is complemented by a pickaxe bearing the jersey number often worn by him, an emote directly inspired by his iconic backflips and barking antics, and a shield sporting Speed’s initial.

The Pirate Speedy skin certainly does a commendable job of showing what the online personality would look like if he were to make an appearance in the One Piece anime. The dagger strapped around the waist, rolled-up pants, unbuttoned shirt, and the big lightning bolt-shaped scar put together a believable One Piece pirate look.

Pirate Speedy Bundle vs. the original IShowSpeed Icon Bundle

The Pirate Speedy Bundle is a comparatively smaller bundle than the original IShowSpeed Icon Bundle, which rolled out in December 2025. The former is a One Piece-themed pack headlined by a single skin, whereas the latter includes a pair of skins, one of which is based on IShowSpeed’s real-life likeness and the other is an original IShowSpeed skin designed by Epic Games.

On one hand, the Pirate Speedy Bundle has just four items in total. On the other hand, the original Icon Bundle starring the famed YouTuber contained 10 items, which included two skins, two back blings, two pickaxes, a glider, an emote, a wrap, and a jam track. Naturally, the newest bundle is 1,200 V-Bucks cheaper than the older one.

So, while the new bundle might be significantly trimmed down in terms of content for IShowSpeed fans, it certainly holds value for those who are fond of anime-style skins and for those who prefer celeb skins that sport an original design.

Other One Piece skins in Fortnite right now

1. Monkey D. Luffy

  • Price: 1,800 V-Bucks
  • Bonus items: Luffy’s Straw Hat back bling, Gum-Gum Pistol pickaxe, Multi-punches Flex emote
  • Skin also included in: One Piece Bundle

2. Nami

  • Price: 1,600 V-Bucks
  • Bonus items: Nami’s Tangerines back bling, Climate Baton pickaxe
  • Skin also included in: One Piece Bundle

3. Usopp

  • Price: 1,600 V-Bucks
  • Bonus items: Usopp’s Kit back bling, 5 Ton Hammer pickaxe
  • Skin also included in: One Piece Bundle

4. Sanji

  • Price: 1,600 V-Bucks
  • Bonus items: Sanji’s Utensils back bling and pickaxe
  • Skin also included in: One Piece Bundle

5. Roronoa Zoro

  • Price: 1,800 V-Bucks
  • Bonus items: Zoro’s Swords pickaxe, Zoro’s Training Gear back bling, Test Of Will emote
  • Skin also included in: One Piece Bundle

6. Buggy

  • Price: 1,600 V-Bucks
  • Bonus items: Buggy’s Coat back bling, Buggy Knives pickaxe

Final thoughts

IShowSpeed’s Pirate Speedy skin brings a fun One Piece-inspired twist to Fortnite, giving fans another way to add the popular streamer to their locker. While the 1,500 V-Bucks outfit already includes Speed’s Coin back bling, the 1,800 V-Bucks bundle is a better deal if you also want the Pirate Blade pickaxe and IShowFlip emote.

If you’re a fan of IShowSpeed or anime-themed cosmetics, Pirate Speedy is worth checking out before it leaves the Item Shop.

FAQs

Is Pirate Speedy an Icon Series skin?

Yes, Pirate Speedy belongs to the Icon Series lineup of celeb skins in Fortnite.

Is the IShowSpeed One Piece skin a Luffy skin?

No, it isn’t a Luffy skin but a skin modeled around IShowSpeed himself with a unique One Piece-styled twist.

Can I gift Pirate Speedy?

Yes, you can gift Pirate Speedy to any Fortnite friend by using the “Gift” option next to the “Purchase” button.

Does the outfit come with the back bling?

Yes, the Pirate Speedy outfit comes with the Speed’s Coin back bling for free.

Will Pirate Speedy come back?

Given IShowSpeed’s skins and similar celeb skins have often returned at some point in the future after their first sale, it is reasonable to expect the same will happen in Pirate Speedy’s case as well.

acceptedAnswer.text: No. GTA 6 limits your active firearm loadout to two sidearms and two longarms. You also have separate slots for melee weapons and other equipment.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

title.rendered: Roll a Barber RNG codes (November 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Roll a Barber RNG codes on November 16, 2026

Looking for free Luck and Roll Speed boosts in Roll a Barber RNG? Redeeming codes can help you roll for rare barbers, earn more money, and upgrade your shop faster.

Roll a Barber RNG is a Roblox tycoon game where you roll for different barbers, assign them to work in your shop, and earn money from their services. Since finding rare barbers can take plenty of attempts, Luck boosts are particularly useful. Some codes also offer Roll Speed and Money boosts to help you progress faster.

Here are all the latest Roll a Barber RNG codes you can redeem for free rewards.

All working Roll a Barber RNG codes

  • 5KLIKES: 5x Luck for 30 minutes and 3x Roll Speed for 30 minutes (NEW)
  • 2MVISITS: 5x Luck for 15 minutes (NEW)
  • 7KCCU: 5x Luck for 15 minutes
  • 6KCCU: 5x Luck for 15 minutes
  • 60KMEMBERS: 5x Luck for 80 minutes, 2x Roll Speed for 80 minutes, 2x Money for 45 minutes
  • SORRYFORDELAY: 5x Luck for 10 minutes
  • 5KCCU: 5x Luck for 30 minutes
  • 30KMEMBERS: 3x Luck for 45 minutes
  • 500KVISITS: 5x Luck for 30 minutes
  • 3KCCU: 2x Roll Speed for 15 minutes

Expired or unverified Roll a Barber RNG codes

100KVISITS, 1400CCU, 1500LIKES, 1700CCU, 1KCCU, 1KLIKES, 2000CCU, 70KVISITS, INSANESUPPORT, LUCKYSPINS, SORRYFORTHEISSUES, THANKYOUFORTHESUPPORT

How to redeem Roll a Barber RNG codes

Codes go in the Shop, and they are case-sensitive, so copy them exactly. The Roblox page is titled Barber RNG, so check that the creator is Roll a Barber Studio.

  1. Open Roll a Barber RNG on Roblox.
  2. Select Shop on the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll down to the Codes box and enter the code.
  4. Select Redeem.

Why your Roll a Barber RNG code is not working

  • Check for typos and letter case. Copy and paste the code instead of retyping it.
  • The code has expired. Check the expired or unverified list above first.
  • You already redeemed it on your account.
  • The boost did not apply. Rejoin on a different server and check again.

Trackers disagree on a few codes. Most list 1500LIKES and 3KCCU as working, but Destructoid lists both as expired, so they stay in the unverified list and are worth trying last. 2MVISITS and 5KCCU also have conflicting boost details, so the list above uses the version most trackers report.

Where to find more Roll a Barber RNG codes

Most code trackers point to the Roll a Barber RNG Discord for new drops. Roll a Barber Studio also runs the Roblox group.

If you like RNG rolls, check out our Slime RNG codes and Grow a Plant codes, or browse our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

  • Razer Naga V3 Pro Gaming Mouse

  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

title.rendered: 4 Ways to prepare your PS5 and Xbox for faster GTA 6 downloads

content.rendered:
GTA 6 is expected to be a massive download, with reports suggesting that its PS5 version could require around 210 GB of storage. That’s a considerable amount of data, particularly if you’re using a slow or unstable internet connection.

If you’re planning to play GTA 6 as soon as it becomes available, waiting hours for the download to finish is probably the last thing you want. Fortunately, there are several ways to improve your console’s connection stability, reduce unnecessary bandwidth usage, and avoid interruptions during installation.

In this guide, we’ll show you how to improve GTA 6 download speeds on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, along with a few additional tips to prepare your console before launch.

Best ways to speed up your GTA 6 download on PS5 and Xbox

1. Switch to an Ethernet Cable

One of the simplest ways to speed up your GTA 6 download is to connect your console to the router using an Ethernet cable. Sure, Wi-Fi is convenient, but your connection can suffer due to various factors such as distance, walls and interference from nearby devices. Using a wired connection helps, as you won’t face unexpected network drops and will be able to maintain more consistent download speeds.

Don’t have an Ethernet cable? You can also try connecting the console to your router’s 5 GHz Wi-Fi band for a faster and more stable connection.

2. Pause other game downloads

Don’t make the mistake of installing other games, updates, or even applications while GTA 6 is downloading. The reason is quite simple: all these activities will compete for your available internet bandwidth. This can slow down your primary download, and you don’t want other things eating into bandwidth that should be going towards GTA 6.

To prevent this, check any ongoing downloads on your PS5 or Xbox Series X/S and pause them until GTA 6 finishes downloading. It’s also a good idea to close any running games and applications, as they can eat up system resources and affect the download performance. Here’s how you can close applications on both consoles

1. On PS5

  1. Press the PS button on your controller.
  2. Open the Control Center and switch to the active game.
  3. Highlight the game you want to close.
  4. Press the Options button on your controller.
  5. Select Close Game.

2. On Xbox Series X/S

  1. Press the Xbox button on your controller.
  2. Highlight the running game in the guide or your recent games.
  3. Press the Menu button on your controller.
  4. Select Quit to close the game.

3. Change download servers

There’s no denying that GTA 6 is one of the most anticipated games of all time, so millions of players are going to rush to download it as it launches. With so many people trying to access the game at the same time, the servers could experience heavy traffic, which means slower download speeds on your PS5 or Xbox Series X/S.

If you notice your download slowing down, what you should do is pause it for around 20-30 seconds before continuing again. This gives your console a chance to re-establish its connection and potentially connect to a less crowded server.

4. Download GTA 6 in Rest Mode

If you need to download other games or update applications during the day, you can leave GTA 6 downloading overnight using your PS5’s Rest Mode. However, before doing so, make sure your console is allowed to maintain an active internet connection while in this mode. Here’s how to set it up:

  1. Open Settings on your PS5.
  2. Select System.
  3. Go to Power Saving > Features Available in Rest Mode.
  4. Turn on Stay Connected to the Internet.
  5. Return to the home screen.
  6. Select Power > Enter Rest Mode.

Once you’ve followed the above steps, your PS5 will continue downloading GTA 6 even when you’re not actively using the console. Similarly, Xbox Series X/S have a Sleep power mode that allows your console to remain in a low-power state to download the game. Here’s how to enable it

  1. Press the Xbox button on your controller.
  2. Go to Profile & system > Settings > General.
  3. Open Power options.
  4. Select Sleep if you want the console to remain in a low-power state.

Additional tips to avoid GTA 6 download problems

Now that you know how to improve GTA 6 download speed, there are a few additional things you should keep in mind to avoid potential download issues on your PS5 or Xbox Series X/S. These simple tricks can ensure that you have a smooth downloading experience:

  • Keep enough free storage: As we’ve said earlier, GTA 6 requires 210 GB of storage on PS5. Before kicking off the download, check your available storage and delete unnecessary games or applications to make room for it.
  • Keep your console updated: Make sure your PS5 or Xbox Series X/S is running the latest available system software. Any pending firmware update can cause unexpected issues, so it’s better to install it before downloading the game.
  • Restart your router: Give your router a quick restart before downloading GTA 6. This can help establish a fresh connection and resolve any temporary network glitches that might otherwise affect your download speeds.
  • Avoid overheating: Place your PS5 or Xbox Series X/S in a well-ventilated area with enough room for proper airflow. Avoid keeping it inside an enclosed space, as excessive heat can affect the console’s performance and potentially interrupt the download speed.

Once the download finishes, use our guide to the best GTA 6 settings to set up your controls, minimap, subtitles, and accessibility options

Wrapping up

GTA 6 is a massive download, so if you’re planning to jump into the game on day one, you’ll want to get everything ready beforehand. By following the tips we’ve mentioned above, you should be able to speed up your download and get the game installed in time for its release in your region.

Still haven’t purchased GTA 6? Check out the pre-order bonuses before placing your order. And if you’re looking to save some money, don’t forget to enter KICK’s GTA 6 Ultimate Edition giveaway for a chance to win a copy.

FAQs

Why is GTA 6 downloading so slowly on PS5?

GTA 6 can take a long time to download on PS5 because of its massive file size, which is expected to be around 210 GB.

Why is GTA 6 downloading so slowly on Xbox Series X|S?

GTA 6 can take a long time to download on Xbox Series X/S because of its massive file size, which is expected to be around 210 GB.

Does using an Ethernet cable increase GTA 6 download speed?

Using an Ethernet cable can improve GTA 6 download speeds on both PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. This is because a wired connection is generally more stable than Wi-Fi and helps your console maintain a consistent connection to the internet.

Should I pause other downloads while installing GTA 6?

You should pause other downloads while you’re installing GTA 6 on your PS5 or Xbox Series S/X. Running multiple downloads divides your available internet bandwidth, which can slow down GTA 6’s download speed.

Does changing DNS make GTA 6 download faster?

Changing your DNS doesn’t increase your internet speed. However, it can speed up GTA 6 downloads if your Internet Service Provider’s (ISP) default DNS server is congested or slow at resolving server addresses during heavy launch traffic.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

mainEntity.name: Does using an Ethernet cable increase GTA 6 download speed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using an Ethernet cable can improve GTA 6 download speeds on both PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. This is because a wired connection is generally more stable than Wi-Fi and helps your console maintain a consistent connection to the internet.

mainEntity.name: Should I pause other downloads while installing GTA 6?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should pause other downloads while you're installing GTA 6 on your PS5 or Xbox Series S/X. Running multiple downloads divides your available internet bandwidth, which can slow down GTA 6's download speed.

mainEntity.name: Does changing DNS make GTA 6 download faster?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your DNS doesn't increase your internet speed. However, it can speed up GTA 6 downloads if your Internet Service Provider's (ISP) default DNS server is congested or slow at resolving server addresses during heavy launch traffic.

title.rendered: Minecraft villager jobs: Everything you need to know

content.rendered:
Villagers are among the most useful mobs in Minecraft. Although they might look like ordinary NPCs wandering around villages, they can take up different professions and trade valuable items with players.

Each villager profession has a dedicated workstation and its own selection of trades. You can exchange emeralds for enchanted books, weapons, armor, food, building materials, and other useful items. You can also sell certain resources to villagers to earn emeralds.

Minecraft has 15 villager job categories, including unemployed villagers and nitwits. However, only 13 of these are actual trading professions. Here’s a look at every villager job, its workstation, the items you can trade, and how to assign or change a profession.

Minecraft villager jobs at a glance

Here’s a quick overview of all 15 villager job categories, their workstations, and the main items you can obtain through trading.

Besides the 15 regular villager professions we’ve mentioned above, Minecraft has another one called a wandering trader. They aren’t particularly a villager, as they don’t spawn in any village. You can find a wandering merchant randomly throughout the world, wearing a special outfit.

Their inventory can carry anything from Potions of Invisibility and Enchanted Iron Pickaxes to Coral Blocks, Dark Oak, Pumpkins, and tons of other things. However, don’t attack a wandering merchant, as not only will it run away, but its accompanying llamas will become hostile and start spitting at you.

All 15 villager jobs in Minecraft explained

Each villager profession has a specific workstation and a different set of trades. Here’s what you can expect from each one.

1. Butcher

Workstation: Smoker

Once given a Smoker, a Butcher villager can trade cooked food items such as pork chops, Cooked Chicken and Rabbit Stew. They can also purchase raw meat from you in exchange for Emeralds. This makes them one of the best sources to obtain food, especially when you’re heading out for adventures such as obtaining an Elytra in Minecraft.

2. Cartographer

Workstation: Cartography Table

The Cartographer villager offers various items in exchange, including Paper, Compasses, Banners, and different exploration maps. These maps can come in clutch when you’re trying to locate villages, buried treasure, Trial Chambers, Ocean Monuments, or Woodland Mansions. This makes Cartographer useful if you’re someone who loves exploring the Minecraft world.

3. Armorer

Workstation: Blast Furnace

Place a Blast Furnace near a villager to turn them into an armorer, and you’ll have a reliable source of protection. These villagers offer different types of armor, including Iron and Chainmail, alongside Shields. Once they’ve been levelled up, you can even get your hands on Enchanted Diamond armour and other high-tier gear.

4. Farmer

Workstation: Composter

The Farmer is one of the most common villager professions in Minecraft, and it’s incredibly useful for stockpiling food. They offer various food items such as Cake, Golden Carrot, Glistening Melon Slices, Cookies, and more. You can even sell food to them in exchange for Emeralds, which is a great way to earn the currency.

5. Cleric

Workstation: Brewing Stand

Looking to brew some Potions in Minecraft? The Cleric villager is the one you should visit. They offer a bunch of useful items, such as Redstone Dust, Ender Pearls, Glowstone and Bottles o’ Enchanting. You can identify them by their robes, and their workstation is a Brewing Stand.

6. Fisherman

Workstation: Barrel

The Fisherman is another useful villager profession that can help you stock up on seafood and other fishing-related items. They provide cooked salmon, cooked cod, enchanted fishing rods, campfires, and more with trading. Once you’ve levelled it up to the highest tier, you can even trade boats for emeralds.

7. Leatherworker

Workstation: Cauldron

As the name suggests, the Leatherworker specialises in leather-based items, such as leather armor, leather horse armor, and saddles through trading. You can even sell them leather, flint and rabbit hide in exchange for Emeralds. Their designated workstation is a Cauldron, which can also be used to store Lava, Water, and Powder Snow.

8. Fletcher

Workstation: Fletching Table

If you’re someone who prefers using a bow and arrow, the Fletcher is a villager you’ll want around. It’s one of the best Minecraft villager jobs for stocking up on ranged weapons and ammunition, which includes crossbows, arrows, flint, tipped arrows, and even enchanted bows. You’ll need a Fletching Table for this villager.

9. Mason

Workstation: Stonecutter

Planning to build a mansion in Minecraft? Then the mason is a villager you’ll want to visit. You can spend your emeralds to get various building blocks, such as bricks, chiseled stone bricks, blocks of quartz, and colored stained terracotta. This can save you a lot of time gathering resources and fighting mobs to collect building blocks. All you need to do is assign them a stonecutter as their workstation, and you’re good to go.

10. Toolsmith

Workstation: Smithing Tables

The toolsmith uses a smithing table as its workstation and can offer you tools such as axes, pickaxes, shovels, and hoes. As you can level them up, you can obtain enchanted tools as well. The smithing table allows you to upgrade your diamond tools to netherine which makes it quite a useful workstation for anyone who wants the best gear.

11. Librarian

Workstation: Lectern

If you want to obtain enchanted swords and armor, having a Librarian around can make things easier. They offer bookshelves and enchanted books, which are essential for enchanting your gear. Apart from these, you can also trade with them to obtain items such as glass blocks, lanterns, candles, and name tags.

You can combine glass blocks with amethyst shards to make Tinted Glass in Minecraft, which blocks light while still letting you see through it.

12. Shepherd

Workstation: Loom

Shepherds are go-to villagers for trading wool and decorative items. You can exchange emeralds to get different colored wool, carpets, paintings, shears, and more. They also purchase wool from you in return for emeralds.

13. Weaponsmith

Workstation: Grindstone

The weaponsmith is a great villager profession in Minecraft, especially if you want to upgrade your arsenal. It offers good early-game weapons such as iron swords and iron axes. Once levelled up, you can unlock better trades, such as enchanted diamond swords, diamond axes, bells, and more.

14. Nitwit

Unfortunately, Nitwits aren’t particularly useful when it comes to trading, as they can’t be assigned to any profession or offer you items in exchange for Emeralds. You’ll find them wandering around with their green robes. However, you can still use them to breed to increase your villager population.

15. Unemployed villager

Unemployed villagers don’t have any specific profession and won’t offer you any trades. However, they can be assigned jobs by placing a suitable workstation nearby. Depending on the workstation you provide, they can become a farmer, armourer, weaponsmith, or any other available profession. This makes unemployed villagers useful if you want to set up a trading hall.

How to give a villager a job in Minecraft

If you’ve found an unemployed villager and want to assign them a specific profession, simply follow these steps:

  1. Find an unemployed villager in your village.
  2. Place the workstation associated with the profession you want near them.
  3. Wait for the villager to detect and claim the workstation.

Once the villager has taken up the profession, you can interact with them to check their available trades and purchase items using emeralds.

How to change a villager’s profession in Minecraft

If you’ve assigned the wrong profession to a villager or simply want to unlock a different set of trades, you can easily change their job. All you need to do is follow these steps:

  1. Find the workstation associated with the villager’s current job.
  2. Break the workstation to remove its profession.
  3. Wait for the villager to become unemployed.
  4. Place the workstation associated with the new profession nearby.
  5. Allow the villager to detect and claim the new workstation.

For example, if you want to turn a Toolsmith into a Librarian, break its Smithing Table and place a Lectern nearby.

However, if you’ve already completed at least one trade with a villager, its profession becomes locked. Breaking its workstation won’t allow you to assign it a different job.

Wrapping up

Minecraft villagers are much more than random NPCs wandering around your village. They can take up 15 different professions, each offering unique trades across Minecraft Java and Bedrock Editions.

From enchanted books and powerful weapons to armour, food, and building materials, there’s plenty you can get from them. Having the right villagers can make a huge difference in your gameplay, so make sure to assign them the correct workstation, level up their profession, and get those trades.

FAQs

How many Villager jobs are there in Minecraft?

There are 15 villager professions in Minecraft. However, only 13 of these professions can offer trades to players, as nitwits and unemployed villagers can’t exchange items. However, unemployed villagers can take up a profession.

Which Villager gives you Mending books?

The librarian villager can offer you Mending enchanted books through trading. If it doesn’t appear, you can reset their trades by breaking and replacing the Lectern, provided you haven’t traded with them before.

Which Villager trades Ender Pearls?

The cleric villager can trade you Ender Pearls in exchange for emeralds once they’ve reached the expert trading level.

Can you change a Villager’s profession after trading?

A villager’s profession cannot be changed once you’ve completed at least one trade with them. Trading locks their profession forever, which means even if you break their workstation, they can’t take up a new job.

Can unemployed Villagers get jobs at night?

You can’t assign an unemployed villager a workstation at night. They will only look for workstations during their work hours.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

mainEntity.name: How many Villager jobs are there in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are 15 villager professions in Minecraft. However, only 13 of these professions can offer trades to players, as nitwits and unemployed villagers can't exchange items. However, unemployed villagers can take up a profession.

mainEntity.name: Which Villager gives you Mending books?

acceptedAnswer.text: The librarian villager can offer you Mending enchanted books through trading. If it doesn't appear, you can reset their trades by breaking and replacing the Lectern, provided you haven't traded with them before.

mainEntity.name: Which Villager trades Ender Pearls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cleric villager can trade you Ender Pearls in exchange for emeralds once they've reached the expert trading level.

mainEntity.name: Can you change a Villager's profession after trading?

acceptedAnswer.text: A villager's profession cannot be changed once you've completed at least one trade with them. Trading locks their profession forever, which means even if you break their workstation, they can't take up a new job.

mainEntity.name: Can unemployed Villagers get jobs at night?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can't assign an unemployed villager a workstation at night. They will only look for workstations during their work hours.

title.rendered: Every Wanted Poster location in Fortnite Treasure Hunters

content.rendered:
Wanted Posters are yet another means of obtaining sprites in Fortnite. Introduced in the Treasure Hunters mini-season, they let players discover buried Sprite Chests in a completely new way, through a Treasure Map.

In Fortnite, there are easily more than a hundred Wanted Poster spawn points in Fortnite, spread across the length and breadth of the One Piece-inspired Crossbones Isle. Further, they are commonly found in named POIs, such as Rubber Resort in the North and Loguetown in the South, and only a few of these appear in random spots across the island.

How many Wanted Posters are in Fortnite Treasure Hunters?

Speaking about precise numbers, there are 141 spots where a Wanted Poster can spawn in Fortnite. From those, Cursed Cavern and Buggy’s Beachhead each have the joint-highest number of spawn points in a single POI at 13. They are followed by Rubber Resort and Loguetown, each of which has 12 of these.

The table below reveals the exact number of Wanted Poster spawn points found in each named POI in Fortnite Battle Royale modes. The order of the following locations is based on how many spawn points each has, with the location appearing first having the highest number of this item.

All Wanted Poster locations in Fortnite

Rather than searching the entire island, focus on a cluster of POIs based on your Battle Bus flight path. Two routes offer access to 35 possible Wanted Poster spawn points each.

Northern route: Rubber Resort to Lil’ Uzi’s Stronghold

If your Battle Bus flight path is closer to the northern half of the island, start at Rubber Resort and work your way towards Buggy’s Beachhead before heading to Lil’ Uzi’s Stronghold.

This route covers three high-density areas and gives you plenty of opportunities to find a Wanted Poster without crossing the entire island.

Southern route: Windmill Village to Busy Bay

If your Battle Bus flight path is closer to the southern half of the island, head towards Windmill Village, then continue through Loguetown and Plunder Port before finishing at Busy Bay.

This route covers four named POIs and offers the same number of possible spawn points as the northern route.

Keep in mind that these totals represent potential spawn locations, not guaranteed posters. Other players may reach a location before you and interact with the available posters. Drop early and move quickly if you want to maximize your chances.

Best route to collect Wanted Posters in Fortnite

If the flight part of the Battle Bus is closer to the top half of the island, the most suitable route to follow for Wanted Posters would be going from Rubber Resort to Buggy’s Beachhead to Lil’ Uzi’s Stronghold. By following this path, you can come across a combined 35 different Wanted Poster locations.

On the flip side, if the flight path for your match is closer to the bottom half of the island, the route that goes through Windmill Village, Loguetown, Plunder Port, and Busy Bay would appear to be the most prolific for Wanted Posters. There are yet another 35 Wanted Poster spots to be found by taking this journey.

While these numbers are theoretically accurate, there can be times when other players have already used some Wanted Posters, in which case you won’t find anything on the wall. Hence, it’s imperative to be quick if you want to maximize your chances of racking up the most amount of Wanted Poster interactions.

How to use a Wanted Poster to get a sprite

Finding a Wanted Poster is only the first step. You must interact with it to receive a Treasure Map, which guides you to a buried Sprite Chest.

Follow these steps:

  1. When near a Wanted Poster, you will hear audio and visual cues (similar to what you get for chests) that you can use to find its exact location.
  2. Once you are right in front of a Wanted Poster, press and hold the interact button. This will replace the item in your active slot with a Treasure Map.
  3. Equip the Treasure Map right away or at a later time and follow the dashed line that appears on the ground.
  4. Follow the dashed line until it connects to a glowing golden part of the terrain marked by an ‘X‘.
  5. Use a pickaxe to unearth the Sprite Chest by striking the marked ground a few times.
  6. Press and hold the interact button to open the chest and spawn a sprite.

How to find Wanted Posters faster

There are certain items that you can equip in order to boost your odds of finding a Wanted Poster. In places densely populated with spawn points for this item, you can make your search efficient and convenient by relying on any Exmarks Sprite variant. Apart from Wanted Posters, this sprite also marks nearby Treasure Maps for you during a match.

On top of making it easier to track down Wanted Posters, if you want the Sprite Chests they ultimately lead you to, which give a rare sprite, you can equip the Cursed Sprite in particular. This critter not only marks the Wanted Posters in your vicinity but also increases the chances of getting highly sought-after sprites from chests.

Why can’t I find any Wanted Posters?

If you have scoured a Wanted Poster hotspot but found nothing yet, it could be that you reached the place late and someone has already exhausted the Wanted Posters in the area. Hence, doing this particular hunt in the early phases of a match is crucial.

To have better chances of getting your hands on this item, you can sometimes try skipping the usually crowded spots, including certain named POIs such as Rubber Resort, and instead go for the unnamed spots on the map shared earlier in this guide. These locations are less likely to have been already visited by others, as they are often found on the periphery of the map and there is little incentive for the players to ransack these parts.

Wanted Poster quest in Fortnite

Another reason why you may want to go after these Wanted Posters is because there is a quest, titled “Use Sprite Wanted Posters to dig up and open Sprite Chests,” that revolves around them. This particular quest, which is part of the “Kickstart” questline, is designed for beginners who are just starting out in Fortnite Treasure Hunters, and hence the objective is quite straightforward and achievable.

To complete the above quest, you just have to use a Wanted Poster to obtain sprites a total of three times. As soon as that requirement is met, you will unlock 20,000 XP. As one of the easiest quests in Fortnite this mini-season, it is not only a good introduction to the Wanted Poster gameplay mechanic but also a virtually guaranteed source of XP for even those players who just normally go about their game without being concerned about quest objectives.

FAQs

Do Wanted Posters spawn in the same place every match?

No, Wanted Posters do not spawn in the same spot every game. Whether it will appear at a known spawn point or not is random and can change with each match.

Can I carry two Sprite Treasure Maps?

Yes, you can carry two or more Treasure Maps since they effectively occupy the same slot as any weapon or consumable.

Can a Wanted Poster give the Pirate Shop token?

No, a Wanted Poster can only help you locate a Sprite Chest that gives a sprite. It can’t grant you a Pirate Shop token in any case.

Do Wanted Posters work in Zero Build?

Yes, Wanted Posters work across all Battle Royale modes, including Zero Build.

What replaced Sprite Cheat Codes?

The Cheat Codes, which were a primary way of getting sprites last season, were replaced by Treasure Chests and Wanted Posters in Fortnite Treasure Hunters.

When do Wanted Posters go away?

Wanted Posters are likely to leave Fortnite once the Treasure Hunters season ends on December 5, 2026.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

mainEntity.name: How many Villager jobs are there in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are 15 villager professions in Minecraft. However, only 13 of these professions can offer trades to players, as nitwits and unemployed villagers can't exchange items. However, unemployed villagers can take up a profession.

mainEntity.name: Which Villager gives you Mending books?

acceptedAnswer.text: The librarian villager can offer you Mending enchanted books through trading. If it doesn't appear, you can reset their trades by breaking and replacing the Lectern, provided you haven't traded with them before.

mainEntity.name: Which Villager trades Ender Pearls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cleric villager can trade you Ender Pearls in exchange for emeralds once they've reached the expert trading level.

mainEntity.name: Can you change a Villager's profession after trading?

acceptedAnswer.text: A villager's profession cannot be changed once you've completed at least one trade with them. Trading locks their profession forever, which means even if you break their workstation, they can't take up a new job.

mainEntity.name: Can unemployed Villagers get jobs at night?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can't assign an unemployed villager a workstation at night. They will only look for workstations during their work hours.

title.rendered: Apple is testing Face ID for iPhone Duo 2, but it may not ship next fall

content.rendered:
Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that Apple is testing second-generation iPhone Duo prototypes with Face ID hardware under the outer display. He made the claim in late October on his Power On podcast. Apple has not decided whether the feature will make it into the final product.

The successor is expected next fall, and Apple is testing hardware for it. If development falls behind, Face ID could wait for a third model. For now, Face ID exists only in prototypes that Apple is still testing. Apple has not confirmed Face ID for any future model.

The first iPhone Duo, Apple’s first entry into the foldable market, uses Touch ID instead. The device became available to customers starting October 23, at $1,999 for 256GB. Apple’s FAQ says: “iPhone Duo uses Touch ID, which is integrated into the side button.” It adds that the sensor works whether the phone is closed or open. Its answer to the Touch ID or Face ID question covers only Touch ID.

In September, Gurman predicted Face ID for the third-generation Duo. The new reporting puts it on the successor instead. He also says Apple is considering an Action button for a future iPhone Duo.

Treat Face ID on the successor as a plan that could slip. Apple has not decided, and the feature could move to a third model.

The thin design leaves little room for the depth-sensing parts Face ID needs, which makes the plan harder to hit. The first iPhone Duo sidesteps the problem by using Touch ID in the side button.

Early owners have reported cracked inner screens since the October 23 launch. Apple has not confirmed a defect. The screen reports and the Face ID plan are separate questions. One concerns phones people already own. The other concerns a model Apple has not decided on.

If you are choosing now, the first iPhone Duo has Touch ID and no Face ID. Waiting for a later model means waiting on a decision Apple has not made.

If Touch ID meets your needs, the first model covers them. If Face ID is the reason you want a Duo, the first model will not give it to you, and the second may not either.

Check Apple’s announcement for the successor before you assume it has Face ID.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

title.rendered: Apple’s smart glasses are waiting on Siri and iPhone app support

content.rendered:
Apple’s first smart glasses, code-named N50, depend on Siri and iPhone apps, Mark Gurman reports in his November 15, 2026, Power On newsletter for Bloomberg. Apple has not announced the glasses, so the details below are reported plans.

The target has moved. Earlier reporting had the glasses unveiled at the end of 2026 and shipping in early 2027. The newer timing has Apple unveiling the glasses at WWDC in June 2027 and shipping them before the end of 2027.

The glasses are part of Apple’s wider plan for AI wearables.

The prototypes are reportedly slightly thinner than Meta’s second-generation Ray-Ban glasses. Some test units have oval camera openings, and a front light signals use or charging. Apple is developing several styles and colors.

According to that reporting, the hardware is largely settled. Software and AI are running late and could delay the 2027 launch. Siri is the schedule risk.

The first model has no AR display, so the glasses depend on Siri. The wearer talks to Siri, and Siri uses the cameras to answer questions about what the wearer sees. Without a display, those camera answers are the core of the product.

Planned uses include identifying buildings, suggesting meals from fridge ingredients, directions, and translating signs and conversations. Also planned are calls, messages, notifications, calendars, reminders, music, and smart home controls.

The software runs on a paired iPhone, which must be a recent model, and Android is not supported. Some functions work over Wi-Fi without a nearby iPhone, but the glasses are not fully standalone.

Siri AI works only on supported iPhones. Its expanded app actions arrived in the first iOS 27.3 beta, which Apple released to developers on November 3, 2026. Apple is rolling out capabilities so Siri can work across apps, including Calendar, Messages, Music, Photos, Reminders, and Safari. Gurman says these controls for Apple’s own apps are set to reach users with iOS 27.3 in December.

Apps must let Siri control specific features in the iPhone app, such as restaurant bookings, ride requests, and ticket purchases. The glasses don’t need separate apps of their own. If an app does not let Siri act inside it, the glasses have nothing to use in that app.

Apple says any developer can connect an app to Siri AI starting with the iOS 27.3 betas. It also says the new integrations first ship to customers in a few months, with App Store submissions opening in the spring. Developers can also add “skills” that combine several actions into one request.

For developers, that spring App Store window comes well ahead of the glasses’ reported launch by the end of 2027.

Watch whether Apple unveils the glasses at WWDC in June 2027, and whether the iPhone apps you use let Siri act inside them by then.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

acceptedAnswer.text: GTA 6 can take a long time to download on PS5 because of its massive file size, which is expected to be around 210 GB.

mainEntity.name: Does using an Ethernet cable increase GTA 6 download speed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using an Ethernet cable can improve GTA 6 download speeds on both PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. This is because a wired connection is generally more stable than Wi-Fi and helps your console maintain a consistent connection to the internet.

mainEntity.name: Should I pause other downloads while installing GTA 6?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should pause other downloads while you're installing GTA 6 on your PS5 or Xbox Series S/X. Running multiple downloads divides your available internet bandwidth, which can slow down GTA 6's download speed.

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your DNS doesn't increase your internet speed. However, it can speed up GTA 6 downloads if your Internet Service Provider's (ISP) default DNS server is congested or slow at resolving server addresses during heavy launch traffic.

mainEntity.name: How many Villager jobs are there in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are 15 villager professions in Minecraft. However, only 13 of these professions can offer trades to players, as nitwits and unemployed villagers can't exchange items. However, unemployed villagers can take up a profession.

mainEntity.name: Which Villager gives you Mending books?

acceptedAnswer.text: The librarian villager can offer you Mending enchanted books through trading. If it doesn't appear, you can reset their trades by breaking and replacing the Lectern, provided you haven't traded with them before.

mainEntity.name: Which Villager trades Ender Pearls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cleric villager can trade you Ender Pearls in exchange for emeralds once they've reached the expert trading level.

mainEntity.name: Can you change a Villager's profession after trading?

acceptedAnswer.text: A villager's profession cannot be changed once you've completed at least one trade with them. Trading locks their profession forever, which means even if you break their workstation, they can't take up a new job.

mainEntity.name: Can unemployed Villagers get jobs at night?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can't assign an unemployed villager a workstation at night. They will only look for workstations during their work hours.

title.rendered: Apple’s AI health study is open to up to 200,000 U.S. iPhone users

content.rendered:
Apple has launched the Apple Health AI Usage Study in the United States. Apple announced it on November 15, 2026. The virtual study comes with a companion study app, which Apple developed with OpenEvidence, and it tests how people use AI for health questions.

The study is open to up to 200,000 eligible participants across the United States. Apple does not say how long it will run.

Joining requires an adult age and a supported iPhone

Participants must be 21 or older. They need an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone, meaning an iPhone 15 Pro or later, running iOS 26 or later.

The study app, called Apple Health AI Study App, is free on the U.S. App Store. It works only on iPhone and requires iOS 26.0 or later.

The gate here is an age limit and a phone. OpenEvidence’s own App Store app is available only to healthcare professionals, so the study’s bar is far lower.

Sharing is optional. The app uses only the Apple Health data you choose to share, such as resting heart rate, activity, sleep, or lab results. Participants keep control over whether to share HealthKit metrics or survey responses.

Study data will not be used to train AI models, and Apple applies security measures to the study data it maintains. Still, the App Store privacy label says a User ID is linked to the user and used for analytics and app functionality. Performance diagnostics are not linked to the user.

ChatGPT can already connect to Apple Health data for logged-in U.S. users who are 18 or older. That came with the Health in ChatGPT rollout in July 2026.

In 2025, Bloomberg reported that Apple was working on a Health+ service with an AI coach for the Health app, expected to launch in 2026. In February 2026, Bloomberg reported that Apple had scaled back those plans and would release some of the features one at a time instead.

Health AI answers can be incomplete or unclear, so take them to a doctor

In the study app, participants can ask everyday health questions and get complex medical information explained in plainer language. Each answer comes with linked citations to peer-reviewed sources. The app flags certain concerning questions and recommends contacting a clinician or other support.

Apple says LLM-based consumer health tools “may at times offer responses that are incomplete or unclear.” That is a fair warning, and it is the reason to take any answer to a doctor before acting on it.

The study looks at what drives user trust, the quality of responses, comprehension, and everyday health actions. It also looks at whether health AI can help participants prepare for visits with their own doctors.

The app is not meant to diagnose or treat any condition, or to replace medical advice. Participants should talk to a doctor or clinician about health concerns, including any medical information the app gives them.

Before you install, read the eligibility rules and the privacy label, and share only the Health data you are comfortable sharing.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

As an Amazon Associate, iGeeksBlog earns from qualifying purchases.

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

title.rendered: iCloud Storage full on iPhone or iPad? Here’s how to clear it fast

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Check Your Usage: To start, go to your iCloud settings to see a detailed breakdown of what is consuming your storage, such as photos, backups, and app data.
  • Identify the Culprits: The most common storage hogs are typically your photo library, old device backups, files in iCloud Drive, and large attachments saved in your messages.
  • Prepare Before Deleting: Before deleting anything from iCloud, always download and back up important files and photos to a local computer or external drive to prevent data loss.
  • How to Free Up Space: To free up space, delete old device backups, remove unneeded files from iCloud Drive, and clean out large videos or duplicate photos from your library.
  • Long-Term Maintenance: To maintain storage long-term, regularly review usage, optimize your photo library, and automatically delete old messages and their attachments in your settings.

Nothing is more frustrating than seeing that dreaded “iCloud Storage Full” alert pop up on your iPhone or iPad. Those free 5GB of storage Apple gives you can fill up surprisingly fast with photos, backups, and random app data. But don’t worry—you can reclaim that space in just a few steps. In this guide, I’ll walk you through exactly how to free up your iCloud storage, delete unnecessary files, and keep your storage under control.

How to check iCloud storage usage

Before freeing up space, you need to see what’s using it.

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Tap your Apple ID at the top, then select iCloud.

  3. Tap Storage to view a breakdown by category—Photos, Backups, iCloud Drive, and more.

Even if you don’t think you use iCloud much, it can still get full due to hidden data like old backups or synced messages.

Why is your iCloud storage full?

Here are common culprits that silently eat up iCloud storage:

  • Photos & Videos: High-res media from iCloud Photos.
  • Device Backups: Especially old backups from unused devices.
  • iCloud Drive Files: PDFs, presentations, and app files.
  • Messages & Mail: Attachments like videos, GIFs, or documents.
  • App Data: Apps like Notes or Voice Memos saving data to iCloud.

Tip: I once found that just deleting years-old video messages saved nearly 2GB!

Must-do before deleting anything

Don’t risk losing important data. Do this first:

  • Back up locally: Move photos, videos, or documents to your computer or external drive.
  • Download key files: Save essential iCloud Drive documents elsewhere.
  • Double-check backups: Keep only the most recent and relevant ones.

How to Free up iCloud storage on iPhone and iPad?

You’ll need to clean up each category individually.

1. Use iCloud Recommendations

  • Go to Settings > Apple ID > iCloud.
  • If you see Recommended for You, tap it. Apple may suggest:
    • Deleting old backups
    • Removing large iCloud Drive files
    • Turning off unnecessary app sync

These are personalized and very effective.

2. Delete old iCloud backups

Old device backups are often just junk.

To delete:

  1. Go to Settings > Apple ID > iCloud > Storage.
  2. Select Backups.

  3. Tap an old device name.
  4. Tap Turn Off and Delete.

If you need more guidance, this article on deleting iCloud backups breaks it down.

3. Clean out photos and videos

Photos and videos are usually the biggest space hogs.

  • Delete unneeded media: Open the Photos app, select photos or videos you don’t need, and delete them. Don’t forget to empty the Recently Deleted album (it holds deleted items for 30 days).

  • Turn off iCloud Photos if you don’t need it: Go to iCloud settings, select Photos under Saved to iCloud, and toggle off Sync this iPhone. Thus, your camera roll will not consume storage space anymore.

  • Review albums: Check albums like Screenshots or Live Photos for unnecessary stuff.

Additionally, clearing out duplicates photos and blurry photos can make a huge difference. If you’re worried about losing memories, back them up first.

4. Delete unnecessary iCloud drive files

  1. Open Files app > Browse > iCloud Drive.
  2. Browse folders to find large or outdated files (like old PDFs or presentations).
  3. Long-press a file, then tap Delete.

You can also accomplish this from the iCloud settings. Access the Storage section, select iCloud Drive, and review large files. Tap and hold a file to delete it.

5. Manage app data in iCloud

Some apps back up more than you think.

  1. Go to Settings > Apple ID > iCloud > Manage Storage.
  2. Tap an app (like Notes or a game) to see how much space it’s using.

  3. Select Delete Data from iCloud and tap Delete to confirm.

Next, turn off syncing for the apps you don’t need to back up to iCloud. For example, you may turn off iCloud for a game you hadn’t played in months, saving a surprising amount of space.

On the iCloud page, tap on Saved to iCloud, scroll down, and toggle off the unnecessary apps.

6. Clear Messages, Mail, and attachments

When you enable syncing, all of your text messages, emails, and attachments consume your iCloud storage. So, you should regularly remove unnecessary messages and emails to free up additional iCloud space.

Messages:

  1. Open Messages, long-press large chats, tap Delete
  2. To keep texts but delete media: Tap contact > See All under Photos > Select and delete media

Mail:

  1. Swipe left on the email with large attachments (like PDFs), select More, and tap Trash Message.
  2. Empty Trash and Junk folders regularly.

7. Delete Voice Memos, FaceTime, and Apple Invites

If you have enabled sync for these apps, they will store data in iCloud, which may consume a lot of space. FaceTime also keeps phone voicemails and video and audio messages in iCloud.

  • Voice Memos: Open the Voice Memos app, tap Edit, select old recordings, and delete them.

  • FaceTime: Go to iCloud Settings > Storage > FaceTime and select Delete Data From iCloud.

  • Apple Invites: Delete old event invites that may contain attachments.

I had a bunch of random voice memos from years ago that were just taking up space. Deleting them was an easy fix.

Final cleanup: Empty Trash

Deleted items don’t clear space until you empty them!

  • Photos: Open Photos, Select Recently Deleted. Tap View Album and verify your Face ID. Then, tap Select > Three-dot icon > Delete All > Delete From This iPhone.
  • Files: In the Files app, tap Browse at the top left corner and select Recently Deleted. Tap the three-dot icon at the top > Select > Delete All > Delete.
  • Mail and Messages: Empty the Trash and Recently Deleted folder.

Pro tips to keep iCloud storage free

To keep your iCloud storage in check long-term, try these habits:

  • Review storage monthly: Check Manage Storage section regularly to catch space hogs early.
  • Use alternative clouds: Store large files in Google Drive or Dropbox instead of iCloud.
  • Limit app syncing: Only sync essential apps to iCloud (turn off from Saved to iCloud section).
  • Delete old Messages automatically: Go to Settings > Apps > Messages > Keep Messages and set to 30 days or 1 year.
  • Optimize photos: Always keep the Optimize iPhone Storage option enabled for Photos.
  • Back up locally: Use your computer or an external drive for big backups.

For more tips to manage storage, check out our guide on iCloud tips and tricks.

Video: Free Up iCloud Storage on iOS 27

Signing off

Clearing iCloud storage doesn’t have to feel overwhelming. By understanding what’s taking up space and deleting what you no longer need, you can free up gigabytes in minutes. With a few good habits, you’ll never see that annoying alert again.

So go ahead and give your iPhone and iPad some breathing room!

  • How to free up storage space on Mac
  • Google storage full warning? Here’s how I freed up space instantly
