mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

acceptedAnswer.text: The librarian villager can offer you Mending enchanted books through trading. If it doesn't appear, you can reset their trades by breaking and replacing the Lectern, provided you haven't traded with them before.

mainEntity.name: Which Villager trades Ender Pearls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cleric villager can trade you Ender Pearls in exchange for emeralds once they've reached the expert trading level.

mainEntity.name: Can you change a Villager's profession after trading?

acceptedAnswer.text: A villager's profession cannot be changed once you've completed at least one trade with them. Trading locks their profession forever, which means even if you break their workstation, they can't take up a new job.

acceptedAnswer.text: You can't assign an unemployed villager a workstation at night. They will only look for workstations during their work hours.

keyPoints.explanation: Photos, device backups, iCloud Drive files, messages, and app data are typical sources that silently consume iCloud storage.

keyPoints.explanation: Back up important files locally, download key documents, and verify backups to prevent data loss before clearing space.

title.rendered: Grow a Plant codes (November 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Grow a Plant Codes on November 18, 2026

Looking for free seed packs and Cash in Grow a Plant? Redeeming codes can help you collect new seeds, grow more plants, and expand your garden without spending extra time grinding for rewards.

Grow a Plant is a Roblox farming game where you open seed packs, plant what you receive, and earn Cash from your crops. You can also upgrade your base to unlock useful features, including drones. Since seed packs are essential for getting new plants, redeem the latest codes to claim free rewards and get your garden growing.

Here are all the working Grow a Plant codes you can redeem right now.

All working Grow a Plant codes

  • SCARECROW: 1 Scarecrow Seed Pack and 1 Harvest Seed Pack (NEW)
  • MOONLIT: 1 Golden Pumpkin Token and 5 Pumpkin Tokens (NEW)
  • FREESEED: Seeds (NEW)
  • STORY⁩⁩⁩⁩⁩⁩: 500 Seeds (NEW)
  • STARBUD⁩⁩⁩⁩⁩⁩: 750 Seeds (NEW)
  • Octo31: 1 Aurora Seed Pack
  • 7KCCU: 1 Aurora Seed Pack
  • WantPet: 1 Frost Egg
  • SpookyCode: 100k Cash and 2 Crystal Seed Packs
  • NewPlayer: 2 Sunny Seed Packs
  • RDCAward: Redeem for 1x RDC Award cosmetic
  • BEANORLEAVE10: Get a cosmetic

Expired Grow a Plant codes

LUNARGLOW10, SPOOKYSEEDPACKPLEASE, TORIGATE

How to redeem Grow a Plant codes

The code box is at the bottom of the Shop menu.

  1. Open Grow a Plant on Roblox.
  2. Select Shop on the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll down to the Code here box.
  4. Type or paste a code exactly as written.
  5. Select Redeem.

Why your Grow a Plant code is not working

  • The code has expired. Check the expired list above first.
  • Codes are case-sensitive, so Octo31 will not work as octo31.
  • You already redeemed it on your account.
  • The code fails on one server. Rejoin the game and try again.

Some older lists show Aurora Seed Packs for Octo31 and 7KCCU. Newer checks list Ember Seed Packs, so go by the list above.

Where to find more Grow a Plant codes

The developer’s Roblox group is where milestone news and patch notes show up, so check there when a new update drops.

Grow a Garden is a separate game with its own codes, so make sure you’re in Grow a Plant before you redeem anything. If you want more free rewards, check out the latest GloryBound codes, Okishima:1336 codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

  • CyberPowerPC Gaming PC (GeForce RTX 5060)

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

title.rendered: GloryBound codes (November 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest GloryBound Codes on November 21, 2026

Gladiator, if you want to survive in the Colosseum in GloryBound, you’ll need all the codes you can get your hands on! Set in Ancient Rome, this Roblox game allows you to train gladiators to fight waves of enemies, take on bosses, and work towards reaching the top.

However, surviving these battles isn’t going to be an easy task, as you’ll need plenty of Lucky Spins and Chests to get new Blessings, better armour and weapons and improve your abilities. So, to help you out, here’s a list of all the GloryBound codes that you can redeem right now for a bunch of freebies!

All working GloryBound codes

  • ASCENSION: 5 Lucky Spins (NEW)
  • UPDATE5: 5 Lucky Spins (NEW)
  • IGNIS: a Legendary Chest (NEW)
  • SORRY: 5 Lucky Spins
  • UPDATE_4: 5 Lucky Spins
  • CURSED: Legendary Chest

Currently, these are the only active GloryBound codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired GloryBound codes

ABILITY, BERSERKER, BOSS, PVP, TRIALS, UPDATE, UPDATE_3

How to redeem GloryBound codes in Roblox

Do you finally know the codes? Well, now it’s time to learn how to redeem GloryBound codes. You first need to finish the tutorial and complete your initial arena fight. Once that is done, here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem the codes for freebies:

  1. Launch GloryBound on Roblox.
  2. Locate the ‘Gift Icon’ button at the top-left corner of the screen.
  3. Choose the Codes option.
  4. Paste a working code and hit Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the codes, the rewards should be added to your inventory automatically.

Why aren’t my GloryBound codes working?

If you can’t make your GloryBound codes work, double-check that you’ve entered them exactly as listed above. Keep in mind that these codes are case-sensitive, so make sure there are no extra spaces before or after them.

You can simply copy and paste the codes directly from our list. If a code still doesn’t work, it might have expired, or you may have already redeemed its rewards.

How to get more GloryBound codes

The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new GloryBound codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, bug fixes, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Discord server: Visit the GloryBound Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
  • Follow the Roblox game page: Check the game’s official Roblox page and the developer’s community for updates, announcements, and potential code releases.
  • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new GloryBound codes become available, so you can easily find the latest rewards in one place.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest  Cameraman Tower Defense codes, Okishima:1336 codes and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

What are the different classes in GloryBound?

GloryBound has three different combat classes: Gladiator, Lancer and Archer. Each of these has a different weapon and fighting style.

How do you get better weapons in GloryBound?

You can easily get better weapons in GloryBound by opening chests, which can be purchased from the Chest Merchant in the vault near the spawn point. You can also earn Chests by clearing Colosseum waves or redeeming active codes.

Does GloryBound have boss fights?

GloryBound has different boss fights that serve as major challenges during your runs. You will go up against War Lion, Undead Brute and Cerberus.

  • SteelSeries Aeon Pro Wireless Controller
  • CyberPowerPC Gaming PC (GeForce RTX 5060)
  • Razer Naga V3 Pro Gaming Mouse

  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Why do I feel anxious about my planet ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feeling sensitive about rankings is normal. Planets are a fun visual, not a measure of real friendship depth. If it raises stress, turn the feature off or take a break and focus on offline time.

mainEntity.name: How many Villager jobs are there in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are 15 villager professions in Minecraft. However, only 13 of these professions can offer trades to players, as nitwits and unemployed villagers can't exchange items. However, unemployed villagers can take up a profession.

acceptedAnswer.text: The librarian villager can offer you Mending enchanted books through trading. If it doesn't appear, you can reset their trades by breaking and replacing the Lectern, provided you haven't traded with them before.

mainEntity.name: Which Villager trades Ender Pearls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cleric villager can trade you Ender Pearls in exchange for emeralds once they've reached the expert trading level.

mainEntity.name: Can you change a Villager's profession after trading?

acceptedAnswer.text: A villager's profession cannot be changed once you've completed at least one trade with them. Trading locks their profession forever, which means even if you break their workstation, they can't take up a new job.

mainEntity.name: Can unemployed Villagers get jobs at night?

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

title.rendered: Best MacBook to buy in 2026: Prices and buying guide

content.rendered:
If you’re planning to buy a MacBook in 2026, choosing the right model can be confusing. Apple now offers several options, including the affordable MacBook Neo, M5-powered MacBook Air, and MacBook Pro models featuring M6, M5 Pro, and M5 Max chips. The company has also introduced a redesigned MacBook Pro with a touchscreen OLED display. 

However, not every MacBook is suitable for every user. A student who primarily browses the web and works on assignments doesn’t need the same performance as a developer, video editor, or 3D artist. 

Whether you’re buying your first MacBook or upgrading an older model, this guide compares Apple’s latest MacBook lineup, explains the differences between its processors and displays, and helps you choose the best MacBook for your budget and requirements. 

Overview of MacBook models in 2026

Apple currently sells three main lines of MacBooks: MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, and MacBook Neo.

The MacBook Air offers a balance of performance, portability, and battery life at a great value, while the MacBook Pro delivers high-end performance and advanced features for professionals.

On the other hand, Apple launched MacBook Neo for students and casual users. It focuses on basic tasks like browsing, streaming, and document work while keeping the price lower than Air and Pro models.

Note: Apple discontinued the M4, M3, and M2 MacBook Air models after launching the M5 MacBook Air in March 2026. The 14-inch MacBook Pro M5 was also replaced by the M6 MacBook Pro in October 2025.

Current MacBook lineup (2026)

Apple’s current lineup includes multiple configurations, so make sure you check the display and processor before purchasing. 

Who should buy which MacBook?

If you’re unsure which MacBook to choose, here are my recommendations based on different usage requirements: 

  • Best MacBook for students, casual & budget users: 13-inch MacBook Neo
  • Best MacBook for most people for office work and everyday productivity: 13-inch MacBook Air M5
  • Best MacBook for developers and business professionals: 14-inch MacBook Pro M6
  • Best MacBook for creative professionals: 14-inch MacBook Pro M5 Pro with PROLED XDR display
  • Best MacBook for power users, high-end creators, and engineers: 16-inch MacBook Pro M5 Max (PROLED XDR display optional)

Key factors to consider before buying a MacBook

Here are all the factors to consider when choosing the best MacBook for your needs.

1. Performance

Apple silicon chips are known for exceptional speed and power efficiency. The right one for you depends on your needs and budget.

  • A18 Pro: The first time an iPhone chip is used in a MacBook. It’s power-efficient and perfect for students and everyday users.
  • M5: Offers excellent performance for multitasking, office applications, photo editing, and everyday creative work.
  • M5 Pro: A balanced powerhouse for business professionals and developers who run resource-intensive apps.
  • M5 Max: The most powerful option, ideal for 4K/8K video editors, 3D artists, graphic designers, and AI developers.
  • M6: Apple’s latest chip delivering up to 30% faster graphics performance and up to 25% faster performance for on-device AI workloads, compared to M5. 

Choosing the right unified memory (RAM) is just as important, as it affects how smoothly your MacBook handles multitasking and heavy apps. Avoid underpowering your workflow, but don’t overspend on specs you’ll never use.

Read more: A18 Pro vs M1: How Apple’s iPhone Chip Compares to the First Mac Silicon

2. Storage (SSD)

MacBook storage cannot generally be upgraded after purchase, so choose carefully. 

Here’s a general guideline: 

  • 256GB–512GB: Suitable for students and everyday users.
  • 1TB: A good choice for professionals who install multiple applications and regularly work with large files.
  • 2TB or more: Better suited to video editors, photographers, developers, and creators. 

You can also use external SSDs if you need extra space.

2. Display

Apple offers different display technologies across its MacBook lineup. 

The MacBook Neo and Air feature Liquid Retina displays, while Pro models offer Liquid Retina XDR displays with ProMotion technology and refresh rates up to 120Hz. 

The redesigned MacBook Pro also introduces an all-new PROLED XDR tandem OLED touchscreen, offering deeper blacks, higher contrast, and touch interaction. 

Screen size is another important consideration. The 13-inch models are easier to carry, while the 15-inch Air and 16-inch Pro offer more screen space for multitasking and creative work. 

3. macOS & Software support

All current MacBook models run macOS 27, Apple’s latest desktop operating system. Based on Apple’s update history, expect at least 6–7 years of software support for any M-series model.

If you plan to use your laptop for several years, choosing a newer-generation model is a good way to get a longer potential software support window. 

4. Battery life

Apple silicon MacBooks offer excellent battery efficiency. The MacBook Air and MacBook Pro are suitable for everyday use and travel, while MacBook Pro models offer up to 24 hours of battery life, depending on configuration and usage. 

Consider your typical working hours and how often you’ll have access to a charger. 

5. Ports & connectivity

The number and type of ports vary significantly across the MacBook lineup. 

  • MacBook Neo: Two USB-C ports (USB 3 and USB 2) and a 3.5mm headphone jack.
  • MacBook Air: Two Thunderbolt/USB 4 ports, MagSafe charging, and a headphone jack.
  • MacBook Pro: Thunderbolt 4/5 ports, HDMI, SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. 

If you regularly connect external monitors, cameras, or storage devices, the MacBook Pro offers more flexibility. 

Best MacBook for students & casual users: 13-inch MacBook Neo

The MacBook Neo is Apple’s most affordable MacBook in Apple’s lineup, starting at only $699. It’s designed for students, casual users, and people who don’t need professional-level performance. 

Powered by the A18 Pro chip, it easily handles my everyday tasks such as web browsing, streaming, writing assignments, attending online meetings, and working with documents while testing. 

Its 13-inch Liquid Retina display provides sharp visuals, while its lightweight design makes it easy to carry around. The MacBook Neo also offers a familiar macOS experience, making it an accessible entry point for people buying their first Mac.

Key highlights

  • A18 Pro chip for fast everyday performance.
  • 13-inch Liquid Retina display with sharp visuals.
  • Up to 16 hours of battery life for all-day use.
  • 256GB base variant with a 512GB option.
  • Lightweight and portable for school or travel.

The MacBook Neo is a practical choice if your daily activities involve browsing, video calls, document editing, and entertainment. However, it isn’t designed for demanding professional workloads such as video editing, complex 3D rendering, or heavy development projects. 

Check out on Amazon

Best MacBook for most people: 13-inch MacBook Air M5

The 13-inch MacBook Air with the M5 chip is the best MacBook for most people in 2026. It offers the perfect balance of performance, portability, and price, making it ideal for students, remote workers, writers, and everyday users.

Powered by Apple’s M5 chip, the laptop delivers faster performance while staying extremely power-efficient. The chip also improves AI processing and multitasking, making everyday tasks feel smooth and responsive.

Moreover, Apple’s updated N1 chip offers Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6. Its fanless design also means it operates silently, making it useful in classrooms, libraries, offices, and shared workspaces. 

Key Highlights

  • M5 chip with up to a 10-core CPU and dedicated Neural Accelerator.
  • 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display with bright, sharp visuals.
  • Up to 18 hours of battery life for all-day use.
  • 512GB base variant with up to 4TB configuration available.
  • Lightweight fanless design, making it silent and easy to carry.

If you need a larger display, you can go for the 15-inch MacBook Air, which costs $200 more.

Check out on Amazon

Best MacBook for developers and professionals: 14-inch MacBook Pro M6 

The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 is an excellent choice for developers, business professionals, and creators who need more performance than the MacBook Air can offer. 

It features Apple’s latest M6 chip, bringing improvements in performance, graphics, and on-device AI processing. Its 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU make demanding tasks such as compiling code, editing videos, and multitasking across professional apps faster and more responsive. 

The laptop also features a Liquid Retina XDR display with ProMotion technology, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and up to 24 hours of battery life. 

Key Highlights 

  • M6 chip with a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU.
  • Dual 16-core Neural Engine for AI workloads.
  • 14.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR display with ProMotion.
  • Configurable unified memory up to 32GB.
  • Up to 24 hours of battery life.
  • Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6.
  • HDMI, MagSafe 3, Thunderbolt 4 ports, and SDXC card slot.

The M6 MacBook Pro is a good choice if you want a professional laptop with Apple’s latest processor but don’t necessarily need the advanced touchscreen OLED display or the extreme performance of M5 Pro/M5 Max. 

Check out on Amazon

Also read: M6 vs M5 MacBook Pro: Should you upgrade?

Best MacBook for business users and creative professionals: 14-inch MacBook Pro M5 Pro with PROLED XDR

Apple’s redesigned MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display with M5 Pro and M5 Max is one of the biggest additions to its 2026 laptop lineup. 

Available in 14-inch and 16-inch configurations, it introduces tandem OLED technology and touchscreen functionality to the Mac for the first time. You can directly interact with creative apps, draw on the screen, and edit content using touch gestures.

The display offers exceptional brightness, deeper blacks, improved contrast, and professional color accuracy. It supports up to 2,000 nits of peak HDR and SDR brightness, a 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio, and an adaptive refresh rate of up to 120Hz. 

Apple has also introduced Dynamic Island to the Mac, providing quick access to Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI. 

Key Highlights 

  • Available in 14-inch and 16-inch sizes.
  • Touchscreen functionality for the first time on Mac.
  • M5 Pro and M5 Max processor options.
  • Up to 128GB unified memory.
  • Configurable storage up to 16TB.
  • Up to 24 hours of battery life.
  • Dynamic Island integration with Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI.

If you’re a video editor, photographer, graphic designer, 3D artist, or music producer, this MacBook Pro offers a combination of professional performance and a more interactive display. 

The 16-inch M5 Max configuration is particularly suitable for users handling demanding 3D projects, large AI models, and high-resolution video production. 

However, if you primarily work with traditional desktop applications and don’t need touch functionality, a standard MacBook Pro M5 Pro may offer better value.

Check out on Amazon

Best MacBook for power users and high-end creators: 16-inch MacBook Pro M5 Max

The 16-inch MacBook Pro with the M5 Max chip is Apple’s most powerful laptop in 2026. It’s built for power users, filmmakers, 3D artists, engineers, and AI developers who need extreme performance for demanding workloads.

The M5 Max chip delivers massive GPU power and supports up to 128GB of unified memory, making it ideal for tasks like 3D rendering, machine learning, and editing multiple streams of 4K or 8K video. The chip can include up to a 40-core GPU with Neural Engine that significantly boosts graphics and AI performance compared with earlier generations.

Key Highlights

  • M5 Max chip with a powerful CPU and up to a 40-core GPU for heavy workloads.
  • 16.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR display with ProMotion for professional-grade visuals.
  • Up to 128GB unified memory with 614GB/s of memory bandwidth for advanced creative and AI workflows.
  • 2TB default storage with up to 8TB configuration.
  • Multiple pro ports, including Thunderbolt, HDMI, SD card slot, and MagSafe.
  • Up to 24 hours of battery life despite the high performance.

The larger 16-inch display and bigger battery are ideal for professionals who need maximum power on the go, without switching to a desktop.

Check out on Amazon

When and Where to Buy a MacBook in 2026

The best time to buy a MacBook is when you need it, but timing can help you save.

Look for deals during Black Friday, Cyber Monday, or Back-to-School sales. Students can also claim Apple’s education discount for added savings. Avoid buying right before major Apple launch events, which usually take place in March and October, to prevent missing out on new models or price drops.

You can buy directly from Apple.com, Amazon, or Best Buy. Refurbished models can also be great deals, but ensure you buy from a trusted source.

For buyers in India, check Apple’s official India store and authorized retailers for local pricing, availability, and applicable offers. 

Final thoughts: Buy the right MacBook for you

That’s everything you need to know about buying a MacBook. Apple has a MacBook for every kind of user, from students and professionals to creatives and business executives.

Choosing the right one depends on how you plan to use it. Take your time, match your workflow to the specs, and you’ll have a MacBook that lasts you years without compromise.

  • Best Accessories for MacBook Air
  • Mac keyboard shortcuts for Apple Notes
  • Best Mac apps to download (Free and paid)

  • Macally Multi-Device Bluetooth Keyboard
  • Belkin Connect 5-in-1 Thunderbolt 4 Dock
  • Anker 7-in-1 USB-C Hub
  • UGREEN Nexode 100W 4-Port GaN Charger
  • Adjustable Laptop Stand with 360° Rotating Base

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

mainEntity.name: Should I pause other downloads while installing GTA 6?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should pause other downloads while you're installing GTA 6 on your PS5 or Xbox Series S/X. Running multiple downloads divides your available internet bandwidth, which can slow down GTA 6's download speed.

mainEntity.name: Does changing DNS make GTA 6 download faster?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your DNS doesn't increase your internet speed. However, it can speed up GTA 6 downloads if your Internet Service Provider's (ISP) default DNS server is congested or slow at resolving server addresses during heavy launch traffic.

title.rendered: What is Captain’s Day in Fortnite? Full details and schedule

content.rendered:
Fortnite Treasure Hunters strongly embodies the ‘pirate adventure’ theme and takes direct inspiration from a popular manga-anime in the same genre called One Piece. As a result, from eye-patch-sporting sprites to rewards for opening treasure chests, there is an abundance of pirate-themed items and quests in the game this mini-season.

Major bosses in the Battle Royale modes, which are being rolled out every week, have also received the title of Captain. Consequently, there are Captain’s Days as well, on which a bunch of different changes to the inventory and map in these modes are implemented. To get a fuller idea of what these are, read on.

What is Captain’s Day in Fortnite Treasure Hunters?

Throughout this month-long season, Fortnite is scheduled to release a new boss, his associated weapon, a sprite themed around him, a POI reworked to incorporate him, and a refreshed chest rewards pool on Captain’s Day, which kicks off every Sunday at 9 AM ET. This weekly event also adds a new map fragment. Collect all six to unlock the X Marks the Zero Point loading screen. See the locations and release dates for all Fortnite Treasure Hunters map fragments.

On the inaugural Captain’s Day, which took place on November 8, A$AP Rocky was succeeded as the Captain by Lil’ Uzi Vert, replacing the former’s cosmetics in the aforementioned rewards pool with those of the latter. However, it’s worth noting that certain other rewards, such as Pirate Shop Access and Extraction Accelerator, were retained despite the changeover.

For details on his Item Shop outfits, cosmetics, and bundle prices, see our guide to Lil Uzi Vert skins and bundles in Fortnite.

Moreover, while Captain’s Day means the addition of a new boss and his own POI on the map, it doesn’t mean the previous one gets removed. In other words, Lil Uzi Vert and A$AP Rocky can both be found in Fortnite Battle Royale matches in their respective locations. Naturally, the loot they drop, which includes their own respective unique weapons, is also available.

Fortnite Captain’s Day schedule for November 2026

The lineup of forthcoming Captains in the Treasure Hunters season, along with the sequence of their arrival, can be seen by visiting the Treasure tab and then the Adventure section in Fortnite. Although the characters to assume the role of Captain are known beforehand, the exact details of their signature weapon, personalized POI, and chest reward items will only be officially known when the corresponding Captain’s Day arrives.

Week 3 introduced Hatsune Miku’s Leekcapper. Here’s how to find and use the Leekcapper in Fortnite.

Captain’s Day benefits a certain section of Fortnite players

The inclusion of Captain’s Day this season has brought major favorable changes for Fortnite players who enjoy unlocking items over spending real money on them. Precisely, the fact that new themed cosmetic rewards are inserted into the chest rewards pool every Captain’s Day gives all players a chance of grabbing a cosmetic that would have otherwise been locked behind the Battle Pass or would have required V-Bucks to be spent in the Item Shop.

From wraps to Icon-tier skins, opening chests in Fortnite Treasure Hunters can bag you an item from a wide range of cosmetics. Such an opportunity certainly bodes well for players who may not necessarily have a lot of V-Bucks to splash on Item Shop purchases, and the move also sets a promising precedent for that particular audience bracket.

FAQs

Is Captain’s Day free?

Yes, Captain’s Day is completely free for Fortnite players.

Does it work in Zero Build and Reload?

Since Zero Build is one of the Battle Royale modes, Captain’s Day does have an effect or does ‘work’ in that mode. However, Fortnite Reload and other non-Battle Royale modes is unaffected by these weekly updates.

Why did my Captain not drop a sprite variant?

When you defeat a Captain, you have the highest chances of getting the base variant of his themed sprite. While other variants such as Fortune and Cursed exist, they are rare and hence may not generally drop after the boss fight.

  • CyberPowerPC Gaming PC (GeForce RTX 5060)
  • Razer Naga V3 Pro Gaming Mouse
  • Redragon Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

title.rendered: Apple turns on Siri AI for 2021 and 2022 Apple TV 4K models in tvOS 27.2.1

content.rendered:
Apple’s tvOS 27.2.1 update turns on Siri AI for the 2021 and 2022 Apple TV 4K models. The build is 24K157, dated November 13, 2026. The new 4th-generation Apple TV 4K also ships on November 13, 2026, and already has Siri AI.

Apple says the update “brings a profoundly more capable and conversational Siri AI to Apple TV 4K.” The earlier tvOS 27.2 update, dated October 26, 2026, did not turn on Siri AI for the 2nd- and 3rd-generation models.

The 2nd generation is the 2021 model, and the 3rd generation is the 2022 model. tvOS 27.2.1 supports Siri AI on the 2nd generation and later, so the update turns it on for both of those models. It works only with an Apple Intelligence iPhone or iPad, as described below.

Siri AI on the TV leans on a nearby iPhone

Siri AI on Apple TV is a full-screen search experience in the Apple TV app. It answers general knowledge questions. It can also answer questions about what is on screen, such as when the next season arrives.

It can use personal context from a nearby Apple Intelligence iPhone, such as a show a friend recommended in Messages. That is the strongest case for the update, and it is also the part that depends on the phone being nearby.

Setup needs an Apple Intelligence iPhone or iPad

Siri AI on Apple TV is available as a beta in English. Setup requires an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, and a paired Siri AI-enabled device has to be nearby. Because it depends on the iPhone or iPad, Siri AI on Apple TV isn’t available in the EU.

If your household has no Apple Intelligence iPhone or iPad, you cannot set up Siri AI on your Apple TV. For that household, this update changes nothing you can use.

Apple’s HomeView smart home hub needs a compatible iPhone or iPad for some of its Siri AI features, so check that before you rely on it. On iPhone, Siri AI gained the ability to recall earlier conversations in iOS 27.2.

Four-speaker surround and Whole Room Audio need the Apple TV 4K (4th generation) plus matching front and rear pairs of HomePod mini 2 or HomePod (2nd generation). Those speaker features are separate from Siri AI, and a 2021 or 2022 model does not meet that hardware requirement.

If you have an Apple Intelligence iPhone or iPad, install 27.2.1 on your 2021 or 2022 Apple TV 4K by going to Settings > System > Software Updates > Update Software. Then go to Settings > General > Siri and turn on Siri AI.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

mainEntity.name: Why can’t I see Snapchat Planets in my app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat Planets sits inside Snapchat Plus, and Friend Solar System needs to be turned on in settings. Start with the basics. Update Snapchat to the latest version from the App Store, then confirm your Snapchat Plus subscription is active and the Friend Solar System toggle is on inside Snapchat+. If planets still do not appear, force quit Snapchat and reopen it, or restart the iPhone.

mainEntity.name: My friend disappeared from my Solar System. Why did this happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planets reflect recent activity, not a lifetime score. If chats slow down or a streak breaks, a friend can slide down or out of the top eight. Rankings shift as habits change, and they can bounce back when activity picks up again.

mainEntity.name: Can my friends see their planet ranking in my Solar System?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your solar view is private. A friend only sees their planet by opening your profile badge, and only if both accounts use Snapchat Plus.

mainEntity.name: Can I manually assign planets to my friends?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Snapchat assigns planets automatically based on interaction patterns. There is no manual override.

mainEntity.name: How often do Snapchat Planets update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snapchat has not published a schedule. In practice, movement can happen day to day or across a week, depending on how much you two interact.

mainEntity.name: Does the Solar System feature affect my friendships or privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The view is meant to be playful and it is visible only to you. If rankings start to feel uncomfortable, turn the Friend Solar System toggle off in Snapchat+ settings. You keep the rest of your Plus features.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Best Friends or Friends badge missing on my friend’s profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The badge appears only when you and that friend sit in each other’s top eight. If it is missing, one of three things is likely true, you are not both in the top eight, one or both accounts are not on Snapchat Plus, or the Friend Solar System toggle is off.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if the feature still isn’t working after troubleshooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the subscription is active, the app is updated, and the toggle is on, try logging out and back in. If that fails, reinstall Snapchat. If the issue persists, contact Snapchat Support from the app or the help site.

title.rendered: Best iPhone Duo apps: 20 picks that actually use the fold

content.rendered:
When I first started exploring my new iPhone Duo, I realized that simply having a bigger screen doesn’t make every app better. Some apps genuinely make use of the fold, offering smarter layouts and new ways to multitask, while others still feel like regular iPhone apps stretched across a larger display.

So, if you want to get more out of your iPhone Duo, I’ve rounded up 20 of the best iPhone Duo apps worth downloading. These apps are specially optimized to make the most of the foldable design, whether you’re working, watching videos, reading, creating content, or gaming.

Quick picks: The best iPhone Duo apps at a glance

If you don’t want to browse through every recommendation, here’s a quick look at the apps I would consider first. I’ve organized them by what they do best and the iPhone Duo position where their features are most useful.

How do you know if an app is optimized for iPhone Duo?

One of the first things I would check before downloading an app is whether it actually supports the iPhone Duo’s foldable display.

Apple has introduced a Made for iPhone Duo badge in the App Store to help users identify apps designed to take advantage of the device. The badge is particularly useful because an app that works on an iPhone Duo isn’t necessarily optimized for it.

There are three important compatibility states to understand.

  • Older iOS SDK: Apps may appear centered with black bars around them when you open these apps on the larger inner screen.
  • iOS 27 SDK: Apps can fill most of the inner display but may not fully adapt to different folding positions.
  • iOS 27.1 SDK: Apps offer more complete support, with layouts and controls that adapt to both screens and different positions.

My recommendation is to look for the Made for iPhone Duo badge and check the app’s latest release notes. If the developer specifically mentions iPhone Duo support, that’s a much stronger indication that the app has received a dedicated update.

Best iPhone Duo apps for productivity

A foldable iPhone can make everyday productivity considerably more convenient. Instead of constantly switching between apps, you can use the larger display to keep more information visible.

Apple has highlighted several productivity apps that take advantage of this approach. Here are five worth considering.

1. Fantastical: The best calendar app for iPhone Duo

If your day revolves around meetings, appointments, reminders, and deadlines, Fantastical is one of the first apps I’d recommend exploring.

Fantastical takes advantage of the larger display by allowing you to see more of your calendar, tasks, and navigation menus together.

On a regular iPhone, you often have to switch between views to find the information you need. The Duo’s larger display makes it easier to keep multiple parts of your schedule visible at once.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • View your calendar and tasks together.
  • Access navigation menus without constantly switching screens.
  • Get a broader view of upcoming appointments.
  • Use the larger display to organize a busy schedule.

Price: Free with a Premium subscription option (starts at $6.99).

Who should download it: Anyone who manages a busy work schedule, multiple appointments, or personal tasks.

Who can skip it: If you only need a basic calendar for occasional appointments, Apple’s built-in Calendar app may be sufficient.

Download

2. Microsoft Outlook: Manage your inbox and messages together

Microsoft Outlook is another productivity app that benefits significantly from the iPhone Duo’s larger display.

Outlook can now display your inbox beside a full email message. Instead of opening an email, going back to the inbox, and selecting another message, you can keep both areas visible.

For anyone who handles work emails throughout the day, this is a meaningful improvement.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • View your inbox alongside an opened email.
  • Read longer messages with more room.
  • Navigate between conversations more conveniently.
  • Use the larger display for a more desktop-like email experience.

Price: Free, with an additional Microsoft 365 subscription starting at $1.99.

Who should download it: Professionals, students, and anyone managing multiple email conversations.

Who can skip it: Users who already prefer Apple’s Mail app and don’t need Outlook’s additional productivity features.

Download

3. Things 3: Keep your tasks organized

I rely on Things 3 daily to organize my projects, daily responsibilities, and long-term goals.

On the iPhone Duo, the fully open display gives you more room to work with your task lists and project organization. You can use the extra screen space to review your upcoming responsibilities without constantly navigating between smaller screens.

It is particularly useful for people who prefer organizing their day into projects, deadlines, and individual tasks.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Organize tasks and projects.
  • Review upcoming responsibilities.
  • Keep more information visible on the larger screen.
  • Plan your day with less navigation.

Price: $9.99

Who should download it: People who want a dedicated task-management system.

Who can skip it: Anyone satisfied with Apple’s built-in Reminders app.

Download

4. Bear: A better space for notes and writing

Bear is a note-taking app that offers a clean writing environment without unnecessary distractions. Thus, it appeals to people who regularly take notes, keep personal journals, or collect research.

The iPhone Duo’s larger display makes it comfortable to work with longer notes and organize information. Bear also supports Split View. For example, you could open a webpage in Safari while keeping your notes visible for writing down important information.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Write and organize longer notes in Markdown.
  • Work with more content on the screen.
  • Use Split View for research and note-taking.
  • Keep your writing workflow organized.

Price: Free with an optional Pro subscription starting at $2.99.

Who should download it: Writers, researchers, students, and anyone who takes frequent notes.

Who can skip it: Users who only need occasional notes and prefer Apple’s Notes app.

Download

5. Goodnotes: Turn your iPhone Duo into a digital notebook

Goodnotes is especially interesting because it brings handwritten note-taking to the iPhone Duo. With its optimized interface, the larger display provides more room for writing, drawing, annotating documents, and organizing handwritten notes.

Apple Pencil support is available with iPhone Duo starting with iOS 27.2. This makes the device more useful for students, professionals, and anyone who prefers writing things down instead of typing.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Take handwritten notes.
  • Annotate documents and PDFs.
  • Organize digital notebooks.
  • Use Apple Pencil for a more natural writing experience.

Price: Free, with subscription options starting at $1.99.

Who should download it: Students, teachers, and professionals who regularly work with handwritten notes.

Who can skip it: Anyone who rarely writes by hand or prefers a traditional keyboard-based workflow.

Download

Productivity pairings worth trying

The real benefit of a larger foldable screen becomes clearer when you use two apps together.

Here are two combinations worth trying:

  • Fantastical + Mail: Keep your schedule visible while responding to important emails.
  • Outlook + Word: Read an email on one side while preparing a document on the other.

These combinations can make the iPhone Duo feel more like a compact productivity workstation than a conventional smartphone.

Best iPhone Duo apps for watching videos

Watching videos is one of the most obvious uses for a larger display. However, the iPhone Duo’s foldable design adds another interesting possibility: you don’t always need to hold the device.

By folding it halfway, you can prop it up on a table and enjoy hands-free viewing.

6. Netflix: Browse clips and continue watching on the larger screen

Netflix is one of the streaming apps highlighted by Apple for iPhone Duo.

One interesting aspect of its experience is how you can browse Clips on the outer display and then open the device to continue watching. This creates a convenient transition between discovering content and enjoying it on the larger screen.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Browse short video Clips.
  • Open the device for a larger viewing experience.
  • Enjoy movies and TV shows on the expanded display.
  • Use the half-folded position for hands-free viewing.

Price: Free app; Netflix subscription required for streaming (starts at $19.99).

Who should download it: Anyone who already uses Netflix for movies, series, and documentaries.

Download

7. Prime Video: Watch movies with X-Ray information

Prime Video takes an interesting approach to the iPhone Duo’s half-folded position. When the device is folded halfway, the video can appear on the upper portion while X-Ray information occupies the lower portion.

If you haven’t used X-Ray before, it provides additional information about the content you’re watching, including cast details. This is particularly useful when you’re watching a movie and want to know more about an actor or character without leaving the video.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Watch content on the upper portion of the display.
  • View X-Ray information on the lower portion.
  • Discover cast information while watching.
  • Use the folded position as a convenient viewing stand.

Price: Free app; subscription required for Prime Video content.

Who should download it: Existing Prime Video subscribers who enjoy discovering additional information about movies and shows.

Download

8. YouTube: A bigger screen for your favorite videos

YouTube is another essential download for anyone purchasing an iPhone Duo. Its optimized experience takes advantage of the larger display, making video consumption more comfortable.

You can use the half-folded position to prop up your device while watching tutorials, product reviews, entertainment videos, and long-form content. I find it particularly useful when following a cooking tutorial or watching a video while working at a desk.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Enjoy videos on the larger inner display.
  • Use the half-folded position for hands-free viewing.
  • Watch tutorials without holding the phone.
  • Take advantage of the additional screen space.

Price: Free; YouTube Premium is optional.

Who should download it: Practically anyone who regularly watches online videos.

Download

Best iPhone Duo apps for creators

The iPhone Duo isn’t just designed for consuming content. Its larger display also creates interesting opportunities for people who record videos, edit content, and take photographs.

For creators, the biggest advantage is having more room for editing controls, timelines, and additional information.

9. Edits: A bigger workspace for video editing

Edits, Instagram’s video-editing application, is one of the apps worth exploring on iPhone Duo.

Video editing on a regular iPhone can sometimes feel cramped. The timeline, preview window, and editing controls compete for limited screen space.

The iPhone Duo’s expanded display gives you more room to organize these elements for Instagram Reels and short-form videos.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Work with a larger editing timeline.
  • View more editing controls.
  • Organize video clips more comfortably.
  • Make short-form video editing easier on a mobile device.

Price: Free.

Who should download it: Instagram creators and people who regularly edit short videos.

Download

10. Detail: Podcast and video editing with on-device AI

While testing, I was impressed by how Detail uses on-device AI models through Apple’s Core AI framework to edit videos. One of its useful capabilities is displaying video alongside its transcript.

This can make editing interviews, podcasts, and spoken-word videos more convenient because you can work with the visual content and associated text together.

The iPhone Duo’s larger display gives this workflow more room. Instead of constantly switching between the video and transcript, you can keep both visible while editing.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Work with video and transcripts together.
  • Use on-device AI-powered editing capabilities.
  • Organize podcast and video workflows.
  • Take advantage of the expanded display for editing.

Price: Free with Pro & Legacy subscription starting at $4.99.

Who should download it: Podcasters, video creators, interviewers, and people who regularly edit spoken-word content.

Download

11. Halide Mark III: A camera app for photography enthusiasts

Halide is a popular choice among photography enthusiasts who want more control over their iPhone camera. It adapts its camera interface to all three iPhone Duo positions.

When closed, it offers a clean viewfinder designed for the outer screen. In the partially open position, you can turn the device into a waist-level viewfinder, creating a shooting experience similar to a classic Hasselblad camera.

When fully open, you get more room to use professional tools like Process Zero for natural RAW photos, manual exposure controls, focus peaking, and Cullen Kelly-designed looks.

Why it’s worth exploring:

  • Access advanced photography controls.
  • Get a more customizable camera experience.
  • Explore manual photography options.
  • The interface smartly adapts to the foldable display.

Price: Paid (Membership starts at $9.99).

Who should download it: Photography enthusiasts who want more control than the standard Camera app offers.

Download

Best iPhone Duo apps for reading, travel, and the kitchen

The larger display isn’t only useful for work and entertainment. It can also improve everyday activities such as reading books, checking travel information, and following recipes.

These four apps demonstrate how the foldable design can make ordinary tasks more convenient.

12. CalibReader: Read books like a physical book

CalibReader is an interesting choice for people who enjoy reading ebooks and PDFs.

When you open the iPhone Duo, CalibReader can display a two-page spread with real page curls, creating an experience closer to reading a physical book.

You can view the cover on the outer display and switch to the larger inner screen for a two-page reading layout. This is intuitive for reading documents, digital books, and other long-form content.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Display two pages together.
  • Read ebooks and PDFs on a larger screen.
  • View the book cover on the outer display.
  • Enjoy a more traditional book-like reading layout.

Price: Free. Unlock all books forever for $9.99.

Who should download it: Ebook readers, students, and people who regularly read PDFs.

Download

13. Flighty: Keep track of your flights

If you travel frequently, Flighty is one of the most useful apps to consider. It helps you track flight information and stay informed about your journey.

The iPhone Duo’s larger display gives the app more room to show travel information, making it easier to check key details without navigating multiple screens.

You can also prop up the device to keep flight information visible while preparing for a journey.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Track flight information.
  • View travel details on a larger screen.
  • Keep important flight information accessible.
  • Use the propped-up position for convenient viewing.

Price: Free with a Pro subscription starting at $4.99.

Who should download it: Frequent flyers, business travelers, and anyone who likes keeping track of flight information.

Download

14. Wider: Make Safari use the entire outer display

Wider takes a slightly different approach to the foldable experience.

Instead of focusing on the larger inner display, this Safari extension is designed to make better use of the outer screen. It expands Safari’s usable width and can also work with Split View.

This is useful because the outer display is where you’ll probably perform many quick browsing tasks without unfolding your phone.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Make Safari use more of the available outer-screen width.
  • Improve the browsing layout.
  • Work with Split View.
  • Get more room for webpage content.

Price: Free.

Who should download it: People who frequently browse the web and want to make better use of the outer display.

Download

15. NYT Cooking: Follow recipes while you cook

If you regularly follow recipes when cooking your meals, the NYT Cooking app will come in handy. The iPhone Duo’s half-folded position makes it easier to place the device on a kitchen counter without a separate stand.

You can keep a recipe visible while preparing ingredients, checking measurements, and following cooking instructions. The larger display also provides more room to read recipe details.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Follow recipes on a larger display.
  • Keep instructions visible while cooking.
  • Use the half-folded position as a stand.
  • Reduce the need to repeatedly pick up the device.

Price: Subscription required (starts at $7).

Who should download it: Home cooks and anyone who regularly follows digital recipes.

Download

Best iPhone Duo games

Gaming is where the iPhone Duo’s foldable design really shines.

Apple’s A20 Pro chip and vapor chamber cooling system are designed to deliver improved performance. Apple claims it can provide up to 35% better sustained performance than the iPhone 17 Pro. That gives developers more opportunities to create games that use the larger display and different folding positions.

Here are five iPhone Duo games worth checking out.

16. Asphalt Legends: Racing on a bigger display

Asphalt Legends is a racing game that benefits from having more screen space. It uses the inner folding display by placing the main racing action on the top screen and the race map, additional telemetry, or controls on the bottom screen.

I enjoyed the clearer track view with useful racing information within easy reach, which made the game more immersive. For players who enjoy fast-paced racing games, the fully open position provides the best experience.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Enjoy racing on a larger display.
  • Get a more immersive view of the track.
  • Take advantage of the device’s performance capabilities.
  • Play without being restricted to the smaller outer display.

Price: Free with in-app purchases starting at $0.99.

Download

17. Delta: Experience dual-screen retro gaming

Delta emulator brings support for classic gaming systems, including Nintendo DS-style experiences. The iPhone Duo’s foldable display makes this particularly appealing because it can recreate the feeling of using a dual-screen handheld gaming device.

You can use one portion of the display for the main gameplay and the other for additional game information or controls. This creates a more natural experience than squeezing two screens onto a conventional smartphone display.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Experience Nintendo DS-style dual-screen layouts.
  • Take advantage of the foldable display.
  • Enjoy supported retro gaming systems.
  • Use the larger screen for a more immersive experience

Price: Free. In-app purchases start at $5.

Download

18. Marbles Unhinged: A game that uses the fold as a control

Marbles Unhinged is one of the most unusual games on this list. Rather than simply stretching traditional gameplay across a larger display, it uses the iPhone Duo’s fold itself as part of the gaming experience.

You tilt the phone to roll the marble through the maze, while physically folding the device’s hinge reshapes the path. The two displays form one continuous board, with the crease acting as a bridge, drop, wall, or gate that changes how you navigate.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Uses the fold as part of the controls.
  • Offers a gaming experience designed around the hardware.
  • Takes advantage of different device positions.
  • Provides something different from conventional mobile games.

Price: 10 levels are free, then unlock at $2.99.

Download

19. Battlefleet Duo: Play battleship in laptop position

Battlefleet Duo is another strategy game designed around the iPhone Duo’s foldable hardware. It brings a Battleship-style gaming experience to the device.

Instead of holding the phone like a conventional smartphone, you can position it halfway open with your fleet on the lower screen and the enemy’s hidden waters on the upper screen.

You can also unfold the device for animated 3D battles or switch to a classic board-game look with grids and pegs. Play against AI, challenge a friend locally, or compete online through Game Center.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Offers a Battleship-style experience.
  • Uses the laptop-style folding position.
  • Takes advantage of the two display sections.
  • Provides a different way to play board-style games.

Price: 2 free battles daily. Unlock the full game at $4.99.

Download

20. Retrocade: Turn your iPhone Duo into a mini arcade

Retrocade is an Apple Arcade title that brings a collection of retro-style gaming experiences to the iPhone Duo.

Its appeal is simple: enjoy a nostalgic arcade experience while using the device’s different positions. Whether you want to enjoy classic-style games during a break or simply explore something different, Retrocade is worth checking out.

Why it’s useful on iPhone Duo:

  • Enjoy retro-inspired arcade games.
  • Explore different device positions.
  • Take advantage of the larger display.
  • Get a nostalgic gaming experience.

Price: Apple Arcade subscription required.

Download

Other games worth watching

A few additional games are also worth checking on the App Store:

  • Zenless Zone Zero: Worth exploring for players who enjoy visually impressive action RPGs.
  • UnGodly: Another title to check for lovers of brutal dark fantasy RPGs.

Fun apps that actually use the iPhone Duo fold

Not every interesting app needs to improve productivity or offer a better entertainment experience. Some developers are using the fold itself as part of the app’s main functionality.

Here are four worth exploring:

  • VNTG: Uses the folding design for a vintage film camera-inspired experience. Close the device to shoot and open it to develop the photo.
  • Deck-Man: Turns the device into a retro cassette-player-style interface and uses Apple Music.
  • Duo Aquarium ($1): Offers an immersive aquarium experience designed around the foldable display.
  • Post Club ($4.99): Type letters to your loved ones using a typewriter on the iPhone Duo.

These aren’t necessarily the first apps I’d recommend installing. However, they demonstrate that the best foldable apps aren’t always the ones that simply display more information. Sometimes, they make the hardware itself part of the experience.

Popular apps not optimized for iPhone Duo yet

Apple has announced that more than 100,000 apps have been optimized for the iPhone Duo. That’s an impressive number, but several widely used apps still lack dedicated optimization.

Compatibility statuses are as of writing. Not optimized does not necessarily mean an app cannot run. Check for app updates regularly, as more developers update to the iOS 27.2 SDK.

How we picked the best iPhone Duo apps

Not every app with a larger-screen interface deserves to be called a good iPhone Duo app. For this list, I focused on apps that offer something useful beyond simply stretching their existing interfaces.

Here are the criteria used to evaluate the recommendations.

1. Dedicated iPhone Duo support

First, I checked whether the app has the Made for iPhone Duo badge or mentions iPhone Duo support in its description. This helps distinguish apps that have received dedicated optimization from those that merely run on the device.

2. Meaningful use of the foldable display

The second consideration is whether the app makes practical use of the larger display or different folding positions.

For example:

  • Outlook uses the larger display to show an inbox alongside a message.
  • Prime Video uses the half-folded position to display video and X-Ray information.
  • CalibReader creates a two-page reading experience.
  • Marbles Unhinged uses the fold as part of its gameplay.

These apps offer experiences that matter more than simply filling extra screen space.

3. Useful everyday functionality

I also prioritized apps that solve real problems. Productivity tools, streaming services, reading applications, travel utilities, and games all have a place on this list.

4. Pricing and availability

Finally, pricing and availability matter.

An app might be free to download but require a subscription for its most useful features. So it’s less appealing.

Final thoughts

The iPhone Duo’s biggest strength isn’t simply its larger screen. It’s the ability to change how you interact with applications depending on how you position the device.

Some apps make everyday tasks easier. Fantastical and Outlook improve productivity, Goodnotes creates a more convenient digital notebook, and CalibReader makes reading feel closer to using a physical book.

Others make the device more entertaining. Netflix and Prime Video take advantage of the half-folded position, while Delta and Marbles Unhinged demonstrate how developers can rethink mobile gaming around foldable hardware.

But I wouldn’t recommend downloading every app just because it carries an iPhone Duo badge. Start with the apps you already use every day, check whether they’re properly optimized, then explore apps that offer genuinely new ways to use the fold.

  • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
  • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

title.rendered: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so agents pay without seeing card details

content.rendered:
ChatGPT Wallet launched on November 13, 2026. It lets dots complete purchases after the user approves them. A dot is the always-on agent inside ChatGPT. At first, Wallet is limited to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US who are 18 or older and have an eligible US-issued card.

OpenAI calls it “the first wallet that lets agents pay without access to users’ actual card details.” The payment network provides a payment token that stands in for the card details. The charge goes to the selected card, and Wallet does not share the actual card details with the business or the agent.

Dots launched on September 29, 2026, for Pro, Business Premium, and eligible Enterprise workspaces. Wallet is how dots pay for purchases. In October, ChatGPT’s virtual try-on shopping sent some purchases through Instant Checkout. Other purchases sent the user to the retailer’s site to finish. The bank-linking preview for US Pro users in May covered budgeting, spending insights, and planning, which is a different job from paying.

Every purchase needs the user’s approval through a security check

Adding a card is a one-time step. Before each purchase, the user reviews the merchant, the items, the total, and the selected card. Approval comes through a security check such as Face ID or a fingerprint scan, and each approval creates a clear record of what the user authorized.

Wallet requires a security check for every purchase, and that is the right rule for an agent that can spend money. One approval never covers the next order. Nothing gets charged on the agent’s word alone.

Wallet also keeps existing card rewards and protections for eligible disputes. The example given is an item that arrives defective. Wallet was built in partnership with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa. OpenAI also says it won’t take a cut of Wallet transactions at first.

Some sites may unintentionally block purchases made through ChatGPT Wallet or other agentic payment products. Wallet’s payment tokens work with existing checkout flows, but risk systems may still flag purchases made by agents. OpenAI is working with businesses to help them adapt.

Only Pro users in the US can use Wallet for now

Free and Plus users are not in the first rollout. No date has been given for wider availability. OpenAI plans to work with businesses, banks, and payment networks to expand it. For everyone else, the missing date is the biggest limit at launch.

Users may later be able to set spending limits, purchase categories, or time periods, and to pre-approve purchases with extra safeguards. None of that is in the launch.

If you are a Pro subscriber in the US with an eligible US-issued card, you can add a card to Wallet now. Everyone else should watch for a date on wider availability.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

As an Amazon Associate, iGeeksBlog earns from qualifying purchases.
