title.rendered: 10 best Minecraft seeds for November 2026

content.rendered:
Looking for a fresh start in Minecraft? It might be time to leave your current world behind and explore a new one with a different seed. Minecraft seeds are codes made up of numbers and letters that determine how a world generates, including its terrain, biomes, and structures.

Every seed creates a unique world, but some offer particularly impressive landscapes, rare resources, and useful structures close to your spawn point. Whether you want to build a peaceful village, explore underground cities, or survive in a frozen landscape, the right seed can make your next adventure much more interesting.

We’ve put together 10 of the best Minecraft seeds for Java Edition to try in November 2026. Each one offers something different, so you can choose a world that matches your playstyle.

10 best Minecraft seeds for November 2026 at a glance

1. Zombie villages

Seed: 67480912992

This seed spawns you right next to two Zombie villages, which makes it an interesting starting point for your survival adventure. You can cure the Zombie Villagers using a Splash Potion of Weakness and a Golden Apple to get discounted trades. These discounts can come in handy when purchasing items. To see what each profession offers, check our guide to Minecraft villager jobs.

Some of the must-explore locations in this seed are:

  • Zombie Village #1:16,0
  • Zombie Village #2: 0, -144
  • Trial Chamber: -233, 9

2. Autumn seas

Seed: -1502246241383881913

Minecraft has plenty of worlds with stunning ocean views, but this seed stands out thanks to its autumn-colored forests surrounded by water. The landscape makes for a perfect spot to capture screenshots or set up some beautiful house builds.

Once you’ve taken in the scenery, you can also venture into the nearby Cheese caves or head underground to explore Trial Chambers.

Here are the coordinates for these locations:

  • Cheese cave #1: -288, -96
  • Cheese cave #2: -136, -144
  • Cheese cave #3: 256, -104
  • Trial Chamber #1: -487, 239
  • Trial Chamber #2: 71, 167
  • Witch Hut: 8, 152

3. Nether portal

Seed: 2990297396645658645

Getting to the Nether can take some effort, but this Minecraft seed gives you a head start. Right next to your spawn, you’ll find a Taiga Village that has a Ruined Nether Portal, saving you the trouble of gathering resources and building one from scratch.

If you’re looking for more, there’s also a Trial Chamber located directly under the village. The village itself is also worth exploring, as you can stock up on food, gather resources, and trade with villagers.

Here are some locations you shouldn’t miss:

  • Taiga Village: 35, -2
  • Ruined Nether Portal: 88, 8
  • Trial Chamber: 25, -20, -9

4. Cherry blossoms

Seed:  -5584399987456711267

Cherry Grove biomes are among the prettiest places to build in Minecraft, thanks to their pink trees and scenic surroundings. This seed places you right in the middle of a beautiful Cherry Grove, giving you an ideal location for a Japanese-inspired house or a peaceful survival base.

For a darker window that still lets you see outside, learn how to make and use Tinted Glass.

The area also has plenty to explore beyond its scenery. You’ll find a Ruined Nether Portal, an Ancient City, Mineshafts, and multiple villages nearby.

Here are the coordinates for the major locations:

  • Ruined Portal: -248, 88
  • Ancient City: -312, 72
  • Mineshaft #1: -360, -392
  • Mineshaft #2: 248, -376
  • Savanna Village #1: 96, 320
  • Savanna Village #2: 48, 624

5. Underground world

Seed: -9058709175479032911

The seed drops you right next to a Desert village nestled inside a lush cave. As you explore your surroundings, you will come across a cave that’s filled with vegetation, mineshafts, and tons of villages packed with loot waiting to be collected.

The terrain makes this seed interesting, as you have unexpected sights waiting around every corner. We’d recommend equipping an Elytra to get a better aerial view of the landscapes and appreciate just how impressive this world is.

Here are the best coordinates of the seed:

  • Desert Village: 192, -368
  • Pillager Outpost: 192, 80

6. Snowy beach

Seed:  -6909477426377259322

You’ll be dropped into a frozen landscape that’s surrounded by nothing but ice, which makes for a challenging start. Resources will be limited, so you’ll need to save and make the most of what you can find.

Head towards the nearby Shipwreck to search for loot and explore the buried treasure that’s scattered along the frozen coastline. Just be careful around Polar Bears, as they can quickly turn everything upside down.

Here’s what you can find here:

  • Ocean Ruins: 696, -280
  • Mineshaft: 632, -520
  • Ruined Nether Portal: 680, -344
  • Shipwreck: 392, -472
  • Ocean Monument: 216, -616
  • Buried Treasure: 873, -407

7. Plains

Seed: 6246468738900744

Looking for a peaceful Minecraft world where you can take your time without worrying about hostile mobs or survival challenges? This is your seed. You’ll spawn in a beautiful landscape featuring cherry blossoms, a lake, and tons of nearby villages.

Settle into one of the villages, explore the nearby mines, gather resources, trade with villagers, and slowly build your way to the top.

There’s more to explore outside the mountains, including a mansion and Tiral Chamber waiting for you underground.

9. Ancient City Wonders

If you’re hunting for Chiseled Soushale in Minecraft, this seed is worth checking out. You’ll find an Ancient City close to your spawn with several more scattered across the surrounding area. However, exploring won’t be a walk in the park, as the Warden will be waiting to fight you. So, make sure you come prepared with your best gear and plan your moves carefully before heading into the deep dark.

How to use seeds in Minecraft

Now that you know about some of the best Minecraft seeds, you might be wondering how to use them in your world. Well, the process is quite easy. Here’s a step-by-step guide to using seeds in Minecraft Java Edition:

  1. Open Minecraft and select Singleplayer from the main menu.
  2. Choose Create New World.
  3. Open the More World Options tab.
  4. Find the World Seed field.
  5. Enter or paste the seed code you want to use.
  6. Adjust your game mode and other world settings.
  7. Select Create New World to generate your world.

Make sure you enter the seed exactly as provided, as even a single incorrect digit can generate an entirely different world with different terrain and structures. If you want to find the seed of your existing world, simply enable Minecraft commands and type /seed in the chat to find it.

Final thoughts

One of the best ways to completely overhaul your Minecraft experience is to start a new world using a different seed. Players across the community have spent thousands of hours discovering seeds that offer everything from beautiful views and valuable loot to hidden underground adventures right near spawn.

However, keep in mind that Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition can generate different worlds even when you enter the exact same seed. All the seeds we’ve mentioned above are made for Java Edition, so make sure you’re playing the correct version before trying them out.

What is the best Minecraft seed in November 2026?

The best Minecraft seed in November 2026 comes down to what kind of adventure you’re looking for. However, 6246468738900744 is a great choice, as it has everything you need for survival, trading and gathering resources.

Do Minecraft seeds work on both Java and Bedrock?

Minecraft seeds can be used in both Java and Bedrock Editions. However, entering the same seed in both versions doesn’t mean you will get an identical world.

Can I use old Minecraft seeds in the latest version?

Old Minecraft seeds can be used with the latest version. However, the generation of the world can depend on the version you’re playing. This is because updates can change structure locations and terrain generation.

How do I find my Minecraft world seed?

You can easily find your Minecraft world seed by opening in the in-game chat and typing /seed command. Make sure cheats are enabled.

Do Minecraft seeds change between updates?

Minecraft seeds don’t change after each update. However, what can change is terrain generation, biomes and other structures.

title.rendered: Fortnite Treasure Hunters: All buried chest locations

content.rendered:
Not all chests in Fortnite are hidden inside houses or locked away in vaults, as there are some that are found buried under the surface. Such chests require excavation before you can pry them open, but give similar rewards to their equivalent type of chest above the ground.

Buried chests in Fortnite Treasure Hunters are quite prevalent across the Crossbones Isle Battle Royale map, thanks to the mini-season being themed around pirates and treasures. Moreover, while some of these chests can be discovered naturally, others require equipping the Treasure Map item first.

You can read more about the abundance of these chests this Fortnite season and find out their approximate locations in the game by going through the guide below.

All buried chest locations in Fortnite Treasure Hunters

There are a total of 62 buried chests scattered throughout the entire One Piece-inspired map, per Fortnite.gg. The same source has also identified map locations for finding these chests, as given below.

How to find buried Sprite Chests using Treasure Maps and gizmos

There are certain Sprite Chests buried deep into the ground whose respective locations are only revealed through using Treasure Maps and certain gizmos, namely Sprite Locator and Lucky Locator. These methods guarantee one sprite per chest, which may or may not be one that you already have.

To obtain a Treasure Map, you must encounter a Wanted Poster first and interact with it. On the other hand, to get a Sprite Locator or Lucky Locator, you must reach certain Sprite Mastery milestones or complete certain quests that have one of these two items as a reward.

Further, to ensure you discover a Sprite Chest that gives you a sprite that is missing from your collection, you should use the Lucky Locator. It is advisable to also carry a Portable Extractor when you are using this particular way to get a new sprite, so that you can extract it as soon as it’s in your possession.

Best sprite for finding buried chests

Hands down, Fortune Exmarks emerges as the most apt sprite to equip on your playthroughs focused on opening buried chests by the dozen. Being an Exmarks Sprite, it marks the locations of nearby Wanted Posters (Treasure Maps) and, being a Fortune variant, it simultaneously reveals the location of all kinds of chests in the player character’s vicinity.

If you can’t find this exact sprite, any Fortune sprite or any other Exmarks Sprite variant can also prove useful, as they possess at least one of the aforementioned traits that can facilitate finding buried chests. It will be interesting to see which one of these sprites becomes more popular, as players strive to unlatch as many chests as they can to get their hands on valuable items such as the Pirate Shop Access or the Sweet Dreams Sprite.

FAQs

Where is the best place to find buried chests in Fortnite?

The best place for buried chests with the highest concentration of them is the POI literally named “The Chest”, located in the north-west part of the map.

How to dig up buried chests in Fortnite?

You can excavate buried chests by using your pickaxe. It will be openable after a few strikes with the tool.

Do buried chests come back after you open them?

Although the official word on it is not known, certain players in the Fortnite community have observed that opened chests respawn when you revisit them after a Storm circle has passed.

Do Photographic Styles affect video recording?

Yes, the buried Sprite Chests, which these Wanted Posters lead to, always contain a single sprite.

title.rendered: Grok Bot on Mac can now use Apple Mail, Messages, and Notes

content.rendered:
Your texts, emails, notes, and reminders are probably all on your Mac right now. Grok Bot can now work with every one of them, but only after you allow each app.

Grok Bot’s official X account posted the update on November 12. It names six Apple apps, Messages, Mail, Notes, Reminders, Calendar, and Contacts, plus Location. The access runs through your Mac, and Grok Bot developer Evan Bacon says you can use it from Grok Bot on your phone, on the web, or in a Tesla.

Mail and Notes are new on the Mac

On iPhone, Grok Bot’s support page lists Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Location, and Home, plus alarms and timers. Mail, Messages, and Notes are not on that list, even though the October iPhone permission screen showed a Messages row. On iPhone, Grok can only read your contacts. The Connect Apps screen says Grok can find and add contacts, which is a wider description than that.

The Mac list is longer than the iPhone list: seven items against six. Mail and Notes hold a lot of private writing, so they deserve a closer look than Calendar or Reminders before you turn anything on.

What each app can do

The Connect Apps screen gives each app one short line and its own Allow button, so you choose the apps one at a time.

  • Messages: read and send messages. This is the one that can send for you.
  • Mail: search and draft emails. The screen does not say Grok can send them.
  • Notes: read and write notes.
  • Reminders: set and check reminders.
  • Contacts: find and add contacts.
  • Location: find places near you.

The Calendar line repeats the Location wording, so the screen does not say what Calendar access covers. If you want to test the feature first, Reminders is the lowest-stakes row.

Two requirements are still missing

  • It does not name a macOS version. The iPhone app needs iOS 18 or later.
  • It does not say whether a paid plan is required. The iPhone app requires a specific paid plan, such as Premium, Super, or Ultra on The X Subscription, or a legacy Cursor plan. The Mac post doesn’t say whether the same rule applies.

How Grok Bot got here

Grok Bot launched in August as an always-on AI agent for Mac and iPhone. On October 22, the iPhone version added access to Calendar, Reminders, and Contacts.

Grok Bot 1.0 followed on November 2. That release focused on AI teammates for teams, with Slack and Microsoft Teams support and improved connections to Gmail, Google Calendar, and GitHub. Team Bots need a Team or Enterprise plan. The 1.0 announcement does not name any Apple app.

Grok’s Gmail and Google Calendar connections run as plugins.

Mac permissions are the bigger question

Apple said it plans to require more explicit steps before any app can get Full Disk Access on the Mac. That permission lets an app reach protected files. Apple hasn’t shipped the change or named a macOS version for it, so Mac permissions still work as they do now.

If you try it, allow only the apps Grok needs for the job, and read each permission line before you allow it.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Want GTA 6 Ultimate Edition for free? Here’s how to enter KICK’s giveaway

content.rendered:
Let’s be honest, the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition isn’t a cheap deal. At $99 USD, it’s a pretty expensive purchase, even for a game as highly anticipated as GTA 6. However, what if we told you you could get it without spending a dime? Well, you heard that right! Popular streaming platform KICK has announced a massive GTA 6 Ultimate Edition giveaway, running from November 12 to December 7, 2026.

The giveaway will see 10,000 lucky winners receive a free digital copy of the game on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles. So, how can you enter and stand a chance of winning? Here’s everything you need to know about KICK’s GTA 6 Ultimate Edition giveaway.

How to enter KICK’s GTA 6 giveaway

KICK is calling this promotion the Sunset Reward Case. It comes with several rewards, including exclusive badges, emotes, and, of course, the highly sought-after GTA 6 codes for PS5 or Xbox Series X/S.

To enter the giveaway and get your hands on these cases, here’s what you need to do:

  1. Visit the official KICK website or open the KICK app.
  2. Sign in to your existing account or create a new one.
  3. Watch any live content on KICK for 180 minutes (three hours).
  4. Once you’ve completed the required watch time, you’ll unlock a Sunset Reward Case.
  5. Open the case to see whether you’ve won a GTA 6 Ultimate Edition code or another reward.

It’s worth keeping in mind that getting a GTA 6 code from the case isn’t guaranteed. Each Sunset Reward Case has a chance of containing the game code, alongside the other available rewards.

You can unlock one case every day, so make sure to keep up with your daily watch time and build your stream. Also, if you’re new to KICK, you’ll receive an additional free case after completing your account setup.

KICK has clarified that its GTA 6 Ultimate Edition giveaway is not affiliated with Rockstar Games. The platform will contact all the selected winners through email to verify their eligibility. However, you won’t receive your game code immediately, as KICK will only start distributing the codes from November 19, 2026.

KICK GTA 6 giveaway: Eligibility and important details

We’ve covered pretty much everything you need to know about the KICK GTA 6 giveaway above. However, if you still have any doubts.

Here’s a quick breakdown of the eligibility criteria and other important details you should keep in mind:

  1. Giveaway period: The promotion runs from November 12 to December 7, 2026. Make sure you unlock and open your reward cases during this period.
  2. Daily entries: You can unlock one case per day by watching 180 minutes of live content on KICK. The watch-time requirement resets daily.
  3. No purchase required: You don’t need to buy a subscription, make a purchase, or deposit money to enter. Paying does not improve your chances of winning.
  4. Available platforms: The prize pool includes 10,000 digital copies of GTA 6 Ultimate Edition for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
  5. Regional restrictions: Xbox codes are available globally, subject to applicable platform and campaign requirements. PS5 codes are restricted to supported countries, and your selected country must match the one registered to your PlayStation Network account.
  6. Winner verification: Winning selections are provisional until KICK verifies eligibility. You may be asked to provide additional information to confirm that you meet the campaign requirements.
  7. Code distribution: KICK won’t issue codes before November 19, 2026. Once your eligibility is confirmed and your code is available, you can find it on the Drops and Rewards page.

Wrapping up!

KICK’s Sunset Reward Case promotion gives players a chance to win one of 10,000 digital copies of GTA 6 Ultimate Edition for PS5 or Xbox Series X|S. All you need to do is watch live content for three hours, unlock a reward case, and open it for a chance to win.

You can repeat the process daily until December 7, 2026, so don’t miss your opportunity to enter. Just remember that winning isn’t guaranteed, and PS5 players must select a region that matches their PSN account.

If you’re lucky enough to win, check out our GTA 6 PS5 storage guide to prepare your console before downloading the game.

FAQs

Is KICK giving away GTA 6 Ultimate Edition for free?

KICK is giving away 10,000 free digital copies of GTA 6 Ultimate Edition for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. To enter, you need to watch any live stream on the platform for three hours and open a case for a chance to win a game mode.

How many GTA 6 copies is KICK giving away?

KICK is providing 10,000 digital copies of the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition as part of the Sunset Reward Case promotion.

How long do you need to watch KICK streams to enter the giveaway?

You need to watch any live stream on KICK for 180 minutes (three hours) in order to unlock a Sunset Reward Case.

Can you enter the KICK GTA 6 giveaway every day?

You can enter the KICK GTA 6 giveaway every day. You will get one Sunset Reward Case daily by watching three hours of live stream on the platform.

Is the KICK GTA 6 giveaway available in India?

The KICK GTA 6 giveaway is available for players in India.

title.rendered: X now lets you post up to 20 photos and videos, up from four

content.rendered:
X now lets you attach up to 20 photos and videos to one post, up from four. Jonah Katz, who leads mobile engineering at X, announced the change on his own account on November 12. The new cap is five times the old one, and it counts photos and videos together.

X has allowed four per post for about 10 years. Katz put it this way: “After 10 years of Twitter/X supporting up to 4 Photos and Videos per post, the limit has been increased to 20!”

The change reached the web first

The higher limit showed up on X’s website before the mobile apps. The iPhone and Android apps are getting it too, but not every user has it yet, and some still see four. Katz’s follow-up post tells users to update the app if the option does not appear.

Big update to the X platform today After 10 years of Twitter/X supporting up to 4 Photos and Videos per post, the limit has been increased to 20! Happy posting https://t.co/8hjclgo3rk

— Jonah Katz (@dinkin_flickaa) November 12, 2026

An earlier test pointed the same way. In June, a test post from an X Developer Platform employee showed six videos attached to one post. At the time, the change had not reached general users. The new cap of 20 is more than three times that test.

What the announcement leaves out

Katz’s announcement covers only the number of attachments. It does not mention longer videos, higher upload quality, or file size limits. It also does not say whether the higher limit needs X Premium or another paid plan, which accounts get it first, or when every account will have it.

X’s public developer documentation still says a post may include up to four photos, one animated GIF, or one video, with no higher number. Apps and scheduling tools that follow those docs may keep the old limit until they update.

What it means for your posts

Four was tight for anyone posting an event. Twenty fits most photo sets from a single day, so a full photo dump can now go in one post. Instagram has allowed 20 photos or videos in one carousel since August 2024, and its carousel posts also let each slide carry its own caption.

With more items in a post, each photo or video can be marked as sensitive on its own, so check each one before you post.

To see whether the change has reached your account, try attaching a fifth photo to a new post. If the app accepts it, you have the new limit. If it stops at four, update the app and try again.

Whether you’re customizing your iPhone, troubleshooting your Android, or tweaking Chrome OS settings, my goal is to help you get more out of your tech.

title.rendered: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster and lower-cost model

content.rendered:
Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen and calls it a fast, lower-cost model for everyday coding and agentic work. Agentic work means jobs where the AI takes several steps on its own to finish a task.

Hydrogen is the speed model, not the top one

Google places Hydrogen beside Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon, its most advanced models. Hydrogen has four thinking levels, from low to xhigh, and high is the default. Thinking levels control how hard the model works on a question before it answers.

Google says Hydrogen finishes tasks about 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash at its default high setting. If you ask many quick questions, that is the number that matters most.

Some people still find Hydrogen slow next to rivals

Not everyone sees the speed gain. Theo (t3.gg) ran the same code review brief through Hydrogen and several rival models, then posted the results.

“Built for speed” Still garbage speeds compared to anything else on the market. Note that I ran Sol and Opus at regular tier! Didn’t even use fast/ultrafast. https://t.co/DWQ8pPExmP

— Theo – t3.gg (@theo) November 12, 2026

Theo’s chart puts Hydrogen at 4 minutes 43 seconds. Gemini 4 Carbon took 14 minutes 8 seconds, Opus 5.5 took 2 minutes 53 seconds, and GPT-6.1 Sol took 2 minutes 17 seconds. Each time is an average of four rounds. He says he ran Sol and Opus at their regular tier, not the fast or ultrafast modes.

That is one coding task, so it is one data point. It does not clash with Google’s 2.5x figure, which compares Hydrogen with Gemini 3.8 Flash, not with rival models. It does show that Hydrogen can beat Carbon and still trail Sol and Opus on this test.

Most of the numbers come from Google’s own tests

On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, an independent score that combines several tests, Hydrogen scores 51 at its default setting and 54 at xhigh. Argon scores 50. A one-point gap at the default setting is small, so the intelligence claim is weaker than the speed claim.

On Terminal-Bench 4.1, a test of AI agents working in a terminal, Hydrogen scores 57%. Gemini 3.8 Flash scores 18.2% on the same test. Google also says Hydrogen produces more than five times fewer fabricated claims, its term for made-up statements, than 3.8 Flash.

Unnamed partners in Google’s tests saw runs 2x to 2.8x faster, with 12% to 23% fewer tokens. Tokens are the chunks of text a model reads and writes, and they are what developers pay for.

These are Google’s own tests and unnamed partner tests. They show what Google measured, not how Hydrogen will handle your work.

Free users can use Hydrogen in the Gemini app

Hydrogen is in the Gemini app’s model picker, labeled “Everyday help.” Free users can’t pick it themselves. They reach it through Auto model selection when a prompt calls for it.

Free accounts lost access to Flash and Pro on October 9. For them, Auto is now the way to reach Hydrogen.

In Google’s Antigravity app, Hydrogen is limited to paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. Antigravity’s Orchestrator pairs Hydrogen with stronger models such as Carbon for longer tasks.

Gemini in Google Sheets starts with Pro and Ultra subscribers. Google says Hydrogen’s output there is more than 30% faster than earlier models.

Google says Hydrogen is rolling out in Search to all users worldwide.

Developers pay $1.50 and $7.50 per million tokens

Developers can use Hydrogen in Google AI Studio and the Gemini API on every tier. It costs $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. Input is what you send the model, and output is what it writes back.

Output costs five times as much as input, so a long answer costs more than a prompt of the same length. The price stays flat across the full 1-million-token context window.

What Google has not said

Google does not give a release date for each product. It says the rollout is gradual.

Before you switch an app to Hydrogen, run your own prompts through it and compare the speed and the bill with your current model.

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Change these 5 PS5 settings for the best GTA 6 experience

content.rendered:
It’s hard to believe, but we’re just a couple of days away from the release of GTA 6. That’s right, gamers, more than a decade of waiting is finally coming to an end, as we’ll be able to dive into the world of Leonida on November 18, 2026. However, if you want to experience the criminal journey of Jason and Lucia in the best way possible, you’ll want to get your PS5 ready beforehand.

From improving audio immersion and visual quality to optimising performance, there are a bunch of console settings you can tweak to make your GTA 6 experience even better. So let’s take a look at the five best PS5 settings you should change before jumping into GTA 6.

5 PS5 settings to change before playing GTA 6 at a glance

1. Enable HDR for better visuals

One of the first PS5 settings you should enable before playing GTA 6 is High Dynamic Range (HDR). This enhances the range of colors, brightness, and contrast displayed on your screen, making the game’s visuals look vibrant and detailed. HDR can make a noticeable difference when exploring Vice City, especially in scenes with contrasting lighting.

To enable HDR on your PS5, here’s what you need to do:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Select Screen and Video.
  3. Head to Video Output.
  4. Set HDR to On When Supported.

Once you’ve enabled HDR, select Adjust HDR and follow the further instructions to calibrate your display’s brightness level. Also, make sure HDR is enabled on your television or monitor for the HDMI input that’s connected to your PS5.

2. Set your PS5 to Performance Mode

Rockstar has confirmed that GTA 6 will run at 30 FPS on the PS5. That’s quite disappointing for players hoping for a higher frame rate, but it’s worth remembering that GTA 6 is an incredibly demanding title for the current-generation consoles.

However, you can still prepare your PS5 to priorities smoother gameplay wherever possible by setting your preferred game preset to Performance mode. This ensures the game, when supporting the option, priorities frames over visual fidelity.

Here’s how to enable it:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Head to Saved Data and Game/App Settings.
  3. Choose Game Presets.
  4. Select Performance Mode.

3. Adjust 3D audio settings

Rockstar has put a lot of effort into making GTA 6’s soundscape feel as realistic and immersive as possible. Gone are the days of the franchise’s arcade-style audio, as players will now experience punchier gunfire, punches that carry a satisfying physical impact, police sirens chorusing through the city’s buildings, and even distant seagulls.

To make the most of these audio details, one of the best PS5 settings for GTA 6 you can enable is 3D Audio. It creates a more immersive sound experience by adding depth and direction to in-game sounds.

Here’s how to switch it on:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Navigate to Sound.
  3. Choose 3D Audio (Headphones) or 3D Audio (TV Speakers).
  4. Enable the feature and follow the instructions on your console.

4. Adjust resolution and display settings

If you’ve gone through the official or even the leaked GTA 6 gameplay footage, it should be quite evident that it’s an incredibly detailed game. Of course, you’ll want to experience its visuals at the highest resolution possible, regardless of whether you’re playing on a 4K television or a gaming monitor.

To make sure your PS5 is outputting the best resolution supported by your display, here’s what you need to do:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Choose Screen and Video.
  3. Head to Video Output.
  4. Change Resolution to Automatic or choose 2160p if your display supports 4K.
  5. Set 120 Hz Output to Automatic.

Your work isn’t done here. Head into your monitor or television’s settings and make sure to enable features such as Game Mode. This can reduce input lag and make your gameplay feel even more responsive.

5. Customise your DualSense controller settings

GTA 6 is taking full advantage of the PS5, particularly its adaptive triggers and haptic feedback. The adaptive triggers will make different in-game actions feel more realistic, whether you’re firing weapons or getting involved in intense car chases. On the other hand, the controller’s haptic feedback will allow you to feel the impact of bullets, explosions, vehicle collisions, and other in-game activities.

Do these features sound exciting? Obviously they do! However, you might want to adjust your controller settings and find the right balance between comfort and immersion. After all, GTA 6 can take hours to complete; the last thing you want to experience is controller fatigue.

So, here’s how you can customise your DualSense settings on the PS5:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Head to Accessories.
  3. Choose Controller (General).
  4. Adjust the Vibration Intensity and Trigger Effect Intensity.
  5. You can also change the brightness and volume of the controller.

This setting ultimately comes down to personal preference. If you’re someone who finds adaptive triggers distracting, especially during driving or combat scenes, it’s a good idea to lower the intensity for a more comfortable experience. However, if you want to make the most of the DualSense’s immersion, keep both Trigger and Vibration Intensity high.

You can also adjust aim sensitivity, camera movement, subtitles, and other options in our guide to the best GTA 6 settings.

Wrapping up

Getting your PS5 ready for GTA 6 doesn’t require a complicated setup. Enabling HDR where supported, configuring 3D Audio, checking your display output, and adjusting DualSense feedback can help you get the most out of the game’s PlayStation features.

Just remember that selecting Performance Mode won’t turn GTA 6 into a 60 FPS experience, as Rockstar has confirmed a 30 FPS target for current-generation consoles.

You should also prepare your console by checking the reported GTA 6 PS5 file size and freeing up enough storage before launch. If you’re planning to play as soon as the game becomes available, check the GTA 6 global release times for your region. And if you haven’t purchased the game yet, here’s how to pre-order GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox.

As of now, Rockstar Games hasn’t confirmed whether GTA 6 will render natively at 4K. However, analysis of pre-release gameplay footage suggests the base PS5 could render the game at 1440P and then upscale it to 4K.

No, it’s been confirmed by Rockstar Games that GTA 6 will not supported GTA 6 on the PS5 at launch. The game will target 30 FPS across the current-generation consoles.

Does GTA 6 support DualSense adaptive triggers?

GTA 6 supports the PS5 DualSense controller’s adaptive triggers and haptic feedback. The game will take full advantage of these features for a more immersive gameplay.

Does GTA 6 support Tempest 3D Audio?

GTA 6 officially supports Sony’s Tempest 3D AudioTech on the PS5. Rockstar Games has confirmed the title will take full advantage of the console’s spatial audio technology.

title.rendered: Cursed sprites in Fortnite: What they do and how to find them

content.rendered:
A new sprite variant has been introduced in Fortnite Treasure Hunters, with the rollout of Cursed sprites. It is only the second sprite variant (excluding the base version) in the game right now, besides the Fortune sprites, and has taken the total count from 24 unique sprites to 34.

Almost every sprite that previously got a Fortune variant has received a Cursed variant, with the sole exception being the Kelper Sprite. This is understandable because the fish-like sprite’s health boost while in water directly contradicts one of the effects of the Cursed sprite variant, which we will talk about later. Moreover, Sweet Dreams and Transponder Snail sprites are still the only two sprites that only come in the base version.

Below, you can learn more about what Cursed sprites bring to the table for those who have it. On the other hand, for those of you who don’t have one yet, you can check out the various ways using which you can eventually acquire the same.

What do Cursed sprites do in Fortnite?

Equipping a Cursed sprite increases your chances of finding rare sprites in chests scattered across the map. However, there’s a catch: your character takes damage whenever you enter the water.

This makes Cursed sprites a trade-off. You get a better chance of finding rare sprites, but you need to be careful around water while one is equipped.

In addition to the aforementioned effects, you obviously do get the underlying benefit of the sprite type. For instance, Cursed Halfpeel’d gives the above benefit in tandem with marked elimination showing up on the map.

How to get a Cursed sprite in Fortnite

There are several ways to find Cursed sprites in Fortnite Treasure Hunters. You can search specific chest types, complete Wanted Poster quests, use locator items, or get help from another player.

1. Search for Sprite Chests and Rare Chests

There are four different types of chests available in Fortnite Treasure Hunters, including Treasure Chest, buried chest, Rare Chest, and Sprite Chest. While the former two may not give any sprite—let alone a Cursed variant—in most cases, the latter two have a strong chance of spawning one. So, it’s highly recommended that, on your hunt for any sprite you don’t already have, you always try to open as many Sprite Chests and Rare Chests as possible.

Having said that, there are certain named POIs in this One Piece-themed mini-season that have a relatively higher concentration of these two kinds of chests. For Rare Chests, you can focus on exploring Lil’ Uzi’s Stronghold, The $.$. Rocky, and Loguetown, each of which have 4 or more such chests.

On the flip side, you will find more Sprite Chests than usual—say at least two to three—in places such as the Windmill Village island, the Rubber Resort island, and the areas directly surrounding Cursed Cavern.

2. Taking Wanted Poster side quests

A new mechanic Fortnite devs have brought into the fray this season is Wanted Posters. When you are close to one, you get an indicator on-screen and, once you find it, you have to collect the poster in order to start the quest for locating a buried Sprite Chest. These chests guarantee a sprite, even though the rarity of the sprite that you get is not guaranteed to be high-tier.

However, this is another effective way of finding new sprites in Treasure Hunters. Importantly, the named locations that house 10 or more Wanted Posters in the Battle Royale modes are Cursed Cavern, Loguetown, Lantern Landing, Arlong Park, The $.$. Rocky, and Lil’ Uzi’s Stronghold. So, make sure you go through a few of these areas in each match to maximize your chances of nabbing a Cursed sprite variant.

3. Use a Sprite Locator or Lucky Locator

Sprite Locator and Lucky Locator are two gizmos available this season through various methods, ranging from reaching certain Sprite Mastery milestones to simply chancing upon one from a Treasure Chest. Both of these items help find buried Sprite Chests. But the difference lies in that the former gizmo leads to a chest that can give any random sprite, whereas the latter item leads to one that always gives a sprite not already present in your collection.

4. Asking a friend for help

Taking a Cursed sprite from a friendly player and indexing it is another viable way of getting your hands on it. All you have to do is find a player who already owns the desired Cursed sprite variant and is willing to help. Even newbies, whose friends list in Fortnite is still taking shape, can visit the game’s official Discord to find like-minded players.

Once you find a player like that, you just have to join a couple of Battle Royale matches with him. In the first one, borrow the Cursed sprite in-game and extract it—use a Portable Extractor for zero-risk extraction. In the next match, you can similarly return the sprite to its original owner. Later, you can visit the Treasure tab and then the Sprites section, from where you can recall a new instance of the Cursed variant you just returned, in exchange for some V-Bucks.

Cursed vs Fortune: Two variants for players with two different approaches

With Cursed sprites following after Fortune sprites, there are now two dedicated variants for players with two different motivations. While the Fortune sprite variant is highly suitable for those who are hunting for the Pirate Shop Access and want to open as many chests in a match as possible, the Cursed sprite variant is similarly a great fit for those players who prioritize completing their sprite catalog over anything else.

If you look at it from a certain perspective, it would appear that Fortune sprites are meant for players who want to grab the unprecedented chance to stock up on tons of free cosmetics, whereas the Cursed sprites are intended for those who want to efficiently collect sprites without having to open too many chests. By giving distinct purposes to these two variants, Fortnite has made it easier for players to equip the right sprite to match their playstyle.

FAQs

When did Cursed sprites come out?

Cursed sprites first hit Fortnite on November 8, the very day on which the Lil Uzi Vert boss also arrived in the game.

Do Cursed sprites hurt you?

Yes. Equipping a Cursed sprite increases your chances of finding rare sprites in chests, but your character takes damage when in water.

Can Sweet Dreams be Cursed?

No. Sweet Dreams is currently available only in its base form and does not have a Cursed variant.

Do Cursed sprites count toward Sprite Mastery?

Yes, just like all other sprite variants that came out before, mastering Cursed sprites does add to your Sprite Mastery level.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Cameraman Tower Defense codes on November 12, 2026

Cameraman Tower Defense is a Roblox tower defense game where you deploy Cameramen and other powerful units to defend against waves of invading toilets. You need Coins to summon random towers, so redeeming active codes is an easy way to get extra currency without grinding matches.

Most currently listed codes reward 50 Coins, while the Vampire code has an unconfirmed reward amount. Redeem the working codes below to collect your free rewards.

All working Cameraman Tower Defense codes

  • LStriderSpeaker: 50 Coins (NEW)
  • Battlepass: 50 Coins (NEW)
  • UTCM: 50 Coins (NEW)

Expired Cameraman Tower Defense codes

NEWMAPS

How to redeem Cameraman Tower Defense codes

Win three matches first, since the code box stays hidden until then. The steps are the same on mobile and desktop.

  1. Open Cameraman Tower Defense on Roblox.
  2. Open the Shop from the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll to the bottom of the Shop window.
  4. Type or paste the code into the Code box.
  5. Press Redeem.

Why your Cameraman Tower Defense code is not working

  • The code has expired. Check the expired list above before you retry.
  • You typed it wrong. Codes are case-sensitive, and a stray space can break one, so copy and paste when you can.
  • You already used it. Each code works once per account.
  • You are on an old server. Rejoin a new server and try again.
  • It’s a Halloween code. It pays event items and candies, not Coins, and it may stop working once the Halloween event closes. Some lists still show it as active, so treat it as unverified.

Where to find more Cameraman Tower Defense codes?

New codes usually land with game updates. The Aligators Games Discord gets them first, and the developer’s Roblox group is the second place to check. Joining the group also gives 200 Coins.

  • Cameraman Tower Defense on Roblox: the game page.
  • Alligator Games Roblox group: the developer’s group.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Anime Galaxies codes, VV ULTIMATUM codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: Best Grok Bot plugins and skills in 2026: 25 worth adding

content.rendered:
Grok Bot doesn’t come with a big skill library. You add plugins from Connect apps, save your own skills in chat, or teach one by showing the Bot a task. The best picks are Google Workspace and Granola for everyday work, Canva for content, last30days for research, and Superpowers and pstack for coding.

A Bot can already browse the web on its own cloud computer, so it can open your to-do app and click around to add a task. That’s slow, and the Bot may not know everything the app can do. Plugins fix that in two ways: connections let the Bot work with an app directly, and skills give it the instructions for a specific job.

Grok Bot installs plugins from the Cursor Marketplace, which is public and lists nearly 500 options. You can browse the full plugin list there. Most of those listings are built for developers, so the 25 below start with everyday work and end with coding. Each plugin uses your own account for that service, so any limits or credits on your plan still apply.

One thing to keep in mind: several of these plugins can send messages, publish posts, or spend money. Start by asking for drafts and checks, and let the Bot act on its own only once you trust it.

Grok vs Grok Build vs Grok Bot

Grok Bot isn’t the same as Grok Build. They’re separate products, and some plugins, such as pstack and Superpowers, are available for both but install differently. This article is about Grok Bot.

What Grok Bot already includes

  • Skill creation: ask the Bot to save a task it just finished as a skill.
  • Teach a task: show the Bot a browser task, and it drafts a skill from your recording. Recordings can run for up to 10 minutes, and this may not be on every account yet.
  • Memory: a Bot keeps your stable preferences, its role, and summaries of past work.
  • Ready-to-connect apps: Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub, and many others are waiting in Connect apps. They still need you to add them and sign in.

Grok Bot’s app connections are expanding beyond third-party services: it can now use Apple Mail, Messages, and Notes on Mac.

Grok’s chat app also has five built-in skills: Word Documents, Presentations, Spreadsheets, PDFs, and Skill Creator. Composio’s guide says Grok Bot has them too, but xAI’s Grok Bot docs don’t list them. To check on your account, ask your Bot what skills it has.

Still choosing an AI agent? Compare Grok Bot with ChatGPT Dots and Claude Duet.

25 best Grok Bot plugins and skills at a glance

“Connect apps” below also means you can use the plugin’s Add to Grok Bot link. Every pick still counts toward your Grok Bot usage, so the last column shows only what’s on top of that.

Everyday work

These plugins help with email, meetings, tasks, and connecting the Bot to other services, so it can handle the routine parts of your day.

1. Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides)

Google Workspace is really six separate plugins, and most people will use several of them together.

  • Gmail searches, reads, and drafts email.
  • Google Calendar finds events and schedules meetings.
  • Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides let the Bot find, create, and edit your files.

For example, you could ask it to pull last month’s numbers from a spreadsheet and turn them into a short slide deck. Gmail can also send mail, so ask for drafts until you trust it. A personal Google account connects directly. A company account may need an admin to approve Grok first.

Try Now: Gmail | Calendar | Drive | Docs | Sheets | Slides

2. Granola (meeting context)

Granola gives the Bot access to your meeting notes, including what was discussed, decided, and promised. It has three skills: looking up past meetings, preparing you for an upcoming one, and checking a draft or plan against what the group agreed. Before a client call, you could ask what you promised them last time.

You need a Granola account that already has meetings in it, so this only helps if Granola is already taking your notes.

Try Granola on Grok Bot

3. Todoist (tasks)

Todoist lets the Bot create, find, and complete tasks and projects. It’s a simple connection with no extra skills, which is fine for a to-do list. For example, you could have the Bot read a meeting recap and add each action item to the right project.

Try Todoist on Grok Bot

4. Zapier (everything else)

Zapier connects the Bot to more than 9,000 apps. That makes it a catch-all for smaller services that don’t have their own plugin. You sign in to your Zapier account and choose which actions the Bot can use. Enable only the ones you need, because each extra action is one more thing the Bot can do in your accounts.

Try Zapier on Grok Bot

5. Your own skill (repeat tasks)

The most useful skill may be one you make yourself, because it fits how you work. Say you want a daily Apple news brief. Ask the Bot to find the day’s top three Apple stories and summarize each in two lines. Fix the result until you like it, then say: “Save this as a skill called Daily Apple news brief.”

From then on, you can ask for it by name or put it on a schedule with a routine. There’s nothing to install, and the steps are in the section on creating your own skill below.

Content and creative tools

These plugins help you make and publish things, including designs, social posts, audio, video, images, and email.

6. Canva (designs you can keep editing)

Canva has seven skills, so it goes well beyond making a single graphic. The Bot can edit an existing design, check it against your brand kit, make the changes reviewers left in comments, and resize a design for Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn all at once. The bulk skill saves the most time. Give it a spreadsheet and a brand template, and it makes one design per row.

Canva also works with ChatGPT and Claude, so your designs aren’t tied to Grok.

Try Canva on Grok Bot

7. Buffer (social posts)

Buffer lets the Bot draft, schedule, and publish posts across your connected channels. It can also manage your queue and ideas, and review how past posts performed. Ask for a week of drafts and read them before anything gets scheduled, because a published post goes out on your real accounts.

Try Buffer on Grok Bot

8. ElevenLabs (voice and audio)

ElevenLabs covers text-to-speech, speech-to-text, dubbing, music, sound effects, voice changing, and removing background noise from recordings. A podcaster could clean up a noisy interview and then dub it into another language.

It has 42 skills, but more than half are for developers building voice agents, so you can ignore those. You sign in with your ElevenLabs account, and some skills may ask for an API key.

Try ElevenLabs on Grok Bot

9. HeyGen (avatar videos and translation)

HeyGen makes presenter videos with an AI avatar, which can be a digital twin built from your photo. For most people, the more useful skill is translation. It dubs a video into more than 175 languages, using voice cloning and lip-sync.

Billing depends on how you connect. Signing in uses the credits on your HeyGen plan, while an API key is billed separately.

Try HeyGen on Grok Bot

10. Runway (images and video)

Runway generates and edits images, video, music, speech, and sound effects. It offers its own Gen-4.5 and Aleph models, plus others such as Seedance, Kling, and GPT Image. For example, you could ask the Bot to animate a product photo, then upscale the result.

You sign in with your Runway account and don’t need an API key. Generating media uses your Runway credits, and any purchase happens on Runway’s website, not in chat.

Try Runway on Grok Bot

11. Email Marketing Bible (email campaigns)

Email Marketing Bible is a free skill for auditing an email setup, building flows, writing copy, and fixing deliverability. It includes 19 chapters and playbooks for 19 industries, and it asks for approval before anything is sent. Its author co-founded the email platform Nitrosend, which appears in its platform comparison.

This one was built for Claude Code and other agents, so it isn’t in Connect apps. Send your Bot the repository link and ask it to load the skill. If you already use Klaviyo or Brevo and want the Bot to manage campaigns there, add their plugin instead.

Try Now: Email Marketing Bible | Klaviyo | Brevo

Research and data

These plugins help the Bot find current information, pull data from websites, and act inside a browser or store.

12. last30days (what people are saying now)

last30days searches the past 30 days across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and more. It scores results by upvotes, likes, and money on the line, then gives you a cited summary. It’s handy when you want to know what people think of something right now, not what a search engine ranks highest.

It isn’t in Connect apps, so setup takes more work. Ask the Bot to run npx skills add mvanhorn/last30days-skill -g on its computer, which needs Python 3.12 or later, and save it as a skill. Reddit, Hacker News, Polymarket, and GitHub work without keys, and X uses the Bot’s own X tools. Some other sources need API keys.

All your Bots share one computer, so any key you put there is available to all of them. You may also need to reinstall the skill if that computer is reset.

Try last30days

13. Exa (better web search)

Exa adds web search and can read a page as clean text. That helps when a task needs current information with sources, such as comparing what several sites say about one product. If the Bot only needs to check a single page now and then, its own browser is enough.

Try Exa on Grok Bot

14. Apify (data from popular sites)

Apify runs ready-made scrapers for sites including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Google Maps, and Yelp. A small business could use it to collect local competitors from Google Maps and list their ratings.

You can browse scrapers without signing in, but running one needs an Apify account. Signup is free and doesn’t require a card. Each run uses Apify usage on top of your Grok Bot usage, so check a scraper’s cost before you schedule it.

Try Apify on Grok Bot

15. Browser Use (more control in a browser)

Browser Use gives the Bot direct control of your own Chrome or of a Browser Use cloud browser. It can fill in forms, take screenshots, pull data, and run repeat web tasks. Using your own Chrome takes a one-time setup to turn on remote debugging.

Be careful with this one. Your own Chrome holds your logged-in accounts, so a separate Chrome profile is the safer choice.

Try Browser Use on Grok Bot

16. Shop (buying things)

Shop, from Shopify, searches more than a billion products across millions of stores. It then builds carts and checks out. Searching and building carts work without signing in. If you sign in, the Bot can use Shop Pay and your saved addresses, and track your orders.

If a store doesn’t support Shop Pay, you approve the purchase and the Bot pays with a single-use card. Use Shop first for price comparisons and reorders, and check every cart before you approve it.

Try Shop on Grok Bot

For developers

These plugins are for people who build software with the Bot, from planning and testing to reviews, databases, and design.

17. Superpowers (building software properly)

Superpowers is for building software with the Bot. Its 14 skills, created by Jesse Vincent, make the Bot brainstorm a design, write a plan, use test-driven development, find the root cause of a bug, and prove a fix works before calling it done. That slows down simple jobs, so save it for real projects and skip it for a quick script.

If you install it in Grok Build instead, its command uses-trust, which skips the install confirmation. Read what a plugin includes before you use that flag.

Try Superpowers on Grok Bot

18. pstack (deeper engineering work)

pstack is Lauren Tan’s engineering bundle, with the motto “if you want to go fast, go deep first.” Its 58 skills include/sharpen, which improves a task before work starts, and/teach, which explains how some code works. /bro Restates the last message in plain language.

About two dozen of the skills are engineering principles, such as fixing root causes and proving that something works. This is the most demanding pick on the list, so try it after Superpowers, and only if you write code regularly.

Try pstack on Grok Bot

19. Thermos (deep branch and PR reviews)

Thermos reviews a code branch hard. One skill audits security and correctness, another checks code quality for things like giant files and tangled logic, and thermos runs both at once and combines the findings. Start with the reviews. It also has optional flows for taking over a branch and getting it ready to merge, and those are better left until you trust the results.

Try Thermos on Grok Bot

20. Cursor Team Kit (CI, reviews, and shipping)

Cursor Team Kit packs 18 skills based on Cursor’s internal engineering workflows. fix-ci finds failing checks and fixes them, review-and-ship reviews a branch and opens a pull request, and what-did-i-get-done summarizes your commits. Its pull request skills need the Bot to have access to your repository.

Try Cursor Team Kit on Grok Bot

21. Continual Learning (keeping project notes current)

Continual Learning reads past chats and keeps a code project’s AGENTS.md file up to date with what it learns. This overlaps with Bot memory, which already keeps your preferences, role, and past work. Add it only if your project relies on AGENTS.md. Otherwise, memory already covers the basics.

Try Continual Learning on Grok Bot

22. Vercel React Best Practices (cleaner React code)

This skill checks React code for problems with component structure, hooks, and similar basics after the Bot edits your components. It comes inside the Vercel plugin, along with 32 other skills for building and running apps, so you can ignore the rest if you don’t host on Vercel. Anything that touches your projects needs a Vercel account.

Try Vercel on Grok Bot

23. Supabase (databases)

The Supabase plugin lets the Bot manage tables, fetch settings, and query data in your projects. It also includes a Postgres best practices skill for writing and reviewing queries and database designs. Point it at a test project first, because it can reach real data.

Try Supabase on Grok Bot

24. Remotion (videos made with code)

Remotion builds videos with React, so you describe the video and the Bot writes the code for it. Its 12 skills cover animations, captions, maps, and exporting the final file. Individuals and small companies can use Remotion for free, while bigger companies need a license. If you just want a quick clip, Runway or HeyGen is the easier choice.

Try Remotion on Grok Bot

25. Impeccable (frontend design polish)

Impeccable helps fix the generic look of AI-made websites. You can steer a page with commands like polish and bolder, or review it with critique and audit. It also comes with a detector that has 62 rules for spotting common AI design habits, such as purple gradients and cards nested in cards.

Try Impeccable on Grok Bot

Using Grok Build instead?

Grok Build installs plugins from the terminal with grok plugin install <name> --trust. You can also add a skill by hand at ~/.grok/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Neither step adds anything to Grok Bot.

How to create your own Grok Bot skill

1. From chat

  1. Finish the task with your Bot.
  2. Ask it to save the task, for example: “Save the process we just used as a skill called Weekly account health.”
  3. Read the skill, then test it on a real one-time task.

2. With Teach a task

  1. Open a one-to-one chat with your Bot on your computer, then open its computer view.
  2. Choose Teach a task, and describe the result you want.
  3. Do the task once, then stop the recording.
  4. Review the draft skill, and test it on a safe example.

Recordings can run for up to 10 minutes and don’t capture your microphone. Keep passwords and other secrets off the screen. If you don’t see Teach a task, it may not have reached your account yet, so create the skill from chat.

What a good skill includes

  • Trigger: when the Bot should use it.
  • Inputs: what it needs, including any app access.
  • Steps: the order of the work.
  • Validation: how it checks the result.
  • Output: what it gives you at the end.
  • Approval rules: what it must ask you about first.

Which Grok Bot plugins and skills to start with

Hold off on Shop and Browser Use until you’ve seen the Bot handle lower-risk jobs, because both can spend your money or act inside your logged-in accounts.

Skill not showing up? Quick fixes

  • The Bot can’t find a skill: open Connect apps, select the connected count next to the title, and enable the skill under Private skills.
  • The Bot says an app is missing: added doesn’t mean signed in. Open the app and choose Authenticate, or Authorize on a phone, if it shows Needs auth or Disconnected.
  • A custom MCP server shows “redirect_uri not allowed”: the server is rejecting Cursor’s sign-in address, so the fix has to come from whoever runs that server. Some servers don’t have one yet.

FAQs

Are Grok Bot skills free?

Skill packs such as Superpowers and pstack don’t list a price, and saving your own skill costs nothing extra. Everything still uses your Grok Bot usage, and plugins for outside services may need that service’s paid plan or credits.

Do Photographic Styles affect video recording?

Often, yes, because many are plain instruction files. Load them through chat, as with Email Marketing Bible. Skills that depend on Claude Code’s own commands or hooks may not work the same way. xAI doesn’t document this path for Grok Bot, so test any skill on a safe task first.

How many skills can a Bot use?

xAI doesn’t publish a limit. Your private skills sit in one library shared by all your Bots, and you enable the ones each Bot should use.

Do skills work on iPhone?

You can add plugins on iPhone, though a few apps ask you to connect them on a computer. Teach a task needs the desktop app. You should be able to ask for a saved skill by name on your phone because the Bot runs on its cloud computer, but xAI’s mobile docs don’t cover this.

Are community skills safe?

Not automatically. A skill is a set of instructions your Bot will follow, and xAI doesn’t say how it checks third-party skills. Read one before you install it, and be careful with keys and files because all your Bots share one computer. It also helps to add “Ask first” rules for sending, publishing, deleting, and buying.

title.rendered: Google Gemini app starts rolling out to Apple CarPlay worldwide

content.rendered:
Google says Gemini is rolling out worldwide on Apple CarPlay starting November 11. The feature brings Gemini Live, the voice chat mode in the Gemini app, to your car’s screen, so you can talk back and forth with Gemini while you drive.

Gemini was the last big chatbot missing from CarPlay

ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Grok, Meta AI, and Perplexity already work on CarPlay. Apple opened CarPlay to voice chatbot apps in iOS 26.4 earlier this year, and Gemini was the last major name without a CarPlay app. This update closes that gap.

Gemini was not entirely absent. It already reached CarPlay through Gemini in Google Maps, which began rolling out to US drivers on October 21. That feature works inside Maps during navigation. The Gemini app’s chat mode is the part arriving now.

Setup takes four steps, then one tap in the car

Google lists these steps before the first conversation in the car:

  1. Update the Gemini app on your iPhone.
  2. Turn on microphone permission.
  3. Use Gemini Live on your phone at least once.
  4. Connect your phone to the car and tap the Gemini icon on the CarPlay screen or side rail.

After that, you can resume a recent chat or start a new one. You can interrupt Gemini to add a detail, change the subject, or pause when you need to focus on an exit. Your CarPlay conversations sync to the Gemini app on your iPhone, so you can read them after you park.

Google calls the feature hands-free, but the first step is still a tap on the screen. ChatGPT on CarPlay works the same way: you tap to start a chat, and there is no wake word. The post does not mention a wake word for Gemini either, so the tap is the only start step it describes.

Calendar, email, and places are the main uses

Google’s examples cover four areas:

  • Calendar: ask what your day looks like or when you need to leave for your next appointment.
  • Gmail: get your daily brief, catch up on unread mail, summarize long threads, and talk through a quick reply.
  • Places: ask for lunch spots or landmarks near your destination.
  • Practice: rehearse a presentation or get a simple explanation of a topic.

Daily Brief has to be turned on before you can use it. Personalization features, including Daily Brief, are not available to users under 18 or in the European Economic Area and Nigeria.

Google leaves out devices, price, and account details

The post does not name:

  • iPhone models or minimum iOS version. It only says to use the latest Gemini app.
  • Car brands or CarPlay versions.
  • Price or plan. The post does not mention a subscription; it says the rollout covers all Gemini users on iOS.
  • Languages. The rollout covers every supported Gemini Live language, but the post does not list them.
  • Account type. Gemini connects to Gmail and Google Calendar, but it is not stated whether personal and Workspace accounts both work.

The post also does not give a date for when every iPhone gets the update. When the first reports went up on November 11, the app update was not yet live, so the CarPlay icon may not appear right away. If it is missing, check the first three steps: update the Gemini app, turn on microphone permission, and use Gemini Live on your phone once.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch with text, dictation and calls

content.rendered:
Meta added an Apple Watch companion to the Muse iPhone app on Monday, November 9. It puts the Muse character on your wrist, so you can reach the AI agent from any watch running watchOS 9 or later.

Works around the clock, and now on your wrist. Muse is now on Apple Watch and Wear OS ⌚️ https://t.co/97QRap5XKz

— Muse (@Muse) November 9, 2026

What Muse is

Muse is Meta’s personal AI agent that does tasks for you, such as sending emails and booking travel. It keeps working after you close the app. Purchases can go through Link, the checkout built by Stripe, which uses one-time-use cards. Muse is free for most uses, with subscriptions for heavier use. It is powered by Muse Spark, the model that also runs Meta AI.

Text, dictate, or call Muse from the wrist

The watch version gives you three ways to reach Muse: type a message, dictate one, or call it. A Muse complication, which is a small shortcut on the watch face, opens the agent quickly. The character’s look echoes the Muse Charm, the pocket-sized device Meta showed in September for talking to Muse. The Muse app also has real-time voice conversations, which started rolling out in the US on November 5, and you can interrupt Muse mid-response.

Apple Watch needs watchOS 9 and the iPhone app

The watch companion lives inside Muse’s iPhone app. Meta’s App Store listing describes it as “the new Apple Watch Companion App” in the notes for versions 15.0 and 15.1. The listing requires iOS 18.0 or later on iPhone, iPadOS 18.0 or later on iPad, and watchOS 9.0 or later on Apple Watch. An iPhone on iOS 17 cannot install this version.

Three things the watch launch leaves open

The listing does not say whether the watch app works when the iPhone is out of range. WhatsApp’s Apple Watch app needs a nearby iPhone for syncing, so that is the limit to check first. Early reports describe the watch app as a front end that relies on the paired phone, though Meta hasn’t said so itself.

Muse checks with you before sensitive actions such as sending an email or making a purchase. The listing does not say whether you can approve those requests from the watch.

Meta’s November voice update started only in the US. The listing does not say whether the watch’s call option works outside the US.

Where Muse is available

Muse began rolling out in the US on iOS, Android, and the muse.ai website. It reached Singapore on October 27 on the same platforms. You can message Muse in the Muse app or in WhatsApp. Meta lists AI glasses as coming soon.

The App Store rates the app 18+. The listing gives no separate country list for the watch feature.

Meta also announced a Wear OS version the same day, but this App Store update and its open questions are about Apple Watch. If you already use Muse on an iPhone and wear an Apple Watch, the wrist shortcut is the reason to try it. Keep approval-heavy tasks on your phone until Meta says the watch can handle them.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

acceptedAnswer.text: Skill packs such as Superpowers and pstack don't list a price, and saving your own skill costs nothing extra. Everything still uses your Grok Bot usage, and plugins for outside services may need that service's paid plan or credits.

mainEntity.name: How many skills can a Bot use?

acceptedAnswer.text: xAI doesn't publish a limit. Your private skills sit in one library shared by all your Bots, and you enable the ones each Bot should use.

mainEntity.name: Do skills work on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can add plugins on iPhone, though a few apps ask you to connect them on a computer. Teach a task needs the desktop app. You should be able to ask for a saved skill by name on your phone because the Bot runs on its cloud computer, but xAI's mobile docs don't cover this.

acceptedAnswer.text: Not automatically. A skill is a set of instructions your Bot will follow, and xAI doesn't say how it checks third-party skills. title.rendered: iPhone 18 Pro Max wins 32-phone battery test, topping all Androids

content.rendered:
The iPhone 18 Pro Max lasted longer than every other phone in CNET’s battery test, published on November 3, 2026. The test ranked 32 phones, including models from Samsung, Google, Motorola and OnePlus, so the Pro Max beat the Android phones too.

It is not the first time an iPhone has come out on top in a battery run against Android. In September 2025, the iPhone 17 Pro Max also beat Samsung’s Galaxy S25 Ultra in a real-world battery run.

The test streamed video for 3 hours, then ran a 45-minute stress test

Each phone started at 100% and went through two runs. The first streamed video over Wi-Fi for 3 hours with the screen at full brightness. The second was a 45-minute stress test that mixed video streaming, a video call, games and social media scrolling. The second run is an anecdotal stress test, so read it as a rough guide to daily use. Each run records the percentage left, and the two results are averaged to set the ranking.

The Pro Max led overall, but the iPhone 18 Pro won the video test

The iPhone 18 Pro Max and the foldable iPhone Duo shared the top spot in the stress test, each finishing down 1%. Google’s Pixel 11 Pro XL tied for third there, down 3%. The 2025 Pixel 10 Pro XL dropped 7% in the same stress test. In the 3-hour video test, the smaller iPhone 18 Pro came out on top, losing 6%. The Pro Max kept 92% in that video run.

The 2026 phones in the test averaged about the same battery life as the 2025 and 2024 models. The Pro Max stands out against that flat average.

The results were also averaged by brand, counting only brands with at least three phones tested. Apple placed first, and OnePlus placed second. This is the second year in a row that iPhones have beaten other brands in these battery tests.

Apple’s 45-hour figure is a different test

Apple’s launch page says eSIM-only iPhone 18 Pro Max models deliver up to 45 hours of video playback, and the iPhone 18 Pro up to 36 hours. Apple says the eSIM models get two extra hours because the space once used by the SIM tray now holds a bigger battery. Those are Apple’s own numbers. This test does not use that measure, so the 45-hour figure cannot be compared with its percentages.

The results also do not say whether the phones were eSIM-only or had a SIM tray, though the results table lists the eSIM model’s capacity. The eSIM iPhone 18 Pro Max has a 5,567 mAh battery, up 9.4% from the 5,088 mAh in the iPhone 17 Pro Max.

CNET credits the Pro Max’s edge over last year’s model to that larger battery, iOS 27 optimizations and the efficient A20 Pro chip. Capacity helps, but the software and chip are part of why the Pro Max finished first.

If you want value over peak endurance, look at the iPhone 17

The iPhone 17 and iPhone 17e are among the best battery values in the results. The iPhone 17 tied for second overall with the iPhone 18 Pro, the Motorola Razr (2026) and the OnePlus 15, even though its 3,692 mAh battery is half the size of the OnePlus 15’s 7,300 mAh. It is the model to compare if the Pro Max is more than you want to spend.

The results do not print overall scores, but averaging the Pro Max’s 92% and 99% gives 95.5%, against 93.5% for the four phones tied for second.

Check AppleCare+ before paying for a battery swap

If your battery has worn down, check your coverage first. Apple says AppleCare+ covers a battery replacement at no extra charge when the battery’s capacity drops below 80%. Without coverage, Apple charges $129 in the U.S. for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max battery service.

If battery life is the only thing you are comparing, this test backs the Pro Max. Treat Apple’s 45-hour figure as its own test, since it is not on this test’s scale.

  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip
