title.rendered: How to buy Fortnite Crew subscription: All methods and subscription benefits

content.rendered:
Gaming subscriptions are nothing new. From Rockstar Games’ GTA+ to Xbox Game Pass, several services offer exclusive perks in exchange for a monthly fee. Fortnite has its own version of this model: Fortnite Crew.

For $11.99 per month, Fortnite Crew currently gives subscribers 800 V-Bucks, a monthly cosmetic bundle, access to multiple in-game passes, and Rocket Pass Premium in Rocket League. However, Epic Games has announced some major changes to the subscription, scheduled to arrive on December 5, 2026.

These changes will increase the monthly V-Bucks allowance, introduce XP bonuses, and bring an end to monthly Crew Pack outfits and the OG Pass. Here’s everything you need to know about Fortnite Crew’s current benefits, upcoming changes, pricing, and how to subscribe.

Fortnite Crew subscription benefits

As of now, Fortnite Crew comes with 800 V-Bucks, a monthly cosmetics bundle, access to the Battle Pass, OG Pass, LEGO Pass, Music Pass, and Rocket League Premium. Here, the cosmetics bundle, aka the Crew Pack in question, generally includes an outfit, its LEGO variant, as well as its associated pickaxe and back bling.

After December 4, the monthly V-Bucks you get with Fortnite Crew will be decided on the basis of how long you have been subscribed to the service. In any case, a minimum of 1,000 V-Bucks every month is guaranteed for subscribers. The different tiers coming in the future, their consecutive months requirement, and their respective V-Bucks offering are given below:

  • Core (1-2 months): 1,000 V-Bucks
  • Bronze (3-5 months): 1,200 V-Bucks
  • Silver (6-11 months): 1,400 V-Bucks
  • Gold (over 12 months): 1,600 V-Bucks

When the update rolls out, both existing and returning subscribers—only those who subscribe by December 31, 2026—will be assigned a tier based on the number of consecutive subscription months they have strung together in the past 12 months. For instance, if you are currently not a subscriber but had been one for 4 months in the past year, then you will be allotted the Bronze tier upon resubscribing instead of the Core tier.

Apart from that, all but one of the existing passes in Fortnite Crew will remain unaffected, as the OG Pass is set to be retired after the end of Chapter 1: OG Season X. Per the developer, Fortnite OG will be back again in the latter stages of 2027. Speaking of phased-out benefits, the Crew Pack cosmetics will also end their monthly run and leave the subscription service permanently on the same day as when the other changes are incorporated.

On top of these benefits, Fortnite Crew subscribers will also gain 20% more XP from playing the game. On the other hand, those non-subscribers who squad up with them will get a 10% boost to their XP as well.

Fortnite Crew price and bundles

Fortnite Crew is currently priced at $11.99 per month. It doesn’t have any other billing frequency, so there is no option for anything like securing an annual subscription in a single stroke. While the latest announcement regarding the subscription brought many pivotal changes, there was no effect on its price whatsoever.

It’s worth remembering that Xbox Game Pass users, who are subscribed to the Ultimate tier priced at $22.99 per month, get Fortnite Crew as a bundled freebie. The validity of this perk lasts for as long as your Game Pass Ultimate subscription does.

To claim the bundled subscription, you will need to launch Fortnite via the Xbox app on PC or on an Xbox console and log in to the game using the same Epic Games account as the one you use for playing. To avoid downloading the full game, you can simply launch it via the cloud, which would still trigger the Fortnite Crew benefits. Notably, this is just a one-time activation process.

You can also use Xbox Cloud Gaming to launch Fortnite without downloading the full game. For more details, check out our guide on playing Xbox games on an iPhone or iPad.

3 ways to purchase Fortnite Crew

1. Subscribe through Fortnite

  1. Launch Fortnite and open the Passes section.
  2. Then, select the Get Battle Pass button.
  3. Next, navigate to the Fortnite Crew option and select it.
  4. Select Subscribe and follow the on-screen instructions to complete the payment.

2. Subscribe through the Epic Games Store

  1. From the store homepage, click on the search bar at the top of your screen.
  2. Next, type in “Fortnite Crew” and select the product from the results.
  3. Lastly, select the Subscribe button to proceed to payment and follow the on-screen directions to confirm the same.

3. Subscribe through a web browser

  1. Open Fortnite.com in your browser and sign in to your Epic Games account.
  2. On the homepage, hover your cursor over “More” and select “Crew” from the drop-down menu.
  3. On the Fortnite Crew page, select Join Now.
  4. Next, click on “Subscribe” and follow the on-screen instructions to complete the purchase.

Is Fortnite Crew worth it?

In 2026 so far, Fortnite Crew has undergone quite a few major structural changes. First, there was a decrease in monthly V-Bucks from 1,000 to 800. Most recently, there has been the announcement of an impending Crew Pack removal in exchange for returning to the original amount of V-Bucks bonus every month.

However, one of the key attractions tied to Fortnite Crew, its monthly V-Bucks, has more or less only been bumped by 200 V-Bucks while taking away a cosmetics bundle that would anyway cost much more than the compensation offered. The higher ceiling, where more V-Bucks are given to subscribers, is essentially locked to those who stick with the service for the long term.

Keeping these takeaways in mind, Fortnite Crew currently seems like an offer that only enthusiasts or those Xbox players who get the subscription as a bundled freebie would want to pursue. The casual audience is better off spending its money directly on V-Bucks instead of buying cosmetics, especially now that the service has been stripped off the monthly free cosmetics of its own.

FAQs

Can you subscribe to Fortnite Crew without a credit card?

Yes. You can use any payment method supported by the Epic Games Store or your platform’s payment system in your region. Available options vary depending on where you purchase the subscription.

Can I directly subscribe to the Gold tier of Fortnite Crew?

No. The Gold tier is based on maintaining a consecutive subscription for at least 12 months within the relevant period. You cannot simply select it as a separate subscription plan.

Has Fortnite Crew price increased recently?

No. Fortnite Crew still costs $11.99 per month in the US. Epic has confirmed that the December 5, 2026 changes will not increase its subscription price.

title.rendered: How to update your AirPods to the latest firmware version

content.rendered:
Updating your AirPods, AirPods Pro, and AirPods Max is essential to ensure you enjoy the latest features and improvements. Apple typically rolls out firmware updates automatically over the air, but you can force an update manually if necessary.

In this guide, I’ll explain how to update your AirPods firmware and check whether they’re running the latest version.

Table of Contents
  • How to update firmware on AirPods
  • How to update AirPods Max firmware
  • How to check your AirPods firmware version
    • Find your AirPods firmware version on iPhone or iPad
    • Find your AirPods firmware version on Mac
  • What is the latest AirPods firmware version?
  • Signing off…

How to update firmware on AirPods

In most cases, AirPods and AirPods Pro firmware updates happen automatically in the background without any notification. The updates are pushed over-the-air (OTA) when the AirPods are placed for charging or within the Bluetooth range of the associated iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

But in case you notice that AirPods are not updated as expected, you can manually force an update using the following steps:

  1. Place the AirPods in their charging case and connect the case to a power outlet using a Lightning cable or a Wireless charger.
  2. Make sure that your iPhone, iPad or Mac is connected to Wi-Fi and has more than 50% battery charge. Also, make sure Bluetooth is on and Low Power mode is off.
  3. Leave your iPhone, iPad, or Mac nearby. Make sure the case’s lid remains closed during the process.

It should complete the firmware update in the background, as there is no specific option to manually trigger it. After about 10 minutes, check whether your AirPods firmware has been updated. The latest AirPods firmware version will be found later in the post.

Note If you don’t own an Apple device, you can’t update your AirPods.

How to update AirPods Max firmware

Updating AirPods Max is similar to updating AirPods, but there are slight differences in the process. These over-ear headphones don’t need a charging case.

  1. Ensure the paired iPhone, iPad, or Mac is 50% charged and has Wi-Fi and Bluetooth enabled.
  2. If you have an iPhone or iPad, plug the charging cable into the AirPods Max, connect it to the power outlet, and keep it close to your device.
  3. If you have a Mac, plug the charging cable into the AirPods Max and connect them to your Mac.

Now wait for 30 minutes, then check your AirPods Max firmware version.

How to check your AirPods firmware version

After you complete the update, checking the current firmware version of your AirPods can help you confirm whether they are up to date. Here’s how to check it on your connected iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

Find your AirPods firmware version on iPhone or iPad

To check your AirPods firmware on your iPhone or iPad, be sure to update your iOS or iPadOS to the latest version. Then do the following:

  1. Go to Settings and select Bluetooth.
  2. Select the info (i) button next to the AirPods.
  3. You can see the version of your AirPods under the About section.

Find your AirPods firmware version on Mac

First, make sure your Mac runs the latest macOS, then do the following.

  1. Click on the Apple icon in the top-left corner of your screen and select System Settings.
  2. Click on Bluetooth from the left panel.
  3. Locate your AirPods in the list, then click the info (i) icon next to them.
  4. Check the Version displayed in the information window.

What is the latest AirPods firmware version?

Apple often updates AirPods firmware to improve connectivity, sound quality, and battery performance; fix bugs; and occasionally add new features like Spatial Audio, head gestures, etc.

The recent 9A348 update for the AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2 brings support for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate features. You get a redesigned AirPods interface, an Adaptive mode slider, custom EQ controls, and compatibility with Apple’s new Siri AI.

Additionally, AirPods Pro 3 get support for Precision Finding via Apple Watch and GymKit for syncing heart rate data. The prior 8B25 update set the stage for integrating Live Translation in the European Union in iOS 26.2.

So, you must check and update your AirPods to get the best experience.

  • AirPods Pro (1st generation): 6F21
  • AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case: 9B47
  • AirPods 5: 9B47
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation: 9B47

  • AirPods (2nd and 3rd generation): 6F21
  • AirPods Max 2: 9B47
  • AirPods Max (USB-C): 7E108
  • AirPods Max (Lightning): 6F25
  • AirPods (1st generation): 6.8.8

For the latest details on firmware updates, be sure to visit Apple’s official website.

Signing off…

Keeping your AirPods up to date ensures that you get the best possible performance and access to new features. While the process is designed to happen automatically, knowing how to check and confirm the latest firmware is useful.

keyPoints.title: Automatic Firmware Updates for AirPods
keyPoints.explanation: Most AirPods and AirPods Pro firmware updates happen automatically over-the-air when they are charging or near your connected device, without notifications.

keyPoints.title: Manual Firmware Update Process
keyPoints.explanation: To manually update your AirPods, place them in their charging case, connect the case to power, ensure your device has Wi-Fi and sufficient battery, and leave them near each other for about 10 minutes.

keyPoints.title: Updating AirPods Max
keyPoints.explanation: Updating AirPods Max involves connecting them to a charged iPhone, iPad, or Mac via a Lightning or USB-C cable and waiting about 30 minutes for the firmware to update.

keyPoints.title: Checking Your AirPods Firmware Version
keyPoints.explanation: You can verify your AirPods firmware version on an iPhone or iPad through Bluetooth settings or on a Mac via System Settings and Bluetooth, to ensure they are up-to-date.

keyPoints.title: Latest AirPods Firmware Versions and Features
keyPoints.explanation: The newest firmware, like 8A356, introduces features such as Spatial Audio, Sleep Detection, Charging Reminders, and improvements in noise isolation, available on latest models.

title.rendered: How to watch Netflix offline when you travel with a Mac

content.rendered:
You’ve picked a movie for the flight and packed your MacBook. Before you leave, check whether you can play that movie once the Wi-Fi goes out. Netflix streams on a Mac through supported browsers such as Safari and Chrome. Adding Netflix to the Dock gives you a shortcut to the streaming site. Official offline downloads work through the Netflix app on supported devices, including iPhones and iPads.

Your best option depends on where you want to watch. A phone is easy to use on a short commute. For a longer film with subtitles, you might prefer the MacBook’s larger screen. Here’s how to prepare for either situation and check that playback works before you go.

Download Netflix shows on your iPhone or iPad

If you’re comfortable watching on your phone or tablet, use the download feature in the Netflix app. It’s available on supported iPhones and iPads, Android devices, Fire tablets, and Chromebooks with Google Play. Each download stays in the Netflix app on the device where you saved it.

On your iPhone or iPad, look for the download arrow on the movie’s page or beside an individual episode. You can also open My Netflix → Downloads to browse titles available to save. Download over Wi-Fi, and choose Standard in the app’s download quality settings if you’re short on storage. For a series, saving just the episodes you expect to watch leaves more room for photos and other travel essentials.

Once the download finishes, stay signed in and turn on Airplane Mode. Make sure Wi-Fi is off, then play the title from Downloads. If you’ll be watching somewhere noisy, check the subtitles as well. It’s easier to fix a missing language track at home than halfway through a flight.

Troubleshoot missing or expired downloads

The download button is missing. Try another title. Some movies and shows are available for streaming only. If the button is missing across the app, check for updates to the Netflix app and your device software.

A title has expired. Reconnect to Wi-Fi and check whether Netflix lets you renew or download it again. If you saved something for the return flight, check it again before you head to the airport. A title that has left the catalog can’t be renewed.

You’ve reached your download limit. Netflix’s ad-supported plans allow 15 downloads per device per calendar month. Deleting a watched episode frees up space on the device. The download allowance resets at the start of the next calendar month.

What if you’d rather watch on your MacBook?

You may already have a few episodes saved on your phone. On a long train ride, though, you might prefer the MacBook’s larger screen for reading subtitles or watching a movie with someone. Can you use the Netflix downloads you already have?

A movie you download through Netflix on an iPhone or iPad stays in the app on that device. You can’t send it to your Mac as a video file using AirDrop, and Netflix doesn’t support AirPlay from an iPhone or iPad.

To watch the same title offline on your MacBook, you’ll need a video file saved directly on the Mac. That’s where a third-party downloader can help. Keeprix Video Downloader, for example, can save supported titles available through your Netflix subscription as MP4 or MKV files, provided you’re authorized to save them. Once the file is on your Mac, you can open it in a compatible video player whenever you’re ready to watch, even without Wi-Fi.

How to save and watch Netflix offline with Keeprix

Keeprix, which contributed this guide, makes a desktop downloader for macOS 12 or later. It opens Netflix in a built-in browser and can save supported titles as MP4 or MKV files. Resolution, audio, and subtitle choices depend on the title. You’ll need to sign in to your Netflix account and have access to the title you select.

For a title you’re authorized to save, try one movie or episode before queuing several.

  1. Open Netflix and Select a Title. Install the Mac version of Keeprix, open the app, and select Netflix.
  2. Sign in through the built-in browser, then open the movie or episode you want to watch. Click the Download button to continue.
  3. Choose Your Settings and Download. Open the download settings and choose an output format, resolution, audio language, and subtitles from the available options.
  4. Test the File Offline. Once the download finishes, open the saved file from Finder with Wi-Fi off. Play the beginning, skip to a later scene, and check the sound and subtitles. If the subtitles are in a separate file, keep it with the video and confirm that your player can load it.

Before you pack, open the exact movie or episode you want to watch on the device you plan to use. A minute of playback with Wi-Fi off can catch an expired download, a missing subtitle, or a file your player can’t open while you still have time to fix it.

Conclusion

If you’re happy watching on your iPhone or iPad, download your movie or episodes in the Netflix app before you leave. If you’d rather use your MacBook’s larger screen, check that the video file you’ve saved opens in your preferred player.

Either way, turn off Wi-Fi and play a scene with the audio and subtitles you plan to use. If you’ve picked something for the return trip, check that it still plays before you head home.

title.rendered: Fortnite Treasure Hunters: Every vault location on the Battle Royale island

content.rendered:
For a long time, vaults have been a source of abundant high-quality loot in Fortnite. The ongoing Treasure Hunters season is no different in that regard. There are nine hidden vaults scattered across the length and breadth of the One Piece-themed Battle Royale island, and each one opens only with a Rare Vault Key.

These massive vaults not only have three Rare Chests that spawn epic and legendary tier loot, but they also have a Sprite Chest that stands a chance to offer the most elusive sprites in the game. Since your player character can go from zero to fully equipped, from highly powerful weapons to rare sprites, by ransacking just a single vault, it becomes imperative to focus on these loot hotspots if you want to quickly build a highly effective arsenal during a match.

The Leekcapper can also turn up in chest loot. See what it does and where to find it.

Below, you can check out all the marked locations where you will find these vaults in Fortnite, along with a description of how to open them using a vault key.

Fortnite vault locations map

There are known to be a total of nine vaults on the Battle Royale island in Fortnite Treasure Hunters. These locations are as described below:

  1. On the beach, south-west of Rubber Resort.
  2. Behind the waterfall, south of Loot Lagoon.
  3. Inside Fortune’s Fort, around its south-western part.
  4. In the hill just east of Lantern Landing.
  5. In the structure west of Cursed Cavern, on the edge of the violet forest near the center of the map.
  6. On the $.$. Rocky ship.
  7. In the sewers beneath the southern part of Loguetown.
  8. Inside the cliff on the beach south of Busy Bay.
  9. Close to the cliff, located to the north-west of Windmill Village.

How to find vault key and access the vault

It’s important to know that finding the vault without the key in your possession is useless. No matter which weapon or item you use, you can’t break through the vault door or its walls in the game. Hence, it becomes imperative to grab a vault key quickly, to avoid an opponent getting to the vault first.

The Rare Vault Key drops at random from regular chests, so the best approach is to open as many chests as you can. Leveling up the Sweet Dreams Sprite can also reward a key, while equipping the Chester Sprite may improve your odds when looting chests. Once you get the key in your inventory, you will see a lock icon appear on your map and minimap.

This lock icon points you towards the nearest unopened vault, so you must follow it to reach the vault. Unlocking the vault door is quite a simple task, and you only have to press the interact button when you are facing it.

How vaults have changed in Fortnite Treasure Hunters

Vaults definitely come in very handy in Fortnite, thanks to the high concentration of valuable loot in those places. They have been available in previous seasons as well—including Chapter 7 Season 4, which concluded in October—but, owing to the ongoing season having a pirate theme, their number has been considerably increased for Treasure Hunters.

Hence, this mini-season emerges as a good time to raid vaults, because they will not be quite as highly contested as in past seasons, simply because of the bump in the number of vault locations. Just don’t wait too long: the mini-season wraps up with the Chapter 7 end event on Saturday, December 5. It will be interesting to see how Fortnite devs decide on the total vault count for future seasons based on the feedback from this one.

FAQs

Where to find vault keys in Fortnite Treasure Hunters?

Vault keys never appear marked on the map. They drop at random from chests, so you just have to keep opening chests during a match to find one.

Where are the vaults on the Fortnite Battle Royale map?

Vaults don’t appear on the Battle Royale map until you have already obtained a vault key from a chest.

How to find every vault in Fortnite Battle Royale?

It is somewhat unrealistic and needless to try and tackle every vault in a single Battle Royale match in Fortnite. Hence, it’s best to only focus on the one or two vaults that are close to the Battle Bus’ path in any given match.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can use any payment method supported by the Epic Games Store or your platform's payment system in your region. Available options vary depending on where you purchase the subscription.

acceptedAnswer.text: It is somewhat unrealistic and needless to try and tackle every vault in a single Battle Royale match in Fortnite. Hence, it’s best to only focus on the one or two vaults that are close to the Battle Bus’ path in any given match.

title.rendered: Fortnite Treasure Hunters: How to check the number of chests you’ve opened

content.rendered:
It’s a pirate-themed season this time, so it only makes sense that chests get a big gameplay emphasis in Fortnite Treasure Hunters. They can once again spawn sprites, and now they also have a rewards pool attached to them. You can see how many you’ve opened in the Quests tab, under the Treasure Hunt section.

On top of everything, there is a wider variety of chests this time compared to the previous season. Sprite Chests are back, joining Rare Chests and standard chests to complete the old lineup. There is also a new kind of chest called the Treasure Chest, which is your gateway to the items in that rewards pool.

How to check how many chests you have opened

  1. In Fortnite, navigate to the Quests tab.
  2. From the sidebar, select the Treasure Hunt section, or scroll down until it appears on screen.
  3. In the quests shown there, you can track how many Treasure Chests, Rare Chests and Sprite Chests you have opened, each counted separately.

Treasure Hunt questline and the rewards for opening chests

As stated earlier, there is a bigger focus on chest-hunting in Fortnite Treasure Hunters. The game has a dedicated questline called “Treasure Hunt”. It records how many chests of each type you open and rewards you for doing so, which shows how much weight this source of loot carries this season.

There are three separate quests in Fortnite right now, one each for the Treasure Chest, Rare Chest and Sprite Chest. Each quest has five stages, and each stage is ticked off once you open a set number of chests. Every stage you complete gives you 10,000 XP, adding to the incentive.

Wrapping up

For a season as littered with chests as Fortnite Treasure Hunters, it only makes sense that the game includes a counter for opened chests and ties XP rewards to it. Beyond in-game loot and highly valuable items such as the Pirate Shop token, there is an extra incentive to scour the island for chests if you want to level up quickly this season.

Treasure Hunters is still taking shape, so many of its sprites and other gameplay-changing items have yet to roll out in Fortnite. It may be worth waiting to see if and how the developers at Epic Games make chests even more appealing, with over half the season still to go.

FAQs

Can I see the total number of chests I opened in the Fortnite Treasure Hunters season?

You will only see separate counts for each type of chest you opened this season. There is no combined count, so you will have to add those numbers together yourself.

Can I see the total number of chests I’ve opened throughout my time in Fortnite?

No. The opened-chests tracker only keeps your record for the Fortnite Treasure Hunters mini-season, which is set to end on December 5, 2026.

Where are most of the chests in Fortnite?

In the current season, the POIs with the highest chest density include Rubber Resort, Lantern Landing, Loguetown and Arlong Park.

mainEntity.name: Can I see the total number of chests I’ve opened throughout my time in Fortnite?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The opened-chests tracker only keeps your record for the Fortnite Treasure Hunters mini-season, which is set to end on December 5, 2026.

mainEntity.name: Where are most of the chests in Fortnite?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the current season, the POIs with the highest chest density include Rubber Resort, Lantern Landing, Loguetown and Arlong Park.

title.rendered: iPhone unavailable: How to reset your iPhone (4 ways)

content.rendered:
Seeing “iPhone Unavailable” on your screen can be frustrating, especially when you need immediate access to your photos, messages, or important files. Whether you’ve forgotten your passcode or entered the wrong one too many times, your iPhone may temporarily or permanently prevent you from unlocking it.

Fortunately, there are several ways to reset an unavailable iPhone, including Apple’s built-in recovery options and third-party tools such as Fonelora iPhone Unlocker.

In this guide, we’ll explain why the error appears, walk through four practical solutions, and compare their requirements to help you choose the most suitable method.

Why Does Your iPhone Say “iPhone Unavailable”?

The “iPhone Unavailable” message is an Apple security feature triggered by multiple incorrect passcode attempts to prevent unauthorized access.

Common causes include:

  • Entering the wrong screen passcode repeatedly.
  • Forgetting a recently changed passcode.
  • Someone else, such as a child, accidentally entering incorrect passcodes.
  • Face ID or Touch ID becoming unavailable, requiring manual passcode verification.

Initially, your iPhone may display “iPhone Unavailable, try again in 1 minute.” Further incorrect attempts can lead to longer lockouts or a screen without a countdown.

If you remember your passcode, wait for the timer to expire. Otherwise, you’ll need a recovery method.

Important: Most passcode removal methods erase local data. If you recently changed your passcode, check Apple’s 72-hour Passcode Reset option first.

How to Reset an Unavailable iPhone: 4 Methods

Method 1. Reset iPhone Unavailable Using “Forgot Passcode?”

Best for: Users who know their Apple Account credentials and want to reset their iPhone without a computer.

Apple provides a built-in reset feature on supported iPhones running iOS 15.2 or later. For iOS 17 and newer, you’ll typically see the “Forgot Passcode?” option on the unavailable screen.

Steps:

  1. On the “iPhone Unavailable” screen, tap Forgot Passcode? when the option becomes available.
  2. Select Start iPhone Reset.
  3. Enter your Apple Account password to sign out of your account.
  4. Tap Erase iPhone to confirm the factory reset.
  5. Once your iPhone restarts, follow the setup instructions and restore an available backup.

For iOS 15.2 or iOS 16, you may see Erase iPhone directly instead.

Limitations:

  • Requires an internet connection and Find My to have been enabled.
  • Requires your Apple Account password.
  • Erases local data and settings.

One exception worth checking: On iOS 17 or later, if you changed your passcode within the previous 72 hours, tapping Forgot Passcode? > Enter Previous Passcode may allow you to use your old passcode and create a new one without erasing data.

If the reset option is missing or you cannot meet its requirements, consider the following methods.

Method 2. Reset an Unavailable iPhone with Recovery Mode

Best for: Users who have a computer and prefer an official Apple restoration method.

If the on-device reset option is unavailable, Apple allows you to restore your iPhone using a Mac or Windows computer.

Recovery Mode is a built-in troubleshooting feature that allows a computer to restore the iPhone’s software even when the device cannot be unlocked normally.

Steps:

  1. Turn off your iPhone.
  2. Connect it to your computer while holding the appropriate recovery button. On Face ID models and iPhone 8 or later, hold the Side button until the recovery-mode screen appears.
  3. Open Finder on a Mac or the Apple Devices app on Windows.
  4. Select your iPhone and choose Restore when prompted.
  5. Wait for the restoration to finish, then set up your iPhone again.

For older iPhones, the recovery-mode button differs by model. Check Apple’s instructions before starting.

Limitations:

  • The restore process permanently erases local data.
  • Entering recovery mode requires the correct button procedure.
  • A stable computer connection is necessary.
  • Activation Lock may still require the previously linked Apple Account.

This method is free and reliable when the device and computer work properly, although it involves more manual steps than a guided unlocking tool.

Method 3. Erase an Unavailable iPhone Through iCloud Find Devices

Best for: Users who remember their Apple Account credentials and previously enabled Find My.

You can also remotely erase your iPhone through Apple’s Find Devices service without connecting the locked phone to a computer.

This option can be especially useful if your unavailable iPhone is not physically nearby or you prefer to initiate the reset from another device.

Steps:

  1. Visit iCloud Find Devices using another phone or computer.
  2. Sign in with the Apple Account associated with your unavailable iPhone.
  3. Select the locked iPhone from your device list.
  4. Choose Erase This Device and follow the confirmation instructions.
  5. Once the erase finishes, set up the iPhone again.

Limitations:

  • Find My must have been enabled before the lockout.
  • You need access to the associated Apple Account.
  • If the iPhone is offline, the erase request will remain pending until it reconnects.
  • All local data is erased, and Activation Lock remains enabled.

If you cannot use Apple’s on-device reset feature, find Recovery Mode too complicated, or prefer a more guided approach, the following option may be worth considering.

Method 4. Reset an Unavailable iPhone with Fonelora iPhone Unlocker

Best for: Users who have forgotten their iPhone screen passcode, cannot access the on-device reset option, or prefer a guided unlocking process.

Apple’s official recovery methods are useful, but they may not be convenient for everyone.
For example, some iPhones do not display the “Forgot Passcode?” option on the lock screen. Others require users to manually enter Recovery Mode, troubleshoot connection issues, or restore the system through a computer.

For users unfamiliar with these procedures, the process can feel unnecessarily complicated.
In these situations, Fonelora iPhone Unlocker offers an alternative way to remove the screen lock from a supported iPhone using a Windows PC or Mac.

The software is designed to address common iOS locking problems, including:

  • iPhone Unavailable and Security Lockout screens.
  • Forgotten 4-digit, 6-digit, or custom screen passcodes.
  • Devices requiring a passcode when Face ID or Touch ID cannot be used.
  • Supported iPhones and iPads locked by a forgotten screen passcode.

Unlike manual recovery procedures, Fonelora provides a visual interface that guides users through the unlocking process. You don’t have to memorize complicated button combinations or independently manage every recovery step.

How to Remove the iPhone Unavailable Screen with Fonelora

Step 1. Install Fonelora iPhone Unlocker

Download and install Fonelora iPhone Unlocker on your Windows computer or Mac.

Launch the program and select Unlock Screen Passcode from the main interface.

Step 2. Connect Your Unavailable iPhone

Connect your iPhone to the computer using a compatible USB cable. Click Start Now and follow the instructions to establish the connection.

Step 3. Remove the Screen Lock and Set Up Your iPhone

Follow the on-screen instructions to prepare the required device files and confirm the unlocking process. Keep your iPhone connected until the screen lock is removed. Once completed, you can set up your iPhone with a new passcode and restore an available backup.

Which iPhone Unavailable Reset Method Is Best?

Each solution has different requirements. The following comparison can help you decide.

*Apple’s 72-hour previous-passcode recovery can preserve data when eligible.

Try Apple’s previous-passcode recovery or built-in reset option first. If these aren’t available, Fonelora iPhone Unlocker offers a simpler, guided alternative for compatible devices, though data may be erased.

Final Verdict

An “iPhone Unavailable” message doesn’t mean your device is permanently locked. Whether you use the Forgot Passcode option, Recovery Mode, or iCloud Find Devices, Apple’s official methods can help you reset your iPhone under the right conditions.

However, if these options aren’t available or you find the recovery process too complicated, Fonelora iPhone Unlocker offers a simpler, guided alternative. With its straightforward interface and step-by-step instructions, you can remove the screen lock from a supported iPhone without navigating complex recovery procedures on your own.

title.rendered: Sweet Dreams Sprite in Fortnite: What it does and how to find it

content.rendered:
For yet another season, sprites have been retained in Fortnite and introduced afresh, with new theme-relevant critters rolled out this mini-season. After debuting in their current form in Chapter 7 Season 3, sprites have been chosen to feature in Fortnite Treasure Hunters as well, which is the third consecutive season that they are now a part of.

Among the new lot of Fortnite sprites this time, Sweet Dreams Sprite is perhaps among the most difficult to find, owing to its Mythic status. As a matter of fact, at present, it is the only Mythic sprite in the game, besides the Plundarrgh Sprite. Below, you can learn more about the Sweet Dreams Sprite and how you can find one.

What does Sweet Dreams Sprite do in Fortnite?

Rather than providing any direct gameplay benefit, the Sweet Dreams Sprite offers the player a random item at every level, with mythic-tier loot spawning once you max it out. Unlike most other sprites, it doesn’t have this in any other sprite variant. The only other sprite that shares this trait is the Transponder Snail Sprite.

Given the ability it grants, the Sweet Dreams Sprite should come in handy for those who want to spend less time ransacking chests, as it automatically provides an item from the loot pool upon leveling up each time. However, since realistically it may be challenging to take the sprite from zero to max level in a single match, you may have to carry it over to a second consecutive match if you want to trigger its mythic item-giving mechanic.

How to get Sweet Dreams Sprite in Fortnite

1. Grab it from a chest

Chests are once again a primary source of finding sprites in Fortnite. There are various types of chests available in the Treasure Hunters season, including Treasure Chests, Sprite Chests, Rare Chests, and buried chests. Among them, the best chances of spawning a Sweet Dreams Sprite are offered by Sprite Chests, which, as the name suggests, guarantee at least one critter appearing when you open any one of them.

These Sprite Chests are scattered throughout the Battle Royale map, but there are a few hotspots that house two or more such chests. These noteworthy POIs are Rubber Resort island, Cursed Cavern, Lantern Landing, Windmill Village island, and The $.$. Rocky.

Since hidden vaults and buried chests often give a sprite, it is advisable to not skip those either. For the former, you would have to obtain a vault key (hidden near the vicinity of the vault itself) and, for the latter, you would have to claim a Wanted Poster and then hunt for the buried chest. Both these options are reliable ways to get your hands on the Sweet Dreams Sprite. Need help finding buried chests? See all buried chest locations in Fortnite Treasure Hunters.

You can also check how many chests you’ve opened and track your Treasure Hunt quest progress.

2. Use a Lucky Locator or Sprite Locator gizmo

Gizmos in Fortnite come in handy for sprite-catchers, as they can facilitate the hunt for new sprites and also the quick extraction of an equipped sprite. Lucky Locator is a gizmo that helps with the former. To be specific, it helps you track the location of a buried Sprite Chest that is more likely to spawn a sprite you don’t already have.

On the other hand, a Sprite Locator has a similar purpose and directs the player to a buried Sprite Chest. However, the discrepancy between the two gizmos is that the chest marked by a Sprite Locator can give any random sprite, regardless of whether you already have it or not.

Both these gizmos are part of Fortnite’s Treasure Chest pool and can be obtained from one of such chests during a match. It’s also worth noting that they only work when you are in the safe zone, away from the Storm.

3. Borrow Sweet Dreams from a friend

One of the easiest and quickest ways of getting the Sweet Dreams Sprite is to simply borrow it from another player to index the same into your sprite collection. For this, you and the other player have to join the same match twice. In the first one, the player offering the sprite can drop it for you to extract. In the second match, you can do the same and return the critter to its original owner.

After that, you can just head back to the Fortnite menu, go to the Treasure tab, and then the Sprites section. From here, you can navigate to the slot of the sprite you had just borrowed and spend some Sprite Dust to recall it. From here on, it’s yours to equip ahead of a match.

Return of sprites in Treasure Hunters

Sprites have returned for another season in Fortnite, continuing a feature that first appeared in Chapter 7 Season 3. The Treasure Hunters mini-season introduces a fresh collection of companions with abilities that fit its treasure-hunting theme.

Sweet Dreams is one of the most interesting additions because it focuses on loot progression rather than a direct combat or exploration ability. Other Sprites offer different benefits, such as revealing treasure, restoring health, or helping players collect additional items.

Epic has also continued expanding the Sprite collection and mastery system, giving players more reasons to explore the island and complete their collections.

With more seasonal content expected, it will be interesting to see what other Sprite abilities and variants arrive before the Treasure Hunters mini-season ends.

FAQs

Where does the Sweet Dreams Sprite spawn in Fortnite?

The Sweet Dreams Sprite is available in all unranked Battle Royale and Zero Build matches.

How long does the Sweet Dreams Sprite effect last?

The Sweet Dreams Sprite’s effect only triggers each time you level it up. So, there’s no continuous effect in play here, but a periodic one.

How to find Sweet Dreams Sprite locations on the Fortnite map?

There are no specific spots that guarantee a Sweet Dreams Sprite, as its spawn locations are random. However, since chests are a major source of getting this sprite, you can focus on certain POIs that have the most number of chests, along with a good variety.

mainEntity.name: How long does the Sweet Dreams Sprite effect last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Sweet Dreams Sprite's effect only triggers each time you level it up. So, there's no continuous effect in play here, but a periodic one.

title.rendered: How to get Chiseled Soulshale in Minecraft

content.rendered:
Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 introduced a bunch of new additions, but one of the most mysterious ones is a secretive block called Chiseled Soulshale. What exactly is its purpose? Well, there’s no official explanation just yet, but some theories suggest it could be connected to the upcoming Sift dimension.

For now, all we know is that it’s a decorative block with a dark green appearance, and it can’t be obtained from the Creative inventory either. So, how do you get Chiseled Soulshale in Minecraft? Here’s a complete guide to help you find it.

Where to find Chiseled Soulshale in Minecraft

The Ancient City method is the only way to obtain the block through normal Survival gameplay in the current experimental build. If you don’t want to explore the Deep Dark, you can use commands instead, provided cheats are enabled.

How to get Chiseled Soulshale from Ancient City chests

The only way to obtain Chiseled Soulshale in the current Minecraft experimental build is by exploring Ancient Cities. These underground structures generate in the Deep Dark biome and have tons of loot chests that have a chance of containing Chiseled Soulshale. However, keep in mind that each chest only has a 23% chance of containing this decorative block. This means you might have to search multiple chests before finally getting your hands on one.

We’d also recommend checking out a guide on the best sword enchantments in Minecraft before venturing into an Ancient City. Why, you might ask? Well, there’s the Warden. It’s one of the deadliest mobs in the game, and it lurks inside the Ancient Cities. It can detect players through vibrations, sounds, and smell.

The Warden’s attacks deal lethal damage, so make sure you’re well-equipped and have a plan to take it down.

How to get Chiseled Soulshale using commands

Don’t want to deal with the Warden? Then make use of Minecraft commands! They’re the quickest way to obtain Chiseled Soulshale in Minecraft, provided you have cheats enabled in your world. Once that’s sorted, follow these steps:

  1. Open your Minecraft world.
  2. Press T to open the chat window.
  3. Enter the following command: /give @p minecraft:chiseled_soulshale 1
  4. Press Enter, and Chiseled Soulshale will be available in your inventory.

If you want multiple blocks, replace the number 1 at the end of the command with your desired quantity. For example, use 64 to receive a full stack.

Can you craft Chiseled Soulshale in Minecraft?

No, Chiseled Soulshale doesn’t have a crafting recipe in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7. You cannot create it using a Crafting Table or Stonecutter.

Your only options in the current experimental build are to search eligible Ancient City loot chests or use the /give command.

Since Mojang hasn’t announced any additional crafting functionality for the block, there’s no confirmed way to produce it using regular materials.

Why is Chiseled Soulshale missing from the creative inventory?

Developer Mojang has added Chiselled Soulshale as a hidden block in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7. This is intentional, as developers want the decorative block to be discovered through exploration rather than selected directly from the Creative menu.

However, it can still be obtained via commands if you do not wish to loot chests in Ancient Cities.

Tips for finding Chiseled Soulshale faster

If you’re planning on finding Chiseled Soulshale in Minecraft, exploring Ancient Cities is your only bet. However, since the chests have a low chance of containing the block, you’ll want to make your exploration as efficient as possible. So, here are a few tips to help you find the Chiseled Soulshale faster:

  1. Supplies: Make sure you’re carrying food, armour, night vision potions, and a pickaxe, as it will help you survive longer in an Ancient City.
  2. Explore: Ancient Cities have tons of different rooms, corridors, and loot chests. So, make sure to check every chest you come across.
  3. Wool Blocks: Place wool around sensors or use it to reduce vibrations and avoid summoning the Warden.
  4. Track Chests: Ancient Cities are huge, and you can revisit areas that have already been explored. Keep track of the chests you’ve opened to avoid wasting time.

Wrapping up

Chiseled Soulshale is one of the most mysterious additions in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7. Although Mojang hasn’t explained its purpose, you can obtain this hidden decorative block by searching eligible Ancient City chests or using commands.

If you prefer Survival gameplay, prepare for a dangerous trip into the Deep Dark and check as many chests as possible. And if you don’t want to deal with the Warden, the /give command offers a much quicker alternative.

As for its possible connection to the Sift dimension, we’ll have to wait for Mojang to reveal more.

FAQs

Can you craft Chiseled Soulshale in Minecraft?

You can’t craft Chiseled Soulshale in Minecraft. It is an unobtainable decorative block through regular crafting.

Where does Chiseled Soulshale spawn?

Chiseled Soulshale can be found inside loot chests scattered across Ancient Cities in the Deep Dark biome.

What are the chances of finding Chiseled Soulshale in an Ancient City?

There is a 23% chance of finding Chiseled Soulshale in an Ancient City loot chest in the current experimental build.

title.rendered: How to get Calcite in Minecraft

content.rendered:
Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 has finally given Calcite more building possibilities, allowing players to turn this decorative block into several new variants. If you’re unfamiliar with it, Calcite is a naturally generated block with a smooth, marble-like appearance. Its light color makes it an excellent choice for building palaces, modern houses, and other decorative structures.

However, finding Calcite can be challenging if you don’t know where to look. It generates naturally in Amethyst Geodes and Stony Peaks, with Ice Caves becoming another source in the upcoming 26.4 update.

Don’t worry, though! Here’s how to find and mine Calcite in Minecraft, along with everything you can craft with it.

Where to find Calcite in Minecraft

Keep in mind that although Calcite can be found in Ice Caves, this feature isn’t available in the public versions of Minecraft Java or Bedrock Edition just yet. You’ll need to download the latest Snapshot or Preview build to access it, as Ice Caves are an upcoming addition to the 26.4 update.

How to get Calcite from Amethyst Geodes

One of the easiest ways to find Calcite in Minecraft is by exploring Amethyst Geodes. These structures spawn naturally in the Overworld, with Calcite forming in their middle layer. In order to find one, you need to look in underground cave systems, as Amethyst Geodes can sometimes generate partially exposed inside them.

Look for the layer of Smooth Basalt. You might also see glowing Amethyst Blocks and crystals through any openings in the structure. Once you find a geode, break through the outer layers to find the white Calcite blocks.

How to find Calcite in the Stony Peaks biome

If you don’t want to venture into underground caves, you can also find Calcite by exploring the Stony Peaks biome. Look for tall mountains in the Overworld, particularly those located near warmer biomes. These mountains have a steep, rocky terrain with little to no snow or vegetation.

Calcite naturally generates on the exposed surfaces of these mountains. This will make it easier for you to spot it against the surrounding stone. Once you find a deposit, it’s yours to collect.

How to mine Calcite in Minecraft

Once you’ve found Calcite in Minecraft at any of the locations mentioned above, collecting it is quite a simple process. All you need is a pickaxe, regardless of whether it’s made of wood, stone, iron, or diamond. Calcite is easy to mine, so you don’t need any special tools or enchantments. Here’s a step-by-step process:

  1. Locate Calcite inside Amethyst Geodes or across the Stony Peaks biome.
  2. Equip your pickaxe and use it to break the Calcite blocks.
  3. Once mined, Calcite will drop as an item that can be picked up and added to your inventory.

Tip: Carry an extra pickaxe if you’re planning a long mining session. This will save you from having to return to your base when your primary tool runs out of durability.

What is Calcite used for in Minecraft?

Calcite has traditionally been used as a decorative block in Minecraft. Its smooth texture and light, marble-like appearance make it a great choice for minimalist builds, palaces, modern houses, and other architectural designs.

However, Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 makes the block much more useful by introducing an entire Calcite building set.

Here are the new variants you can create:

  • Calcite Pillar: A vertical decorative block that works well for columns and architectural details.
  • Calcite Slabs: Half-height blocks that help create smoother surfaces and layered designs.
  • Calcite Stairs: Useful for building staircases and adding depth to structures.
  • Calcite Walls: Decorative barriers that fit naturally into castles, houses, and other builds.
  • Polished Calcite: A refined version of the original block with a cleaner appearance.
  • Polished Calcite Bricks: A brick-style variant that adds more texture to decorative builds.

You can also create slabs, stairs, and walls from the Polished Calcite and Polished Calcite Bricks sets.

These additions give builders more flexibility when working with light-colored materials. Calcite can also serve as an alternative to quartz when you want a similar bright aesthetic without relying entirely on quartz blocks.

Can you craft Calcite in Minecraft?

No, you cannot craft the original Calcite block in Minecraft. It generates naturally in specific locations, including Amethyst Geodes and the Stony Peaks biome.

In compatible Minecraft 26.4 development builds, you can also find it inside Ice Caves.

However, once you collect Calcite, you can use it to craft several decorative variants, including Polished Calcite, Calcite Pillars, and Polished Calcite Bricks.

Tips for finding Calcite faster

Finding Calcite in Minecraft isn’t particularly difficult, as it generates naturally in a bunch of locations. However, there are a few tricks you can use to speed up your search and collect more blocks in less time.

  1. Equip an Elytra: If you don’t have an Elytra already, check out our guide on how to get one. You can use it to glide across mountain ranges, cover more ground, and quickly spot Calcite deposits in Stony Peaks.
  2. Explore large Caves: Amethyst Geodes typically generate inside underground caves. Exploring large cave systems can save you the trouble of digging randomly underground and make finding these structures easier.
  3. Carry an extra Pickaxe: Calcite is easy to mine, but carrying a spare pickaxe ensures you won’t have to return to your base if your primary tool breaks while collecting it.

Wrapping up

Whether you explore underground Amethyst Geodes or climb the Stony Peaks, there are several ways to collect Calcite in Minecraft. The upcoming Ice Caves also provide another location to find this decorative block.

Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 makes Calcite even more useful by introducing Pillars, Slabs, Stairs, Walls, Polished Calcite, and Polished Calcite Bricks. So, grab your pickaxe, collect a few stacks, and start experimenting with the new building options!

FAQs

Can you craft Calcite in Minecraft?

You can’t craft Calcite directly in Minecraft. It is a naturally generated block that can be found by exploring Amethyst Geodes, the Stony Peaks, and Ice Caves.

What pickaxe do you need to mine Calcite?

You can mine Calcite with any pickaxe in Minecraft, including Wooden, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite.

Does Calcite require Silk Touch?

You don’t need the Silk Touch enchantment in Minecraft to mine Calcite. It can be obtained using any pickaxe.

What is the best biome to find Calcite?

The Stony Peaks biome is the best place to obtain Calcite in Minecraft. The block can be found exposed on the mountain surface.

Is Calcite renewable in Minecraft?

Calcite is not a renewable resource in Minecraft. It naturally generates in specific locations in the game.

title.rendered: iPad shipments fell 27.5% in Q3 as tablet shipments hit a three-year low

content.rendered:
Research firm Omdia counted about 11.6 million iPads shipped in the third quarter of 2026, down 27.5% from a year earlier. The whole tablet market shipped 32.2 million units, down 23% from 41.8 million, the lowest level in nearly three years.

Omdia counts sell-in shipments, meaning units sent to sellers, so the figures don’t measure customer purchases. The Portuguese-language MacMagazine report covers the same quarter.

Apple fell faster than the market, and Lenovo was the only top-five grower

Apple kept the top spot with 36% of shipments, but its share fell 2.2 percentage points, from 38.2%. Its 27.5% drop was steeper than the 23% fall in the whole market. Samsung, the second-largest seller, fell 21.7%. Huawei had the steepest drop of the top five, at 43%. Lenovo, in third place, was the only one of the five to grow, up 11.9% to a 12.7% share, while Xiaomi slipped 10.6%.

Omdia links the slump to supply limits and buyers who can wait

Omdia research manager Himani Mukka says supply constraints are “limiting vendors’ ability to deliver meaningful specification upgrades.” New models look close to their predecessors, and she expects buyers to delay purchases until the improvements are bigger. Buyers who need a tablet now can compare the models in an iPad buying guide.

IDC now expects a memory shortage to cut global smartphone shipments by 16.7% this year, deeper than the 12.9% it forecast in February, and it says low-cost Android devices will take the hardest hit. Mac shipments fell 11.3% in the same quarter, by IDC’s count.

The figures cover only the third quarter, so they do not show whether the slide continues into the holiday quarter. Omdia, however, doesn’t expect a meaningful tablet recovery before 2028. If your current iPad still works, these numbers alone are no reason to buy or wait.

title.rendered: Instagram’s Edits app now runs on Mac, with 4K export

content.rendered:
Instagram has released Edits for Mac, a desktop version of its free video editor. It runs only on macOS and needs a Mac with Apple silicon, M1 or later. Intel Macs are out, and there is no Windows version.

Edits began as a phone app, first as an iOS pre-order and then on the App Store and Google Play in April 2025. For how the phone app works, read how to use Instagram Edits for Reels. The Mac app is its first desktop version.

Edits for Mac adds a multi-track timeline and 4K export

Instagram’s page describes a multi-track timeline with precise editing tools, keyframes for transitions, and audio waveforms for beat-accurate cuts. Users also get color wheels and curves for grading, layered audio for longer projects, and the option to import their own LUTs and fonts. Captions are automatic and unlimited.

Projects export in 4K with no watermark. Users can work across several aspect ratios, so one project can fit horizontal and vertical formats.

The layout is meant to feel familiar to phone users, with more room for complex edits. Instagram also says more desktop-only features are coming, but it does not name them. Its tagline for the app is “Your biggest ideas, on a bigger canvas.”

Reports from launch day add that the Mac app supports Model Context Protocol (MCP), so creators can connect an AI agent to assemble a rough cut and then refine it by hand in Edits. Instagram’s own page does not mention this feature.

Edits for Mac is free, but it requires an Instagram login and a newer Mac

The download is free, and the page lists no paid tier. It comes as a direct download from Instagram’s website. Users must sign in to Instagram, which keeps their projects tied to their account. Projects can publish straight to Instagram without a download and re-upload. The app also includes Instagram’s licensed, royalty-free audio library, which matters most for Reels creators.

Macs already include Apple’s free editor, iMovie, and users can compare Edits with other video editors for Mac.

The page names no minimum macOS version beyond Apple silicon. It also does not say whether a project started on a phone can open on the Mac, though launch reports say cross-device projects are not supported yet; only saved audio and text styles carry over from the phone app. To check a Mac, choose the Apple menu > About This Mac. A chip such as M1 or later meets Instagram’s requirement. An Intel processor does not.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Top 5 armor enchantments in Minecraft

content.rendered:
If you’re planning to take on the Ender Dragon or explore dangerous areas in Minecraft, you’ll need more than just diamond or Netherite armor. The right enchantments can make a significant difference to your survivability by reducing incoming damage, improving durability, and helping you deal with specific threats across the Overworld, Nether, and End dimension.

However, with so many enchantments available, choosing the right combination can be confusing. Some are essential for almost every armor set, while others are more useful for specific activities, such as exploring underwater structures or surviving dangerous falls.

To make things easier, here are the five best armor enchantments in Minecraft, what they do, and which armor pieces you should use them on.

Quick picks: Best armor enchantments at a glance

What are the best armor enchantments in Minecraft?

The best all-around armor enchantments in Minecraft are Protection IV, Mending I, and Unbreaking III. These three improve your defense and armor durability, making them useful for almost every survival playthrough.

For additional utility, add Feather Falling IV to your boots and Respiration III to your helmet. This combination gives you a strong balance of protection, durability, and underwater exploration benefits.

Let’s look at what each enchantment does and why it’s worth using.

1. Protection IV — the one enchantment every piece needs

After spending hundreds of hours in Minecraft, if there’s one armor enchantment that has proven to be clutch in every situation, it’s Protection IV. Its main job is to reduce damage from a wide range of sources, including the likes of explosions, fire, and mob attacks. The enchantment can be applied to all four pieces of armor.

In terms of raw stats, a single Protection IV enchantment provides you with 16% damage reduction on the armor piece it’s applied to. However, if you manage to enchant all four pieces, you’ll get a combined 64% damage reduction.

Keep in mind that Protection IV can’t be paired with the likes of Fire Protection, Blast Protection, and Projectile Protection. It also won’t shield you from hunger, the void, or the /kill Minecraft command.

2. Mending — how to keep armor forever

Let’s be honest, whether you’re exploring the world or hunting for an Elytra in Minecraft, you’re bound to encounter mobs and other hazards that can seriously damage your armor. Sure, you can always repair the damaged pieces, but that means spending additional resources. This is exactly where Mending I comes in handy, as it lets you restore your armor’s durability without having to worry about making manual repairs.

Mending works by using the experience (XP) orbs you collect to automatically repair your armor. It can be applied to helmets, chestplates, leggings, and boots. Each XP point restores two durability points, and the enchantment is compatible with Protection IV. However, if you have multiple Mending-equipped items that need to be repaired, the game will automatically choose which pieces receive the durability restoration.

Mending helps armor last longer, but Curse of Vanishing can still cost you the item when you die. Here’s what the curse does and how to keep your gear.

3. Unbreaking III — why it still matters with Mending

Some enchantment combinations are simply too good to pass up, and Unbreaking III paired with Mending is the perfect example. Mending works to restore your armor’s durability using XP orbs, and Unbreaking reduces the chances of losing durability in the first place. Together, they make your diamond or Netherite armour last for ages.

You can only apply Unbreaking III to all four armor pieces, including helmets, chestplates, leggings, and boots. At its maximum level, the enchantment gives your armor a 30% chance to avoid losing durability whenever it takes a hit. This means your armor can last approximately 43% longer on average compared to pieces without Unbreaking. What’s even better is the fact that it can be combined with Mending 1 and Protection IV for an all-rounder setup.

4. Feather Falling IV — the best boots enchantment

Feather Falling is one of the most valuable enchantments you can have on your boots in Minecraft, especially if you spend a lot of time exploring caves, climbing mountains, or navigating areas where there’s a chance of falling. As the name suggests, this enchantment reduces the amount of fall damage you take. This would make accidental drops from heights far less dangerous.

Feather Falling IV is what you need to aim for. This reduces any fall damage you take by 48%. It comes in quite handy even when you’re using an Elytra or teleporting with Ender Pearls, as both can leave you taking fall damage. It can be combined with Protection IV for even better damage reduction.

5. Respiration III — for oceans and monuments

When it comes to the best armor enchantments in Minecraft, Respiration III is another must-have, especially if you love the seas. This enchantment can only be applied to helmets, and its primary benefit is that it increases the amount of time you can spend underwater before running out of oxygen. This gives you much more time to explore the ocean floor, collect valuable loot, and discover hidden structures without constantly having to resurface.

Respiration III allows you to stay underwater for up to 60 seconds before your oxygen supply completely runs out. Even after that, you have a 75% chance of avoiding drowning damage with each passing second. To make the most of this enchantment, pair it with Aqua Affinity, as it allows you to mine blocks at your normal speed while underwater.

Best enchantments for each armor piece

Honourable mentions

We’ve covered the best all-around armor enchantments in Minecraft, but that doesn’t mean they’re your only options. Our top picks do give you the best overall protection and utility, but there are also other enchantments that can be even more effective in specific situations. The best choice ultimately comes down to the kind of adventure you’re preparing for and your playstyle. With that in mind, here are some honourable mentions worth considering:

  • Blast Protection IV: If you’re tired of taking explosion damage from Creepers or the Wither, Blast Protection IV is what you need. It reduces damage from explosions by 32%.
  • Swift Sneak: This enchantment increases your movement speed while sneaking. It’s useful when you are exploring ancient cities, as it lets you move quickly while avoiding the Warden.
  • Depth Strider III: Another excellent underwater enchantment is Depth Strider III. It increases your movement speed in water, which makes it easier to explore the ocean floors.
  • Frost Walker II – With Frost Walker II equipped, nearby water blocks temporarily turn into frosted ice as you walk over them. This lets you cross lakes and rivers without having to swim.
  • Thorns III – This enchantment gives you a chance to damage enemies whenever they attack you. When maxed out at level II, it has a 45% chance of activating.

Is Thorns worth it?

On paper, Thorns seems like one of the best enchantments in Minecraft. Seriously, whenever an enemy attacks you, this enchantment has a chance of retaliating and dealing damage back to the attacker. At its maximum level, Thorns III has a 45% chance of activating and dealing 1-4 points of damage to whoever dares to hit you. That sounds like a deal too good to miss.

However, there’s a catch. Every time Thorn activates, your armor will end up losing two durability points. This can cause your armor to wear down quickly, especially when you’re surrounded by multiple mobs or going toe-to-toe against other players.

So, is Thorns worth using? Well, that depends on your playstyle. If you go against mobs or engage in PvP, we’ll recommend applying Thorns III to just one armor piece rather than your set for passive damage. However, if you spend most of your time exploring, completing quests, or gathering resources, don’t bother slapping on this enchantment.

How to combine enchantments without “Too Expensive!”

Sometimes, when combining different enchantments on your armor using an anvil, you might run into the “Too Expensive!” message. This means that the anvil operation can’t be completed due to the item’s previous work penalty. In survival mode, if any work requires 40 XP or more, the anvil won’t allow you to do the work.

So, how can you avoid running into this issue? One workaround is to combine compatible enchanted books with each other first before applying them to your armor. You can also use an enchanting table to add enchantments directly to your equipment. Mending 1 can also be applied to your armor, as it allows you to restore durability using XP orbs instead of constantly repairing your gear with an anvil.

Do armor enchantments help against Freezing in 26.4?

Unfortunately, traditional armor enchantments such as Protection IV, Unbreaking III, and Mending 1 won’t give you any protection against the Freezing effect in Minecraft 26.4. In order to counter this mechanic, you need to wear at least one piece of leather armor.

This is crucial as prolonged exposure to Freezing can cause your character to freeze and take damage. So, if you’re planning to explore Ice Caves or encounter the new Frostbite mobs, make sure you carry a spare piece of leather armor and equip it whenever you come across the new freezing mechanic.

Wraaping up!

Choosing the right armor enchantments in Minecraft can make a huge difference to your survivability, whether you’re fighting the Ender Dragon, exploring dangerous caves, or travelling through the Nether.

For the best all-around setup, prioritize Protection IV, Mending I, and Unbreaking III across all four armor pieces. Add Feather Falling IV to your boots and Respiration III to your helmet for extra utility.

You can also experiment with enchantments such as Thorns, Swift Sneak, and Depth Strider depending on your playstyle. Ultimately, the best armor setup is the one that helps you survive the challenges you encounter most often.

FAQs

What is the best armor enchantment in Minecraft?

The best armor enchantment in Minecraft is Protection IV, as it reduces the incoming damage by 16% per armor piece.

Can you have Protection and Blast Protection on the same piece?

You can’t apply Protection and Blast Protection on the same armor piece in Survival mode.

How many enchantments can one armor piece hold?

There’s no limit to the number of enchantments a single armor piece can have in Minecraft. You can combine multiple compatible enchantments.

Is Mending better than Unbreaking?

There’s no one that’s necessarily better, as Mending and Unbreaking work best together. Mending repairs your armor using XP orbs, and Unbreaking III reduces how frequently it loses durability.

Does Feather Falling stack with Protection?

Feather Falling IV does stack with Protection IV in Minecraft. Feather Falling reduces your fall damage by 48%, and Protection gives additional damage reduction.

title.rendered: WhatsApp’s AI photo expansion is in iPhone beta testing

content.rendered:
WhatsApp is testing an AI photo expansion tool on iPhone. The tool uses Meta AI to extend a photo’s edges so it fills a vertical 9:16 frame. It has reached some beta testers, and no official announcement from WhatsApp or Meta has been published yet.

The details come from WABetaInfo, a site that tracks WhatsApp beta builds. It found the feature in WhatsApp beta for iOS 26.44.10.16, which is available through TestFlight.

Users pick expand in the drawing editor, and nothing sends until they tap send

Users open a photo in a chat, and WhatsApp opens its drawing editor. They pick the expand option from the AI effects. Meta AI takes a few seconds to analyze the photo and generate the expanded version, which then appears in the editor. The tool also works in Status updates, the same place where WhatsApp ran AI image editing tests on iOS in December 2025.

Users can tap undo to restore the original, or run expand again for a different result. WhatsApp does not send the photo on its own. The beta report says results are more accurate when the photo has clear detail around its borders.

The same feature already appears in WhatsApp’s Android beta (version 2.26.44.8), under the Edit tab. It only shows up for photos that aren’t already in a supported format, so a square 1:1 photo is a good way to check for it.

Apple’s Extend already does something similar on iPhone

Apple’s Extend, one of the new AI editing tools in iOS 27 Photos, creates new visual details around the edges of a photo. It needs an iPhone that supports Apple Intelligence. WhatsApp has been adding AI tools in steps. In March, it began testing a dedicated Meta AI tab that groups its AI features in one place.

The beta report gives no release date, only that more testers will get the feature over the coming weeks. It also says some App Store users can already use it, without naming countries or versions. The report does not say whether photos are processed on the phone or on Meta’s servers.

title.rendered: Claude can now see your bank and card accounts, but it can’t move money

content.rendered:
Anthropic has added Personal Finance to Claude, letting the chatbot read bank and card data. Announced on November 5, 2026, the beta starts rolling out this week for Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers in the US. Free plans and users outside the US are not included.

Claude connects through Plaid and never sees the bank password

Users sign in to their bank through Plaid, a service that links apps to banks, and approve Claude’s read-only access on that screen. Anthropic says Claude never receives the password. Users choose which accounts to connect, and unlinking an account cuts off Claude’s access to its data. Personal Finance is separate from the Claude connectors for other apps.

For each connected account, Claude can see the bank name, account name and type, the last four digits, balances, and credit limits. It can also see up to two years of transactions. Conversations in the Personal Finance hub are not used to train Anthropic’s models.

Claude can explain spending, but it can’t act on it

Claude can total spending by category and compare it with earlier months. It can flag duplicate charges, unexpected fees, and bills that have crept up over time. It can explain terms such as APR, including how much interest a user has been charged, and build charts, bill calendars, and dashboards that users can keep adjusting.

The bill calendar answers a common payday question: what is left after the bills come out.

Claude cannot move, manage, or invest money, and the feature is not designed to give investment advice. Claude can also make mistakes, so users should ask which transactions sit behind a figure and check important numbers with their bank. For larger financial decisions, the announcement says Claude should work “alongside the licensed professionals and regulated firms” users already trust. Anthropic is asking banks, wealth managers, and other financial firms to help shape that work.

Anthropic’s Claude Duet, a separate assistant, works on pending tasks even after users log off, though it requires joining a waitlist.

ChatGPT’s version launched in May as a limited US preview for Pro

OpenAI’s ChatGPT personal finance assistant let Pro subscribers link bank accounts, credit cards, and investments through Plaid when it launched on May 15, 2026. Claude’s version uses the same Plaid connection and also starts in the US, but its eligible plans include Max and Ultra.

The announcement does not say whether Personal Finance works on the web, iPhone, or Android, or which banks it supports, but Anthropic’s Help Center does. It lists the web, Claude Desktop, iOS, and Android apps, supports US banks only, and lets users link up to 16 banks. Personal Finance is not available inside Claude Duet.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

As an Amazon Associate, iGeeksBlog earns from qualifying purchases.

title.rendered: Treasure Hour in Fortnite: Confirmed timings and expected boosts

content.rendered:
The Pirate Shop token in Fortnite is all the rage among players right now. As it turns out, the allure of getting almost everything from the Item Shop for free is something that has strongly captivated the imagination of the community. And that is also why fans grew excited when a ‘Treasure Hour’ event was announced by the game’s official channels.

A recent post by Fortnite suggests that the Pirate Shop Access—one of Fortnite’s treasure chest rewards—could be set to remain an extremely rare item even during the forthcoming Treasure Hour, much to the fans’ dismay. However, there are other parts of the game, including certain sprite types, that are set to receive boosts for that period. This should make some items relatively easier to obtain for fans.

What is Treasure Hour in Fortnite?

Treasure Hour is a forthcoming two-hour event in Fortnite during which players will have a better chance to find certain in-game items than usual. Among the things currently revealed to get a boost for the first-ever Treasure Hour day are Fortnite Sprite variants, which will basically spawn more often. In addition, each player would also be equipped with a Shock Rocket and a Self-revive from the very beginning of a match.

This event is planned to take place twice every Saturday throughout the Fortnite Treasure Hunters mini-season, with the first iteration kicking off on November 7, from 2 PM to 4 PM ET and then again from 9 PM to 11 PM ET. Interestingly, Treasure Hour is positioned in the week such that it is followed by Captain’s Day on Sunday at 9 AM ET. This particular day will see a new character taking over a POI, a new SMG being introduced, among other things.

Interestingly, Treasure Hour is positioned in the week such that it is followed by Captain’s Day on Sunday at 9 AM ET.

Fortnite Treasure Hour worldwide schedule

While in the US, Treasure Hour in Fortnite commences and concludes on Saturday itself; in many parts of the world, it extends to Sunday. Moreover, in certain regions such as Japan, the Fortnite event’s both instances take place entirely on Sunday. The following table should help you find its exact schedule across several different time zones around the globe.

Why you should join the Treasure Hour in Fortnite

As of now, the inaugural Treasure Hour is confirmed to feature a boosted spawn rate for the Fortune variant of sprites, which is notably the only variant in Treasure Hunters (besides the base variant, obviously) right now. As such, it’s clear that those still missing out on this particular version of any of the various sprites available in the game have a great opportunity to fill in the gaps in time.

In successive Treasure Hour days, it is nearly certain that the event will focus on different sprites and their variants. Hence, in particular, if you are a completionist, you should regularly jump into Fortnite during events like this one, as they are generally an efficient way to get some of the highly sought-after items in the game.

You can also check the Fortnite Treasure Hunters vault locations to find all nine vaults, each with a Sprite Chest and Rare Chests.

FAQs

Is Treasure Hour on Saturday or Sunday?

The Treasure Hour in Fortnite takes place every Saturday between 2-4 PM ET and then between 9-11 PM ET.

How long does Treasure Hour last?

Each Treasure Hour event in Fortnite has two instances, each of them lasting for two hours.

What time is Treasure Hour in India?

In India, Fortnite Treasure Hour is set to start on Saturday at 11:30 PM and end on Sunday at 1:30 AM. Followed by its second round on Sunday, from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM.

Do I need to do anything to join?

You don’t need to do anything in particular, besides joining any Fortnite Battle Royale mode match during this event.

Is Fortnite dev hour real?

Yes, because it is just another name for Treasure Hour in the Fortnite community.
