title.rendered: How to craft a Straw Bed in Minecraft

content.rendered:
One of the most useful items in Minecraft is undoubtedly the straw bed. What’s this? Well, it’s a variant of the regular bed that also allows you to sleep and skip the night. However, what makes it unique is that it doesn’t set your respawn point.

This can come in handy when you’re exploring the world and want to keep your base as a spawn point in case things go south. Starting a new world for your next adventure? Browse these best Minecraft seeds. So, if you’re wondering how to craft a straw bed in Minecraft, here’s a complete guide to help you out.

What you need to make a Straw Bed?

Crafting a straw bed in Minecraft is quite a simple process. All you need is a few Hay Bales and a Crafting Table. So, here’s a step-by-step guide on how you can craft one:

  1. Craft Hay Bales by placing 9 Wheat in a Crafting Table.
  2. Open the Crafting Table’s 3×3 crafting grid.
  3. Place 3 Hay Bales in a single horizontal row.
  4. Collect the 4 Straw Beds from the result slot and add them to your inventory.

It’s important to keep in mind that all 3 Hay Bales need to be arranged in a single horizontal row within the 3×3 crafting grid. You can use the top, middle, or bottom row, as long as all three Hay Bales are placed next to each other.

However, keep in mind that the 2×2 crafting grid in your inventory can’t be used to craft a straw bed. You need to use the Crafting Table to access the 3×3 grid and complete the recipe.

What you need: hay bales and wheat math

The Hay Bales are the important ingredient needed to craft a straw bed. However, before that, you’ll need to get your hands on Wheat to craft them. Here’s a quick rundown of all materials you need:

  • x9 Wheat = 1 Hay Bale
  • x3 Hay Bales = x4 Straw Beds

Where to find straw beds without crafting

Don’t want to go through the trouble of gathering Wheat and crafting a Straw Bed in Minecraft? Well, there’s another way to get your hands on one. Straw Beds can also generate naturally in Abandoned Camps, which can spawn across 18 different biomes in the game.

Make sure to check the Barrels found within these camps as well, as they can also contain Straw Beds. Once you find one, simply break the Straw Bed and add it to your inventory. Now, it can be carried and placed anywhere you need.

How does a straw bed work?

As we’ve said before, a Straw Bed in Minecraft functions just like a regular bed. You will be able to sleep through the night or skip thunderstorms and wake up in the morning. However, there are a few differences that you should know about.

The most unique aspect of a Straw Bed is the fact that it doesn’t change your respawn point when you sleep in it. This makes it quite useful when you’re exploring a place far away from your main base. You will be able to pass the night, escape monsters and bad weather without replacing your original spawn location.

Straw Bed is also a single-use item. Once you wake up or leave the bed early, the Straw Bed will automatically break and won’t be usable again. Also, the Straw Bed can’t be used in the Nether or the End. If you try to use it, it will simply break without causing an explosion, unlike regular beds.

Straw Bed vs. regular bed

Both Straw Beds and regular beds allow you to sleep and skip the night. However, they have completely different purposes, recipes, and features. Let’s take a look:

Straw bed not working? Fixes to try

Now that you know how to craft a Straw Bed in Minecraft and understand its unique mechanics, you should be all set to use one in your world. However, if you’re still having trouble getting it to work, here are a few common issues you might encounter and how to fix them –

1. Check the Minecraft version

Keep in mind that Straw Beds were introduced in Java Edition 26.4 Snapshot 3 and Bedrock Edition 26.40 Preview. If you’re playing on an older version of Minecraft Java or Bedrock, you won’t be able to craft or use them. Make sure your game is updated to a version that supports Straw Beds.

2. Don’t try to sleep in the Nether or End

Once again, Straw Beds can’t be placed in the Nether or the End. So, if you’re planning to head to grab the Elytra, placing it in the End will simply destroy it. Use this item in the Overworld.

3. Check the placement area

Before placing a Straw bed, make sure there’s enough room for it. Check that no blocks or entities are occupying the space where you want to place it. This can prevent the bed from being placed properly.

Wrapping up

Straw Beds are incredibly useful in Minecraft, especially when you’re exploring the world and don’t want to change your respawn point. You just need a total of 27 Wheat to make 4 Straw Beds, and they can also be found in Abandoned Camps. However, keep in mind that they’re single-ise utems can’t replace regular beds when setting up a permanent base.

FAQs

Does a straw bed set your spawn point?

A Straw Bed does not set or change your respawn point in Minecraft. You can sleep in it to skip the night or a thunderstorm while still retaining your original spawn point.

How many straw beds does one craft make?

One crafting recipe will give you 4 straw beds in Minecraft. You need 3 Hay Bales, which requires a total of 27 Wheat.

Can you reuse a straw bed?

You can’t reuse a straw bed. Once you wake up from the bed or leave early, it will automatically get destroyed.

Can you use a straw bed in the Nether?

A straw bed can’t be used in the Nether. If it’s placed in the Nether or the End, it will automatically get destroyed.

Can you craft a straw bed without a crafting table?

A Straw Bed can’t be crafted without the help of a crafting table in Minecraft. Its recipe requires a 3×3 crafting grid.

What’s the straw bed command?

You can obtain a Straw Bed by typing the following command: /give @p minecraft:straw_bed 1

title.rendered: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7: New calcite blocks, Flurry disc, and more

content.rendered:
We’re just weeks away from the Minecraft 26.4 Winter Update, and Mojang continues to share bits about what’s coming with the update through Snapshots. The developer has now dropped Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7, which introduces a new Calcite Block, the Flurry Music Disc, a secret block, and tons of quality-of-life improvements.

If you want to know everything about the update, here’s a complete breakdown of Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 and how you can download it.

What’s new in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7?

Is Snapshot 7 on Bedrock? Java vs. Bedrock comparison

Unfortunately, Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot is exclusive to the Java Edition. However, Bedrock players can try out the same upcoming features through Preview 26.70.23. Both builds bring the same features to the table, including the likes of the Calcite blocks and Flurry Music Disc. However, there are some differences between the two versions, in terms of available features and how players can access them.

All 12 new Calcite blocks and how to craft them

Snapshot 7 adds 12 Calcite building blocks across three families: Calcite, Polished Calcite, and Polished Calcite Bricks. Each family includes Pillars, Slabs, Stairs, and Walls.
You can craft the polished variants at a Crafting Table, then use a Stonecutter to make the different shapes.

Where to find the Flurry music disc

Another major addition that’s worth checking out in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 is the Flurry Music Disc. To get your hands on this disc, you’ll need to go explore Igloo basements and search through the chests for it.

If you don’t want to spend time searching for Igloos, you can use Minecraft commands to locate one instead. Simply enter /locate structure minecraft: igloo to find the nearest igloo and head there to check its chests. Keep in mind that not every Igloo generates with a basement. So, be prepared to explore several of them before eventually finding the Music Disc.

Freezing, Frostbite and Stray changes

The Freezing Effect has seen some changes with the latest update. Previously, wearing Leather Armor was the most effective way to protect yourself from freezing.

But with the new update, being on fire also counters it. As long as you’re burning, the Freezing Effect will no longer build up on you. This can come in handy when exploring snowy and cold biomes.

Another significant change affects how Frostbites and Strays spawn. Previously, Zombies and Skeletons exposed to cold environments could transform into Frostbites and Strays, respectively. With Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7, Zombies and Skeletons even wearing a single piece of Leather armor will no longer undergo this transformation.

Additionally, Strays are no longer restricted to Snowy Plains, Ice Spikes, and Frozen Rivers. They can now spawn in six additional biomes, which include:

  • Deep Frozen Ocean
  • Frozen Peaks
  • Frozen Ocean
  • Frozen River
  • Snowy Slopes
  • Jagged Peaks

Other changes: keyboard navigation, UI, and graphics testing

Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 also brings several quality-of-life changes. Mojang continues to focus on making the game more accessible, refining UI navigation, and testing different graphics settings. Here’s a breakdown of all the major changes included in the update:

1. Accessibility improvements

Keyboard navigation across various gameplay screens has been improved. Players can now navigate screens such as the Crafting Table, Loom, and Enchanting Table without completely relying on a mouse. For instance, pressing the Tab key allows you to switch between different groups of inventory slots. Similarly, Ctrl + Enter now functions like right-click. This should be quite useful when you’re crafting items and battling other players on the best Minecraft servers.

2. UI improvements

Snapshot 7 also brings several UI changes to make navigating menus easier. When you hover over entries in the list, such as worlds or friends, they will now be highlighted with a grey outline. Text fields also behave differently depending on whether you’re navigating them using the Tab key or arrow keys. Additionally, the mouse cursor will automatically disappear when you navigate the UI using a keyboard, alongside tons of other minor changes.

3. Graphics API testing

Mojang has also updated its graphics API testing settings. Choosing the Default option will now randomly switch between Vulkan and OpenGL every time the game is launched. The developers have been testing Vulkan in recent Snapshots, and OpenGL has received less testing. This change is meant to help the developers test both rendering systems following changes to the game’s rendering code. However, this is a temporary change and will be reverted in a future update.

What’s the mystery decorative block?

In Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot, Mojang has also introduced a mysterious decorative block that’s been added “somewhere” in the game. So, what exactly is it? Well, after playing the new snapshot, we found that the new block is called Chiseled Soulshale.

This block has a dull green appearance and can be found in Ancient Cities. You can also break it using any tool. Its true purpose beyond decoration still remains unknown, but players speculate that it could be connected to the portal leading to the Sift dimension.

How to play Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7

If you want to try out all the new features introduced in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7, you can easily download and install the experimental build through the Minecraft Launcher. Just follow these steps to get started:

  1. Open the Minecraft Launcher on your PC.
  2. Select the Installations tab.
  3. Enable the Snapshots option.
  4. Select New Installation and open the Version menu.
  5. Choose 26.4 Snapshot 7.
  6. Name the installation, select Create, and launch it from the Play tab.

When does Minecraft 26.4 release?

Minecraft 26.4 is planned for Q4 2026, but Mojang has not announced an exact release date. Snapshot 7 introduces what Mojang described as the final gameplay features for the upcoming game drop, but that does not confirm a launch date or mean testing is complete.

title.rendered: Nothing’s first AI-native product ships in December with no new screen

content.rendered:
Nothing’s first “AI-native” product ships next month, which means December 2026. CEO Carl Pei says it has no new screen. In an X post titled “Toolmakers,” published on November 4, he called it “a tool” that “couldn’t have been an app.” He gave no name, price, or specs.

Pei’s wording is narrower than “screen-free”

Pei only said “no new screen,” which leaves open whether the device has a display of any kind, and whether it uses the screen on your phone. Nothing hasn’t said either way.

The teaser image shows the NOTHING (R) wordmark, a COMING SOON label, and the rounded corner of a dark object. It doesn’t show what the object does. These details are still missing:

  • The product name
  • The price
  • The specs
  • The countries where it will sell
  • Whether it needs a phone to work

Pei’s essay argues AI proves itself at work first

The post is a long essay, and much of it is about AI at work. Pei writes that consumer demand for AI is small next to demand from knowledge work. He also says the missing piece is context: “context doesn’t live in a chat box. It lives in the tools you use and carry every day.” If the device follows that argument, it is built for work. Pei hasn’t said what it does.

A product that “couldn’t have been an app” probably needs new hardware

If the product couldn’t be an app, its main job probably depends on hardware an app can’t supply. Pei hasn’t described that hardware.

In the same essay, Pei lists what the industry is chasing: “the pendant, the pin, the glasses, the companion.” He calls looking for the iPhone of AI today “a dead end.” Apple reportedly put its camera-equipped AI pendant on hold in September. That pendant is the same AirTag-sized AI pin first reported in January, and it faces the same history: the Humane AI Pin was criticized and then discontinued in 2025.

Nothing already has tens of millions of devices out

Pei says “tens of millions of our devices” are already in people’s pockets and ears. Those include earbuds such as the Ear (2), which launched in March 2023. That gives the new product a large base of existing devices to reach.

An October rumor from leaker Roland Quandt said Nothing is planning two pairs of AI smart glasses, one without cameras. Nothing hasn’t confirmed that, and nothing in Pei’s post links it to the December product.

Wait for the name and price before you plan around it

Wait for the name, the price, and a list of what the product does. The official details so far come from Pei’s post, and it names none of those three. Until Nothing shares them, there is nothing concrete to compare it with.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Fortnite Treasure Chest rewards: Full list and schedule

content.rendered:
In Fortnite’s new One Piece-styled mini-season, titled Treasure Hunters, chests play a very pivotal role. Besides an entire POI featuring a giant chest and being literally named “The Chest,” their importance is consolidated by the fact that the chest pool items are essentially the replacement for loot hack items from Chapter 7 Season 4, aka Fortnite Override.

For those unaware, loot hacks in the previous season were a pool of special weapons or items that had a chance of spawning from chests. These loot hack items would change every other week, bringing a fresh pool of options. The new chest rewards pool in Treasure Hunters is more of the same but with a couple of key differences.

Unlike Fortnite Override’s loot hacks that needed to be unlocked using V-Bucks first and whose spawn rate could be boosted by spending more V-Bucks, Fortnite Treasure Hunters’ chest rewards need no unlocking and can’t be tweaked in terms of how often a particular reward appears. Moreover, instead of being refreshed every second week, the latter are scheduled to be rotated out and replaced with new items weekly.

Speaking of weekly rotation, you can check out which items are currently active in the rewards pool and which may get introduced next. Further below, you can peruse the schedule according to which these updates are planned to roll out.

Week 2 treasure chest rewards

Want Lil Uzi Vert’s other outfits and cosmetics? See the Fortnite x Lil Uzi Vert skins, bundles, and prices guide.

While the chest rewards for the successive weeks are not known in their entirety, it is expected that Week 3 will feature skins based on virtual singers, namely Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto. Additionally, Week 4 will revolve around an original Fortnite character named Oscar.

Fortnite Treasure Hunters rewards pool schedule

Reward pool items, obtained from chests in Battle Royale modes, are set to change four times by the end of Fortnite Treasure Hunters. However, there are a few items that have been leaked to be part of the pool for at least two weeks, if not for the whole season. These items are:

  • Pirate Shop Access 2026
  • Pirate Shop Access 2027
  • Portable Extractor
  • Extraction Accelerator
  • Sprite Locator
  • Lucky Locator
  • Golden Firework

Apart from the aforementioned, the other follow the weekly schedule as defined below.

How Treasure Chest rewards feature changes Fortnite

Treasure Hunters’ chest rewards offer a rotating selection of items without requiring players to unlock the pool or spend Sprite Dust to access it. That leaves players free to use Sprite Dust for other activities, such as restoring lost sprites before a match or purchasing a gizmo from an Extraction Site.

One of the most notable reported rewards is Pirate Shop Access, which could give players a way to obtain Item Shop cosmetics without spending V-Bucks. However, the draft does not establish whether this reward is guaranteed, how often it appears, or whether its drop rate can change. Check official announcements for any updates to its availability.

For another source of high-value loot, see the Fortnite Treasure Hunters vault locations; each vault contains three Rare Chests and a Sprite Chest.

FAQs

Are Treasure Chest rewards free?

Yes, treasure chest rewards are completely free.

Do my squadmates get the reward too?

It depends on what kind of reward you have earned. While common gizmos such as Portable Extractors aren’t shared among the squad, other extremely rare items such as the Pirate Shop token are given to all the squad players if even one of them gets his hands on it.

Are Pirate Shop items permanent?

Yes. Once you get an item from the Pirate Shop, it is added to your Locker permanently.

When do Treasure Chest rewards end?

These treasure chest rewards are refreshed weekly, except for some exceptional items that carry over. This pool will come to an end with the culmination of the Treasure Hunters mini-season on December 5.

title.rendered: Apple will check public iCloud links for harmful content in iOS 27.3

content.rendered:
Starting with iOS 27.3, Apple will check files shared with “Anyone with the link” for harmful content. Apple published the change on November 3, 2026. It covers iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS at version 27.3 or later. iOS 27.3 is still in beta, so this change is not in a public release yet. Apple released the first developer beta on November 3 and has said the public release is planned for December.

When you choose Share a Link for a photo in iCloud Photos or a file in iCloud Drive, you pick one of two audiences:

  • “People you choose” only lets people you invite or approve open the item.
  • “Anyone with the link” lets anyone who has the link open it, and Apple’s page says that includes Apple.

The new check applies to that second option. Apple’s page doesn’t say whether it also covers Send a Copy, and it describes no change to “People you choose.”

So the check covers any file you share with “Anyone with the link,” wherever you post that link.

Public links are outside end-to-end encryption, even with ADP on

With Advanced Data Protection turned on, most of your iCloud data is end-to-end encrypted. That means Apple doesn’t hold the keys, so only your devices can read the data.

Apple’s page says a shared item is no longer end-to-end encrypted when it can be accessed by Anyone with the Link. That holds even if the owner or participants have Advanced Data Protection turned on. A file you make public is the exception, and that’s the line I’d read twice before tapping Share a Link.

Flagged uploads can be removed and the account blocked

If you try to upload harmful content, Apple says it can move, refuse, modify, remove, or delete the content at any time. It can also block or disable your Apple Account, and block a new account with the same email address or phone number. Apple may involve law enforcement “if necessary.”

Apple’s page leaves out the details

Apple’s page doesn’t say:

  • How the check works, or whether a person reviews flagged items.
  • What counts as harmful content.
  • Whether you can turn the check off. The page describes no setting for it.
  • Which countries or regions get it. It says only that “Not all features are available in all countries or regions.”
  • Whether a Public Website link in Shared Albums is covered. The page doesn’t name Shared Albums.
  • Whether the iOS 27.3 beta includes the check.
  • How to appeal a flagged item.

The page says these items “will be checked by Apple for harmful content” and never says how. That is the gap I’d ask Apple about first.

Two checks before you share a link

Before you send an iCloud photo or file through a link:

  1. Choose “People you choose” for private files, such as family photos or documents with personal details.
  2. If you choose “Anyone with the link,” assume Apple can open the file, and from iOS 27.3, it will check the file for harmful content.

title.rendered: Apple now lets apps show an offer when you try to cancel a subscription

content.rendered:
Apps that sell auto-renewing subscriptions can now show you a message, a picture, or a special offer while you cancel. Apple announced the feature on November 4, and developers can set it up now in App Store Connect, the dashboard where they manage their apps.

The message appears during cancellation

Apple says the message shows up in the cancellation flow, the screens you see after you choose to cancel. Every message needs a header and body text. It can also include an image, one or more offers, or both.

Developers set up these messages for each auto-renewable subscription, which is a plan that renews on its own each billing period. Apple first showed the App Store Connect version at WWDC in June, though the Retention Messaging API itself has been available by request since last year. The App Store Connect part is open to all developers.

Only some subscribers see the offer

Subscribers see one of three versions of the message:

  • Text only
  • Text with an image
  • Text with an offer

The offer shows only to subscribers who qualify, and it takes the place of the image if the developer added one.

Developers set two rules for each offer. The first is how long a person must have held a paid subscription before they qualify. The second is an optional wait before the same person can use that offer again. A new subscriber may see no offer at all.

An offer can be a discount or a free period. Developers choose the offer type: pay as you go, pay up front, or free. A free period is easier to judge than a discount, since there is no price to compare.

Apple limits what the message can say

Each app can have up to 10 retention messages. One message can cover several subscriptions, but each subscription can have only one message at a time. Because of that, the 10-message cap is less of a limit for an app with many plans than it first sounds.

The message text can’t mention a price, a discount, or an offer. Every subscriber sees that text, whether or not they qualify. App Review rejects messages that mention pricing or offers, and messages go through App Review before they are published.

A server can choose the message for each person

Developers who run their own server can use the Retention Messaging API to pick a message for each subscriber, based on that person’s subscription details. The API can also offer a different plan in the same subscription group as an alternative to canceling. Apple says API access is available by request.

The server has to respond quickly, within 700 milliseconds in production. If it doesn’t, the App Store shows the developer’s default message instead. Developers must also pass a performance test before they use the API in production. I’d start with App Store Connect, because the API needs an access request and a performance test first.

Stopping a plan still uses the usual steps

The App Store tells you what happens if you go ahead with canceling. To stop a plan, follow the steps for canceling a subscription on your iPhone or iPad. To find every plan you pay for, check your subscriptions in Settings or the App Store.

If you were charged for a renewal you didn’t want, you can ask Apple for a refund. Apple says to expect an update within 24 to 48 hours, and refund eligibility varies by country or region.

What Apple hasn’t said yet

Apple’s developer post and its App Store Connect help page don’t list the iOS, iPadOS, or macOS versions that show the message. Apple’s Retention Messaging API documentation does: messages appear only on iOS 15.1 or later, iPadOS 15.1 or later, visionOS 1 or later, and macOS 14 or later.

Neither page lists storefronts where messages won’t appear, beyond letting developers choose the countries or regions for each offer, or says whether users can turn messages off. Neither gives a review time for messages.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Top 5 sword enchantments in Minecraft

content.rendered:
Planning to take down the Ender Dragon and explore the vast world of Minecraft? Well, you’re going to need a sword equipped with the best enchantments. Sword enchantments are a great way to boost your weapon’s damage and combat abilities, which makes it easier to beat down mobs, fight other players, and even farm XP.

They’re available in both Java and Bedrock editions and can prove to be game-changers when applied correctly. However, with 10 different enchantments available for swords, choosing the right one can be a bit confusing. So, to help you out, here’s a look at the top 5 sword enchantments in Minecraft that will help you create the ultimate weapon.

Top 5 sword enchantments in Minecraft at a glance

1. Sharpness

Whether you’re exploring a single-player world or battling other players on Minecraft servers, Sharpness is easily the best enchantment you can slap onto your sword. It increases the weapon’s overall attack damage, allowing you to take down hostile mobs and other players much faster.

The best part is that each level of Sharpness further boosts your sword’s damage, which makes it a great choice for any combat situation.

2. Looting

Looting is particularly useful for players who spend a lot of time exploring and farming mobs in Minecraft. This enchantment increases the chances of mobs dropping items when you take them down, as well as the quantity of certain drops.

So, if you’re hunting down Wither Skeletons, a sword with Looting can increase your odds of finding Wither Skeleton Skulls. It also increases the number of Ender Pearls you will be able to obtain from Endermen.

3. Fire Aspect

Fire Aspect sets your enemies ablaze whenever you hit them with your sword. The flames deal additional damage over time, which makes it easy to beat mobs and puts pressure on other players during combat.

This proves to be incredibly useful in PvP battles, where the continuous fire damage can disrupt your opponent’s attacks. Fire Aspect can also cook meat dropped by animals, which is another way to obtain food while on the go.

4. Unbreaking

Using your sword repeatedly will eventually wear down its durability and cause it to break. This is where Unbreaking comes in handy.

The enchantment reduces the chances of your weapon losing durability whenever you use it, which allows you to sustain yourself on the ground for much longer.

5. Mending

If you want to keep your sword in good condition, another enchantment worth considering is Mending. It collects all the XP you gain from defeating mobs, mining, and other activities to repair your weapon’s durability.

This means you can restore your sword simply by collecting experience orbs instead of spending additional resources on repairs or crafting a replacement. Pair Mending with Unbreaking, and you’ll have a Sword that outlasts everything.

Mending helps repair your sword, but Curse of Vanishing can still make it disappear when you die. Learn what Curse of Vanishing does and how to keep your items.

Best sword enchantment combinations in Minecraft

If you’re looking to build the ultimate sword in Minecraft, adding the enchantments we’ve mentioned above won’t cut it. You need the right combination of enchantments that complement each other and improve your weapon’s performance. After spending countless hours exploring the game and studying different enchantments, we’ve put together the best combinations to help you dominate every PvE and PvP encounter.

1. All-Rounder

  • Sharpness V
  • Unbreaking III
  • Mending
  • Fire Aspect II
  • Sweeping Edge III
  • Looting III
  • Knockback II

2. Mob Farming

  • Sweeping Edge III
  • Looting III
  • Sharpness V
  • Mending
  • Unbreaking III

3. PvP Fighting

  • Fire Aspect II
  • Sharpness V
  • Unbreaking III
  • Knockback II
  • Mending

How to enchant a sword in Minecraft

Now that you know which sword enchantments are worth using in Minecraft, it’s time to put them to work. However, how exactly do you enchant your weapon? Well, gamers, there are two different ways to go about it, and each of them has its own requirements and process.

1. Enchanting Table

  1. Craft an Enchanting Table with 4x Obsidian, 2x Diamonds, and 1 Book.
  2. Place the Enchanting Table and surround it with up to 15 Bookshelves.
  3. Farm enough XP levels and obtain lapis lazuli.
  4. Place your sword in the Enchanting Table and choose the available option.

2. Anvil

  1. Craft an Anvil with 3x Iron Blocks and 4x Iron Ingots.
  2. Trade with Librarian villagers or find loot chests to obtain enchanted books.
  3. Place your sword in the Anvil slot.
  4. Put down the enchanted book in the Anvil.
  5. Spend XP levels to apply the enchantment.

If you’ve enabled cheats in your Minecraft world, you can also use specific commands to apply enchantments directly to your sword. Keep in mind that Minecraft Bedrock Edition only supports six sword enchantments, whereas Java Edition lets you apply seven.

Wrapping up!

Enchanting your sword becomes increasingly important as you progress through Minecraft, deal with tougher enemies and take on bigger challenges like defeating the Ender Dragon. The right enchantment combination depends on how you plan to use your weapon, but Sharpness V is a must-have for anyone.

You can upgrade your weapon with the help of an Enchanting Table or an Anvil, depending on the enchantments you want to apply.

FAQs

What is the strongest sword enchantment in Minecraft?

Sharpness V is considered to be the best all-around sword enchantment in Minecraft as it increases your weapon’s attack damage. This makes it useful against all mobs and other players.

Can you put Sharpness and Smite on the same sword?

No, you cannot apply both Sharpness and Smite to the same sword in Minecraft, as they’re mutually exclusive.

What is the maximum enchantment level for a sword?

The maximum enchantment level for a sword depends on the enchantment itself. For instance, Sharpness can go up to Level V, but Fire Aspect maxes out at Level II.

Is Sweeping Edge available in Minecraft Bedrock?

Sweeping Edge is only available in Minecraft Java Edition and can’t be obtained in the Bedrock Edition.

What is the best enchantment combination for a Netherite sword?

The best enchantment combination for a Netherite sword in Minecraft is Fire Aspect II, Unbreaking III, Looting III, Sharpness V and Mending.

mainEntity.name: When do Treasure Chest rewards end?

acceptedAnswer.text: These treasure chest rewards are refreshed weekly, except for some exceptional items that carry over. This pool will come to an end with the culmination of the Treasure Hunters mini-season on December 5.

mainEntity.name: Can you put Sharpness and Smite on the same sword?

title.rendered: How to get Elytra in Minecraft

content.rendered:
There’s no shortage of ways to travel in Minecraft, but one item you’ll want to get your hands on as soon as possible is the Elytra. What’s this? Well, the Elytra is a utility item that allows you to glide through the air. You can equip it in your chestplate slot through your inventory.

However, obtaining one isn’t as simple as killing mobs or searching through chests. You’ll need to take out the Ender Dragon and travel further into the End dimension. If you’re confused, here’s a complete guide on how to get Elytra in Minecraft and how you can use it to its maximum potential.

Elytra in Minecraft at a glance

How to get Elytra in Minecraft

Before we begin, it’s worth noting that the Elytra is an end-game item in Minecraft. This means that you’ll need to unlock access to the End dimension and defeat the Ender Dragon before you can start looking for it.

Once you’ve completed these requirements, follow the steps below to obtain the Elytra:

  1. Find yourself a Stronghold and activate the End Portal.
  2. Defeat the Ender Dragon if you still haven’t done so.
  3. Locate the End Gateway portal and throw an Ender Pearl to enter it.
  4. In the End Cities, search for an End Ship, which can be identified by its purple colour.
  5. Enter the End Ship and look for the Elytra inside an item frame.
  6. Break the frame to collect the Elytra.

While you’re exploring End Cities, you will also encounter Shulkers. Be careful around these hostile mobs, as their levitation attacks make them quite dangerous. If you’d rather skip the grind of defeating the Ender Dragon and exploring the End, you can make use of Minecraft commands to switch your game mode to Creative and obtain Elytra directly in your inventory.

How to use Elytra in Minecraft

Now that you’ve obtained the Elytra in Minecraft, the next step is learning how to use it. To begin with, equip the item in your chestplate slot. Once it’s equipped, there are a few ways you can take to the skies and make the most of the Elytra:

1. Glide from a high place

The simple way to use the Elytra is by jumping off a high location, such as a cliff or tower you’ve built. Once you are airborne, hit the jump button again to activate the Elytra and begin gliding. However, keep in mind that you won’t be able to gain altitude on your own, and you’ll gradually lose height. This method is useful for exploring nearby areas, scouting for resources, or escaping hostile mobs.

2. Use Firework Rockets

Firework Rockets are one of the best ways to boost your Elytra’s speed and keep yourself in the air for longer. You can craft them using 1x Paper and 1-3 pieces of Gunpowder. Using more Gunpowder will increase the rocket’s flight duration.

Once you have crafted your rockets, equip them in your hotbar and follow these steps:

  1. Jump off a high location and hold the jump button to activate your Elytra.
  2. Equip Firework Rockets in your hand.
  3. While gliding, use a rocket to launch yourself forward and increase your speed.
  4. Adjust your direction to maintain your momentum or gain some altitude.

3. Use a Trident with Riptide

Another way to launch yourself in the air using Elytra is with a Trident enchanted with Riptide. This enchantment allows you to push yourself forward when using the Trident in water or during rainy weather. When combined with the Elytra, it can help you travel through the air if you don’t have Firework Rockets.

How to repair Elytra in Minecraft

The Elytra is useful for travelling across the Minecraft world, but it isn’t indestructible. Its durability gradually decreases as you use it for gliding, and you’ll eventually need to repair it to keep using it. Since finding another Elytra requires travelling back to the End and exploring End Cities, repairing your existing one is a much better option.

There are two ways to repair an Elytra in Minecraft:

1. Phantom Membranes

  1. Phantoms spawn at night when you haven’t slept for three in-game days. Defeat them and collect Phantom Membranes.
  2. Craft an Anvil and place it down.
  3. Open the Anvil interface and place your damaged Elytra in the first slot and Phantom Membranes in the second.
  4. Spend the required XP levels and collect your repaired Elytra.

2. Combine two damaged Elytra pieces

  1. Place an Anvil and open its interface.
  2. Place your damaged Elytra in the first slot.
  3. Add another damaged Elytra in the second slot.
  4. Spend XP levels and collect the Elytra.

Wrapping up!

Elytra is one of the most useful transportation items in Minecraft as it allows you to glide through the world once equipped in your chestplate slot. However, obtaining it requires you to defeat the Ender Dragon and explore the End Islands in search of End Ships. You can also use the Firework Rockets to gain speed while gliding or use a Trident to push yourself forward.

FAQs

Can you craft Elytra in Minecraft?

You can’t craft Elytra in Minecraft with a Crafting Table or any other station. The only way to obtain them in Survival Mode is by defeating the Ender Dragon and then exploring the End Cities for End Ships.

Can you find Elytra without defeating the Ender Dragon?

Beating the Ender Dragon is necessary to obtain the Elytra in normal survival gameplay. This is because defeating the dragon activates the End Gateway, which provides access to End Cities.

How many Elytra can you find in one End City?

You can find one Elytra on every End Ship. However, some End Cities might not have an End Ship, which means you won’t find an Elytra there at all.

Can you use Elytra and a chestplate together?

You can’t equip an Elytra and a chestplate at the same time in Minecraft. Both items use the same chestplace slot in your inventory, so equipping one replaces the other.

title.rendered: How to get the Pirate Shop token in Fortnite and unlock items for free

content.rendered:
Fortnite Treasure Hunters has introduced a valuable new item called Pirate Shop Access, aka the Pirate Shop token. This extremely rare collectible, upon activation, grants the player access to the Pirate Shop, which is basically the Item Shop but with every item that would normally cost V-Bucks made completely free for a limited time.

Throughout this One Piece-themed mini-season, players have a chance of getting the Pirate Shop token from chests scattered throughout the Battle Royale map. That’s because it is one of the chest reward pool items currently active in Fortnite. However, given its rarity, very few players are publicly known to have found it so far.

Fortnite Pirate Shop token explained

Pirate Shop Access gives players a 14-day window to claim eligible items from the Item Shop. Items claimed during this period remain in your Locker after the access expires.

The reward has two activation windows: one for 2026 and another for 2027. The 2026 activation must be used by December 15, 2026, while the 2027 activation can be used between January 1 and December 15, 2027. Each activation lasts 14 days from the time you start it.

The reward does not cover real-money offers, gifting, or Battle Pass rewards. You can also claim only one Sidekick that you do not already own. Pirate Shop Access is tied to your Fortnite account and cannot be transferred.

Eligible Item Shop categories may include:

  • Skins
  • Back blings
  • Pickaxes
  • Gliders
  • Emotes
  • Sidekicks (only one purchase per sidekick)
  • Jam tracks
  • Wraps
  • Instruments
  • Kicks
  • Loading screens
  • Bundles
  • Packs
  • Trails
  • Cars

The available items depend on what appears in the Item Shop during your access period.

Pirate Shop Access is a limited-time reward associated with the Treasure Hunters mini-season, which is expected to end on December 5, 2026. The token’s reported availability and activation deadlines are separate, so check the in-game message for the exact dates on your account.

How to find and use the Pirate Shop token in Fortnite

Since this particular reward has among the lowest drop rates in the game, you must focus on trimming down the odds. To do so, it’s best to enter Battle Royale modes as a squad because, even if any one player stumbles upon the Pirate Shop token, the rest of the squad also gets the resulting benefit.

On top of that, since this item is unlocked from opening chests, you can double down on your hunt for the same by ransacking through the usual hotspots. According to Fortnite.gg‘s data, depicted in the image below, the POIs where you are likely to find a high concentration of chests are Rubber Resort, Arlong Park, The $.$. Rocky, Lantern Landing, Loot Lagoon, and Fortune’s Fort.

While you scour the map for chests, don’t ignore the Wanted Posters or Vault Keys if you come across them. That’s because these two items lead you to high-tier chests, which also have a chance of providing Pirate Shop Access. While a Wanted Poster leads to one buried chest, Vault Keys lead to a locked room filled with around three to five special chests. Want to find buried chests around the map? See all buried chest locations in Fortnite Treasure Hunters.

Upon nabbing the Pirate Shop token during a match, you will be prompted to claim the same as soon as it’s over. Once that’s out of the way, you can head straight to the Shop tab and activate the Pirate Shop Access by using the button shown in the bottom-right corner of your screen and then confirming your decision.

The following X post below by snowshoe, who is among the first Fortnite players publicly known to have bagged the Pirate Shop token, shows the final activation step and how the Item Shop listings change after that.

HERE IT IS YALL!! ITS ALLLLL OF THE SHOP FR IM SO HAPPY 🥹😭 https://t.co/qo3hzhEL0D

— snow (@snowslept) November 1, 2026

About Fortnite Pirate Shop Access hacks and mods

There’s no doubt that the Pirate Shop token is among the most sought-after items in Fortnite right now, if not simply the most. In the past, the game has offered free cosmetics and items through in-game cup events and quests, whereas certain product purchases have also come with bundled freebies. However, getting almost unlimited free access to all the Shop items for a two-week period is unprecedented, and hence it has also given birth to a variety of scams in its wake.

There are multiple reports of Fortnite accounts being sold and of players relying on tools to significantly facilitate the process. However, as announced by the game’s official account, such “fake” tools and account sales are basically a “scam.” So, even if you are very to get your hands on the Pirate Shop token, it is best to use the aforementioned strategy instead of being lured by shady sellers and dubious tools, as the latter also carries a risk of your Fortnite account getting a permanent ban.

FAQs

Can you get the Pirate Shop token from any chest?

Players have reported finding Pirate Shop Access in chests during Battle Royale. Epic has not publicly confirmed the full drop rules or the odds, so no specific chest type or location is guaranteed to contain it.

Does Pirate Shop Access make every Item Shop item free?

It lets you claim eligible items that normally cost V-Bucks during the 14-day activation period. Real-money offers, gifting, and Battle Pass rewards are excluded, and the Sidekick restriction applies.

Can you transfer Pirate Shop Access to another Fortnite account?

No. The reward is tied to the account that receives it and cannot be transferred.

title.rendered: OpenAI says ChatGPT search is about one-fifth of Google’s volume

content.rendered:
OpenAI says ChatGPT now handles about one-fifth as many search-style queries as Google. ChatGPT consumer product lead Adam Fry shared the figure at an OpenAI-hosted dinner in New York on November 2. That’s a big claim, but OpenAI hasn’t shared the data behind it. So for now, the 20% figure comes only from OpenAI itself.

OpenAI’s idea of a “search” is broad and unclear

According to OpenAI, a search is anything people used to look up on a search engine but now ask ChatGPT instead. OpenAI says people first used ChatGPT mostly for help with writing and coding. Now they also use it to look up information about people, places, and things.

OpenAI has said that every question that triggers a web search counts as one search. So if you send 20 prompts in one conversation and each one searches the web, that’s 20 searches, not one. What OpenAI hasn’t explained is how it decides which prompts count as “search-like” in the first place. The answer could change the total a lot.

We don’t know which Google number OpenAI used

OpenAI also hasn’t said which Google figure it compared against, what time period it covers, or which countries are included.

The latest public number from Google is a bit dated. In March 2025, Google said it handles more than 5 trillion searches a year, based on data from January 2025.

Outside estimates are much lower

Other estimates put ChatGPT well below 20%. In February, SEO software company Ahrefs estimated that ChatGPT gets about 12% of Google’s search volume.

However, Ahrefs only counted the kinds of searches people have traditionally done on Google. Since it measured things differently from OpenAI, you can’t compare the two numbers directly. Still, the gap between 12% and 20% shows how much the result depends on what you count as a search.

Ads are live, and Safari support is still a plan

ChatGPT started showing ads to Free and Go users in the U.S. in February, and as of October 21, ads are live in 89 countries. Ads don’t appear in conversations about health, mental health, or politics. Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education subscribers don’t see ads at all.

OpenAI says its ads business passed $1 billion in annualized revenue within 200 days and that more than 100,000 advertisers have used it. But it hasn’t said how many free users see these ads or how much advertisers pay, so it’s hard to tell how big this business really is.

Apple, meanwhile, plans to let AI search engines such as ChatGPT into Safari. But during the Google antitrust case, Apple’s Eddy Cue testified that AI search engines probably won’t become Safari’s default option.

Google can also keep paying Apple to stay the default search engine. A 2025 ruling allows these deals as long as they aren’t exclusive and last no more than one year.

The bottom line

The 20% figure is interesting, but it can’t be checked yet. Until OpenAI shares which Google number it used and how it decides what counts as a search, it’s best to treat it as OpenAI’s own claim rather than an independent measurement.

title.rendered: Apple Music’s Selfie Sing records you singing, but only in iOS 27.3 beta

content.rendered:
Apple Music is getting a new feature called Selfie Sing, which records a video of you singing along to a song. Right now, the front-camera recording only works in the iOS 27.3 beta, so you won’t find it on iPhones running the regular public software yet.

The feature was first spotted by @aaronp613, who shared it in this X post on November 4:

Here is your first look at Selfie Sing, new in iOS 27.3, inside of Apple Music Record a video selfie, adjusting vocals to make it yours, and share your performance with friends (Animoji is not available for this feature, I used it so I don’t have to post a video of me singing) https://t.co/fLQ3B5DV4N

— Aaron (@aaronp613) November 4, 2026

Selfie Sing looks like an add-on to Apple Music Sing, the existing karaoke mode that shows lyrics on screen and lets you turn the singer’s vocals up or down. What’s new is a front-camera view that records you while the lyrics play on screen.

How it works: pick a song and start recording

Selfie Sing comes with its own playlist. Choose a song, tap the camera icon, and then tap the red button to start recording. The lyrics scroll on screen as you sing, and your video is recorded along with them.

Add effects after you finish

Once the song is over, you can adjust how loud your voice is or add one of four effects: Megaphone, Echo, Concert Hall, or Studio. After that, you can save the video to Photos or share it. And don’t worry if you’re not a great singer. Apple’s playlist description says you don’t need to be pitch-perfect.

Only a few songs support it for now

The recording option isn’t available on every song yet. The Selfie Sing playlist currently includes:

  • “Respect” by Aretha Franklin
  • “Girls Just Wanna Have Fun” by Cyndi Lauper
  • “Like a Virgin” by Madonna
  • “Wonderwall” by Oasis
  • “Hungry Like the Wolf” by Duran Duran
  • “…Baby One More Time” by Britney Spears

More songs may be added later, but Apple hasn’t confirmed that.

What Apple says about Sing (and what it doesn’t)

Apple Music Sing requires an Apple Music subscription. Our Apple Music tips guide for iPhone explains how Sing’s karaoke mode works, but it was written for iOS 26, so some steps may look different on iOS 27.

According to Apple’s Sing help page, the feature works on iPhone 11 or later, iPhone SE (3rd generation), several iPad models, and Apple TV 4K (3rd generation or later). The page also says that if you don’t see the Mic button on a supported device, Sing may not be available for that particular song. However, it says nothing about video recording, so it’s not yet clear which devices will support Selfie Sing.

iOS 27 also brought expanded lyrics translation and pronunciation to Apple Music.

What we still don’t know

Apple hasn’t announced when Selfie Sing will be released. It’s also unclear:

  • Whether the camera option will come to iPad, Mac, or Apple TV
  • Which countries will get it
  • Whether it will need an Apple Music subscription, like Sing does

AppleInsider reports that the camera option didn’t appear on an iPad Pro running iPadOS 27.3 in its testing, and it expects iOS 27.3 to reach the public in December.

How to try it right now

The Selfie Sing playlist already shows up on iOS 27.2, but the camera option doesn’t. To actually record a video, you’ll need the iOS 27.3 developer beta, and Apple hasn’t confirmed a public beta for it yet.

If you don’t want to run beta software, wait for the public release. Once it’s out, open the Apple Music app, search for the Selfie Sing playlist, pick a song, and look for the camera icon.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: iOS 27.3 beta is out with the Health app back and Siri AI in more apps

content.rendered:
Apple released the first iOS 27.3 beta to developers on November 3, 2026 (build 24C5037i). Apple’s developer post confirms the release and asks developers to build and test their apps with Xcode 27.3.

Here’s what’s new and what you should know before you install it.

Siri AI can do more, but with daily limits

Siri AI now works across many more of Apple’s own apps. According to Apple’s Siri AI developer post, the new actions cover Calendar, Files, Finder, Journal, Mail, Maps, Messages, Music, Notes, Photos, Preview, Reminders, Safari, Shortcuts, and Weather. For example, you can ask Siri to find a coffee shop you visited last week, or to archive files you haven’t opened in over a year.

The beta also adds two Mail actions: one unsubscribes you from mailing lists, and the other undoes a sent message. Apple hasn’t mentioned these in its posts, so they may not make it to the final release.

There’s a catch, though. A footnote from Apple says Siri AI and other server-based features come with daily usage limits, and that expanded access will be a paid option later. Apple hasn’t said what those limits are or what the upgrade will cost.

In this beta, Siri AI supports English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish, and now adds Traditional Chinese, Norwegian, Turkish, and Vietnamese, the four languages Apple had said were coming by the end of the year. That brings the total to 10 languages. Siri AI is also not available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, or watchOS.

The redesigned Health app is back, but Health Age needs an Apple Watch

The redesigned Health app is available in the iOS 27.3 developer beta starting today, and Apple says it will reach everyone as a free update later this year. It also supports more languages this time, not just U.S. English.

The redesign is built around three main sections:

  • Insights gives you a daily summary based on your Activity Rings, heart rate, sleep, and vitals.
  • Longevity tracks seven areas of your health, from heart health to hearing.
  • Health Age compares your health data with your actual age. It uses Apple Watch readings such as VO2 max, resting heart rate, sleep, and heart rate variability.

Because Health Age relies on Watch data, Apple confirms it requires an Apple Watch. If you only have an iPhone, you won’t get this score. The redesigned app as a whole also needs an iPhone or iPad that supports Apple Intelligence.

Apple has also added movement checks you can do at home using your iPhone camera and Apple Watch. Apple says the video is processed on your device and is never recorded, stored, or shared.

This isn’t the first time we’ve seen the new Health app. Apple first added it in iOS 27.2 beta 1, removed it in beta 4, and then shipped iOS 27.2 without it. Since beta features can be pulled again, it’s best not to count on the new Health app until it actually ships.

Apple Intelligence comes to China in December

In a Chinese-language newsroom post dated October 31, Apple said Apple Intelligence features would open for testing in China on November 4 with the latest iOS developer beta. Regular users in China will get them when iOS 27.3 launches in December.

The first batch of features includes Live Translation, Clean Up, Writing Tools, Visual Intelligence, and Genmoji. Siri AI is not part of this launch.

To use these features, you’ll need one of these iPhones:

  • iPhone 16 or later
  • iPhone Duo
  • iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max
  • iPhone Air

Your device language and Siri language also need to be set to English or Simplified Chinese.

In China, parts of Siri, Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence are powered by Alibaba’s Qwen model. To learn more about why Siri AI is missing, read Apple Intelligence in China without Siri AI.

Other changes in the beta

The beta also brings several smaller updates:

  • Safari: You can now use vertical tabs (turn them on in Safari settings). There’s also a new Adaptive Dark Mode that darkens websites that don’t have their own dark theme.
  • StandBy: StandBy features that started on the iPhone Duo are now available on every iPhone running iOS 27, along with more clock face options.
  • Fitness+: A new Gym Strength program creates a four-week workout plan based on your goals, experience, schedule, and available equipment.
  • Apple Watch: Live Rewind and Siri Recap need iOS 27.3 on your paired iPhone. You can turn them on in the Watch app.
  • Control Center: The VPN toggle now lets you switch between different VPNs.
  • Other changes in the beta: Apple has also announced that iOS 27.3 will check public iCloud links for harmful content. It hasn’t said whether the check is included in the current beta or whether it covers Shared Album links.

Changes for iPhone Duo owners and developers

If you have an iPhone Duo, you can now swipe in from the left or right edge of the outer display to bring content down within reach of your thumb. To turn it on, go to Settings > Accessibility > Touch.

The bigger news is for app developers. Through a new Developer Preview, any developer can now connect their app to Siri AI using App Intents. Apple says these apps will reach users “in a few months,” and App Store submissions will open in the spring.

Only the developer beta is out for now

If you want to try it, open Settings > General > Software Update. Under Beta Updates, choose iOS 27 Developer Beta. Apple hasn’t announced a public beta yet. For the full walkthrough, see how to install the iOS 27 developer beta on iPhone.

author.description: I’ve been writing about tech for over 5 years, with 1000+ articles published so far. From iPhones and MacBooks to Android phones and AI tools, I’ve always enjoyed turning complicated features into simple, jargon-free guides. Recently, I switched sides and joined the Apple camp. Whether you want to try out new features, catch up on the latest news, or tweak your Apple devices, I’m here to help you get the most out of your tech.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio: With over 5 years of hands-on tech writing experience and more than 900 published articles, I’ve explored the best of Apple, Android, and Chrome OS. From iPhones and MacBooks to Pixel devices and Chromebooks, I break down complex features into simple, relatable guides—minus the jargon. Whether you’re customizing your iPhone, troubleshooting your Android, or tweaking Chrome OS settings, my goal is to help you get more out of your tech.

title.rendered: How to fix Wi-Fi problems on a Mac: 10 easy solutions

content.rendered:
It’s frustrating to experience Wi-Fi issues on your Mac when you’re trying to stay productive or enjoy a seamless online experience. From slow connections to frequent dropouts, Wi-Fi problems can occur for a variety of reasons.

Sometimes, it may happen after updating macOS. Or, there may be other causes, such as network setting errors or software glitches.

Fortunately, there are several troubleshooting steps you can take to restore your Mac’s Wi-Fi to full functionality. In this article, we’ll look at how to fix Wi-Fi problems on any Mac, including Macs running macOS 27, macOS Tahoe, or macOS Sequoia. Menu names change a little between versions, so if a label looks different on your Mac, look for the closest match in the same settings pane.

But first, let’s check a few things to make sure the issue is actually with macOS and not the Wi-Fi network itself.

  • If you’re experiencing a problem with a specific app such as Slack or WhatsApp, check if Wi-Fi is working in other apps.
  • Check if the Wi-Fi network works on other devices connected to it, such as your iPhone or iPad.

If you’re experiencing Wi-Fi issues across multiple apps on your Mac and the network is working fine on other devices, proceed with the steps below to fix Wi-Fi issues on your Mac.

Before you start: Check whether the problem is your Mac or the network

First, check whether other devices can use the same Wi-Fi network.

  • If your iPhone or another device also cannot get online, the issue may be with the router or internet service.
  • If other devices work but your Mac does not, focus on your Mac’s Wi-Fi connection and settings.
  • If only one app or website fails, check that app or website before changing your Mac’s network settings.

How to fix Wi-Fi issues on a Mac

Start with step 1 and work down the list. Check Wi-Fi after each step, and move on only if the problem is still there.

1. Restart your router

One of the first things you should try to resolve Wi-Fi issues is to restart the router. To do so, turn off the router and disconnect it from its power supply. Wait for at least thirty seconds, and then plug it back in and power it on. Connect your Mac to the network and check if Wi-Fi works now.

Also make sure that:

  • The router is not overheating. Ensure that it hasn’t been covered or placed at a location where there isn’t much ventilation.
  • The router is not placed on or near any large metal surfaces. For instance, if it’s placed on a filing cabinet or near the radiator, it may not work correctly.

2. Turn off Wi-Fi and then turn it back on

This might seem simple, but it often works to fix any temporary glitches.

  1. On your Mac’s menu bar, click the Wi-Fi icon. If it’s not there, click Control Center and then the arrow next to Wi-Fi.
  2. Toggle off Wi-Fi, wait for a few seconds, and then toggle it on again.

Check if this fixes the Wi-Fi issues you were facing.

3. Restart your Mac

Restarting any device can often fix a lot of issues. This works for Wi-Fi issues on your Mac too.

  1. Open the Apple menu.
  2. Select Restart.
  3. After your Mac starts again, reconnect to Wi-Fi and test it.

Once your Mac turns on again, check if Wi-Fi is working.

4. Install the latest macOS update

macOS updates sometimes fix Wi-Fi bugs, and sometimes an update causes them. If your problem started after an update, check for a newer one.

  1. Open the Apple menu and choose System Settings.
  2. Select General, then Software Update.
  3. Install any available update, if appropriate.
  4. Test Wi-Fi again.

5. Forget the network and reconnect your Mac to it

Follow the steps below to reconfigure the Wi-Fi network on your Mac. Forgetting a network also deletes its saved password, so have the password ready.

  1. Open System Settings and select Wi-Fi.
  2. Find the saved network or the list of known networks. Depending on your macOS version, you may need to select Details or Advanced.
  3. Choose the option to forget or remove the network.
  4. Return to the Wi-Fi list and select your network.

If you only want to stop your Mac from joining the network automatically, turn off Auto-Join for it instead. The password stays saved. If the drops start only after your Mac wakes from sleep, read how to fix Mac disconnecting from Wi-Fi after sleep.

If you only want your Mac to stop joining the network automatically, turn off Auto-Join for that network instead of forgetting it.

6. Change DNS servers

DNS is what your Mac uses to translate domain names into IP addresses when you’re browsing the web. Changing DNS servers can help fix Wi-Fi issues when Wi-Fi shows as connected, but websites won’t load. It won’t fix a network that won’t connect at all. Follow the steps below:

  1. Click the Apple menu and open System Settings.
  2. Click Network, then click Wi-Fi and choose Details next to the network you’re connected to.
  3. From the left side, select DNS.
  1. Click the ‘+‘ symbol under DNS Servers.
  2. Type in the following IP address: 8.8.8.8.
  1. Press the Return key on your keyboard.
  2. Click ‘+‘ again to add a secondary DNS server.
  3. Type in 8.8.4.4 and press Return.
  4. Close System Settings and check if Wi-Fi works for you now.

8.8.8.8 and 8.8.4.4 are Google’s public DNS servers. To go back to your original setup, remove both entries.

7. Check the firewall

In rare cases, the built-in firewall or third-party firewall software might disrupt your Wi-Fi connection. The built-in firewall mainly blocks incoming connections, so check it after the simpler steps above. Follow the steps below to test with it turned off.

  1. Click the Apple menu and open System Settings.
  2. Click Network and select Firewall.
  1. Toggle off the Firewall, then test your Wi-Fi.
  1. Turn the Firewall back on when you’re done testing.

If you use a third-party firewall, turn it off for the test too.

8. Check third-party apps

Many third-party apps like VPNs, parental control, or antivirus software can cause Wi-Fi issues on your Mac, especially after you update macOS.

Therefore, if none of the steps given above have fixed your Wi-Fi issues, try to disable or uninstall any third-party apps that could be causing the problem.

9. Run Wireless Diagnostics

If you continue to face Wi-Fi issues on your Mac, you can run Wireless Diagnostics to help identify the problem. Use it when Wi-Fi connects, but webpages, email, or streaming still fail. Here’s how:

  1. Close all open apps.
  2. Try to connect to the Wi-Fi network if you aren’t already connected.
  3. Press and hold the Option key on the keyboard and click the Wi-Fi icon in the menu bar.
  4. Click on Open Wireless Diagnostics.
  1. Follow the onscreen instructions to analyze your network connection.

Your Mac will analyze any Wi-Fi issues, and you can click the Info buttons in the Summary pane to learn more about each item listed.

Wireless Diagnostics doesn’t change your network settings. It can also save a report that your internet provider or IT support can use.

10. Contact your internet provider or Apple Support

If several devices cannot connect, contact your internet provider or the person who manages the network.

If other devices work normally but your Mac still cannot connect after these steps, contact Apple Support. Persistent problems may require more detailed troubleshooting.

Final thoughts

Most Mac Wi-Fi problems can be narrowed down by checking the network, restarting your router and Mac, and reviewing a few connection settings. Try the simplest fixes first, then move on to more advanced steps only if the issue continues.

If your Mac still cannot connect while other devices work normally, run Wireless Diagnostics to gather more information. You can also contact Apple Support for help identifying whether the problem is related to your Mac or its network settings.

FAQs

Why is my Mac connected to Wi-Fi but there’s no internet?

Your Mac has joined the network, but internet traffic isn’t getting through. Check whether an iPhone or another device can get online on the same Wi-Fi. If none can, restart the router or check with your internet provider. If only your Mac fails, restart it, then try the DNS steps above. A duplicate IP address can also block internet access.

Why does my Mac keep disconnecting from Wi-Fi?

When the Mac and Wi-Fi router are placed at a distance, signal strength is low. As a result, your Mac may often drop the connection. Similarly, such issues may occur if you have not restarted your router or your Mac in a long time. Move closer to your router and restart both your router and your Mac to help fix the issue. If the drops continue, forget the network and reconnect to it, as shown in step 5.

Why won’t Wi-Fi turn on on my Mac?

Check the Wi-Fi icon in the menu bar or in Control Center, and make sure Wi-Fi is turned on. Then restart your Mac. If Wi-Fi still won’t turn on, contact Apple Support, since the Wi-Fi hardware may need a repair.

How do I run Wireless Diagnostics on my Mac?

Quit all open apps first. Then, try connecting to a Wi-Fi network if you aren’t already connected. Next, press and hold the Option key and click the Wi-Fi icon in the menu bar. Finally, click Open Wireless Diagnostics and follow the on-screen instructions.

title.rendered: iPad mini 2026 vs iPad mini 2024: What’s changed and should you upgrade?

content.rendered:
After a two-year gap, Apple has released a new version of the iPad mini. The 2026 model brings some notable changes over the previous generation, including a faster A20 Pro chip, an 8.5-inch OLED display, a thinner, lighter design, and IP67 water resistance.

But there’s a catch! The new iPad mini costs $200 more than the 2024 model’s launch price. So, is it worth paying more for the OLED display and faster processor, or does the A17 Pro iPad mini still offer better value? Let’s compare the iPad mini 2026 vs iPad mini 2024 to see what’s genuinely new and which one makes more sense to buy.

iPad mini (A20 Pro) vs iPad mini (A17 Pro): Quick specs comparison

The biggest differences between the two generations are the OLED display, A20 Pro chip, thinner body, water resistance, and updated wireless connectivity.

Apple has improved almost every major hardware component, but it hasn’t increased advertised battery life or changed the storage options. The price has also increased considerably, making the 2026 model a more premium purchase.

OLED display vs LCD: How much better is the new iPad mini’s screen?

The display is the biggest reason I’d consider buying the 2026 iPad mini. Apple has finally replaced the LCD panel with OLED, a long-requested feature of compact iPad users.

The 2024 iPad mini features an 8.3-inch Liquid Retina LCD with a resolution of 2266 × 1488 pixels and 500 nits of brightness. The 2026 model gets a slightly larger 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR OLED panel with a resolution of 2316 × 1512 pixels.

Here’s what the upgrade brings:

  • Deeper blacks: OLED pixels can turn off individually, producing deeper blacks and better contrast.
  • Better contrast: The new display offers a 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio.
  • Higher brightness: It reaches 600 nits for SDR and up to 1,200 nits peak HDR brightness.
  • Larger viewing area: The display grows from 8.3 inches to 8.5 inches, with thinner bezels.
  • Nano-texture option: Selected 256GB and 512GB configurations offer optional nano-texture glass to reduce reflections.

For someone who regularly watches movies, reads ebooks, or edits photos, the OLED panel should make a noticeable difference.

However, there’s one disappointment: the new iPad mini still doesn’t support ProMotion or a 120Hz refresh rate. Both generations are limited to 60Hz. So, although the OLED panel improves image quality, scrolling and animations won’t feel as smooth as they do on an iPad Pro.

My take? I’d consider the OLED upgrade more important than the processor upgrade for most everyday users. It’s something you’ll notice every time you turn on the display.

Design and build quality: Thinner, lighter, and water-resistant

Apple hasn’t completely changed the iPad mini’s familiar design, but the 2026 model is noticeably thinner and lighter.

  • Thinner body: The 2026 iPad mini measures 5.4mm thick, compared with 6.3mm on the 2024 model.
  • Lighter construction: The Wi-Fi model weighs 255g, down from 293g. This makes it more comfortable to hold for extended reading sessions.
  • IP67 protection: The new model can withstand immersion in up to 1 metre of water for 30 minutes under controlled laboratory conditions. The 2024 model has no official IP rating.
  • New colors: Apple replaces Space Gray, Purple, and Blue with Midnight and Starlight.
  • Same compact footprint: Despite the larger display, Apple maintains almost the same overall dimensions by reducing the bezels.
  • Redesigned Smart Folio: The new two-panel TechWoven Smart Folio offers adjustable viewing angles and is sold separately.

I particularly like the weight reduction. The iPad mini is designed to be carried around and used with one hand, so being lightweight makes more practical sense.

One thing worth remembering: IP67 doesn’t mean the iPad is waterproof. Water resistance can decrease with normal wear, and liquid damage isn’t covered under Apple’s standard warranty.

A20 Pro vs A17 Pro: How much faster is the new iPad mini?

The 2026 iPad mini gets Apple’s A20 Pro chip, replacing the A17 Pro found in the 2024 model. It’s built using a newer 2nm manufacturing process, compared with the A17 Pro’s 3nm process. It replaces 2 performance cores with 2 super cores.

There’s an important detail here: the 128GB and 256GB models get a 5-core CPU and 16-core Neural Engine, while the 512GB model gets a 6-core CPU and Dual 16-core Neural Engine. All configurations feature a 7-core GPU with dedicated Neural Accelerators and support hardware-accelerated ray tracing.

Apple claims the A20 Pro delivers:

  • Up to 60% faster multithreaded CPU performance.
  • Up to 2.7x faster graphics performance.
  • Up to 4.5x faster AI performance than the previous generation, ideal for running on-device models and local LLMs.

The improved CPU should help with demanding applications, multitasking, and photo editing. The faster GPU is especially useful for gaming, 3D rendering, and creative apps.

In my opinion, the A20 Pro definitely makes the 2026 iPad mini a more future-proof device, but I wouldn’t upgrade from the A17 Pro purely for everyday performance. The 2024 model is already powerful enough for browsing, reading, note-taking, and most games.

Apple Intelligence and Siri AI: What changes?

The 2024 iPad mini already supports Apple Intelligence because it uses the A17 Pro chip. The 2026 model doesn’t introduce Apple’s AI platform to the iPad mini for the first time. Instead, its A20 Pro chip provides more processing power for demanding AI tasks.

With iPadOS 27, Apple’s newer Siri AI experience also brings improvements such as personal context understanding, on-screen awareness, improved conversations, enhanced image generation, and local AI processing.

The A20 Pro’s Neural Accelerators and increased memory bandwidth should help with local AI workloads. The 512GB configuration is particularly interesting because it includes the Dual 16-core Neural Engine.

However, I wouldn’t buy the new iPad mini solely for Apple Intelligence. The A17 Pro model already supports Apple’s AI platform.

Cameras: Landscape Center Stage finally arrives

Apple hasn’t increased the camera resolution with the 2026 iPad mini, but it has made a practical change to the front camera’s placement.

Both generations feature a 12MP front Center Stage camera and a 12MP rear camera. However, the new model has the camera at the landscape edge, making video calls feel more natural when using the iPad horizontally.

Other changes include:

  • Landscape front camera: The 2024 model places its camera on the portrait edge, while the 2026 model moves it to the landscape edge.
  • Center Stage: Both generations automatically adjust framing to keep you in view during video calls.
  • Adaptive True Tone flash: The rear camera now gets an Adaptive True Tone flash, improving photo capture and document scanning.
  • Same rear camera: Both retain a 12MP wide camera with 4K video recording at up to 60fps.

I think the landscape camera is a genuinely useful improvement for video calls, online classes, and meetings.

Speakers and audio: Apple’s new Acoustic Display

The 2024 iPad mini uses traditional stereo speakers positioned along its shorter edges. The 2026 model replaces this arrangement with Apple’s Acoustic Display technology.

Instead of relying on conventional external speaker openings, the new audio system is integrated into the display assembly.

  • Display-coupled woofers help produce deeper bass and more volume.
  • Hidden custom tweeters deliver high-frequency audio.
  • The redesigned sealed enclosure contributes to IP67 protection.
  • The new arrangement is designed to improve audio for movies, games, and music.

I like this change because the iPad mini is frequently used as a portable entertainment device. However, independent listening tests will be needed to establish how much better it sounds.

Connectivity: Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and a new C2 modem

Connectivity gets a substantial upgrade with the 2026 iPad mini. Apple has replaced the previous wireless networking hardware with its own N1 chip.

  • Wi-Fi 7: Replaces Wi-Fi 6E, offering improved wireless performance and network efficiency. You’ll need a compatible router to benefit.
  • Bluetooth 6: Replaces Bluetooth 5.3 and supports newer wireless connectivity features.
  • Thread: Adds support for compatible smart-home devices.
  • Apple C2 modem: Cellular versions use Apple’s C2 modem instead of the Qualcomm Snapdragon X70 found in the 2024 model.
  • Faster cellular speeds: Apple claims up to 50% faster cellular data speeds compared with the previous generation.

The standard Wi-Fi model doesn’t get the C2 modem; it’s exclusive to Cellular configurations.

I particularly like Apple’s move toward its own wireless chips. However, actual cellular speeds will still depend on your carrier, network coverage, and location.

Battery life and charging: Has Apple improved it?

Despite the more efficient A20 Pro chip, Apple continues to advertise the same battery life as the previous generation.

The new model actually has a slightly smaller battery, dropping from 19.3Wh to 18.9Wh.

One improvement worth mentioning is fast charging. With a compatible USB-C power adapter rated at 35W or higher, the new iPad mini can reach up to 50% charge in just 30 minutes. The adapter is sold separately.

My take? I’d have liked Apple to offer better battery life, especially considering the higher price. Still, faster charging support is useful when you need to top up your tablet before heading out.

Storage and Apple Pencil: What remains the same?

Apple hasn’t increased the storage options or changed Apple Pencil compatibility with the new iPad mini. Both generations offer the same storage capacities: 128GB, 256GB, and 512GB, and support the same Apple Pencil Pro and Apple Pencil USB-C models.

The 512GB model now has a better CPU and Neural Engine configuration. But for simple note-taking, reading, and sketching, the 128GB and 256GB versions will do just fine.

iPad mini 2026 vs iPad mini 2024: Price comparison

The biggest challenge for the 2026 iPad mini is that its price is quite high. Apple already raised the starting price in June 2026, making the new model $100 more expensive than its predecessor.

Cellular configurations cost an additional $150 across the storage options.

iPad mini 2026 price in India

For Indian buyers, the 2026 iPad mini starts at ₹82,900 for the Wi-Fi model.

Additional costs:

  • Cellular models cost an additional ₹18,000 across the storage options.
  • Nano-texture glass: ₹10,000 on eligible configurations.
  • Education pricing starts at ₹76,900.
  • TechWoven Smart Folio: ₹8,500.

The price increase is difficult to ignore. The OLED display, A20 Pro chip, and water resistance are meaningful upgrades, but spending $699 on a compact tablet isn’t a small decision.

If you can find the 2024 iPad mini at a substantial discount, it remains a sensible purchase for reading, browsing, taking notes, and everyday entertainment.

iPad mini 2026 vs iPad mini 2024: Which one should you buy?

The 2026 iPad mini is clearly the more capable device, but the improvements don’t make the older model obsolete. Your decision should depend on how you use your tablet.

My final verdict

The iPad mini 2026 is the biggest upgrade Apple has given its compact tablet in years. The move to OLED alone makes it more appealing for reading, watching movies, and creative work. Add a thinner design, lower weight, IP67 protection, the A20 Pro chip, and Wi-Fi 7, and you get a much more capable tablet.

However, I wouldn’t recommend replacing the 2024 iPad mini just because the new one has a faster chip. The A17 Pro model remains powerful, supports Apple Intelligence, and offers a great everyday experience for considerably less money.

My pick: The 2026 iPad mini for new buyers, and the 2024 iPad mini for existing owners who don’t need OLED.

There’s one thing I wish Apple had included: a 120Hz ProMotion display. At $699, keeping the refresh rate limited to 60Hz feels like an unnecessary compromise, especially when Apple has made such a significant investment in the OLED panel.
