aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"Ava is a die-hard Apple aficionado and seasoned writer with a knack for breaking down complex tech concepts into easily digestible content. Having honed her writing and editing skills over 5 years at renowned media houses like TechBurner, Ava crafts informative and engaging articles including troubleshooting guides, product reviews, editorials at iGeeksBlog. When not typing, you can find her exploring the latest Apple releases or pondering the future of tech innovation."

About Ava Biswas

  • Ava is a die-hard Apple aficionado and loves testing the latest tech gadgets.
  • She is always on the lookout for issues Apple users are facing, finds solutions, and crafts troubleshooting guides.
  • Her goal to make tech easy for everyone encouraged her to break down complex concepts into easily digestible content.

Experience

Ava has been employing her professional writing and editing skills for over 4 years at renowned media houses like TechBurner and iGeeksBlog. Using her expertise, she crafts informative and engaging How-To's, troubleshooting guides, product reviews, and editorials. When not typing, you can find her exploring the latest Apple releases or pondering new tech innovations.

title.rendered: Fortnite One Piece Bundle: Price, items, and how to get them

content.rendered:
The One Piece crossover finally landed in Fortnite on November 1, alongside the launch of the Treasure Hunters mini-season, completing the lineup of the anime ‘big three’ in the game, which also includes Naruto and Bleach. This highly anticipated arrival comes weeks after a series of strong rumors and teases from official sources.

With the Fortnite x One Piece collab now already here for some time, the One Piece Bundle has reached the “best sellers” section in the Item Shop at the time of writing. Headlined by Luffy, Nami, and Usopp skins and their associated cosmetics, this compilation is up for grabs for 4,000 V-Bucks.

Alternatively, the three aforementioned skins are also available as individual purchases, with Luffy priced at 1,800 V-Bucks and the other two characters priced at 1,600 V-Bucks each.

The One Piece Bundle and all items inspired by the widely acclaimed anime are scheduled to exit the Shop on December 5, 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET. So, that means interested Fortnite players only have just over a month’s time to seize this offer.

How to get the One Piece Bundle in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab.
  2. Now, head to the One Piece section and select the One Piece Bundle.
  3. On the next screen, select and hold the Purchase button to confirm your decision.

All One Piece Bundle items in Fortnite

Nearly all of the following items in the One Piece Bundle are also being sold solo, except Luffy’s Straw Hat back bling and Gum-Gum Pistol pickaxe, which are bundle exclusives. Importantly, there are two more One Piece skins in the game that are not included in the bundle but are instead a part of the Fortnite Battle Pass.

These skins are modeled around Portgas D. Ace and Nico Robin, aka Ms All Sunday and require the purchase of this season’s Battle Pass. You can also get access to the Battle Pass through Fortnite Crew. See the Crew subscription benefits and ways to join.

Once you have done that, you have to play enough Fortnite matches and gain enough XP to reach a certain level for these skins and relevant cosmetics. While Ms All Sunday unlocks immediately, Ace unlocks at Level 35 in the Battle Pass.

1. Monkey D. Luffy

  • Price: 1,800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

2. Nami

  • Price: 1,600 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

3. Usopp

  • Price: 1,600 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

4. Luffy’s Straw Hat back bling

  • Exclusively available in: One Piece Bundle

5. Nami’s Tangerines back bling

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

6. Usopp’s Kit back bling

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

7. Roasted Meat back bling

  • Price: 400 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

8. Gum-Gum Pistol pickaxe

  • Exclusively available in: One Piece Bundle

9. Climate Baton pickaxe

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

10. 5-ton hammer pickaxe

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

11. Giant Meat on the Bone pickaxe

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

12. Going Merry glider

  • Price: 1,200 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

13. Multi-Punches Flex emote

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

14. Straw Hat Guitar pickaxe and back bling

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: One Piece Bundle

Should you buy the One Piece Bundle or just the Luffy skin?

The Luffy skin alone is selling for 1,800 V-Bucks, whereas the One Piece Bundle, which contains all three skins, their related items, and two bundle-exclusive cosmetics, costs just over double that price. So, for hardcore anime fans and One Piece enthusiasts, the latter option looks like a particularly strong deal.

On the other hand, those who aren’t big into this Japanese IP and just want to dip their toes into this Fortnite collab for the sake of their FOMO, it would be enough to simply get the Luffy skin and call it a day. Being the protagonist of One Piece, this character is an instantly recognizable face in the community and hence the most prominent part of the recently released crossover.

FAQs

Is the One Piece Bundle free with Fortnite Crew?

No. But since the Fortnite Crew subscription unlocks the Battle Pass, you can claim a different set of One Piece items, including Ms All Sunday (Nico Robin) and Portgas D. Ace skins, as you play and gain XP in Fortnite.

If I already own an item that is also in the One Piece Bundle, will it lower the cost of the bundle?

Yes. The final price of the One Piece Bundle for you will be shown after taking out the price of the item you already own.

Will the One Piece Bundle return to Fortnite?

Yes. Due to its sheer popularity, it is reasonable to expect the One Piece Bundle to return again at some point in the future beyond this mini-season.

title.rendered: M6 iMac vs M4 iMac: What’s new and should you upgrade?

content.rendered:
Apple has finally upgraded the iMac, an update that was long overdue since the M4 iMac launched in 2024. The new M6 iMac brings a faster processor, improved AI performance, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and faster SSD speeds.

While the design and display remain unchanged, there are several improvements under the hood. But is the M6 iMac worth upgrading to, or is the M4 iMac still a better buy? Let’s find out.

M6 iMac vs. M4 iMac: Specs compared side by side

At first glance, the M6 iMac might look almost identical to its predecessor. However, Apple has made several internal changes, particularly to the processor, memory bandwidth, storage, and wireless connectivity.

Here’s how the two generations compare:

Specifications vary by configuration. The entry-level M6 has a 10-core CPU and GPU, while the higher-end version has a 12-core CPU and GPU. The M4 equivalents have 8-core and 10-core configurations.

What didn’t change between the M4 and M6 iMac?

Despite the new processor, the M6 iMac doesn’t introduce a major external redesign, similar to the newly launched M6 14-inch MacBook Pro. Here’s what Apple has retained from the M4 iMac 2024:

1. Design and colors

The M6 iMac retains the same slim 24-inch all-in-one design as the M4 model. It also continues to come in seven colors: blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver.

The overall appearance, stand, and color-matched accessories remain familiar. So, if you place the two models side by side, you probably won’t notice much difference from the front.

2. Display: Same 4.5K Retina experience

Apple decided to keep the specifications of the display unchanged. Both models have a 24-inch 4.5K Retina display with a resolution of 4480 × 2520 and a maximum brightness of 500 nits. You also get P3 wide color and True Tone technology for a comfortable viewing experience.

For everyday activities such as browsing, writing, watching videos, and editing photos, the viewing experience should feel very similar.

However, the M6 brings improvements to external display support:

  • Two-port M6 model: Supports up to 6K at 60Hz or 4K at 165Hz.
  • Four-port M6 model: Supports up to 5K at 120Hz or 4K at 240Hz.

As I regularly connect an external monitor for a larger workspace, I will lean towards the new model for smoother visuals. However, these improvements don’t mean the built-in iMac display itself has a higher refresh rate.

3. Camera and audio: No major changes

The M6 iMac retains the same 12MP Center Stage camera found on the M4 model. It supports Desk View, which lets you show your desk or workspace during video calls.

The audio setup also remains familiar:

  • Six-speaker sound system with force-cancelling woofers.
  • Spatial Audio support with Dolby Atmos.
  • Three-microphone array with directional beamforming.

If you regularly attend video meetings or use your iMac for entertainment, both models should offer a similar experience. The M6’s improvements are primarily under the hood, not in its camera or speakers.

How much faster is the M6 chip than the M4?

This is where the M6 iMac makes its strongest case.

The M6 iMac comes with either a 10-core or 12-core CPU, with two high-performance super cores, alongside performance and efficiency cores. Its GPU also gets the same two-core increase, offering 10-core and 12-core options. Apple even added Neural Accelerators to each GPU core for AI workloads and increased memory bandwidth to 170GB/s.

For comparison, the M4 iMac offers an 8-core CPU and GPU in its entry-level configuration and a 10-core CPU and GPU in the higher-end version.

Ultimately, the performance difference depends on what you do with your computer. Everyday browsing and document editing won’t feel dramatically different, but demanding creative workloads and AI processing stand to benefit more.

Early benchmarks: M6 iMac vs M4 iMac

Early testing of the M6 iMac indicates what the new processor can achieve compared with the M4 iMac.

Geekbench 7 multi-core results show:

These results suggest the M6 platform delivers considerably higher multi-core performance.

Is the M6 iMac better for Apple Intelligence and local AI?

AI performance is one of the biggest reasons Apple is highlighting the M6 iMac. The new chip combines a Dual 16-core Neural Engine with Neural Accelerators in every GPU core to accelerate machine-learning tasks, support advanced macOS 27 Golden Gate features, and handle demanding AI workloads like Siri AI processes.

Apple claims the M6 iMac can deliver up to five times faster on-device AI prompt processing in LM Studio compared with the M4 iMac. This is particularly interesting for people who want to experiment with local AI models rather than relying entirely on cloud-based services.

Did memory and storage improve on the M6 iMac?

Apple hasn’t increased the starting memory or storage capacity, but it has improved the speed at which the M6 iMac can access and process data.

Both generations start with 16GB unified memory and 256GB SSD storage. Depending on the configuration, you can get up to 32GB RAM and 2TB storage.

The M6 also moves to faster PCIe 5.0-based SSD storage, with Apple claiming up to twice the storage performance compared with the M4.

What does this mean in everyday use?

  • Large files can load faster.
  • Applications and projects can launch more quickly.
  • Moving large files between storage and memory-intensive applications can become more responsive.
  • Creative workflows involving large photo and video libraries can benefit.

However, don’t confuse faster storage with more storage. If you regularly work with large video files, I would still recommend choosing at least 512GB or 1TB rather than relying on the 256GB base configuration.

What’s new in connectivity: Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and 2.5Gb Ethernet

Connectivity is another area where the M6 iMac gets a meaningful upgrade. Apple has introduced its N1 wireless networking chip, bringing newer Wi-FI 7 and Bluetooth 6 to the desktop.

Wi-Fi 7 offers higher potential throughput, improved efficiency, and lower latency compared with Wi-Fi 6E when paired with a compatible router. The M6 also supports Thread networking technology, which can be useful in compatible smart-home setups.

The M4 iMac already offered Thunderbolt 4, so the M6 doesn’t introduce a new Thunderbolt generation. Instead, the improvements focus on wired Ethernet, offering a 2.5Gb connection.

There is one configuration difference worth remembering:

  • The 10-core M6 model has two Thunderbolt 4 ports and can be configured with 2.5Gb Ethernet.
  • The 12-core M6 model has four Thunderbolt 4 ports and includes 2.5Gb Ethernet.

This makes the higher-end model more appealing to people who need multiple wired accessories and faster network connectivity.

Who benefits most? If you use cloud storage, connect to a NAS, transfer large video files, or have a Wi-Fi 7 router, you will definitely appreciate the improved connectivity features of M6. For someone using a standard home Wi-Fi connection and a few Bluetooth accessories, the difference may not be noticeable.

M6 iMac vs M4 iMac price

Price is one of the biggest considerations when deciding between these two iMacs. The M6 starts at $1,499 in the US, which is $200 more than the M4’s original launch price.

M6 iMac Pricing

However, there’s an important detail: Apple had already increased the M4 iMac’s US starting price to $1,499 and $1,699 for the respective models in June 2026. That means the new model’s entry price isn’t necessarily higher than the outgoing model’s final US price.

This creates an interesting buying situation. The M6 two-port model now costs the same as the M4 four-port model’s updated price, but with an improved CPU, faster connectivity, and better storage performance.

Should you buy the M6 iMac or a discounted M4 iMac?

This is probably the most important question for anyone shopping for a new iMac. The M6 is clearly the more capable machine, but that doesn’t automatically make the M4 a bad purchase.

I’d compare the two based on your workload, the configuration you need, and the actual price difference.

Buy the M6 iMac if you:

  • Are upgrading from an Intel or M1 iMac.
  • Regularly work with demanding applications and large creative projects.
  • Want better performance for local AI models.
  • Have a Wi-Fi 7 router or use a NAS with a faster wired network.
  • Want faster SSD performance and additional memory bandwidth.
  • Plan to keep your desktop for several years.

Buy a discounted M4 iMac if you:

  • Primarily browse the web, write documents, watch videos, and manage everyday tasks.
  • Don’t need advanced local AI capabilities.
  • Find a configuration at least 15% cheaper than an equivalent M6.
  • Want to save money without sacrificing the familiar iMac design and display experience.

For basic productivity, the M4 remains a capable desktop. Paying considerably more for the M6 may not make sense if you won’t use its additional processing power.

If you already own an M4 iMac

I wouldn’t recommend replacing an M4 iMac just to get the M6 chip.

The M4 already handles everyday productivity, photo editing, multitasking, and most creative workflows comfortably. The M6 improves performance, but the unchanged display, design, camera, and ports mean the overall experience won’t change much.

The exception is if you specifically need faster local AI processing, higher graphics performance, or the newer networking features.

Final verdict: Is the M6 iMac worth buying?

The M6 iMac is a meaningful internal upgrade, but not the redesign some users might have expected. Apple has focused on making its all-in-one desktop faster and better equipped for AI rather than changing its appearance.

The faster processor, improved memory bandwidth, Neural Accelerators, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and faster SSD make it a better long-term purchase for people who need additional performance. However, the unchanged display, camera, audio system, and overall design make it difficult to recommend as an essential upgrade for existing M4 owners.

My recommendation: If you’re moving from an Intel or M1 iMac, I’d choose the M6. If you’re buying your first iMac, the M6 chip would still be better than the M4 unless you find a heavily discounted M4. But if you already own the M4, I’d save the money and wait for a more substantial upgrade.

mainEntity.name: Does Pirate Shop Access make every Item Shop item free?

mainEntity.name: Can you transfer Pirate Shop Access to another Fortnite account?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The reward is tied to the account that receives it and cannot be transferred.

mainEntity.name: Why is my Mac connected to Wi-Fi but there's no internet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your Mac has joined the network, but internet traffic isn't getting through. Check whether an iPhone or another device can get online on the same Wi-Fi. If none can, restart the router or check with your internet provider. If only your Mac fails, restart it, then try the DNS steps above. A duplicate IP address can also block internet access.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Mac keep disconnecting from Wi-Fi?

acceptedAnswer.text: When the Mac and Wi-Fi router are placed at a distance, signal strength is low. As a result, your Mac may often drop the connection. Similarly, such issues may occur if you have not restarted your router or your Mac in a long time. Move closer to your router and restart both your router and your Mac to help fix the issue. If the drops continue, forget the network and reconnect to it, as shown in step 5.

mainEntity.name: Why won't Wi-Fi turn on on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check the Wi-Fi icon in the menu bar or in Control Center, and make sure Wi-Fi is turned on. Then restart your Mac. If Wi-Fi still won't turn on, contact Apple Support, since the Wi-Fi hardware may need a repair.

mainEntity.name: How do I run Wireless Diagnostics on my Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quit all open apps first. Then, try connecting to a Wi-Fi network if you aren't already connected. Next, press and hold the Option key and click the Wi-Fi icon in the menu bar. Finally, click Open Wireless Diagnostics and follow the on-screen instructions.

title.rendered: Apple sends new mercenary spyware warnings to users in 99 countries

content.rendered:
Apple has sent a new round of threat notifications to iPhone users in 99 countries, with alerts arriving since October 29. The alerts say the person may be targeted with mercenary spyware. Apple has not made a public statement about this batch, so the count comes from alert text people have shared publicly. That same text says Apple has now notified users in over 150 countries in total.

Mercenary spyware is made by private companies and sold to customers, often governments. Governments rarely build it themselves. Apple says these alerts are “high-confidence” signs that a specific person was targeted, and it does not say who is behind the attacks.

Germany’s parliament got the alerts too

Germany’s federal cyber security office, the BSI, warned that members of the Bundestag, the German parliament, and other public figures had received Apple’s alerts. The BSI says recipients have been getting them since October 29. Digital minister Karsten Wildberger has since confirmed that members of the federal government were also warned, and the BSI tells recipients to assume their device may have been compromised.

Government spokesperson Stefan Kornelius told the Financial Times that Berlin is “taking the incident and the warning very seriously.” He declined to say whether Chancellor Friedrich Merz was among those targeted. Taking the warning seriously is the right answer. Declining to say is a cautious move, though, and it leaves the first question people will ask unanswered.

The 99-country count shows reach, not victims

In August, Apple sent alerts to users in 110 countries. This round came about 11 weeks later. The count tells you how far the notices went. It doesn’t tell you how many phones were compromised.

Radwan Mortada, a Beirut-based filmmaker, shared his notice on X. It said Apple had detected “another attack against your device.” He says he was targeted before, in 2021. I’d read 99 as a measure of how wide the targeting is, not a count of hacked phones.

The alert confirms targeting, not a successful attack

Apple calls these alerts a sign that a user has been individually targeted. They don’t confirm that an attack worked. The BSI makes the same point: the notice doesn’t say whether the attack succeeded.

Spyware like this often uses zero-click attacks, which need no click or action from the target. The BSI points to frequent crashes and fast battery drain as signs that a device may be infected.

What to do if you get one

Real alerts can show up on the Lock Screen, in Settings, by email, or at account.apple.com. Scam messages can copy that look, so check the details before you act.

  1. Don’t tap links, open files, or install profiles from the alert. Apple says its notices never ask for those, or for your Apple Account password or a verification code.
  2. Check the notice on your Apple Account. Sign in at account.apple.com. A genuine notice shows at the top of the page.
  3. Update iOS right away, unless experts are already examining the phone. The BSI gives this advice.
  4. If you think you could be a target, turn on Lockdown Mode and get expert help. Apple points to a nonprofit helpline, Access Now’s Digital Security Helpline. The BSI notes that Lockdown Mode makes new attacks harder, but it doesn’t remove an infection that is already there.

Most iPhone owners won’t need Lockdown Mode, but if you think you could be a target, it’s the setting I’d turn on first.

Fake Apple security alerts are a different problem. They are scam pop-ups that claim your iPhone is infected. Apple doesn’t show virus pop-ups in Safari, so force-close the browser instead of tapping anything in the pop-up.

Update your iPhone today, whether or not you got an alert.

title.rendered: Minecraft Bedrock 26.60: All new features and bug fixes

content.rendered:
It seems like there’s no stopping Minecraft updates (Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5), and this time, Bedrock is getting its own share of new content! That’s right, Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 is finally out, bringing a new biome, mobs, fresh effects, and a ton of gameplay changes and fixes that’ve flipped the script upside down.

So, let’s take a complete look at Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 and explain everything you need to know about the update.

Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 at a glance

All new features in Minecraft Bedrock 26.60

1. Ice Cave Biome

Itching to explore some new areas in Minecraft? Well, Bedrock 26.60 brings Ice Caves. This is a brand-new biome that can be found beneath the colder regions of the Overworld. This icy underground location features a terrain that’s made up of Calcite and Packed Ice, with patches of snow scattered across the ground. Players can also discover various ores hidden inside deep pockets of Deepslate and Stone.

2. Ice Crystals & Icicles Blocks

With a new biome comes a bunch of new blocks to discover. First up are Ice Crystals, which naturally spawn on the ground inside Ice Caves and give off a faint glow. You can also place them on the sides of blocks, which makes them a great decorative piece for all winter-themed builds. Then we have Icicles, which are sharp, spike-like blocks that generate along Ice Cave ceilings and floors. These blocks can gradually grow over time and deal damage to players and mobs if they fall.

3. Frostbite Mob

Be careful while exploring Ice Caves, as you might come across the Frostbite. These hostile mobs are basically zombies that have adapted to the chilly environment. Their weapon of choice is Iceballs, which cause a freezing effect. Frostbites are themselves immune to freezing and can walk across Powder Snow without getting slowed down, which makes these mobs a dangerous threat.

4. Freezing Effect

Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 brings a new Freezing effect that can affect both players and mobs. Once inflicted, the target gradually freezes and takes damage over time, while their jump speed and movement are nerfed. Players can apply this effect by brewing a Potion of Freezing, which requires an Awkward Potion and an Ice Ball. The update also adds Arrows of Freezing, which apply the same on-hit effects when they get hit with them.

All bug fixes in Minecraft Bedrock 26.60

1. Gameplay fixes

Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 isn’t just about new content additions, as the update also brings several gameplay fixes and improvements across exploration, survival, and everyday activities. Lush Caves will now generate in humid regions, while Swamp Caves will no longer spawn Mycelium or isolated Corallium Dirt blocks. Placing Snow Blocks will also produce vibrations that Sculk Sensors can detect. Learn how to collect and use Snow Blocks and Snow Layers in your world. Several in-game maps have been updated to make destinations easier to identify, and Cushions placed in unloaded chunks will no longer disappear.

2. Redstone and block

Redstone enthusiasts will be happy to know about Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 as it addresses multiple connectivity and rendering issues. Redstone dust will now visually connect properly with certain custom blocks, and the issue that prevented upward connections from appearing correctly when connecting to another wire has been resolved. Wool and Concrete blocks will also now play their intended instrument sounds when used with Note Blocks. On top of that, players can no longer place Straw Beds on blocks occupied by entities.

3. Mobs and Combat fixes

The update also brings a handful of changes related to mobs and combat. The bugs affecting Slimes and Sheeps have been addressed, along with a rare issue where healing a mob could kill it. Tambed baby mobs can restore their health when fed food, and Armour Stands have received equipment swapping fixes that allow players to change items reliably.

4. Commands, Visuals, UI and & Stability

Players who regularly use Minecraft commands or create automated builds will see several improvements. Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 fixes multiple issues related to block selection, visual glitches, and crashes when changing the render resolution on PlayStation consoles. The Marketplace and Minecraft Realms have also seen multiple improvements. Navigation across menus, settings, and multiplayer features has also been refined to make the overall experience smoother. Finally, performance improvements across supported platforms should help make the game more stable and reduce crashes.

How to download Minecraft Bedrock 26.60

You’ll be glad to know that Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 is available across all supported platforms. However, the steps to download it can depend on your device. Here’s how you can get it:

Windows

  1. Open the Microsoft Store.
  2. Go to Library.
  3. Select Get updates.

You can also launch Minecraft Launcher and check for updates directly.

Android and iOS

  1. Open the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
  2. Search for Minecraft.
  3. Select Update if the update is available.

Xbox

  1. Open My games & apps.
  2. Select Manage.
  3. Choose Updates.
  4. Find Minecraft and install the update.

PlayStation

  1. Highlight Minecraft on the home screen.
  2. Press the Options button on your controller.
  3. Select Check for Update.

Wrapping up

Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 adds experimental content from Drop 4 of 2026, including Ice Caves, Frostbites, Ice Crystals, Icicles, and the Freezing effect. Alongside these additions, the update delivers more than 600 bug fixes and improvements. Keep in mind that the new content is experimental and requires the relevant experimental settings to be enabled.

FAQs

What is a Frostbite mob in Minecraft Bedrock?

The Frostbite is a new hostile mob added with Minecraft Bedrock 26.60. It is a zombie that has adapted to cold environments and is capable of throwing Ice Balls at players.

Is the new Ice Caves feature experimental?

Ice Caves in Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 are an experimental feature introduced as part of the Drop 4 of 2026.

Does Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 support Nintendo Switch 2?

Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 officially supports the Nintendo Switch 2.

title.rendered: Google plans Quick Share for Android and iPhone apps in 2027

content.rendered:
Google is building a Quick Share SDK that lets Android and iOS apps add Quick Share file sharing inside the app itself, with a release planned for the first half of 2027. Google announced it in an Android Dev Summit 2026 session titled “Enabling seamless cross-device interactions.” It gave no exact date, so “first half” could mean as late as June 2027.

An SDK, or software development kit, is a package of ready-made code that developers drop into their apps. This one gives apps Quick Share, the nearby file-sharing feature built into Android.

Quick Share opens as a panel inside the app

Today, sharing a file from an app means opening the system share sheet and then Quick Share’s full-screen view. With the SDK, the app opens Quick Share itself as a bottom sheet, a panel that slides up from the bottom, with a preview of the files being sent. iPhone apps get a separate Quick Share iOS SDK. Android Authority also reports that Tap to Share, where touching two phones together starts a transfer, is part of the SDK.

Google lists five selling points:

  • Encryption: files are end-to-end encrypted between the two devices and move over the local network.
  • Speed: the SDK sets up hotspots automatically and uses Wi-Fi Direct, a phone-to-phone Wi-Fi link, on supported devices.
  • No compression: photos and videos keep their original quality.
  • Offline use: sharing works without a cellular connection.
  • No servers: developers don’t need costly server infrastructure to move files.

No compression is the one I’d care about most. Messaging apps often shrink photos and videos before sending them, so a transfer that keeps the original file is a real reason to use this instead of a chat.

It follows Quick Share’s push toward iPhone

Quick Share first worked with Apple’s AirDrop on the Pixel 10 in November 2025, and more Galaxy, OnePlus, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, and Honor phones have joined the list since. That route has a setup step on the iPhone: AirDrop has to be set to Everyone for 10 minutes before the Android phone can see it.

In May, Google also said Quick Share would arrive inside apps, including WhatsApp, with no date given. Google hasn’t said whether WhatsApp’s version will use this SDK.

Nothing changes until apps add it

Apps have to opt in, and Google hasn’t named any that will. Even after the SDK ships, your favorite chat or file app gets in-app Quick Share only if its developers add it. The AirDrop route depends on the phone maker. The SDK route depends on each app’s developer.

The coverage so far leaves several things open:

  • OS version requirements on Android and iOS.
  • Whether the Android side needs Google Play services.
  • Whether a phone using the SDK can send to a phone that only has the built-in Quick Share or AirDrop.
  • Whether Google will charge developers anything.

For now, there is nothing to switch on. Sharing from Android to an iPhone today still means the AirDrop route on a supported phone, or the QR code option Google added in May, which sends files to an iPhone through the cloud.

  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Apple will require an 18+ rating for dating apps and romantic AI companions

content.rendered:
Apple said in a developer news post on November 2 that any app with dating features, or a virtual companion that engages users in sexual or romantic content, will get a minimum age rating of 18+. The new questions arrive in App Store Connect on November 16, and every app has to answer them by January 12, 2027.

Romantic AI companions now fall under Dating and Relationships

The age rating questionnaire is getting two new items: Shared Location and Dating and Relationships. Dating and Relationships covers “features that enable dating or relationship connections between real people and/or a virtual companion that engages a user in sexual or romantic content.” An app that declares it can’t go below 18+.

The second half of that definition describes AI companion apps, though Apple’s post never says “AI” and names no apps. The trigger is what the companion does, which is the right test, since a developer can call an app anything. A companion that stays friendly isn’t described. Apple also doesn’t say how it will treat a general chatbot that users can steer into romantic roleplay.

Developers answer the questionnaire themselves, so the rating depends on what they admit to. Apple pulled Kromix, an AI nudify app, in August, and said the app appeared to have added the prohibited features after it passed App Review. The new post mentions no extra checks on these answers. Apple did tighten its rules on October 16 with guideline 2.5.19, which bars apps from adding features after approval that weren’t in the reviewed version, and threatens removal from the App Store and the Developer Program.

Developers must answer by January 12, and Apple names no penalty

Developers give these answers when they submit an app update or change their questionnaire. All apps, including ones that never update, must have them completed by January 12, 2027.

Apple’s post doesn’t say what happens to an app that misses that date, and a deadline with no stated penalty is easy for a small developer to put off. The last questionnaire deadline, January 31, 2026, came with the 13+, 16+ and 18+ tiers Apple added in 2025 and a warning that app updates could be interrupted without answers.

Apple used the same approach for social media in July. A question added on July 9 asks whether an app has social media features. Answers have been required since September, and apps that say yes get a Social Media label on their App Store page and a minimum 13+ rating. The answers also decide which apps count toward the Social Media category in iOS 27’s Time Allowances, which parents use to cap time by category. The new post doesn’t say whether Dating and Relationships or Shared Location will get a product page label or a Screen Time hook.

Brazil sets its own ratings, with a route to a lower one

Brazil’s rules go further. Local regulations there require an A16 rating for Shared Location and an A18 rating for Dating and Relationships. A developer who believes its app qualifies for less, such as a location-sharing app built for parents and children, can request an official rating from Brazil’s Ministry of Justice and Public Security. Once it’s verified, that rating shows on the Brazilian App Store.

Elsewhere, Apple says only that apps with Shared Location “may not have an impact on their minimum age rating in some regions.” It lists no regions, so the rating for a family location app outside Brazil is still unknown.

In three countries, 18+ also means an adult check

Since February 24, Apple has blocked 18+ app downloads in Australia, Brazil and Singapore until the App Store confirms the user is an adult. An app with Dating and Relationships becomes an 18+ app, so those downloads should sit behind that check too.

Apple doesn’t say when the new ratings will appear on App Store pages, whether as each developer answers or all at once after January 12.

  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)

title.rendered: Apple Q4 revenue hits $114.5B, up 12%, as iPhone and Mac carry the quarter

content.rendered:
Apple reported its fiscal fourth-quarter results on Monday, November 2. Revenue, which is the total money from sales before any costs come out, reached $114.5 billion for the three months that ended September 26. That was up 12% from $102.5 billion a year earlier, or about $12 billion more.

I’d give Apple credit for landing above its own July forecast of 9% to 11% growth. It was also a record for a September quarter. This was the first earnings report with John Ternus as CEO, after he took over from Tim Cook on September 1.

Profit grew faster than sales

Earnings per share, which is profit for each share of Apple stock, rose 14% to $2.10. Net income, the company’s total profit after all costs, was $30.7 billion.

Part of that per-share gain came from tariff refunds, which are money returned on import taxes Apple had already paid. Those refunds added about 5 cents per share. Without them, the per-share gain would be closer to 11%. That is my math from the reported figures, not a number Apple gave.

iPhone brought in about half of Apple’s sales

iPhone revenue rose 17% to $57.58 billion, up from $49.03 billion. That was about half of everything Apple sold, and another September-quarter record.

The quarter only had nine days of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max sales, which started September 18. Setting a record with just nine days of those sales is a good sign for the holiday quarter.

Mac was the surprise of the quarter. Its revenue rose 24% to $10.79 billion, the fastest growth of any product line. Greater China revenue rose 21% to $17.54 billion, a September-quarter record that Ternus pointed out on the call.

iPad and wearables went backward

iPad revenue fell 10% to $6.23 billion. CFO Kevan Parekh, who runs Apple’s finances, blamed supply limits and a tough comparison with last year’s A16 iPad launch.

Wearables, Home and Accessories fell 8% to $8.30 billion. That category covers products such as Apple Watch and AirPods. Parekh tied the drop to last year’s Apple Watch SE 3 and AirPods Pro 3 launches.

Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5 went on sale for the last nine days of the quarter, which is about a tenth of the quarter. That is a short window to win back lost sales.

Services is still growing, just more slowly

Services, which covers the App Store, iCloud, Apple Music, and other paid services, hit an all-time high of $31.57 billion. That is up about 10% from $28.75 billion.

Services grew 12% in the June quarter. Apple blamed App Store rule changes and weaker mobile gaming for the slower pace that followed.

Services also earns far more per dollar than products. Apple’s financial statements show it kept about 76 cents of each Services dollar after direct costs. That share is called gross margin. For products, the figure is about 37 cents.

That makes a slowdown in Services a bigger worry for profit than a weak iPad quarter. I’d watch Services more closely than the iPad numbers. Apple expects Services to grow 8% to 9% in the December quarter, citing licensing deals with outside companies and currency changes.

Memory costs are cutting into profit on each sale

Memory chips are the parts that hold data while a device runs, and their prices are climbing. That is squeezing Apple’s margins, which is the share of each sale it keeps after direct costs.

Total gross margin was 47.9%, inside the 47% to 48% range Apple had forecast. In plain terms, Apple kept about 48 cents of each sales dollar after direct costs. About one percentage point of that came from tariff refunds, though. The June quarter’s 50.1% included about two points of refunds.

Parekh said that without refunds in both quarters, margin would have dropped about a point from June, mostly because of higher memory costs.

The next quarter looks worse. Apple forecast gross margin of 45% to 46% for December. It tied that to higher memory costs and some costs from ramping up Siri AI. Ternus called current memory pricing “unprecedented” and said costs will keep rising past December.

Shoppers have already felt part of this. In June, Apple raised prices on Macs, iPads, Apple TV, HomePod, and Vision Pro because of the memory shortage, and iPhone prices followed in September. On the call, Apple said it did so reluctantly.

Wall Street focused on that margin. Apple beat estimates of $113.4 billion in revenue and $1.99 per share, CNBC reported, but shares still fell about 3% after hours. The margin forecast came in below the 46.3% that analysts had expected.

I’d watch that margin forecast more than the revenue record. At 45% to 46%, Apple keeps less from each sales dollar than the 47.9% it kept this quarter.

Operating expenses, the day-to-day costs of running the company, also rose, up 21% to $19.19 billion.

Siri AI will come with usage limits, and no prices yet

Ternus said AI features that run on Apple’s servers, including Siri AI, will get usage limits. Extra access can be bought later. Apple gave no prices and no limit numbers.

Until those numbers show up, I’d assume Siri AI comes with a meter on it. Check the limits once Apple publishes them before you count on the feature.

December could be Apple’s biggest quarter if supply holds

Apple forecast December-quarter revenue growth of 7% to 10%. Against the $143.8 billion it made in last year’s December quarter, that works out to roughly $154 billion to $158 billion. Parekh said that would be Apple’s best revenue quarter ever. He tied the range to what Apple calls its “best view of constrained supply.”

Memory is the limit on Mac and iPad, where Apple expects supply constraints in the December quarter. Ternus listed the holiday lineup as the foldable iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, new home hardware, Touch on Mac, and Siri AI. The touchscreen MacBook Pro, which brings touch to the Mac for the first time, ships November 6 starting at $2,899.

The iPhone Duo went on sale October 23 starting at $1,999, so its early sales all fall in the December quarter. Apple says it is still supply-constrained and hard to predict when supply and demand will balance. If you want one for the holidays, plan on waiting.

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: Fortnite Dante Bundle: Price, Coco Guitar item, and how to get them

content.rendered:
Halloween has consistently been a major time of the year in Fortnite, for which the game has often had some curated content on offer. The month-long Fortnitemares event is one such effort in celebrating the spooky October occasion.

And then there is also the cascade of Halloween-themed cosmetics and collabs, such as the Dante Bundle inspired by the 2017 animated film Coco, that get dropped throughout this period. The Dante Bundle, which features the canine sidekick Dante and the flamboyant Coco Guitar, are currently available as part of the Día de los Muertos promotion.

While the combo itself is available for 1,800 V-Bucks, Dante and Coco Guitar individually are priced at 1,500 V-Bucks and 800 V-Bucks, respectively. Importantly, all the Día de los Muertos items are up for grabs only for a limited time and will exit the Item Shop on November 7, 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET. So, those looking to nab these cosmetics must do so before Saturday evening.

How to get the Dante Bundle in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, navigate to the Shop tab.
  2. Next, scroll all the way down to the Día de los Muertos section and select the Dante Bundle.
  3. At last, press and hold the Purchase button to complete your transaction.

Where can you use Dante?

Dante and any other sidekicks can be used in several official Fortnite modes, including Battle Royale, Save the World, LEGO Fortnite and Fortnite Festival. Besides them, this Item Shop purchase can also be used in third-party maps, depending on if the developer has enabled this option for the players or not.

It is also worth keeping in mind that Fortnite sidekicks like Dante only act as a visual enhancement and have no real gameplay impact. A sidekick can react to its environment and can also emote, but it can’t help you locate enemies, nor can it expose your own location on the map to them.

All Día de los Muertos items in Fortnite

For clarity reasons, it’s important to highlight that there are two items named Dante in this section in the Item Shop. On one hand, there is Dante the sidekick and, on the other hand, there is Dante the player character skin.

Apart from the Dante Bundle, Rememberance Salvador (headlined by the Rememberance Salvador skin) and Rest In Peace (headlined by the Salvador skin) bundles are also there. They are worth 1,100 V-Bucks and 1,800 V-Bucks, respectively. Moreover, there is no bundle that contains all of the Día de los Muertos cosmetics, which are listed in their entirety below.

1. Rosa outfit

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Bonus item: Calavera back bling

2. Dante outfit

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Dante Bundle

3. Salvador

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Bonus item: Vihuela de los Muertos pickaxe and back bling

4. Remembrance Salvador

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Rememberance Salvador Bundle

5. Dante sidekick

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Dante Bundle

6. Coco Guitar back bling and pickaxe

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Dante Bundle

7. Six String Striker back bling and pickaxe

  • Price: 1,200 V-Bucks

8. Vihuela de los Muertos back bling and pickaxe

  • Exclusively included with: Salvador skin, Rest In Peace Bundle

9. Calavera back bling

  • Exclusively included in: Remembrance Salvador Bundle

10. Spirit Cape back bling

  • Exclusively included in: Dante (character skin, not sidekick)

11. Calavera Case back bling

  • Exclusively included in: Remembrance Salvador Bundle

12. Calavera Club pickaxe

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Remembrance Salvador Bundle

13. Baleful Bellow pickaxe

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Rest In Peace Bundle

14. Spirit glider

  • Price: 1,200 V-Bucks

15. Converse Chuck 70 ‘Day Of The Dead’ kicks

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks

16. Sugar Skull wrap

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Rest In Peace Bundle

Wrapping up

Fortnite has featured several collaborations based on live-action horror franchises, making the Coco crossover a refreshing change. The Dante Bundle brings a more colorful, animated style to the game.

Players who enjoyed Fortnite’s collaborations with Disney and Pixar properties, such as Toy Story, The Incredibles, and The Nightmare Before Christmas, may find this crossover just as appealing.

FAQs

Can you customize Dante?

Unlike some other Fortnite sidekicks such as Jack-O’-Cat, you can’t customize Dante’s appearance.

Is the Coco Guitar the same as the Alebrije Guitar?

Yes, the Coco Guitar and the Alebrije Guitar are one and the same thing. While the former refers to the item using the name of the movie in which it appears, the latter relies on the name of the motif that the item sports for the same purpose.

Can enemies see Dante?

No, enemies can’t see any of your sidekicks, including Dante. Only you can see it.

blockGraphs.question: Can you customize Dante?
blockGraphs.answer: Unlike some other Fortnite sidekicks such as Jack-O'-Cat, you can't customize Dante's appearance.

blockGraphs.question: Is the Coco Guitar the same as the Alebrije Guitar?
blockGraphs.answer: Yes, the Coco Guitar and the Alebrije Guitar are one and the same thing. While the former refers to the item using the name of the movie in which it appears, the latter relies on the name of the motif that the item sports for the same purpose.

blockGraphs.question: Can enemies see Dante?
blockGraphs.answer: No, enemies can't see any of your sidekicks, including Dante. Only you can see it.

title.rendered: Here’s how to get Snow Bricks in Minecraft

content.rendered:
Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 6 introduces Snow Bricks, a new building block for winter-themed builds. You can craft them from Snow Blocks and use their slab, wall, and stair variants to create snowy houses, castles, and igloos.

Snow Bricks also have a special interaction with Sulfur Cubes, making them useful for more than decoration. Here’s how to craft them and use their different variants.

Snow Bricks in Minecraft at a glance

What are Snow Bricks in Minecraft?

As we’ve already mentioned below, Snow Bricks are among the new building blocks introduced with Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 6. They come in different variants, all of which can be crafted with the help of a Crafting Table.

Snow Bricks are a perfect way to design snowy houses, castles, and igloos, especially when combined with newer blocks such as Ice Bricks. They also have a few interesting features up their sleeves, such as:

1. They don’t melt in sunlight

One of the biggest advantages of Snow Bricks is that they don’t melt when exposed to sunlight in Minecraft. Unlike regular snow, these blocks maintain their shape in any environment, which means they’re flexible to use and players won’t have to worry about them melting.

2. They interact with Sulfur Cubes

Snow Bricks also have a unique interaction with Sulfur Cubes. When a Sulfur Cube absorbs these blocks, it unlocks the Fast Sliding archetype. This helps with movement and the creation of many unique minigames.

How to get Snow Bricks in Minecraft

In order to craft Snow Bricks in Minecraft, you’ll need to gather a few materials and tools. Here’s what you will need to get started:

Getting your hands on Snow Blocks is probably the only tricky part of this recipe. For this, you’ll need a Shovel that’s enchanted with Silk Touch and head over to a snowy biome to collect them.

If you don’t have the enchantment, you can simply gather Snowballs by breaking snow and combine them to craft Snow Blocks. Once you have the materials ready, here’s how you can craft Snow Bricks in Minecraft:

  1. Place a Crafting Table and interact with it to open the crafting menu.
  2. Arrange four Snow Blocks in a 2×2 formation within the grid.

Once you’ve placed the required materials, four Snow Bricks will appear in the output slot. Simply move them to your inventory, and you’re good to go. It’s quite a simple recipe that doesn’t require any additional materials.

Need help collecting them? Here’s how to get and use Snow Blocks and Snow Layers.

Snow Bricks crafting recipe in Minecraft

Apart from the regular blocks, Snow Bricks come in three variants: slabs, walls, and stairs. These can come in handy if you’re building an igloo, a house, or creating staircases. Each variant has its own crafting recipe, which is as mentioned below:

  • Slabs: Use x3 Snow Bricks in a single line in a single horizontal row on the Crafting Table for x6 Snow Brick Slabs.
  • Walls: Place x6 Snow Bricks across two complete horizontal rows on the Crafting Table for x6 Snow Brick Walls.
  • Stairs: Arrange 6 Snow Bricks in a staircase pattern, starting with 1 block in the left column, 2 in the middle, and 3 at the bottom for x4 Snow Brick Stairs.

Wrapping up

With the holiday season approaching, Minecraft 26.4 is right around the corner, and its latest Snapshot has introduced Snow Bricks as a new building block. It comes in three additional variants, all of which can be crafted with Snow Blocks. These can be used to create ice-themed mini-games, custom challenges, and winter structures such as castles and igloos. What’s more, Snow Bricks don’t melt and have a unique interaction with Sulfur Cubes.

FAQs

Can you craft Snow Bricks in Minecraft?

You can craft Snow Bricks in Minecraft with x4 Snow Blocks when arranged in a 2×2 pattern on a Crafting Table. This gives you four Snow Bricks.

How many Snow Blocks do you need to make Snow Bricks?

You require x4 Snow Blocks to craft Snow Bricks in Minecraft.

Can you find Snow Bricks naturally in Minecraft?

No, you won’t be able to find Snow Bricks naturally in Minecraft. They can only be crafted.

Do Snow Bricks melt in Minecraft?

Snow Bricks do not melt in Minecraft, even when exposed to sunlight or placed in different biomes in Minecraft.

Can you make Snow Bricks in Minecraft Bedrock Edition?

Yes, Snow Bricks can also be crafted in the latest Minecraft Bedrock Edition.

title.rendered: M6 vs M5 MacBook Pro: Same price, 2nm chip, no OLED. Should you upgrade?

content.rendered:
Apple has upgraded the MacBook Pro with its new M6 chip, bringing a 2nm processor, a 12-core CPU and GPU, improved AI performance, Wi-Fi 7, and Bluetooth 6. However, the upgrade isn’t as exciting as it sounds.

The new 14-inch MacBook Pro retains the familiar mini-LED display, same design, and 24-hour battery rating, with no OLED or touchscreen. So, is the M6 worth upgrading to from the M5? I’d say M5 owners can skip this generation, while M1 and M2 users have more reasons to make the switch.

Here’s everything that changed between the M6 and M5 MacBook Pro, including performance, AI, display, battery life, pricing, and whether you should buy it.

M6 vs M5 MacBook Pro: Quick specs comparison

At first glance, the M6 MacBook Pro looks familiar. The real differences are inside, particularly the processor, graphics, Neural Engine, memory bandwidth, and wireless connectivity.

Here’s how the two 14-inch models compare.

The biggest differences are that Apple has added two CPU cores, two GPU cores, a more capable Neural Engine, and faster wireless connectivity. However, the M6 also costs more than the M5’s 1TB launch price, which was later increased to $1,999.

Does the M6 MacBook Pro have OLED or a touchscreen?

This is probably the biggest disappointment for anyone expecting a complete MacBook Pro makeover.

The standard M6 MacBook Pro continues to use Apple’s 14.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR mini-LED display. There’s no OLED panel, touchscreen functionality, or Dynamic Island. Apple has retained the traditional MacBook Pro display experience instead of making the visual changes many users have requested.

Apple also introduced a higher-end MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR display, which uses tandem OLED technology and adds touchscreen support and Dynamic Island. See how the PROLED XDR display compares with mini-LED.

Apple has effectively separated its MacBook Pro lineup into two different upgrade paths. The standard M6 is for people who prioritize processing power and AI, while the more expensive PROLED model targets people who want a redesigned display and touch interaction.

If you’re curious about Apple’s first touchscreen Mac, check out our detailed coverage of the touchscreen MacBook Pro and its new features.

My take? If OLED and touchscreen support are your priorities, don’t buy the standard M6 expecting a software update to bring them later.

Design and display: What stayed the same?

Apple hasn’t redesigned the standard 14-inch MacBook Pro for 2026. You still get the familiar aluminum chassis, 14.2-inch display with 3024 × 1964 resolution, up to 1,600 nits peak HDR brightness, and 120Hz ProMotion. The optional nano-texture finish is also available. Space Black and Silver remain the color choices.

Apple has retained the 12MP Center Stage camera, six-speaker system, three Thunderbolt 4 ports, HDMI, SDXC card slot, and MagSafe 3 charging.

In other words, if you place the M5 and M6 models side by side, you won’t find many visual reasons to choose one over the other.

If you enjoy customizing your Mac, check out these MacBook Pro PROLED XDR wallpapers.

M6 chip vs M5 chip: How much faster is it?

This is where the M6 MacBook Pro actually earns its name. Apple has moved to its first 2nm chip, improving processing power, graphics, and energy efficiency.

The M6 uses a 2nm manufacturing process, compared with the M5’s 3nm technology. Moving to a smaller process allows Apple to fit more transistors into a chip while improving performance and power efficiency.

The CPU has also received a significant upgrade. The M5 has a 10-core CPU, while the M6 moves to 12 cores, consisting of:

  • 2 super cores for demanding single-threaded tasks.
  • 4 performance cores for intensive workloads.
  • 6 efficiency cores for everyday tasks and background processes.

The GPU also increases from 10 to 12 cores. Each GPU core includes a Neural Accelerator, helping accelerate AI-related graphics workloads. Apple has additionally introduced third-generation Dynamic Caching and an updated ray-tracing engine.

If you’re interested in how Apple arrived at this architecture, our guide to the history of Mac processors provides a useful look at the evolution from Intel processors to Apple Silicon.

Apple claims the M6 delivers:

  • Up to 30% faster graphics performance compared with M5.
  • Up to 25% faster on-device AI workloads like LLM prompt processing.
  • Up to 1.3x faster performance in Xcode and Blender compared with M5.
  • Up to 2.5x faster Xcode performance compared with the 13-inch M1 MacBook Pro.
  • Up to 11.7x faster graphics performance compared with the 13-inch M1 MacBook Pro.

For video editing, compiling code, 3D projects, or graphics-intensive games, the extra CPU and GPU resources could make a meaningful difference.

However, I wouldn’t recommend upgrading to an M6 purely because Apple advertises 30% faster graphics. The M5 is already capable, and the difference won’t necessarily be noticeable during everyday browsing, document editing, or streaming.

Neural Engine and Apple Intelligence: What the 32-Core NPU changes

Apple is clearly making AI a bigger part of its Mac strategy, and the M6 reflects that direction.

The M5 features a 16-core Neural Engine, while the M6 introduces a Dual 16-core Neural Engine architecture. This gives the new chip substantially more dedicated AI processing capacity.

Apple claims the Neural Engine delivers up to 1.9x faster performance than M5. The overall chip also delivers up to 25% faster on-device AI workloads. For large language models, Apple reports up to 1.3x faster time-to-first-token compared with M5.

What does it mean in everyday use? Developers experimenting with local LLMs, creative professionals using AI image tools, and people who regularly work with AI-powered applications can run demanding AI models directly on their Mac.

The M6 MacBook Pro also ships with macOS 27 Golden Gate, which brings Apple’s newer AI experiences and system improvements.

I think the Neural Engine upgrade will matter more over the next few years than for today’s everyday tasks. If Apple continues expanding on-device AI, the additional processing capacity could become increasingly useful.

Memory and storage: A small bandwidth bump

Apple hasn’t increased the standard memory or storage capacity with M6. The base configuration still offers 16GB of unified memory and 1TB of SSD storage. You can configure the laptop with up to 32GB of memory and 4TB of storage.

The improvement comes from memory bandwidth.

Important: The 170GB/s bandwidth is available only with the 24GB and 32GB configurations. The entry-level 16GB model retains 153GB/s.

If my work involves video editing, AI software, major development tasks, or running several resource-intensive applications simultaneously, the 24GB option would suit me best. It gives you additional memory headroom and higher bandwidth.

For everyday users, however, the standard 16GB model should still handle typical productivity tasks comfortably.

Connectivity: Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and Thread support arrive

Connectivity is another area where the M6 MacBook Pro receives a meaningful upgrade.

Apple replaces the previous wireless connectivity setup with its N1 wireless chip. The M5 supports Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3, while the M6 moves to Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, alongside Thread support.

Here’s what that means:

  • Wi-Fi 7: Offers improved wireless performance, lower latency, and better network efficiency. You’ll need a compatible Wi-Fi 7 router to use its capabilities.
  • Bluetooth 6: Brings newer wireless connectivity capabilities for compatible accessories.
  • Thread: Adds support for a low-power networking technology used by compatible smart-home devices.

Apple has also improved external display support. The M6 can drive two external 4K displays at up to 165Hz, compared with 144Hz on the M5.

I particularly like the addition of Wi-Fi 7 because it makes the M6 more future-ready. But if your existing router only supports Wi-Fi 6 or 6E, then you should not expect any drastic gains in internet speed simply by buying the new MacBook.

Battery life and charging: No major change on paper

Both models are rated for up to 24 hours of battery life. Apple describes the M6 MacBook Pro as offering the longest battery life ever in a Mac, but it didn’t provide a directly comparable breakdown of video streaming and wireless web browsing in its launch announcement.

The published figures for the M6 and M5 include up to 24 hours of video streaming and 16 hours of wireless web browsing, backed by a 72.4Wh battery.

Charging is familiar, too. The M6 supports fast charging, reaching up to 50% in approximately 30 minutes with a compatible higher-wattage adapter, such as Apple’s 96W USB-C power adapter. The standard M6 box includes a 70W adapter.

However, I would like to test the battery myself before calling the M6 the winner. Apple’s improved power efficiency sounds promising, but advertised battery life and real-world battery life aren’t always the same thing.

M6 vs M5 MacBook Pro price: Same price, and the M5 is gone

Here’s where the comparison becomes interesting.

The M6 MacBook Pro starts at $1,999 in the US, with an education price of $1,899. However, the M5’s pricing changed during its lifecycle, so the two models didn’t actually have the same starting price throughout their availability.

Apple subsequently discontinued the standard M5 model when introducing the M6. This means the M6 matches the M5’s later $1,999 price point, although it costs more than the M5’s earlier 1TB starting price.

M6 MacBook Pro price in India

For Indian buyers, Apple starts the M6 MacBook Pro at ₹2,39,900.

Here’s the configuration-wise pricing:

Additional costs:

  • Nano-texture display: ₹18,000.
  • Education pricing for the base model: ₹2,27,900.

These are Apple’s listed Indian prices, before applicable retailer promotions or bank offers.

My recommendation is to keep an eye on discounted M5 inventory and Apple Certified Refurbished units. If you can find an M5 with 1TB storage at a much lower price than $1,999, it could offer better value, particularly if you don’t need Wi-Fi 7 or the additional AI performance.

Should you upgrade to the M6 MacBook Pro?

Now for the question that matters most: should you buy the M6 MacBook Pro or wait for the next model?

I wouldn’t give everyone the same recommendation. Your current MacBook and the kind of work you do matter much more than Apple’s generation number.

If you own an M5 MacBook Pro

I wouldn’t recommend upgrading.

You already have a powerful processor, a capable GPU, a beautiful display, and excellent battery life. The M6 improves performance and wireless connectivity, but the overall experience won’t change much.

Consider upgrading only if you specifically need Wi-Fi 7, higher memory bandwidth, or additional AI processing capacity.

If you own an M3 or M4 MacBook Pro

The M6 is worth considering if your workload has become more demanding. Developers, video editors, and people working with AI applications could benefit from the additional processing capacity.

However, if your M3 or M4 MacBook Pro still handles your work comfortably, there’s little reason to rush into buying another laptop.

For M1 or M2 MacBook Pro users

This is where I’d seriously consider the M6.

You’ll get a newer CPU architecture, improved graphics, significantly more AI processing capacity, and modern wireless connectivity. Apple also claims substantial performance improvements over the M1 generation.

If you’re buying your first MacBook Pro

I’d choose based on your priorities:

  • Buy the M6 MacBook Pro if you want the latest standard Apple Silicon chip, Wi-Fi 7, and better AI performance.
  • Consider a discounted M5 if you want to save money and don’t need the latest connectivity.
  • Choose the PROLED model if OLED, touchscreen support, and the redesigned display are important to you.

If you’re planning to buy other Apple devices this year, you can also track upcoming Apple products in 2026 before deciding.

M6 vs M5 MacBook Pro: My final buying verdict

The M6 MacBook Pro is a worthwhile generational improvement, but it isn’t a must-have upgrade for everyone.

What I find interesting is Apple’s decision to prioritize processing power and AI capabilities without changing the standard MacBook Pro’s design. The 2nm chip, faster GPU, Dual 16-core Neural Engine, and Wi-Fi 7 make the M6 more capable, but the lack of OLED and touchscreen support means you need to go for the more expensive PROLED model.

Here’s how I’d make the decision:

My pick for most new buyers: M6 MacBook Pro with 24GB memory and 1TB storage. It’s a sensible middle ground for people who want additional memory headroom for creative work and AI applications.

title.rendered: Poppy Secret Run in Fortnite: Map code, what it is, and how to play it

content.rendered:
An intriguing aspect of Fortnite is that it is also a sandbox platform, such as Roblox, for others to make their own games. Thanks to that, there is an increasingly diverse variety of games or experiences within Epic’s online multiplayer title that players can indulge in.

Poppy Secret Run is one such unique game that offers something entirely different. It revolves around the player character going through an obstacle course, with its own set of rules and objectives, while intertwining the gameplay with American singer Poppy’s music that doesn’t just play in the background but also has visual elements modeled around it.

What is Poppy Secret Run?

Poppy Secret Run is a music-themed platform game in which players navigate an obstacle course while collecting clock-like items. The route includes jumping over pits, sliding beneath fallen beams, and moving between surfaces without falling.

The map code is 3416-2408-7383. The experience is available on PC and consoles until November 23, 2026, so make sure to try it before it leaves Fortnite.

At the start, players choose between The Light and The Dark. That choice changes the world they move through and determines which ending they receive. The final section may also include a challenge in which players dodge incoming projectiles.

After completing the course, players can see their score and its position on the leaderboard.

How can I play Poppy Secret Run?

So long as you are on PC, PlayStation or Xbox, you can simply follow the steps below to dive straight into Poppy Secret Run.

  1. Open Fortnite and select Discover using the magnifying-glass icon.
  2. Select the search box and enter 3416-2408-7383.
  3. Choose Poppy Secret Run from the search results.
  4. Next, this particular Fortnite map’s page will load; hit the Select button here.
  5. Once the map loads, select Play to start.

Who is Poppy Secret Run for?

Poppy Secret Run may appeal to players who enjoy quick platforming challenges and prefer an experience they can finish in one session. Its course combines jumping, sliding, collecting items, and avoiding hazards.

The map is built around Poppy’s “Time Will Tell,” which makes it especially appealing to her fans and to players who enjoy music-themed experiences.

FAQs

Can I play Poppy Secret Run in Fortnite for free?

Yes, the full Poppy Secret Run experience is available for free in Fortnite.

Is Poppy Secret Run a rhythm-based game?

No. Even though it features Poppy’s ‘Time Will Tell’ as the background music and carries an aesthetic component inspired by the song, it doesn’t require you to time your gameplay actions to a rhythm or tune like rhythm-based games do. It is simply a platform game with licensed music playing throughout the levels.

Can I get a Poppy skin in Fortnite?

No, that’s not an option since this collab is limited to the Poppy Secret Run map and no cosmetics are involved.

title.rendered: Apple’s next touchscreen MacBook Pro could get M7 Pro and M7 Max in 2027

content.rendered:
Apple has barely introduced its first touchscreen MacBook Pro models, but it’s already preparing their successors. According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, Apple is developing next-generation touchscreen models with M7 Pro and M7 Max chips for 2027, with new hardware capabilities aimed particularly at artificial intelligence workloads.

Interestingly, Apple could also introduce a redesigned entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro, bringing the thinner chassis and slimmer display bezels of its premium models to a more affordable option.

M7 Pro and M7 Max chips could focus on AI

The biggest highlight of Apple’s upcoming MacBook Pro lineup could be its new M7 Pro and M7 Max processors. These chips are expected to introduce additional hardware capabilities to handle demanding on-device AI workloads more efficiently.

Apple hasn’t shared any technical details about the M7 chip family yet, so it’s unclear exactly how much faster these processors will be compared to the current M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, which power the first touchscreen models Apple unveiled on October 28.

We covered earlier that Apple could skip the M6 Pro and M6 Max generations entirely and move directly from the M5 Pro and M5 Max to the M7 lineup. If accurate, this would mark a notable change in Apple’s usual processor upgrade cycle.

Entry-level MacBook Pro could get a redesign

Apple is also reportedly developing a new 14-inch MacBook Pro, codenamed K104, powered by the standard M7 chip.

This upcoming version is expected to adopt the thinner and lighter chassis introduced with Apple’s redesigned touchscreen MacBook Pro lineup. It should also feature slimmer display bezels, in line with previous leaks.

However, it’s unclear whether this model will get premium features such as an OLED display and touchscreen support. Apple could continue using its Liquid Retina XDR display to maintain a clear distinction between the standard and premium MacBook Pro models.

M7 MacBook Pro models launch timeline

According to the report, Apple’s high-end MacBook Pro models featuring M7 Pro and M7 Max chips could arrive toward the end of 2027. The entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro with the standard M7 chip is also expected next year, possibly as early as the first half of 2027, as per the leaked 2027 roadmap.

Apple hasn’t officially confirmed these plans.

If the reports are accurate, 2027 could be an interesting year for MacBook buyers. Alongside improved AI performance, Apple could make its redesigned MacBook Pro more accessible with a refreshed entry-level model.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the Coco Guitar and the Alebrije Guitar are one and the same thing. While the former refers to the item using the name of the movie in which it appears, the latter relies on the name of the motif that the item sports for the same purpose.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest VV Ultimatum Codes on November 20, 2026

There are tons of Bleach-inspired games on Roblox, but if there’s one that’s a must-try, it’s VV: ULTIMATUM! You can choose between three factions: Shinigami, Quincy, and Hollow, each with their own unique abilities, quests, and progression paths.

Your goal is to level up, unlock powerful transformations, and fight against other players. However, in order to be ahead of the competition, you need the best abilities and builds, which is only possible with Rerolls. So, here’s a list of the active VV: ULTIMATUM codes which help you unlock a bunch of freebies!

All working VV ULTIMATUM codes

  • sheep44: Tokens and Ability Rerolls (NEW)
  • happyhallovveen: Tokens and Ability Rerolls (NEW)
  • checkmailbox: Tokens and Ability Rerolls (NEW)
  • CLANS: Tokens and Ability Rerolls (NEW)
  • ARTHEMISTBDAY: 21 Ability Rerolls, 21 Ability Variant Rerolls, 21 Reiotsu Color Token, 21 Whetstone, and 21 Accessory Token (NEW)
  • 215KLIKES: 5 Ability Rerolls, 5 Clan Rerolls, and 5 Experimental Hogyoku Shards
  • BUILDPOINTS: Built Reset Token
  • SORRYFORCODEBUG: 5x Experimental Hogyoky Shards and 5x Ability Rerolls
  • SHUNKOSATURDAY: Tokens and Ability Rerolls
  • BANKAIONTHEWAY: Tokens and Ability Rerolls
  • GOODMORNING: Tokens and Ability Rerolls
  • SORRY4DELAY: Tokens and Ability Rerolls
  • LINI_MOZZARELLA: 10 Ability Rerolls
  • UPD2: Mythical Reset Token, and 20 Ability Rerolls
  • WNasko: 10 Ability Rerolls, 10 Experminetal Hogyoku Shard, and 10 Ability Variant Rerolls
  • HOLLOVVEEN: 30 Clan Rerolls, 15 Ability Rerolls, 5 Experimental Hogyoku Shards, 10 Ability Variant Rerolls, 1 Build Reset Token, 10 Reiatsu Color Tokens, 15 Theme Tokens
  • latenight: 30 Clan Rerolls
  • 205KLIKES: 5x Ability Reroll, 5x Clan Reroll, and 5x Experimental Hogyoku Shard

Currently, these are the only active VV ULTIMATUM codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired VV ULTIMATUM codes

100KLIKES, 140KLIKES, 160KLIKES, 30KLIKES, 35ROLLS, 75KLIKES, DAY1, FEWREROLLS, FULLRELEASE, MIDVVEEK, MINIUPDATE, SDFIX, SHUTDOWNFIX, UPDATE1

    How to redeem VV ULTIMATUM codes?

    Do you finally know the codes? Well, now it’s time to learn how to redeem VV: ULTIMATUM codes. Before you begin, you need to first finish the ‘Humble Beginnings’ questline. After you’ve done that, make sure to join the Midnight Continent Roblox community. Once that’s done, here’s a step-by-step process on how to redeem the codes:

    1. Launch VV: ULTIMATUM on Roblox.
    2. Wait for the lobby to load and complete the short tutorial.
    3. Click on the Shop icon in the top left corner.
    4. Choose the Codes option and hit Verify in the Join the group section.
    5. Paste a working code and hit Redeem to claim your reward.

    Once you’ve redeemed the codes, the rewards should be added to your inventory automatically.

    Why aren’t my VV ULTIMATUM codes working?

    Are your VV: ULTIMATUM codes not working? Well, double-check that you’ve entered them exactly as listed above. Keep in mind that these codes are case-sensitive, so make sure there are no extra spaces before or after them.

    You can simply copy and paste the codes directly from our list. If a code still doesn’t work, it might have expired, or you may have already redeemed its rewards.

    How to get more VV ULTIMATUM codes

    The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new VV: ULTIMATUM codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, bug fixes, or community milestones.

    To stay updated, you can:

    • Join the official Discord server: Visit the VV: ULTIMATUM Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
    • Follow the Roblox game page: Check the game’s official Roblox page and the developer’s community for updates, announcements, and potential code releases.
    • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new VV: ULTIMATUM codes become available, so you can easily find the latest rewards in one place.

    If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Anime Galaxies codes, Build a Phone Empire codes and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

    FAQs

    What factions can you choose in VV: ULTIMATUM?

    In VV: ULTIMATUM, there are multiple factions to choose from: Shinigami, Quincy and Hollow. Each of them determines which side your character belongs to and how you are going to progress.

    How do you unlock special abilities in VV: ULTIMATUM?

    VV: ULTIMATUM allows you to get your hands on special abilities by progressing through your faction’s storyline, reaching certain level requirements, completing quests, and defeating specific bosses.

    Does VV: ULTIMATUM have codes?

    VV: ULTIMATUM has active codes that can give you free rerolls, ability rerolls, Build Reset Tokens, and other rewards.
