title.rendered: Apple reportedly plans three new iPads for 2027, including OLED iPad Air

content.rendered:
Following the recent introduction of the OLED iPad mini, Apple is reportedly preparing three more iPad models for the first half of 2027. According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, the tech giant is working on a new entry-level iPad, an upgraded iPad Air, and a next-generation iPad Pro.

The upcoming releases could bring some significant improvements across Apple’s tablet lineup, including an OLED display for the iPad Air, a faster chip for the standard iPad, and a new vapor chamber cooling system for the iPad Pro. Here’s what we know so far about Apple’s reported iPad plans for 2027.

OLED display could finally arrive on the iPad Air

According to Gurman, Apple plans to bring OLED technology to the iPad Air, after adding it to the recently launched iPad mini. This would be a notable upgrade over the current Liquid Retina LCD display, offering deeper blacks, better contrast, and more vibrant colors.

However, it may retain a 60Hz refresh rate instead of adopting 120Hz ProMotion technology and may also continue using Touch ID rather than switching to Face ID, as we have seen in the latest iPad mini.

Gurman didn’t name the processor for the upcoming model, but a move from the current M4 chip to an M5 chip is expected. The display upgrade could also make the iPad Air more expensive. The base 11-inch model, which already costs $749 after Apple’s June price increase, might cost somewhere between $799 and $899.

Entry-level iPad could finally support Apple Intelligence

Apple is also reportedly preparing an update to its most affordable iPad, which hasn’t received a major refresh since early 2025.

Based on earlier reports, the biggest upgrade could be Apple’s A19 chip, paired with 8GB of RAM, potentially bringing Apple Intelligence support. The current entry-level model lacks support for Apple’s AI features, making this a meaningful upgrade for users who don’t want to spend more on an iPad Air or iPad Pro.

Apart from the processor, the new iPad is also rumored to include Apple’s N1 wireless networking chip, which is expected to bring Wi-Fi 7 support. Cellular models may feature the C1X modem for improved connectivity and power efficiency.

Don’t expect a major design overhaul, though. According to current reports, Apple does not plan any design or display upgrade for this model. However, refreshed color options could be introduced.

iPad Pro could get vapor chamber cooling

The next iPad Pro might focus more on performance improvements than external design changes.

According to Gurman, Apple plans to introduce a vapor chamber cooling system in its next-generation iPad Pro to maintain better performance during intensive tasks, including gaming, video editing, and AI processing. Apple has already introduced this technology in its iPhone 17 Pro lineup to improve heat dissipation during demanding workloads.

As for the processor, the next iPad Pro is expected to move beyond the current M5 generation. While the M6 chip is a likely candidate, Apple could potentially use an M7 chip instead.

No other major hardware changes have been reported so far. Considering that the iPad Pro received a significant redesign with its OLED display in 2024, Apple may focus primarily on internal improvements for its next refresh.

When will Apple launch the new iPads?

According to Gurman’s report, Apple is planning to introduce all three models during the first half of 2027.

That means we could see the new entry-level iPad, iPad Air, and iPad Pro arrive sometime between January and June next year. However, Apple hasn’t announced an official launch schedule or confirmed any of these devices.

The reports also suggest that Apple isn’t currently planning major iPad refreshes for the second half of 2027, unless its existing launch plans change.

title.rendered: Terrifier returns to Fortnite: How to get the Art the Clown skin

content.rendered:
The Terrifier horror movie franchise has returned to Fortnite, with the Art the Clown skin heading its content lineup. It was originally released in October 2025, during the previous year’s Fortnitemares event, and was last seen in the Item Shop earlier in June this year (during Chapter 7 Season 3).

While Art the Clown—as an individual purchase—is priced at 1,500 V-Bucks, it can also be bought as part of the Art the Clown Bundle, which comes in at 2,200 V-Bucks. All these items inspired by the 2016 slasher flick will stay in the Shop tab until November 2, 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET. So, those of you eyeing the same only have a few days to go for it using the steps given below.

How to get the Art the Clown skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab.
  2. Next, head down to the Terrifier section and select Art the Clown.
  3. Lastly, press and hold the Purchase button to complete your transaction.

All Art the Clown Bundle items in Fortnite

1. Art the Clown

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Art the Clown Bundle

Players can don the guise of the sinister clown from the Terrifier franchise and leverage his intimidating look versus other Fortnite players.

2. Cutlery Club pickaxe and back bling

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Art the Clown Bundle

It is a pack that contains two different items: Terrifier-inspired back bling and pickaxe. These items are only available either as a pair or in the bundle. In other words, you can’t purchase just the back bling or just the pickaxe.

3. Horn ‘n Hacksaw emote

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Art the Clown Bundle

This emote combines two essentials from Art the Clown’s inventory, the hacksaw and the bike horn.

4. Clown Attack wrap

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Art the Clown Bundle

This classic black-and-white aesthetic flaunts a clown insignia, incorporating Art the Clown’s colors into your weapons.

Art the Clown skin’s Fortnite Shop history

According to Fortnite.gg, Art the Clown has been rotated into the Item Shop every 2-3 months since its introduction last year. It has had a total of three different runs, excluding the current one. Before October 30, it last went up for grabs on June 16, in other words, 136 days ago. The table below shows all of its stints so far, in reverse-chronological order, and the important data behind them.

Art the Clown Bundle: Worth it or not?

Art the Clown isn’t the only horror-themed clown skin in Fortnite’s catalog, with Jack the Clown-which itself went up for sale earlier in October— also tagging along in the same category. However, the unsettling monochrome aesthetic that the Terrifier antagonist possesses is something unique of its own.

Unlike other Fortnite collaboration skins priced at 1,500 V-Bucks, Art the Clown doesn’t include a back bling, emote, or another bonus cosmetic when purchased on its own. The Art the Clown Bundle costs 2,200 V-Bucks and includes five cosmetics, making it a better-value option if you want the additional items.

So, if you are going to purchase this skin anyway, you should seriously consider upgrading your cart to include the Art the Clown Bundle instead. On the other hand, for those of you who are on a budget and are confused about which 1,500 V-Buck skin they should choose, it’s better to pick any other one that comes with a free item and hence offers better value for money than the Art the Clown skin.

title.rendered: Fortnite Treasure Hunters Battle Pass: One Piece skins and more revealed

content.rendered:
Fan anticipation surrounding Fortnite Treasure Hunters, which kicks off on November 1, 2026, has been mounting over the past couple of weeks, especially thanks to its highly awaited collab with One Piece. Recently, the game officially revealed images and a teaser, shedding light on the various new skins, including those based on fan-favorite characters from the manga-turned-anime, that are going to join the upcoming mini-season.

With the One Piece chest already sitting on Fortnite’s Battle Royale map, there is little time left until a change of theme takes over the game. Downtime for update v43.00 is expected to begin at 2 AM ET (11 PM PT on October 31), with the new season going live once servers return. As such, we now have a firm understanding of which One Piece characters are rolling out in the game, which other IPs are getting Fortnite cosmetics, and what the Battle Pass is seemingly set to feature.

Once the mini-season is live, use our guide to find all nine Fortnite Treasure Hunters vault locations across the Battle Royale island.

What’s in the Fortnite Treasure Hunters Battle Pass?

On October 28, Fortnite revealed its key art for the Treasure Hunters mini-season, which features all anime-style skins bar one, as shown in the image below. Since this type of promotional art has often acted as a glimpse of the respective season’s Battle Pass content, the community is reading it the same way this time around as well.

With that said, the Fortnite Treasure Hunters Battle Pass characters shown here, in clockwise order, are:

  • Captain X
  • Ace
  • Cuddle Team Leader (remix skin)
  • Jonesy (remix skin)
  • Charlotte (remix skin)
  • Nico Robin

Fortnite x One Piece crossover: All confirmed characters and items

Across the various promotional pictures and videos, several different One Piece characters have been confirmed. These range from main leads such as Luffy to other fan favorites such as Ace.

1. Monkey D. Luffy

2. Roronoa Zoro

3. Nami

4. Usopp

5. Vinsmoke Sanji

6. Portgas D. Ace

7. Buggy

Nico Robin, revealed through the Battle Pass key art, brings the One Piece lineup to eight characters.

Apart from skins modeled on them, a few of these One Piece characters are apparently also getting their own Mythic items, drawn from the franchise’s lore, in Fortnite. The items spotted in the teasers so far include Luffy’s Gum-Gum abilities, a Zoro sword Mythic and Usopp’s Slingshot, along with a tangerine healing item.

In addition, a few visual revamps, such as One Piece-themed POIs in Battle Royale, are also depicted in the media released so far. Interestingly, the intimidating Sea King from the highly rated anime, called Lord of the Coast, may also appear in some capacity.

More collab skins in Fortnite Treasure Hunters

While One Piece is basically headlining the Treasure Hunters season, collabs with other IPs are set to land during the same period. These partnerships involve famous virtual singers Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto. The former will be getting a unique pirate-themed skin in the game, whereas the latter will be making her Fortnite debut.

It’s not just virtual celebs and fictional characters that make up the noteworthy collabs coming to Fortnite in the coming weeks. Real-world, chart-topping rappers A$AP Rocky and Lil Uzi Vert are also confirmed to get their own Fortnite skins in the Treasure Hunters mini-season.

See the Lil Uzi Vert skins, cosmetics, and bundle prices for the full lineup.

IShowSpeed also joined the mini-season with a pirate-themed outfit inspired by One Piece. See how to get the Pirate Speedy skin.

For what is expected to be a short season, Fortnite Treasure Hunters is looking reasonably packed with crossover cosmetics and other in-game makeovers. So far, the fan excitement around the One Piece-led update has been impressive. It now rests on Epic Games to show whether it can turn this positive hype into strong momentum and boost Fortnite’s player engagement.

FAQs

When does Fortnite Treasure Hunters end?

No official end date has been confirmed for Fortnite Treasure Hunters so far. But given that it’s a mini-season and most of them last roughly a month, players should expect it to be over around late November or the first week of December.

Is Luffy in the Battle Pass?

No, Luffy doesn’t appear in the key art, which often foretells who is in the Battle Pass. However, you can expect Luffy to be available via the Item Shop.

How much is the Treasure Hunters Battle Pass?

Similar to recent Battle Passes, the One Piece-themed mini-season’s Battle Pass is expected to cost 800 V-Bucks (the $8.99 V-Bucks pack), though Epic hasn’t listed the price yet.

Will One Piece skins be in the Item Shop?

Yes. Since only Ace and Nico Robin appear in the Battle Pass key art, the remaining One Piece skins are almost certain to be sold via the Item Shop.

title.rendered: Anime Galaxies codes (November 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Anime Galaxies Codes on November 07, 2026

In the mood for some tower defense action? It’s time to check out Anime Galaxies on Roblox! The game lets you summon characters from your favorite anime universes, build a powerful team, and defend your base against waves of enemies.

However, putting together a strong team requires more than just collecting units. You’ll also need resources to improve their stats, unlock better traits, and prepare them for tougher battles. That’s where Anime Galaxies codes come in handy. Redeem them for free Gems, Stat Tokens, Trait Crystals, Event Capsules, and other rewards to strengthen your squad.

All working Anime Galaxies codes

  • GOLDENDICE: 500 Rainbow Stars and 10 Event Capsules ( NEW , requires level 25)
  • CRYSTALGIFT: 500 Rainbow Stars and 10 Event Capsules ( NEW , requires level 25)
  • STARSHOWER: 500 Rainbow Stars and 10 Event Capsules ( NEW , requires level 25)
  • UPDATESOON: 500 Rainbow Stars and 10 Event Capsules ( NEW , requires level 25)
  • UPDATE05: 500 Rainbow Stars and 10 Event Capsules ( NEW , requires level 25)
  • INVITATION2: 500 Rainbow Stars and 10 Event Capsules ( NEW , requires level 25)
  • INVITED: Free Muzan Invitation (requires level 100)
  • 3KCCU: 500 Rainbow Stars and 10 Event Capsules (requires level 25)
  • 2KCCU: 500 Rainbow Stars and 10 Event Capsules (requires level 25)
  • GALAXYEVENT: 10 Event Capsules (requires level 25)
  • GALAXYGEMS: 2,000 Gems, 5 Stat Tokens, 25 Trait Crystals, and 3 Stat Locks (requires level 25)
  • 1KLIKES: 1,000 Gems, 30 Stat Tokens, 150 Trait Crystals, and 20 Stat Locks
  • 100KVIS: 2,000 Gems, 100 Trait Crystals, and 20 Stat Tokens
  • 1KFAV: 1,500 Gems, 100 Trait Crystals, and 20 Stat Locks
  • 1KCCU: 2,500 Gems, 100 Trait Crystals, and 20 Stat Tokens
  • RELEASE: 1,500 Gems, 50 Trait Crystals, and 10 Stat Tokens

Currently, these are the only active Anime Galaxies codes that can be claimed. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired Anime Galaxies Codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem Anime Galaxies codes in Roblox

Finally got the codes? Well, now let’s take a look at how to redeem Anime Galaxies codes in Roblox!

  1. Open Anime Galaxies on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load and complete the short tutorial.
  3. Head to the CODES Fountain.
  4. Paste a working code and hit Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the codes, the rewards should be added to your inventory automatically.

    Why aren’t my Anime Galaxies codes working?

    Are your Anime Galaxies codes not working? Well, double-check that you’ve entered them exactly as listed above. Keep in mind that these codes are case-sensitive, so make sure there are no extra spaces before or after them.

    You can simply copy and paste the codes directly from our list. If a code still doesn’t work, it might have expired, or you may have already redeemed its rewards.

    How to get more Anime Galaxies codes

    The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new Anime Galaxies codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, bug fixes, or community milestones.

    To stay updated, you can:

    • Join the official Discord server: Visit the Anime Galaxies Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
    • Follow the Roblox game page: Check the game’s official Roblox page and the developer Champions TD community for updates, announcements, and potential code releases.
    • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new Anime Galaxies codes become available, so you can easily find the latest rewards in one place.

    If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Cat Battles Codes, Build a Phone Empire codes and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

    FAQs

    How do you get new units in Anime Galaxies?

    In order to get new units in Anime Galaxies, you need to summon characters with the help of banners using Gems. These banners have a number of different character rarities.

    Does Anime Galaxies have different game modes?

    Anime Galaxies has several different game modes, each offering different challenges and rewards. There are Story, Nightmare, Challenges, Endless, Raids, and Portals modes.

    Can you evolve units in Anime Galaxies?

    You can evolve units in Anime Galaxies into stronger forms and improve their stats, damage output, and abilities.

title.rendered: Best iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max accessories: The ones worth buying

content.rendered:
Getting a new iPhone is definitely fun, but finding the right accessories can be daunting. From protective cases and screen protectors to fast chargers and power banks, you have many options to pick from.

Apple released the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max in Black, Silver, Glacier, and Burgundy, and both get the most out of Qi2.2 25W wireless chargers and AVS-compatible wall adapters. In this guide, I’ll cover the best iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max accessories worth considering, so you can find the ones that fit your needs without wasting money on things you don’t really need.

How I choose the best iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max accessories

I wouldn’t choose an iPhone accessory based on its marketing claims alone. Start by identifying a specific problem you want it to solve.

Here are five criteria to narrow down the options:

  • Protection: Pick accessories that will save your iPhone from everyday scratches, accidental drops, and other common mishaps.
  • Convenience: Make sure it makes everyday tasks easier, such as charging, taking photos, or navigating while driving.
  • Portability: I always pick compact ones that I can carry without adding unnecessary bulk.
  • Compatibility: Check whether it works with the right iPhone model, your case thickness, and the required power output.
  • Value for money: Does it offer a useful advantage over a less expensive alternative?

I also consider how each accessory fits into a larger setup. A magnetic case, wireless charging stand, and magnetic power bank can work together to create a convenient charging system.

With that in mind, here are the products I’d consider buying for the iPhone 18 Pro or 18 Pro Max.

Best iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max cases

A good case should protect your iPhone without hiding its design or making it uncomfortable to hold. Here are my iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max case picks, from crystal-clear finishes to practical kickstand designs.

  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Clear Case: Pick this one to show off your new burgundy iPhone. It provides good everyday protection and MagSafe compatibility. The anti-yellowing claim is appealing, although I’d still expect some wear over time.
  • FNTCASE Matte Translucent Magnetic Case: Glossy clear cases aren’t for everyone, so here’s a matte alternative. It’s only 0.7mm slim but still offers solid drop protection. I like its grippy anti-slip texture on the sides and its understated look.
  • TORRAS O3 Kickstand Case: A built-in kickstand is useful for propping up your phone while watching videos or joining calls. TORRAS has added a 360° rotating ring stand with built-in magnets for MagSafe support.

Best iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max screen protectors

Scratches, glare, and unwanted onlookers can spoil your experience with the iPhone. These screen protectors offer different benefits, whether you prefer easy installation, a matte finish, or added privacy.

  • Spigen GlasTR EZ Fit Screen Protector: This is my practical pick for anyone who wants an easy screen protector installation. Its high-alumina silicate tempered glass is tougher than standard tempered glass, and the oleophobic layer keeps fingerprints at bay.
  • TORRAS OrigArmor Anti-glare Screen Protector: If screen reflections annoy you more than a slight drop in display clarity, this 3D curved matte protector deserves a spot on your iPhone 18 Pro accessories list.
  • JETech Privacy Screen Protector: Consider this one if you regularly check work messages or banking apps in public spaces. Since I use my phone mostly indoors, I’d prefer a traditional clear protector.

Best charging adapters and cables

A reliable charging setup saves time and makes everyday life easier. I’ve shortlisted compact chargers, versatile GaN adapters, and convenient cables for home, work, and travel.

  • UGREEN Nexode Air GaN Charger: This compact charger with foldable prongs is ideal for everyday carry. It delivers up to 65W, supports the AVS protocol for faster iPhone charging, and pairs a latest-generation GaN chip with UGREEN’s Thermal Guard technology to prevent overheating.
  • ESR Xtend Retractable Charger: I like how the adapter keeps its 3.1ft cable contained instead of letting it tangle. It’s rated at 45W but can peak at up to 60W of dynamic power through AVS, and an extra USB-C port lets you charge two devices simultaneously.
  • INIU 240W Fast-Charging USB-C Cable: You should always have a reliable USB-C cable handy for all of your devices. I keep one in my travel bag so I don’t have to unplug my bedside cable every time I leave home.

Best wireless chargers for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max

Wireless charging is all about convenience, but the right charger depends on how many devices you own. These options range from simple charging pads to all-in-one stations for your Apple gear.

  • Belkin 2-in-1 Folding Fast Charging Station: Buy this charger if you regularly charge your iPhone alongside AirPods. It offers Qi2.2 25W charging with ChillBoost passive cooling technology. It’s one of my favorite travel accessories.
  • LISEN 25W MagSafe Charger: A dedicated charging pad is an interesting choice because the phone will always have a fixed place on my desk. Its active cooling fan, 36W power adapter, and 5-foot cable make it a convenient charging setup.
  • ESR 3-in-1 Charger Stand with CryoBoost: This foldable charging station can charge your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods at the same time with Qi2.2 25W support. It also features an active cooling system for managing heat during wireless charging.

Best power banks for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max

Running out of battery while traveling or taking photos is frustrating. These power banks help keep your iPhone charged on the go.

  • Anker MagGo 2 Pro Power Bank: This 10,000mAh magnetic power bank combines Qi2.2 25W wireless charging with an active cooling fan, a smart display, and a built-in stand. I’d consider it for travel and busy days when extra battery life is needed. It also comes in a Burgundy finish that matches the new iPhone.
  • Baseus Picogo Air AM71 Power Bank: Consider it only if you want an ultra-slim power bank. It’s 0.27 inches thick and packs a 5,000mAh battery. You get up to 7.5W magnetic wireless charging and faster 22.5W wired USB-C charging.
  • INIU MagSafe Portable Charger: This combines a 10,000mAh battery with Qi2.2 25W wireless and 45W wired charging, plus a pop-out Apple Watch charger. I’d consider it for travel because it charges four devices at once and comes with a short strap-style USB-C cable.

Best car accessories for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max

A good car mount keeps navigation within easy view without requiring you to hold your phone. Whether you prefer magnetic attachment or a traditional grip, these options can help make your driving setup more convenient.

  • Miracase MagSafe Adjustable Car Mount: It features a strong magnetic hold, a suction base, and 360-degree adjustability. I’d use it to securely mount my iPhone for navigation, whether on the dashboard or the windshield.
  • Lamicall Car Phone Holder: Choose this if you use a thick case, wallet case, or ring case that isn’t compatible with magnetic car mounts. The holder uses an adjustable grip to keep your iPhone in place without relying on magnets.
  • ESR MagSafe Car Mount Charger: You may want this charging mount if you regularly use navigation on long drives and want to avoid arriving with a nearly empty battery. It supports Qi2.2 25W charging with CryoBoost active cooling. For occasional navigation, a basic holder and charging cable would be enough.

Other essential iPhone 18 Pro accessories

Some accessories may not be necessary, but they can make everyday phone use more comfortable. These extras are worth considering if they fit your routine.

  • Nomad Leather MagSafe Wallet with Integrated Tracking: It’s essential for me because I frequently misplace my wallet and prefer to carry fewer items in my pockets. The wallet holds up to 4 cards and lets you track it in the Find My app.
  • Apple Wrist Strap: A wrist strap is useful on trips when you’re constantly pulling out your phone to take photos. Pick a color that matches your iPhone and carry it elegantly.
  • PopSockets Phone Grip for MagSafe: Large phones can feel awkward to hold, so I’d consider a PopSockets grip for secure one-handed use. You can also use it as a stand. However, you’ll need to slide it off for wireless charging.

My top picks: Which accessories are actually worth buying?

Honestly, you don’t need to buy all these accessories just because you got a new iPhone. I’d start with the basics and add extras only when I know I’ll use them regularly.

For everyday protection, choose the Spigen Clear Case to show off your iPhone’s design, or the TORRAS kickstand case if you watch videos often. I’d pair it with the Spigen EZ Fit screen protector because an easy installation is always a plus.

For charging, the UGREEN Nexode Air is a great choice for portability, while the Anker MagGo Power Bank 2 Pro makes more sense for travel. If you also own an Apple Watch and AirPods, consider the ESR 3-in-1 charger to keep everything organized in one place.

For driving, I’d choose the ESR car mount charger. However, if you use a thick or wallet-style case, the Lamicall car phone holder is a more practical option because it doesn’t rely on magnets.

Always start with a case, a screen protector, and a reliable charger. Everything else depends on your lifestyle.

Our favorite Amazon finds:

  • Anker MagGo 3-in-1 Qi2 15W Charging Station
  • JLab JBuds Lux ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
  • 3-Pack USB C Charger (20W Dual Port)
  • UGREEN Magsafe Tripod Stand
  • UtechSmart 4-in-1 USB-C Dual HDMI Hub

title.rendered: Fortnite x Predator Badlands is here: Dek skin, bundle, and prices

content.rendered:
Predator: Badlands, the 2025 sci-fi movie, has arrived in Fortnite with a collection of themed cosmetics inspired by its two main characters, Dek and Thia. The crossover brings the Yautja warrior Dek to the Item Shop as a playable outfit, while Thia, the android portrayed by Hollywood actress Elle Fanning, appears as a Back Bling.

While the Dek skin is priced at 1,500 V-Bucks and comes with a free emote, the Thia back bling only includes itself and hence comes in at 600 V-Bucks. In addition, these can also be bought as part of a Predator-inspired package called the Predator: Badlands Bundle, which costs 2,000 V-Bucks.

The collaboration is available for a limited time, with Epic’s Item Shop listing showing an end time of November 4, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC (November 3 at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET). Here’s how to get the Dek skin and explore everything included in the Predator: Badlands crossover.

How to get Dek or Thia from Predator: Badlands in Fortnite

You can purchase the Predator: Badlands cosmetics directly from the Fortnite Item Shop. Follow these steps:

  1. In Fortnite, navigate to the Shop tab.
  2. Then, scroll down all the way to the Predator section (found under “Fortnitemares”) and select your preferred cosmetic.
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to confirm your pick.

All Predator Badlands Bundle items in Fortnite

The crossover features four cosmetics, including a playable outfit, a Back Bling, a pickaxe, and an emote. Here’s a breakdown of each item and its price.

1. Dek outfit

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also includes: Predator’s Sword Slash emote
  • Also included in: Predator Badlands Bundle

2. Thia back bling

  • Price: 600 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Predator Badlands Bundle

3. Dek’s Plasma Sword pickaxe

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Predator Badlands Bundle

4. Predator’s Sword Slash emote

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Predator Badlands Bundle

Is the Predator Badlands Bundle worth buying?

Being a Fortnite crossover featuring a world-renowned IP, the Predator Badlands Bundle surely consists of some eye-catching, highly recognizable cosmetics. Especially the skin modeled around Predator Dek, which comes with an additional style that makes the character don his iconic helmet, is something that most pop culture enthusiasts would be excited about.

Given that the Dek skin alone is priced at 1,500 V-Bucks and getting your hands on it still leaves out Thia, another important character from the movie, the Predator Badlands Bundle appears to be an essential for those who want the definitive experience from this crossover. At just 500 V-Bucks more, you will get not just both the characters but also a themed emote and a themed pickaxe.

Other Fortnitemares 2026 collabs to check out

Fortnitemares 2026 has brought several major pop culture collaborations to Fortnite, featuring characters and cosmetics inspired by popular horror franchises and movies. From the Freddy Krueger mythic encounter to Friday the 13th-themed cosmetics, the Halloween event has offered plenty of new content.

Apart from Predator: Badlands, other collaborations featured during the event include Beetlejuice, Obsession, The Slender Man, A Nightmare on Elm Street, and Five Nights at Freddy’s. However, Item Shop availability changes regularly, so check the current shop before deciding which cosmetics to purchase.

If you’re interested in the Predator crossover, make sure to check its availability before the limited-time offer expires.

FAQs

When did the Predator Badlands skin release in Fortnite?

The Predator Badlands skin first rolled out in the Item Shop on October 28.

Can you buy Dek separately in Fortnite?

Yes, you can buy the Dek skin separately as well, if you don’t want to go for the entire Predator Badlands Bundle.

Can I get a Thia skin in Fortnite?

No, you can’t because there is no Thia skin available in Fortnite. The Android character was incorporated into the game as a back bling instead.

  • How to get the Dante Bundle in Fortnite

  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

title.rendered: All Minecraft cheats and commands: Full list and how to use them

content.rendered:
Minecraft seems like a simple game at first, but there’s a lot more to it than meets the eye. From collecting resources and crafting items to fighting hostile mobs and exploring massive worlds, there’s always something new to discover. However, keeping track of every gameplay mechanic can feel overwhelming, especially if you’re just starting out.

That’s where Minecraft commands come in. These built-in instructions let you control different aspects of your world, whether you want to switch to Creative mode, teleport to a location, change the weather, summon mobs, or give yourself valuable items. Some players use them to make Survival easier, while others rely on them to experiment with builds and create custom experiences.

To help you get started, here’s a guide to the most useful Minecraft cheats and commands, including how to enable cheats, how to use commands, and examples for different gameplay situations.

All Minecraft commands at a glance

Looking for a new world to explore? Try one of these best Minecraft seeds.

How to enable cheats in Minecraft

In order to use Minecraft commands, you’ll first need to enable cheats in your world. The process is quite different for Java and Bedrock Edition, so let’s walk you through the steps for each version.

1. Java Edition

New World

  1. Launch Minecraft.
  2. Choose Singleplayer from the main menu.
  3. Click on Create New World.
  4. Open the More World Options menu.
  5. Locate “Allow Cheats” and switch it ON.
  6. Create your world to start playing.

Existing World

  1. Load your single-player world.
  2. Press Esc to open the pause menu.
  3. Choose Open to LAN.
  4. Turn Allow Cheats to ON.
  5. Hit Start LAN World.

Note: Keep in mind that enabling cheats through Open to LAN is temporary. The setting applies to that LAN session rather than permanently changing the world’s original cheat setting.

2. Bedrock Edition

New World

  1. Open Minecraft.
  2. Click on Create New World and open settings.
  3. Find the Cheats section.
  4. Switch on the Activate Cheats option.
  5. Create the world and begin playing.

Existing World

  1. Return to the world selection screen and find your saved world.
  2. Click on the pencil icon right next to the world to edit its settings.
  3. Scroll down to the Cheats section.
  4. Switch on Activate Cheats.
  5. Load the world.

Note: Enabling cheats in a Bedrock world disables achievements for that world. This change cannot be reversed for that save, so consider making a backup before enabling cheats.

Must read: Minecraft Bedrock 26.60: All new features and bug fixes

How to use Minecraft commands

Once cheats have been enabled, running commands in Minecraft is quite simple. Just follow these steps to enter and execute any command in your world:

  1. Press T on your Keyboard or open the chat window.
  2. Type / followed by the command you want to execute.
  3. Enter any additional information necessary for the command, such as the player’s name or coordinates.
  4. Press Enter or the send button on your platform to execute the command.
  5. The command will be executed as long as you have the required permissions.

Before experimenting with commands, there are a few things worth remembering. Minecraft commands and their effects can depend on whether you’re playing Java or Bedrock Edition. If you’re unsure what commands you have access to on a multiplayer or single-player server, you can type / in the chat window to see what’s available.

All Minecraft game mode and difficulty commands

Minecraft offers four main game modes, each designed for a different playstyle. You can switch between them using the /gamemode command.

1. Game mode commands

Minecraft lets you choose between four game modes: Survival, Creative, Adventure, and Spectator. Here are the commands to switch between each of them.

2. Difficulty commands

You can also adjust the difficulty of your world. There are four levels, and each affects the game in multiple ways.

3. Minecraft teleport commands

4. Minecraft item and inventory commands

If you want to get specific items, clear your inventory, or enchant your equipment, these commands can save you plenty of time.

Be careful when enchanting valuable gear: Curse of Vanishing makes an item disappear when you die. Learn how Curse of Vanishing works and how to keep your items.

5. Minecraft weather and time commands

6. Minecraft mob and entity commands

Minecraft commands are a useful way to control your world, whether you want to teleport to specific locations, give yourself diamonds, change the weather, summon mobs, or build structures faster. To use them, enable cheats in your world or make sure you have the required permissions on a multiplayer server, then enter your chosen command in the chat window.

The most useful command in Minecraft is the /teleport command as it allows you to save time while exploring or building.

Minecraft commands work in Survival mode, as long as you have cheats enabled in your world and have the permissions to use them.

You can get command blocks in Minecraft by using the /give command. However, you will need to enable cheats first.

To get 64 diamonds, use the following command: /give @s diamond 64.

To teleport to a village in Minecraft, first find the coordinates of the nearest village, and then use the /teleport command.

title.rendered: iPhone Air 2 leak reveals dual 48MP cameras and a bigger battery

content.rendered:
Apple’s next ultra-thin iPhone could be getting some much-needed upgrades. The iPhone Air 2 has resurfaced in a new leak that suggests Apple is addressing some of the biggest compromises of its first-generation iPhone Air.

According to a Weibo post from well-known Chinese tipster Digital Chat Station, the iPhone Air 2 will retain its slim design and 120Hz OLED display while adding an A20-series chip, two 48MP rear cameras, and a larger battery of around 3,500mAh.

iPhone Air 2 display: Same size, same smooth 120Hz

According to the leak, the iPhone Air 2 will sport a 6.55-inch flat OLED display with a 1.5K+ resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. This would keep essentially the same screen size as its predecessor, which already offers a 6.5-inch ProMotion display that runs at up to 120Hz, so don’t expect a big change on the display front.

Under the hood, Apple could equip the device with an A20-series chipset built on a 2nm process, delivering an iPhone 18 Pro-like performance upgrade. The iPhone 18 Pro, which launched in September, already runs on Apple’s 2nm A20 Pro chip.

Dual 48MP rear cameras could fix the biggest Air limitation

The camera department could receive one of the most noticeable upgrades. The iPhone Air 2 is tipped to feature a 48MP primary sensor and a 48MP ultra-wide camera. For comparison, the original iPhone Air features only a single 48MP rear camera.

Adding an ultra-wide sensor would give users more flexibility when capturing landscapes, group photos, and wider scenes. It would also bring the camera experience closer to Apple’s standard iPhone models.

This isn’t the first time we’ve heard about Apple’s plans to improve the camera hardware. A previous report by The Information said the iPhone Air 2 could borrow cooling and camera features from the iPhone 17 Pro.

Bigger battery yet thinner design

The iPhone Air 2 is rumored to feature a battery capacity of around 3,500mAh or higher, up from the 3,149mAh battery in the original model. The difference is small, but combined with the new, efficient 2nm processor, it could increase overall battery life.

It’s surprising that Apple may make all these upgrades without increasing the phone’s thickness. Previous leaks suggest the iPhone Air 2 could measure just 5.2mm thick, making it even slimmer than its 5.64mm predecessor.

The device is also expected to feature Apple’s next-generation N2 wireless networking chip and C2 modem, potentially improving connectivity and power efficiency.

iPhone Air 2 launch timeline

Apple is reportedly planning to launch the iPhone Air 2 in spring 2027 alongside the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e. This follows earlier reports suggesting that Apple had reconsidered its launch plans for the second-generation Air.

Of course, all the specs mentioned are still based on leaks. However, if the reports prove accurate, the iPhone Air 2 could address the two biggest weaknesses of its predecessor: the single rear camera and modest battery.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

title.rendered: How to find Yeat in Fortnite and unlock a free jam track

content.rendered:
The Fortnite x Yeat collaboration arrived during Fortnitemares 2026, bringing cosmetics inspired by the American rapper and a special Battle Royale quest. While most Yeat-themed items require V-Bucks, you can unlock one reward for free by completing his in-game challenge.

The quest, called Unreleased Music, tasks you with finding five bells around Yeat’s location and returning them to him. Complete it to earn the Heliman Jam Track without purchasing the Yeat outfit or spending V-Bucks.

The quest is tied to Chapter 7 Season 4, which is scheduled to end on November 1, 2026. If you want to claim the free track, here’s where to find Yeat in Fortnite and how to complete his quest.

Yeat map location in Fortnite

Finding Yeat in Fortnite Battle Royale is rather convenient because his location is essentially marked by a tall tower that is hard to miss. This structure is situated on the snow-capped hills, which are to the north of Reality’s Reign and to the east of Nitemare Neighborhood.

Upon reaching the location, you need to check the area at the base of the tower. There is a van right under the structure, near which you will find the Yeat NPC roaming around. To kick off the quest, you just have to approach him and hit the respective button prompt to interact.

How to complete Yeat quest in Fortnite

  1. Interact with Yeat and select the Unreleased Music dialogue option.
  2. Keep selecting the text bubble option to proceed with the dialogue until the NPC finishes.
  3. As soon as that interaction finishes, you will have to collect 5 bells within about three minutes, placed at random spots in and around the tower itself.
  4. Once you find a bell, press and hold the interact button to retrieve it.
  5. At last, after collecting all the bells, head back to Yeat, interact, and select the “I just heard Heliman” chat option to complete the quest and unlock the Heliman Jam Track.

Once you’ve completed the quest, the Heliman Jam Track should be added to your Locker. Open the Locker and navigate to the Jam Tracks section to find Heliman by Yeat. You can then equip it and use it in supported Fortnite music experiences.

Fortnite and its NPC quests

For instance, Fortnite has previously introduced characters such as Catwoman, Poison Ivy, and Harley Quinn, along with special encounters involving bosses. During the ongoing Fortnitemares event, Freddy Krueger has also appeared as a boss players can defeat for in-game rewards.

However, Yeat’s Unreleased Music quest takes a different approach. Instead of fighting a boss or surviving an intense encounter, you simply need to locate five bells and return them to the rapper. It’s a relatively straightforward challenge that gives players a free Jam Track without requiring a V-Bucks purchase.

If you haven’t completed it yet, head to the tower north of Reality’s Reign before the Chapter 7 Season 4 event window closes.

title.rendered: Minecraft Java vs. Bedrock Edition: What’s the difference?

content.rendered:
Minecraft is all about exploring a massive world that’s made out of blocks, collecting resources, crafting items, building incredible structures, and taking on dangerous mobs. As a sandbox game, it gives you the freedom to play your way, whether you want to build an entire city or simply survive in the wild.

However, your experience depends partly on which edition you choose. Minecraft has two main editions: Java and Bedrock. Both offer the same core sandbox experience, but they differ in platform support, multiplayer, modding, controls, and graphics. If you’re wondering which one to choose, here’s everything you need to know about Minecraft Java vs. Bedrock Edition.

You can also use cheats and commands to change your world or adjust gameplay, see our complete list of Minecraft cheats and commands.

Minecraft Java vs. Bedrock Edition at a glance

What is the difference between Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition?

Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition bring the same basic sandbox experience, but each of them caters towards a different set of players.

For Java Edition, it runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, which makes it a solid choice for anyone who wants to experiment with mods, join custom servers, slap on shaders, and explore all sorts of advanced gameplay features. Not only that, but you can also revisit older versions of Minecraft to see how the game has changed over time.

On the other hand, Bedrock Edition is available on Windows, consoles, and mobile devices, which makes cross-platform multiplayer much easier. Developer Mojang has specifically optimised this version to run across a range of hardware, and it also comes with the Minecraft Marketplace where players can purchase official add-ons, texture packs, maps, and cosmetic items.

Minecraft Java vs. Bedrock Edition: Every major difference explained

1. Supported platforms

One of the biggest differences between Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition is platform availability.

Java Edition is designed for PC players and runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It offers plenty of flexibility for players who want to customize their game and experiment with community-created content.

Bedrock Edition is available on Windows, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and supported iOS and Android devices. This broader availability makes it easier to enjoy Minecraft on a console, computer, or phone.

If you primarily play on a console or mobile device, Bedrock is the version to choose. If you’re using a Mac or Linux computer, Java is the native edition available to you.

2. Crossplay

Both versions of Minecraft allow you to play with friends, but the way multiplayer works is different. In Java Edition, you can join all sorts of servers and explore different worlds, but everyone in your group must be playing on the same Java version.

However, Bedrock Edition allows you to team up with friends across supported devices. For instance, you can play Minecraft on your PlayStation while your friend joins the same world from an Android phone, as long as you’re both using Bedrock Edition.

3. Mods vs. add-ons

Mods have been a huge part of Minecraft Java Edition for a decade, with the community pumping out new ways to change the game. Right from bringing new mobs, items, dimensions and skins to overhauling gameplay performance and changing existing mechanics, Java Edition allows you to mod almost every single aspect of the game.

However, the Bedrock Edition doesn’t follow the same approach. What you instead get is the Minecraft Marketplace. This is where Mojang offers community-made content, including skins, texture packs, and gameplay add-onset, which can be bought with real money. Sure, there’s a lot to explore, but the selection is limited, and you have to pay.

4. Performance and FPS

Minecraft Bedrock Edition is built from the ground up to run across a wide range of platforms, which includes the likes of consoles, mobile devices, and PCs. This means it’s well optimised to run even on relatively low-end hardware, which makes it a solid choice for anyone who wants an experience without worrying about performance.

The Java edition is a more demanding version for any system. This is especially noticeable when you install multiple mods or use shaders to change up the game’s visuals. However, the performance ultimately comes down to your hardware, graphics settings, and the number of mods you’re running

5. Graphics, shaders and visual features

The two Minecraft editions have the same blocky art style, with the same textures and environments. However, The Java edition lets you change how the game looks with community-made shader packs.

Browse our picks for the best Minecraft shaders to find one that suits your visual style and PC. These can transform the way lighting, shadows, and reflections work in the game. Most of the mods are available for free and help give your world a fresh look.

Bedrock Edition also allows you to change the game’s visuals. You can easily enable the Vibrant Visuals option through the settings or even explore community-made shaders and add-onset. However, the range of customisation options is more limited compared to Java Edition.

6. Servers and realms

Minecraft Java Edition has no shortage of servers packed with different ways to experience the game. Whether you’re into RPGs, survival challenges, or competitive PVP, there’s something for everyone. If you’re looking for a place to start, check out our list of the best Minecraft servers to find one that suits your playstyle.

Bedrock Edition has no shortage of multiplayer servers either, with the added benefit of cross-platform support. However, the variety of servers and custom game modes available generally is more limited than what you’ll find in Java Edition.

Both versions also come with Minecraft Realms. For the unaware, this is a subscription service that lets you set up private worlds and invite your friends over to play.

Minecraft Java vs. Bedrock: Which edition is better for mods?

If you’re comparing Minecraft Java vs. Bedrock and modding is your top priority, the Java edition is the clear winner. Its modding community has been around for over a decade, giving players access to an endless collection of custom content. You can bring in new biomes, weapons, machines, and even gameplay systems that can’t be found in the core experience.

If that wasn’t enough, you can even bring in aspects of other game franchises into Minecraft with modding. What’s the best part about all of this? Most of these mods are generally free to download, which means you can experiment with countless ways to switch up your gameplay and have a blast.

Minecraft Java vs. Bedrock: Which is better for multiplayer?

If playing with friends is your main priority, Minecraft Bedrock Edition is without a doubt the version to purchase. Its biggest advantage is simply the fact that it is cross-platform. It doesn’t matter whether your friends are on a PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch or a mobile phone; as long as they own the Bedrock edition, you can play together. Everyone gets access to the same world and multiplayer features.

What’s also great about Bedrock, particularly on consoles, is that players get access to split-screen multiplayer. This means the game can be enjoyed with friends and family on the screen without needing separate devices.

Can you switch between Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition?

Still can’t pick between Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition? Don’t worry, as you don’t have to choose just one. If you’re playing on PC, buying Minecraft gives you access to both editions at no additional cost. In order to switch between them, simply launch the official Minecraft Launcher and select your preferred version from the sidebar.

However, keep in mind that both editions store their game files, saved worlds, and progress separately. This means your worlds, settings, and progress won’t automatically transfer when you switch from one edition to another.

Wrapping up!

Minecraft offers two editions with the same core sandbox appeal but different strengths. Neither is universally better; the right choice depends on how you prefer to play.

Choose Java Edition if you want extensive mods, shader packs, community servers, and the flexibility to experiment with different game versions. Choose Bedrock Edition if you want to play across supported devices, use controller or touch controls, enjoy console split-screen, or access its Marketplace and official Vibrant Visuals mode on compatible hardware.

If you’re playing on a Windows PC, you can get both editions in the Java & Bedrock Edition for PC package. That gives you the flexibility to choose whichever version suits your next Minecraft adventure.

FAQs

Is Minecraft Java better than Bedrock?

Minecraft Java is suited for players who like to install mods and join custom servers. However, Minecraft Bedrock is suited for players with lower-end systems and who want to play with friends across different devices.

Can Java and Bedrock players play together?

Unfortunately, Minecraft Java and Bedrock players can’t play together as they use different multiplayer systems.

Which Minecraft edition has better performance?

Minecraft Bedrock Edition generally has better performance as it’s been optimised to run across a range of hardware and platforms.

Can you install mods on Minecraft Bedrock Edition?

You can install mods on Minecraft Bedrock Edition using add-onset, which can introduce new items, blocks, textures, and other mechanics into your world. These are available on the Minecraft Marketplace and third-party sources.

Is Minecraft Java Edition available on consoles?

No, Minecraft Java Edition is not available to play on Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo consoles.

Do Java and Bedrock have the same updates?

Minecraft Java and Bedrock do get the same major updates. However, some features can differ and arrive at different times.

Can you convert a Java world to Bedrock?

A Java world can be converted to Bedrock Edition using third-party tools such as Chunker. However, keep in mind that the conversion might not be perfect, and modded entities or Java-specific mechanics might not transfer.

title.rendered: Download the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display wallpapers in 4K

content.rendered:
Apple has unveiled a redesigned MacBook Pro with a new PROLED XDR display, tandem OLED technology, and touch support for the first time on a Mac. Alongside the new hardware, the announcement has brought a fresh collection of colorful wallpapers featuring glossy abstract shapes, metallic curves, and vibrant artwork.

If you want to give your desktop a similar look without upgrading your Mac, you’re in the right place. I’ve collected six new MacBook Pro PROLED XDR wallpapers featuring everything from the silver-and-blue design to a luminous green butterfly and flowing purple-and-green patterns. You can download your favorite design and use it on your MacBook, iMac, Windows PC, or another desktop display.

Download MacBook Pro PROLED XDR wallpapers

This collection features not only the official MacBook Pro 2026 wallpaper designed by Apple, but also several amazing wallpapers. Choose your favorites and give your desktop a fresh visual upgrade.

You may find the original wallpaper collection and previews on AppleWalls, an independent archive of Apple wallpapers.

1. Silver and blue PRO wallpaper

Let’s start with the official artwork for Apple’s new MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR display. Its flowing, metallic lines against a deep black background create a sleek, minimal look. Perfect for giving your desktop a dark, premium finish.

Download

2. Colorful abstract design

A vibrant mix of pink, orange, blue, and purple gives this wallpaper an energetic, bold appearance. It features many layers of shapes and elements, reminding me of an underwater theme. I’d choose this one if I wanted a colorful desktop that immediately catches the eye.

Download

3. Glass abstract artwork

This wallpaper combines a deep black background with glossy, sculptural shapes in red, silver, green, and electric blue. The flowing metallic curves and textured surfaces give it a unique look without making the screen feel too busy.

Download

4. Glass dolphin and microphone on the screen

A transparent, glass-like dolphin stretches across the top, while a red sphere and golden geometric form add contrast in this unusual 3D artwork. The shiny silver and blue surfaces keep the composition neat against the black background.

Download

5. Beautiful green butterfly

This nature-inspired wallpaper features a striking butterfly with luminous green wings, purple edges, and pink highlights. The textures are so elaborate that they create an ethereal feel, while the deep green background makes its bright colors pop.

Download

6. Purple and green flow wallpaper

The next abstract design combines beautiful contrasting colors to form flowing, feather-like shapes. The composition is detailed enough to create a sense of movement, making it a good choice if you prefer artistic wallpapers over simple gradients.

Download

Give your Mac a fresh look

Whether you prefer the understated silver-and-blue design or a more colorful abstract composition, these six MacBook Pro PROLED XDR wallpapers offer an easy way to refresh your desktop. Their combination of rich colors, glossy textures, and dark backgrounds makes them appealing choices for a MacBook, iMac, or Windows PC.

If you’re curious about the hardware behind the new wallpapers, read our guide to the touchscreen MacBook Pro for more details about its display and other upgrades.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Build a Phone Empire Codes on November 01, 2026

Build a Phone Empire on Roblox is a must-try for tycoon game fans! You start from a small garage and gradually turn into a massive smartphone company. From designing your phones and choosing their specifications to hiring employees and researching new technologies, there’s plenty to keep you hooked.

However, growing your business requires tons of coins and Research Points (RP), which can take time to earn. But there’s no need to worry, as here’s a list of all Build a Phone Empire codes that you can redeem for free coins and RP.

All working Build a Phone Empire codes

  • LAPTOPS: 75K Cash and 90 RP (NEW)
  • WELCOME: 38K Cash and 60 RP (NEW)
  • COMPANIES: 38K Cash and 60 RP (NEW)
  • CEO: 23K Cash and 30 RP (NEW)
  • SPOOKY: 38K Cash, 60 Candy, and 60 RP (NEW)
  • FLAGSHIP: 38K Cash and 15 RP (NEW)

As of now, these are the only active Build a Phone Empire codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired Build a Phone Empire codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem Build a Phone Empire codes in Roblox

Now that you’re aware of the active codes, it’s also crucial to learn how to redeem them and claim your freebies. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Build a Phone Empire codes in Roblox.

  1. Fire up Build a Phone Empire on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click on Store.
  4. Choose the Codes section.
  5. Paste a working code and hit Redeem to claim your reward.

If the code is accepted, the corresponding rewards should be credited to your account. Check your Cash and Research Points balances to confirm the rewards have been added.

Why aren’t my Build a Phone Empire codes working?

If your Build a Phone Empire codes aren’t working, double-check that you’ve entered them exactly as listed above. Keep in mind that these codes are case-sensitive, so make sure there are no extra spaces before or after them.

You can simply copy and paste the codes directly from our list. If a code still doesn’t work, it might have expired, or you may have already redeemed its rewards.

How to get more Build a Phone Empire codes

The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new Build a Phone Empire codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, bug fixes, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Discord server: Visit the Build a Phone Empire Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
  • Follow the Roblox game page: Make sure to keep an eye on the Roblox page and the Devtech Studios community for updates, announcements, and potential code releases.
  • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new Build a Phone Empire codes become available, so you can easily find the latest rewards in one place.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Hollow codes, Cat Battles Codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

How do you get better phones in Build a Phone Empire?

In order to get better phones in Build a Phone Empire, you need to research new technologies to get improved components, better cameras, processors, and other features.

Can you customize your phone in Build a Phone Empire?

Build a Phone Empire lets you customize your smartphones by choosing their screen size, cameras, corners, buttons, colour, finish and logo.

How do you earn money in Build a Phone Empire?

You can earn money in Build a Phone Empire by designing and launching smartphones, then making profits from sales.

  • SteelSeries Aeon Pro Wireless Controller
  • CyberPowerPC Gaming PC (GeForce RTX 5060)
  • Razer Naga V3 Pro Gaming Mouse
  • Redragon Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

title.rendered: GTA 6 PS5 file size revealed: How much storage do you need?

content.rendered:
Rockstar Games has been sharing details about GTA 6 ahead of its launch, but one question remains on many players’ minds: how much storage space will the game require? Rumors have suggested different file sizes, but Rockstar hasn’t officially confirmed the game’s download or installation size yet.

Now, a new report from PlayStation Game Size, an account known for tracking information from PlayStation Store listings, claims that GTA 6’s Standard Edition could require a 210 GB download on PS5. With the game’s release approaching, this gives players an early idea of how much storage they may need to free up. However, the figure remains unconfirmed, so here’s what we know so far.

GTA 6 PS5 file size at a glance

The 210 GB figure comes from a third-party PlayStation Store tracking account, not an official Rockstar announcement. The suggested 250 GB of free space is a practical precaution rather than a confirmed system requirement.

How much storage does GTA 6 need on PS5?

According to PlayStationsize on X, GTA 6 Standard Edition could take 210 GB of storage on the PS5. Although Sony hasn’t listed the game’s official storage requirements yet, the insider has a fairly reliable track record for uncovering such details. The information has been pulled from Sony’s backend, where game-related details surface before an official announcement. However, as always, Rockstar could still make changes before launch, so it’s best to treat this figure as unconfirmed for now.

🚨 Grand Theft Auto VI – 𝐃𝐨𝐰𝐧𝐥𝐨𝐚𝐝 𝐒𝐢𝐳𝐞 : 210 GB – 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐫𝐝 ($79.99) Pre-Load : November 12 Release : November 19 𝐑𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐞 : Midnight https://t.co/5vXkgnqfC7

— PlayStation Game Size (@PlaystationSize) October 27, 2026

If this figure is true, GTA 6 takes a massive jump in file size compared to previous Rockstar games. For context, GTA 5 takes up around 95 GB, and Red Dead Redemption 2 requires 105 GB on PS5. However, considering the scale of GTA 6, its highly detailed world, and everything we’ve seen in the official trailers and leaks, a larger file size isn’t all that shocking. Rockstar is going all out when it comes to this open-world, and all that detail is bound to require a lot of storage space.

When can you preload GTA 6 on PS5?

Rockstar has confirmed that GTA 6 preloading will begin on November 12, 2026, which is exactly seven days before the game’s scheduled release.

Considering the GTA 6 file size could be as large as 210 GB, downloading it in advance will give you plenty of time to get things ready, especially if you’re using a slower internet connection.

The same applies if you’re purchasing the physical edition, as it comes with a download code. You will be able to preload the game starting on the same date, giving you enough time to download the files before launch day.

If you’re still deciding which version to buy, check out our guide to GTA 6 editions and what each version includes.

Will GTA 6 have the same file size on PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S?

Insiders haven’t reported the GTA 6 file size for Xbox Series X/S consoles yet, but it’s likely close to what we’ve seen reported for the PS5. Looking at Rockstar’s previous releases, the storage requirements on PlayStation and Xbox consoles have generally been in the same ballpark.

For instance, GTA 5 took 44 GB on PS4 at launch, while the Xbox One version required 42 GB. There’s no guarantee the same will hold true for GTA 6, but we don’t expect a massive difference between the two versions.

However, the file size isn’t the only thing worth considering when comparing the platforms. PS5 and PS5 Pro owners will be able to enjoy exclusive GTA 6 features, which allow the game to take full advantage of Sony’s hardware compared to the Xbox Series X/S.

Will GTA 6’s file size increase after launch?

If you think 210 GB of storage is all you’ll need for GTA 6, you might want to think again. It’s likely that the GTA 6 file size is going to increase after launch, as Rockstar will release updates, bug fixes, and additional content.

These updates can bring new things to the table, such as missions, vehicles, and other features that take up even more space on your console. Then there’s also GTA 6 Online, which is expected to arrive in 2027 and could increase the game’s overall storage requirements.

The developer hasn’t announced a post-launch update schedule or confirmed how much additional storage GTA 6 will need. However, you should keep some extra SSD space available rather than assuming that the 210 GB figure is all you’ll need.

Wrapping up

Rockstar Games hasn’t officially revealed GTA 6’s file size yet, but PlayStation Game Size has reported that the Standard Edition could require a 210 GB download on PS5. If the figure proves accurate, players will need to set aside a significant amount of storage before launch.

Rockstar has confirmed that preloading begins at local midnight on November 12, 2026, ahead of the game’s November 19 release. Until the official storage requirements are published, treat the reported size as provisional and leave some extra space for installation and future updates.

While you’re getting your console ready, adjust its display, audio, and controller options with these PS5 settings for the best GTA 6 experience.

Once you’re in the game, use our guide to the best GTA 6 settings for in-game controls, navigation, subtitles, and accessibility options.

FAQs

What is the GTA 6 file size on PS5?

The GTA 6 file size on PS5 is reportedly 210 GB, according to PlayStationsize on X. However, Rockstar Games hasn’t confirmed the figure yet.

How much free storage should I keep for GTA 6?

As GTA 6 is rumoured to be around 210 GB on PS5, we’d recommend keeping at least 250 GB of free storage to be safe. This also covers potential updates.

When does GTA 6 preload start on PS5?

The GTA 6 preload on PS5 begins on November 12, 2026. This gives players a full week to download the game before launch.

Can I preload GTA 6 before its release date?

Yes, you can preload GTA 6 before its official release date, which allows you to download the game in advance. Preloading begins on November 12, 2026.

Will GTA 6 have the same file size on PS5 Pro?

It’s likely that the GTA 6 file size on the PS5 Pro will also be 210 GB, the same as the standard PS5.

How much storage does GTA 6 need on Xbox Series X|S?

No reports have surfaced suggesting GTA 6’s file size requirements for Xbox Series X/S. However, it’s likely that the game will need a similar amount of storage as it does on PS5 to run.

title.rendered: Apple’s iPhone Duo could grab nearly 30% of the foldable market in 2027

content.rendered:
Apple’s first foldable iPhone could become a major force in the foldable smartphone market faster than expected. According to market research firm TrendForce, the iPhone Duo is projected to capture 29.8% of the global foldable smartphone market in 2027, putting Apple in second place behind Samsung.

The forecast comes as early demand for the iPhone Duo appears strong, with delivery estimates on Apple’s website extending into January 2027 for some orders less than a week after preorders opened on October 16. But while brand appeal will help Apple succeed, display reliability and the long-term durability of its folding design remain key challenges.

Apple could challenge Samsung’s foldable dominance

In its latest report on the iPhone Duo’s launch and foldable display challenges, TrendForce estimates that Apple could ship around 5 million foldable iPhones in 2026, giving it approximately 24.8% of the market. Its 2027 projection raises Apple’s expected share to 29.8%.

Samsung is still expected to lead the market, although its projected share could decline from 35.1% in 2026 to 31.9% in 2027. Huawei’s share is also forecast to fall from 24.8% to 21.3%.

The shift could make Apple one of the most influential players in a market long dominated by established Android foldable manufacturers.

The foldable market could rebound in 2027

TrendForce expects global foldable smartphone shipments to reach 23.5 million units in 2027, representing year-over-year growth of 16.3%. That would be a significant improvement over the just 0.5% growth TrendForce projected for 2026 in its previous forecast.

Apple’s entry could help revive demand by bringing foldable phones to a wider audience. Its integration of hardware, software, and developer tools may also give it an advantage as manufacturers compete to make larger foldable displays more useful for everyday multitasking.

Apple’s approach to the foldable design also raises questions about authentication features, including whether the iPhone Duo will rely on Face ID or introduce a different biometric unlocking solution

Still, hurdles remain. TrendForce’s latest assessment highlights reports of damaged inner displays, potentially expensive repairs, and apps that do not fully adapt to the Duo’s unfolded screen. TrendForce also notes that Apple has replaced a small number of units with inner-display abnormalities. These issues could become defining factors in how consumers view the iPhone Duo in the long run.

Can Apple turn early demand into long-term success?

The iPhone Duo’s early market performance suggests that Apple could quickly become a serious competitor in foldable smartphones. But capturing nearly 30% of the market in 2027 remains a forecast, not a guaranteed outcome.

Ultimately, Apple’s success will depend on whether it can deliver a reliable folding display, improve app compatibility, and make its larger screen genuinely useful. If it gets those fundamentals right, the iPhone Duo could help push the foldable market beyond hardware experimentation and toward a more practical, multitasking-focused smartphone experience.

title.rendered: How to get the Inoxtag skin in Fortnite: Price and bundle details

content.rendered:
Popular French creator Inoxtag is the latest online personality to join Fortnite as an in-game outfit. It’s a milestone moment for the creator, who first gained recognition through his Fortnite videos.

As part of this Fortnite collaboration, players can get more than just Inoxtag’s outfit. The collection also includes Ace’s Cozy Pack back bling, inspired by his pet dog, along with a pickaxe, an emote, and a themed wrap.

The Inoxtag outfit costs 1,500 V-Bucks, while the full Inoxtag Bundle costs 2,000 V-Bucks. The outfit also includes the Inoxtag’d wrap, so you don’t need to purchase that cosmetic separately if you buy the skin. The collection is available in the Item Shop until November 5, 2026, so here’s how to get the outfit and everything included in the collaboration.

Steps to claim the Inoxtag skin in Fortnite

Follow these steps to purchase the Inoxtag outfit from the Fortnite Item Shop:

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab.
  2. Next, scroll down to the Inoxtag section and select the Inoxtag skin.
  3. Finally, confirm your decision by pressing and holding the Purchase button.

You can purchase the Inoxtag outfit individually for 1,500 V-Bucks or get the full bundle for 2,000 V-Bucks. If you want the other cosmetics as well, the bundle is the better-value option.

List of all Fortnite x Inoxtag cosmetics

The Inoxtag collection includes five cosmetics: the outfit, its accompanying wrap, a back bling, a pickaxe, and an emote. Here’s a breakdown of their prices and bundle availability.

1. Inoxtag outfit

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also includes: Inoxtag’d wrap
  • Also included in: Inoxtag Bundle

2. Ace’s Cozy Pack back bling

  • Price: 600 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Inoxtag Bundle

3. Kaizen Mountain Axes pickaxe

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Inoxtag Bundle

4. Lil’ 4×4 emote

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Inoxtag Bundle

5. Inoxtag’d wrap

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Inoxtag Bundle

Fortnite creator collaborations in 2026

A wide variety of internet celebrities, from highly sought-after streamers such as Ninja to eminent TikTok figures such as Khaby Lame, have previously collaborated with Fortnite, resulting in their likenesses appearing in the game.

Meanwhile, when we talk about 2026 specifically, we have witnessed fresh cosmetics inspired by three different creators, namely Kai Cenat, IShowSpeed and now Inoxtag. All these skins are part of the Icon tier, which is a category also shared by the sportsperson-based skins and the singer-based skins in Fortnite.

While only a few creator-based Icon skins have arrived in the game this year so far, the cadence has been noticeably more prolific when it comes to content modeled around singers and rappers, with big names including Lil Wayne and Olivia Rodrigo coming into the fold this year.

On the other hand, sportspersons have faced a similar fate as creators in this regard, as this year saw just a couple of new footballers, namely Vinicius Jr and David Beckham, enter the fray despite it being a FIFA World Cup year.

FAQs

How to get the Inoxtag Fortnite skin for free?

The Inoxtag outfit was available as a free reward for eligible players who achieved the required placement in the Inoxtag Icon Cup. That tournament has already taken place. The current Item Shop options are the outfit for 1,500 V-Bucks or the full bundle for 2,000 V-Bucks.

How to get the Inoxtag Fortnite wrap?

The Inoxtag’d wrap is included with the Inoxtag outfit and the Inoxtag Bundle. It also has a listed standalone price of 500 V-Bucks, but purchasing the outfit means you don’t need to buy the wrap separately.

Which other creators have previously done a similar collaboration with Fortnite?

Fortnite has featured online creators such as Ninja, MrBeast, Kai Cenat, and IShowSpeed in its crossover lineup. The available collaborations and their Item Shop schedules can change over time.

blockGraphs.question: How to get the Inoxtag Fortnite skin for free?
blockGraphs.answer: The Inoxtag outfit was available as a free reward for eligible players who achieved the required placement in the Inoxtag Icon Cup. That tournament has already taken place. The current Item Shop options are the outfit for 1,500 V-Bucks or the full bundle for 2,000 V-Bucks.

blockGraphs.question: How to get the Inoxtag Fortnite wrap?
blockGraphs.answer: The Inoxtag'd wrap is included with the Inoxtag outfit and the Inoxtag Bundle. It also has a listed standalone price of 500 V-Bucks, but purchasing the outfit means you don't need to buy the wrap separately.

blockGraphs.question: Which other creators have previously done a similar collaboration with Fortnite?
blockGraphs.answer: Fortnite has featured online creators such as Ninja, MrBeast, Kai Cenat, and IShowSpeed in its crossover lineup. The available collaborations and their Item Shop schedules can change over time.
