title.rendered: Beetlejuice in Fortnite: Skin, bundle, prices, and more

content.rendered:
Ever since Beetlejuice was teased in the official key art for Fortnitemares 2026, fans of the classic horror comedy have been waiting for the crossover to arrive in Fortnite. Now, the iconic character and a collection of themed cosmetics are available in the Item Shop, where they went live on October 23, 2026, at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET.

The Beetlejuice outfit costs 1,500 V-Bucks, while the full Beetlejuice Bundle costs 2,400 V-Bucks. The outfit also comes with Beetlejuice’s Marquee back bling. The bundle includes eight cosmetics, with a listed original combined value of 5,300 V-Bucks, so it saves you 2,900 V-Bucks. However, the two Beetlejuice-themed Jam Tracks are sold separately.

The cosmetics are scheduled to leave the Item Shop on November 2, 2026. If you want to add the ghost with the most to your locker, here’s how to get the skin and a breakdown of every item and its price.

How to get the Beetlejuice skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, navigate to the Item Shop tab.
  2. After that, scroll down until the Beetlejuice section appears and select the desired skin.
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to confirm your decision.

Every Beetlejuice collab item in Fortnite

The Beetlejuice collection includes an outfit, a back bling, two emotes, kicks, a wrap, a pickaxe, and a guitar that doubles as a back bling and pickaxe. Two additional Jam Tracks are available separately.

1. Beetlejuice outfit

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also comes with: Beetlejuice’s Marquee back bling
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

2. Beetlejuice’s Marquee back bling

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

3. Day-o emote

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

4. Sandworm Surfer emote

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

5. Marquee Masher pickaxe

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

6. Sandworm Sneakers kicks

  • Price: 1,000 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

7. Beetlejuice Spirals wrap

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

8. Six-stringed Sandworm pickaxe and back bling

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

9. Banana Boat (Day-O) jam track

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks

10. Jump In The Line jam track

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks

Besides the Jam Tracks, all the other items shown above make up the Beetlejuice Bundle. Although these Harry Belafonte songs were used in the Beetlejuice movie, they have only been listed as individual purchases.

Horror film crossovers in Fortnitemares 2026

The ongoing Halloween-themed Fortnitemares event is all about spooky in-game events and new cosmetics based on scary media, so horror film crossovers are right up its alley. This year, we have seen everything from horror classics such as A Nightmare on Elm Street to modern hits such as Obsession make their way into the online multiplayer title, with various themed cosmetics and gameplay updates.

As Fortnitemares 2026 comes to a close, a chunk of these Fortnite collabs also enter their final days of availability. Whether it be the Freddy’s Nightmare Mythic melee weapon or the Scream-inspired Last Call Mythic item, these parts of the game are set to bow out in a matter of days, as the One Piece-themed Treasure Hunters mini-season arrives on November 1.

You may like to read: What’s in the Fortnite Treasure Hunters Battle Pass?

However, since the cosmetics are something that you can carry forward into the next year and beyond, those looking to grab a memento of 2026’s Halloween-oriented content in Fortnite shouldn’t hesitate to go for their preferred skins, back bling, and the like while they still have some time.

Don’t miss these related reads:

  • Doja Cat returns to Fortnite: Here’s how to get the skin
  • Aetheria map in Fortnite: What it is, how to play it, beginner tips
  • How to get the Jack-O’-Cat sidekick in Fortnite before it leaves
  • Final Spritemare in Fortnite: Full schedule, boosted Sprites, and login rewards

Level up your gaming setup:

  • Logitech G Astro A10 Wired Gaming Headset
  • SteelSeries Aeon Pro Wireless Controller
  • CyberPowerPC Gaming PC (GeForce RTX 5060)
  • Razer Naga V3 Pro Gaming Mouse
  • Redragon Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

title.rendered: iOS 27.2 is here with smarter Siri AI, Messages tools, and Pencil support

content.rendered:
Apple has released iOS 27.2, bringing a collection of new features and refinements to compatible iPhones. Released on October 26, 2026, the update expands Siri AI language support, adds contextual suggestions to Messages, refreshes Apple Music, and improves several built-in apps. It also enables Apple Pencil (USB-C) support on Apple’s foldable iPhone Duo.

Unlike a minor maintenance update, iOS 27.2 introduces changes across Photos, Podcasts, Apple TV, FaceTime, and other parts of the operating system. Apple has also expanded Siri AI language support and included more than 160 security fixes, making this an important update for eligible iPhone users.

Here’s a closer look at what’s new in iOS 27.2, which features require compatible hardware, and what you should know before updating your iPhone.

iOS 27.2 brings major improvements to Siri AI

One of the biggest changes in iOS 27.2 is the expansion of Siri AI. Apple’s updated assistant can now recall previous conversations. For example, you can ask Siri about a restaurant it recommended in a previous conversation instead of starting from scratch.

Siri AI can also draw information from more sources, including photos attached to Messages, Calendar event attendees, and voicemails. Apple has improved how Siri uses Safari browsing history and Reading List information to provide relevant answers.

The update also introduces an Excluded Apps setting. This option lets users select which apps will be available to Siri, Search, and system suggestions. Thus, you can control how Apple’s intelligent features interact with personal information.

Another useful addition is granular text selection in Siri responses. Instead of copying an entire answer, users can select and copy only the specific text they need.

Siri AI adds support for five more languages

With iOS 27.2, Siri AI expands beyond English to support five additional languages:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

However, Siri AI remains unavailable in the European Union and mainland China. The feature also requires compatible hardware, including the iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max, along with the iPhone 16 series and newer supported models.

Messages gets contextual suggestions

The Messages app adds a feature called Suggestions, which helps users act on the context of their conversations.

For example, if someone sends a dinner invitation, Messages may suggest adding the event to Calendar. Other supported suggestions can help users create reminders, add information to Notes, open locations in Maps, or track flights and packages.

You can also choose which categories of suggestions you want to see, providing more control over the feature.

Apple Music gets a visual refresh

Apple Music gets a visual refresh in iOS 27.2. As part of Apple’s latest Apple Music rebranding, the update brings a redesigned black-and-white app icon that replaces its familiar red appearance.

The changes extend inside the app, where blue replaces red as the accent color for selected navigation elements. Also, Music widgets have been updated with black backgrounds to match the updated visual identity.

Photos improves Shared Albums and image transparency

The Photos app receives several practical improvements in iOS 27.2.

  • Shared Albums allows editing captions and comments so that participants can correct information or update details after posting.
  • Apple also added ways to avoid duplicate photos in those albums and to remind users before Shared Albums expire, giving participants a chance to save important images and videos.

Another notable addition is support for Google’s SynthID watermarking technology in Photos and Image Playground. This helps identify images generated in Image Playground and certain edits in Photos, including Extend and Reframe, and larger changes made with the Clean Up tool. Users can check supported images through Google’s SynthID Detector.

Podcasts and Games get smaller but useful updates

Apple has reorganized the Podcasts app’s Home tab to make it easier to find new content and resume unfinished episodes. Instead of grouping everything under Up Next, the interface now separates content into two sections: New Episodes and Continue Playing.

The Games app also receives improvements to its Friends tab. You can see more context for friend suggestions, and view recently played games on friends’ player pages to discover what other players are enjoying.

Apple TV adds profiles on iPhone and iPad

The Apple TV app now supports creating individual profiles directly in the iPhone and iPad app’s account settings. This will help families to keep their recommendations and viewing preferences separate from one another.

You can create a profile by providing a name, selecting a profile rating, and specifying whether it is intended for a child. The default setting for the child profile is PG content rating, with additional options available to customize age ratings for movies and television shows.

FaceTime adds accessibility improvements

iOS 27.2 introduces support for adding a third-party sign language interpreter or live captioner to a FaceTime call. This gives users additional ways to make conversations accessible, depending on their communication needs.

Apple has also expanded Dual Capture to group FaceTime calls on supported iPhone models. The feature lets the front and rear cameras capture video simultaneously, so users can share both their face and their surroundings during a conversation.

Dual Capture support is available on selected newer devices, including the iPhone 17 series, iPhone Air, iPhone 18 Pro models, and iPhone Duo, running the latest iOS 27 version.

Shortcuts app gets new Automation features

Apple has introduced several improvements to the Shortcuts app in iOS 27.2.

  • New iPhone Duo automation: Create automations that run when you open or close your foldable iPhone.
  • Workout automation: The “When I Start a Workout” trigger now supports the Fitness app to automate workout-related tasks.
  • Improved app automation: The “When Weather Is Opened or Closed” trigger can now provide the name of the app that was closed.
  • Easier shortcut editing: You can edit shortcut names and icons directly from the Shortcuts library on iPhone and iPad.

iPhone Duo gets Apple Pencil support

One of the more notable device-specific additions is support for Apple Pencil (USB-C) on the iPhone Duo. The feature lets you draw, annotate, and interact with supported content using a compatible Apple Pencil.

Apple had previously indicated that Pencil support would arrive later, and iOS 27.2 delivers that capability through a software update.

The update also introduces Edge Light on the iPhone Duo, which illuminates the user’s face during video calls.

More changes across iOS 27.2

Beyond the headline features, the update includes several additional improvements:

  • Apple TV Multiview: Watch up to four live sports streams simultaneously in the Apple TV app for supported sports events included in the subscription, such as Major League Soccer, Formula 1 (F1) in the U.S., and Friday Night Baseball doubleheaders during the Major League Baseball season.
  • Phone app: Call Context can remind users of a contact’s anniversary during a call when the date is saved in Contacts.
  • Home app: Compatible smart locks now offer options such as automatically locking after a door closes and alerts when a door stays open too long.
  • HomePod: A new Lock Controls setting helps prevent accidental audio playback from unwanted touches while preserving controls for functions such as timers and alarms.
  • Clock: Alarm lists now use smaller a.m. and p.m. labels.
  • App Tracking Transparency: Users in the European Union receive changes to tracking permission prompts, including an alternative expanded prompt in certain countries.

Apple also tested a redesigned Health app during the iOS 27.2 beta period. However, that redesign did not make it into the public release and is expected to arrive in a later update.

iOS 27.2 includes more than 160 security fixes

Alongside its new features, iOS 27.2 addresses more than 160 security vulnerabilities. Apple has indicated that the vulnerabilities fixed in this release were not actively exploited, but installing security updates remains an important way to protect an iPhone.

Overall, iOS 27.2 is a substantial update that makes Apple’s software more useful across everyday tasks. If you have a compatible iPhone, I recommend installing the update to take advantage of the new features, expanded AI capabilities, and important security fixes.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"Ava is a die-hard Apple aficionado and seasoned writer with a knack for breaking down complex tech concepts into easily digestible content. Having honed her writing and editing skills over 5 years at renowned media houses like TechBurner, Ava crafts informative and engaging articles including troubleshooting guides, product reviews, editorials at iGeeksBlog. When not typing, you can find her exploring the latest Apple releases or pondering the future of tech innovation."

About Ava Biswas

  • Ava is a die-hard Apple aficionado and loves testing the latest tech gadgets.
  • She is always on the lookout for issues Apple users are facing, finds solutions, and crafts troubleshooting guides.
  • Her goal to make tech easy for everyone encouraged her to break down complex concepts into easily digestible content.

Experience

Ava has been employing her professional writing and editing skills for over 4 years at renowned media houses like TechBurner and iGeeksBlog. Using her expertise, she crafts informative and engaging How-To's, troubleshooting guides, product reviews, and editorials. When not typing, you can find her exploring the latest Apple releases or pondering new tech innovations.

title.rendered: Best Minecraft servers to play in 2026: IPs, modes and editions

content.rendered:
There’s no denying that Minecraft is fun on its own, but playing with other people takes the experience to a whole new level. Whether you want to team up with friends, compete against other players, or explore a completely different kind of adventure, Minecraft servers offer something for everyone.

Over the years, thousands of servers have introduced unique game modes, including PvP, SkyBlock, Factions, MMORPGs, and minigames. With so many options available, choosing the right server can be tricky. To help you decide, we’ve rounded up some of the best Minecraft servers to try in 2026, from Hypixel and The Hive to the newly relaunched Mineplex, along with their server addresses, supported editions, and standout features.

Best Minecraft servers at a glance

Note: Server availability, supported Minecraft versions, and connection details can change. Check each server’s official website if you encounter connection issues.

Best Minecraft servers in 2026

1. Hypixel

Server IP Address: mc.hypixel.net

It’s safe to say that Hypixel remains one of the most popular Minecraft servers in 2026, thanks to its mix of competitive multiplayer and original minigames. It features various modes like Bed Wars, SkyBlock, SkyWars, Murder Mystery, and plenty of other games that can keep you entertained for hundreds of hours. Whether you enjoy PvP battles or prefer more relaxed gameplay, Hypixel has something for everyone.

2. The Hive

Server IP Address: geo.hivebedrock.cloud

If you’re playing Minecraft Bedrock Edition, The Hive is definitely a server worth checking out. It is packed with minigames like BedWars, Hide and Seek, Murder Mystery, DeathRun, and plenty of other modes to keep you hooked. One of the best things about The Hive is the fact that it’s accessible across multiple platforms, including mobile devices and consoles.

3. MCC Island

Server IP Address: play.mccisland.net

Next up, we have MCC Island, which takes inspiration from the popular Minecraft Championship tournament. It’s particularly famous for its fast-paced games, including Hole in the Wall, Sky Battle, and Battle Box, where you can compete against other players or team up with your friends. What makes MCC Island stand out compared to other Minecraft servers is its focus on skill-based gameplay and progression, which gives you tons of reasons to keep playing.

4. CubeCraft Games

Server IP Address: play.cubecraft.net

CubeCraft is one of the OG Minecraft servers, having been around since 2012. While it does not offer a massive selection of games, it makes up for it with well-designed games like EggWars, SkyWars, Lucky Islands, and parkour, featuring multiple themes. It’s also a great choice if you want to play with friends, as several game modes offer team-based gameplay where you can work together and take on other players.

5. Mineplex

Server IP: mineplex.com (Java), play.mineplex.com, port 19132 (Bedrock)

Mineplex was once one of the most popular Minecraft servers thanks to its mind-boggling selection of games. However, it was shut down in May 2023, which left many in the community disappointed. It was the server that debuted several classic game modes, such as Bridges, Cake Wars, Dragon Escape, and SkyWars. Fortunately, the server returned under new ownership on June 12, 2026, bringing back classic titles and even attracting a peak of around 11,000 players upon its return. The developers have plenty of plans for the future, with seasonal events and regular updates to keep things fresh.

6. Wynncraft

Server IP: play.wynncraft.com

Wynncraft is the Minecraft server to try if you’re looking for the ultimate MMORPG experience. Taking cues from the likes of RuneScape, it features a massive custom-built fantasy world where you can explore different regions, complete quests, battle enemies, and hunt for treasures. The best part about all of this is that you don’t need to install any mods to experience this full-fledged RPG. 2026 has proven to be a major year for Wynncraft, as the developers finally released the Fruma Expansion on April 4, 2026, after seven years of development.

7. DonutSMP

Server IP: donutsmp.net

The final entry on our list of the best Minecraft servers is none other than DonutSMP. The server has gained popularity in the community for its survival gameplay and chaotic PvP battles. You can build your own base, gather resources, and fight other players as you work your way up. With an active community and a steady stream of updates, DonutSMP is a great server if you’re trying to experience the more competitive side of Minecraft.

Which Minecraft server is best for you?

After spending hours playing Minecraft and testing different game modes across servers, we can say that choosing the best Minecraft server ultimately comes down to personal preference. Each server we’ve listed above caters to a specific playstyle and audience. However, if you’re still confused, we’ve also put together a quick list to help you find the right pick:

  • PvP/minigames: If you’re in the mood for competitive modes like Bed Wars and SkyWars, Hypixel and Mineplex are your best bets.
  • Bedrock & mobile: The Hive is an excellent choice for Bedrock players, including those on mobile. It has tons of minigames that can be enjoyed with strangers and friends.
  • RPG: Nothing comes close to the RPG experience you’ll get on Wynncraft. Its extensive quests, dungeons, and character progression make it a great choice for any MMORPG fan.
  • Survival: Love grinding for resources and fighting other players? Well, consider DonutSMP. It’s a server all about survival, progression, and PvP.

How to join a Minecraft server on Java and Bedrock

Joining a Minecraft server is quite easy, but the process depends on whether you’re playing Java Edition on PC or Bedrock Edition on mobile, console, or PC. Before you get started, make sure you have the server’s IP address and port, and check whether it supports your version of Minecraft.

Not sure which version you’re playing? Our guide to Minecraft Java vs. Bedrock Edition explains the key differences.

Join a Minecraft server on Java Edition

  1. Fire up Minecraft on your PC and click Multiplayer from the main menu.
  2. Choose Add Server to add a new server to your list.
  3. Enter a server name of your choice and paste its IP address into the Server Address field.
  4. Click Done to save the server.
  5. Select the server from your list and hit Join Server to start playing.

You also have the option of Direct Connection in the multiplayer menu, where you can enter the server address and join instantly without saving it to your list.

Join a Minecraft server on Bedrock Edition

  1. Launch Minecraft and choose Play from the main menu.
  2. Find the Servers tab.
  3. Scroll down and choose Add Server.
  4. Enter the server address and port number if required. The default port is 19132.
  5. Hit Add and Play to connect to the server.

Some featured servers, including The Hive and CubeCraft, can be accessed directly through the Servers tab. On consoles, adding a custom server may be restricted or require additional steps, depending on the platform.

Wrapping up

Minecraft servers offer plenty of ways to enjoy the game beyond single-player, whether you’re into competitive minigames, survival challenges, or full-fledged RPG adventures. Hypixel and MCC Island are great for competitive gameplay, The Hive is a solid choice for Bedrock players, and Wynncraft is worth exploring if you prefer quest-driven RPGs. Meanwhile, DonutSMP offers a more intense survival experience with PvP and player-driven progression.

Ultimately, the best Minecraft server depends on your preferred playstyle and the edition you’re using. Try a few options from this list, explore their game modes, and find the community that suits you best. Just make sure to check the server address and version requirements before joining.

FAQs

Are Minecraft servers free to play?

Most Minecraft servers are free to join and play. However, many servers also offer paid ranks, cosmetics, and other perks that can be purchased with real money.

Can Java and Bedrock players play together?

Java and Bedrock players can play together, but only on servers that support crossplay, such as CubeCraft, Mineplex, and DonutSMP.

What is the best Minecraft server for PvP?

Hypixel is considered one of the best servers for PvP in Minecraft. It’s a great choice if you enjoy competitive matches and battling other players.

Is Mineplex back?

Yes. Mineplex officially returned on June 12, 2026, under new ownership, bringing back classic minigames with support for Java and Bedrock.

What is the most popular Minecraft server?

Hypixel remains one of the most popular Minecraft servers, thanks to its huge selection of minigames and SkyBlock.

What is the best Minecraft server for iPhone?

The Hive is considered the best Minecraft server for iPhone players.

Which Minecraft version should I use for Hypixel?

You can still use Minecraft 1.8.9 for Hypixel’s classic minigames, but SkyBlock now requires Minecraft 1.21.9 or newer.

title.rendered: Apple unveils new iPad Mini with OLED display, A20 Pro chip, and more

content.rendered:
Apple has announced its new iPad mini, bringing the tablet’s biggest upgrade in years with an OLED display, a powerful A20 Pro chip, and a thinner, lighter design. The new model also introduces water and dust resistance, improved cameras, and faster connectivity, making it a more capable option for users who want a compact tablet. It starts at $699, with pre-orders opening on October 28.

iPad Mini gets a bigger OLED display

The new iPad mini features an 8.5-inch OLED display, up from the previous model’s 8.3-inch LCD screen.

Apple says the display delivers deeper blacks, richer colors, and peak brightness of up to 1,200 nits, more than double the previous model. A nano-texture glass option is also available on the 256GB and 512GB models for reducing glare in bright environments. The larger screen fits into the same overall footprint thanks to 24% thinner bezels.

The redesigned tablet measures just 5.4mm thick, compared with 6.3mm for its predecessor, and weighs only 255 grams. It also carries an IP67 rating for water and dust resistance, adding durability for everyday use.

A20 Pro chip brings a performance boost

Apple has equipped the new iPad mini with the A20 Pro chip, which includes Neural Accelerators in each GPU core to support demanding tasks and Apple Intelligence features. The tablet runs iPadOS 27, bringing Apple’s latest software capabilities to the compact device.

Other notable upgrades include a 12MP Center Stage front camera positioned along the landscape edge for video calls, fast charging support (up to 50% in around 30 minutes with a compatible adapter), and an Acoustic Display speaker system that hides the speakers beneath the glass and enclosure.

Apple has also upgraded wireless connectivity with its N1 chip, which supports Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread. Cellular models include the C2 modem, which Apple says delivers up to 50% faster cellular data speeds than the previous model.

New iPad Mini price and release date

The new iPad mini starts at $699 for the Wi-Fi model with 128GB of storage, a $100 increase over the previous model’s starting price. The Wi-Fi + Cellular version starts at $849. Buyers have three storage options (128GB, 256GB, and 512GB) and two color choices: Midnight and Starlight.

In India, the new iPad mini is priced from ₹82,900 for the Wi-Fi model and ₹1,00,900 for the Wi-Fi + Cellular model.

Pre-orders open at 10:10 a.m. PT (1:10 p.m. ET) on October 28, 2026, while the tablet will arrive in stores and begin reaching customers on November 6.

Equipped with an OLED screen, an enhanced processor, and increased durability, the new iPad mini offers a substantial refresh for users who want a powerful, easy-to-carry tablet. However, the higher starting price may make buyers weigh whether the display and performance upgrades justify the additional cost.

title.rendered: Doja Cat returns to Fortnite: Here’s how to get the skin

content.rendered:
Popular American singer and rapper Doja Cat has entered the Item Shop in Fortnite once again, drawing a lot of fan attention. As a result, the Doja Cat skin and related cosmetics are among the “best sellers” in the game at the time of writing.

First introduced in October 2025 (Chapter 6 Season 4), these Doja Cat items are up for grabs individually and as part of the Doja Cat Fortnite bundle. Two skins have come out of this crossover, and each costs 1,500 V-Bucks. If you buy them with the bundle, everything together will cost you 3,200 V-Bucks. The offer lasts as long as this particular Fortnite collab is in the Shop, which is until October 30, 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET.

How to get the Doja Cat skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab.
  2. Then, scroll down to the Doja Cat section and select your desired Doja Cat skin.
  3. Once that’s done, press and hold the Purchase button to complete your transaction.

All Doja Cat Bundle items in Fortnite

The main Doja Cat Bundle contains 12 items, including two outfits, pickaxes, back blings, emotes, wraps, a Jam Track, and a loading screen, worth 7,700 V-Bucks if bought separately. A few extras, such as the Lamborghini car body and wheels, are sold outside the bundle. Here’s a breakdown of the items and their individual prices.

1. Doja Cat

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

2. Mother Of Thorns Doja

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

3. Agora Wings back bling

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

4. Scarlet Wings back bling

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

5. Doja’s Claw Swords pickaxe

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

6. Mother’s Mic pickaxe and back bling

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

7. Agora Hills emote

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

8. Woman emote

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

9. Fallen petals wrap

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

10. Rhinestoned wrap

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

11. Lamborghini Huracan STO car body

  • Price: 3,500 V-Bucks

12. Wheel of Thorns wheels

  • Price: 400 V-Bucks

13. Agora wheels

  • Price: 400 V-Bucks

14. Aaahh Men! jam track

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

15. Paint The Town Red jam track

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks

16. Mirrored Mother loading screen

  • Exclusively available in: Doja Cat Bundle

Singer collabs in Fortnite in 2026

Fortnite has kept singer collabs coming regularly in 2026, just as it has over the past few years. This year’s lineup has included many singers making their debut in the game, such as Lil Wayne, Olivia Rodrigo, Madison Beer, Chappell Roan, and Laufey.

Apart from the above, a bunch of previously introduced musician skins were also rotated back into the Item Shop this year, with Icon-tier Fortnite skins such as those inspired by Eminem, Lady Gaga, Billie Eilish, Sabrina Carpenter, and Ice Spice in the mix. And now, with this latest return, Doja Cat joins the list of returning singer-based skins.

With another Fortnite Festival season still to come this year, it’s fair to expect at least one more notable singer to make their way into the game. As of Season 15, which wraps up on October 31, Lil Tecca is headlining the affairs, and according to recent rumors, A$AP Rocky is among the prime suspects for this role next. The rapper has already teased a Fortnite collab on Instagram, and leakers expect his arrival around November 1, though Epic Games hasn’t confirmed a date yet.

FAQs

Is Doja Cat still in Fortnite?

Yes, the Doja Cat outfit is available to buy again, for the first time since February 2026.

How long will Doja Cat be in Fortnite?

Doja Cat dropped with the October 25, 8 PM ET / 5 PM PT Shop reset (October 26 in UTC) and will stay in the Shop for roughly five days, until October 30 at 8 PM ET / 5 PM PT (October 31 in UTC).

How to get Doja Cat emote in Fortnite?

To get one of Doja Cat’s emotes (Agora Hills or Woman, 500 V-Bucks each), you have to either purchase it individually or grab the Doja Cat Bundle.

title.rendered: Instagram tests 90-minute horizontal videos to take on YouTube

content.rendered:
Instagram is making another move into long-form video, and this time, it is targeting podcasters, comedians, and creators who want to share full-length content without sending viewers to another platform. The Meta-owned social network is testing a new format called Features, which supports horizontal videos up to 90 minutes long.

According to The Hollywood Reporter, the test began with select creators in the United States on October 26, 2026, following earlier testing in Brazil. Instagram plans to expand the US test to tens of thousands of creators. The feature could help Instagram compete more directly with YouTube, particularly as video podcasts and creator-led entertainment continue to attract audiences.

Instagram wants viewers to watch full-length videos

Features is designed to bridge the gap between Instagram’s short-form Reels and longer videos. Creators can connect shorter Reels to their full-length videos, allowing viewers to discover a clip and continue watching the complete episode without leaving Instagram.

The platform also plans to recommend these longer videos on the Explore page and elsewhere in the app. This approach would let creators capitalize on the success of their viral clips and create longer viewing experiences without viewers having to leave Instagram.

The move addresses the time limitation of Reels, which typically run around three minutes or less, and opens the door to full podcast episodes, comedy specials, interviews, and other long-form productions. Early creators involved in the test include podcast host and SKIMS co-founder Emma Grede, beauty creator Monet McMichael, street interviewer Preston Rakovsky, and football content creator Donald De La Haye.

In addition, Instagram is looking for ways to help creators earn money from this content through existing brand partnerships and sponsored placements. However, the company has not yet established a YouTube-style revenue-sharing model for this new format.

Instagram is expanding beyond smartphones

The Features test arrives as Instagram broadens its video strategy beyond mobile devices. The company recently introduced its dedicated Apple TV app, letting users watch Reels and other video content on a larger screen and making its content part of the living-room entertainment experience.

Features will start on mobile, but Instagram’s longer-term plan is to bring these videos to its TV app as well.

With longer videos, television support, and enhanced features for discovering content, Instagram seems to be moving beyond being just a social media app.

title.rendered: How to check Activation Lock before buying a used Apple device

content.rendered:
If you’re planning to buy a used Apple device, there’s one step you should never skip: checking its Activation Lock status. If it’s turned on, you won’t be able to use the device without the previous owner’s Apple Account credentials.

Keep reading, and I’ll show you how to check Activation Lock before buying a used iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Watch. I’ll also share what to do if the device is iCloud-locked.

What exactly is Activation Lock on Apple devices?

Activation Lock is a security feature that’s part of Apple’s Find My service, and it stops anyone else from using your device. It turns on automatically when you set up Find My on your device. Apple stores your Apple Account on its activation servers and links it to that device.

After that, anyone who wants to turn off Find My, erase the device, or reactivate and use it needs the original Apple Account and password (or, on iPhone and iPad, the device passcode). This makes a lost or stolen Apple device practically useless to anyone except its owner.

Activation Lock also stays on even if you remotely erase your device, as long as Find My isn’t turned off. Every time someone tries to activate the device, it checks with Apple’s servers and asks for the owner’s credentials. This also improves your chances of getting a lost or stolen Apple device back.

Note: AirPods, AirTag, and other Find My accessories can also be locked to an Apple Account. If you’re buying used AirPods, ask the seller to remove them from the Find My app or iCloud.com/find first. Apple can’t remove this lock for you.

Why check the Activation Lock status before buying a used Apple device?

Apple’s advice is simple: if the device is Activation Locked, don’t buy it. Checking the status upfront helps you:

  • Avoid buying a stolen device: A device that’s still locked could be lost or stolen.
  • Make sure you can use it: You can’t set up or activate a locked device.
  • Get a fresh start: A properly erased device has no old accounts or data on it.
  • Avoid scams: Some sellers don’t mention that the device is still linked to their account, and only offer to remove it later for an extra fee.

Besides Activation Lock, there are a few other things to check, especially on a used iPhone. See our checklist of things to check before buying a used iPhone for more details.

Where you buy also matters. If you’re looking for a refurbished iPhone, our guide to the best places to buy a refurbished iPhone can help.

How to check the Activation Lock status on iPhone or iPad

You need the device in hand, because Apple no longer offers a way to check Activation Lock remotely. Here are three ways to check it on a used iPhone or iPad (the same steps work on an older iPod touch).

Method 1: During setup

Turn on the device or wake it up and If you see any of the following alerts…

Activation Lock is turned on:

  • iPhone Locked to Owner: Activation Lock is on (iOS/iPadOS 15 or later). Don’t buy the device.
  • Hello screen: The device has been erased and is ready to set up. Go ahead and set it up with your own Apple Account.
  • If setup later asks for the previous owner’s Apple Account and password, the device is still linked to their account. Don’t buy it until the seller removes it.

Method 2: From the Lock Screen

  1. Turn on the device.
  2. If you see a Lock Screen asking for a passcode, or the Home Screen, the device hasn’t been erased yet.
  3. Ask the seller to factory reset it in front of you.
  4. After it’s erased, start the setup.
  5. If you’re asked for the previous owner’s Apple Account and password, Activation Lock is still on.

Method 3: Using Find My settings

  1. If the device is already set up, open the Settings app.
  2. Tap Apple Account at the top and select Find My.

  3. Here, tap on Find My iPhone (or iPad/iPod Touch). If Find My is turned on, Activation Lock is also enabled.

  4. Ask the seller to turn it off, sign out of their Apple Account, and erase the device before you pay.

Tip: If the seller has Stolen Device Protection turned on, they may need Face ID or Touch ID to make these changes. If they’re away from a familiar location, some actions, like signing out of their Apple Account, can also need a one-hour security delay. Plan the handover with that in mind.

While you’re in Settings, also go to General → About → Parts and Service History. Apple says Activation Lock can protect individual parts too. A part listed as “Unknown” may be non-genuine or taken from another iPhone.

How to check the Activation Lock status on a used Mac

Like iPhone, a Mac turns on Activation Lock when Find My Mac is turned on. It’s supported on Macs with Apple silicon or the Apple T2 Security Chip running macOS Catalina or later, when two-factor authentication is on for the Apple Account. Here’s how to check:

  1. Click the Apple menu () and choose About This Mac.
  2. Click More Info, then scroll down and click System Report. (You can also hold the Option key and choose Apple menu → System Information.)
  3. In Hardware Overview, look at Activation Lock Status.

Buy the Mac only if it says Disabled.

You can also go to System Settings → [seller’s name] → iCloud and check whether Find My Mac is on.

If the Mac has already been erased, start the setup. If you see an Activation Lock screen asking for an Apple Account, don’t buy the Mac until the seller removes it from their account.

How to check Activation Lock status for a used Apple Watch

You can also go to System Settings → [seller’s name] → iCloud and check whether Find My Mac is on.

If the Mac has already been erased, start the setup. If you see an Activation Lock screen asking for an Apple Account, don’t buy the Mac until the seller removes it from their account.

How to check Activation Lock status on a used Apple Watch

When you pair an Apple Watch with an iPhone that has Find My turned on, Activation Lock turns on for the watch too.

  1. Turn on the Apple Watch. If you see the watch face, apps, or a passcode screen, it hasn’t been erased yet. Ask the seller to unpair it from their iPhone, which turns off Activation Lock and erases the watch.
  2. Try pairing the watch with your iPhone. If setup asks for the previous owner’s Apple Account password, Activation Lock is still on, and you can’t use the watch.
  3. For cellular models, also make sure the seller has removed and cancelled their cellular plan.

What to do if the device is iCloud locked?

If you find out that a device you’re buying, or already bought, is Activation Locked, here’s what to do:

  • Check for Lost Mode: If the screen shows a lost message or the owner’s contact details, the device may be stolen. Don’t buy it.
  • Ask the seller to remove it remotely: They can sign in at iCloud.com/find with the Apple Account shown on the screen, select the device, and click Remove This Device. They can also do this from the Find My app on another device.
  • Apple Watch: Ask the seller to unpair it in the Watch app, or remove it from Find My.
  • Seller forgot their password: They can reset it at iforgot.apple.com. The original owner can also submit an Activation Lock support request to Apple with proof of purchase (Apple’s Activation Lock removal page).
  • Walk away if the seller won’t unlock it. The device may be stolen.
  • Report suspicious listings to the marketplace or local authorities.

For more details, see our guide on what to do if your iPhone or iPad is stuck on Activation Lock.

Signing off…

Checking Activation Lock before buying a used iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Watch takes a minute and can save you from a device you can’t use. Make sure Find My is turned off and the previous owner has removed their Apple Account before you pay. If Activation Lock is still on, walk away. It’s not worth the risk.

FAQs

How can I bypass the Activation Lock on my iPhone?

You cannot legally bypass Activation Lock. Apple designed it as a security feature to prevent stolen devices from being used. The only way to remove it is by entering the original Apple Account and password. If you forgot your Apple Account, visit Apple’s official recovery page.

Does factory resetting remove the Activation Lock?

No. Factory resetting does not remove the Activation Lock from an Apple device. Even if you erase the device, it will still ask for the previous owner’s Apple Account and password during setup. Activation Lock can only be disabled by turning off Find My iPhone before erasing the device.

title.rendered: iPhone Duo display cracked or showing a white line? Here’s what to do

content.rendered:
The iPhone Duo’s new foldable display has raised concerns after some users reported cracks near the hinge shortly after its October 23 launch. Some have also noticed white lines and pixel issues on the inner screen, raising questions about the phone’s durability.

Apple hasn’t confirmed the cause or how widespread the issue is yet. If you’ve just bought a Duo, here’s what I’d look out for and what I’d do if it happened to my phone. The good news is that if a manufacturing defect caused the crack, Apple’s one-year limited warranty may cover it, so don’t rush into paying for a repair.

What is the “Crackgate” issue with the iPhone Duo display?

On Reddit, several owners reported cracks appearing along the center crease, with a horizontal block of pixels glowing white. In some cases, it happened right during setup, making people wonder if just folding the phone would be enough to make this happen.

The investigation is becoming more interesting because the display itself may not be the cause. In my iPhone Duo hinge teardown report, I already discussed how certain components could put excessive pressure on the delicate inner display. Dust entering the hinge and potential stress points around its internal components have also attracted attention.

However, further investigation hasn’t established that all the cracks have the same origin. According to Apple, “We are aware of an issue impacting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units. If users experience issues with their iPhone Duo display, they should contact AppleCare for a replacement.”

For owners, the immediate concern is simpler: a damaged folding display can be expensive to replace. So don’t panic if your phone works normally, but watch for unusual hinge noises, visible cracks, flickering, or bright lines across the screen.

What to do immediately if your iPhone Duo display is cracked

If you notice a crack or display defect, avoid experimenting with the phone to determine how bad the problem is. Here’s how I’d handle the situation.

1. Stop folding and unfolding the phone

My first move would be to stop opening and closing the iPhone Duo unnecessarily. Apple’s official iPhone Duo hinge troubleshooting guide also recommends checking for hinge problems such as unusual noises, stiffness, misalignment, and visible damage.

Do not force the hinge if it feels stiff, makes an unusual clicking or cracking sound, or refuses to close completely. Apple’s handling guidance mainly focuses on keeping sand and grit away from the hinge, but you should also avoid pressing directly on the display crease or forcing the two halves together.

Keep the phone on a stable surface when you are not using it. If the white line is getting worse, the hinge looks damaged, or the device gets unusually hot, stop using it and get in touch with Apple.

2. Document the damage

While preparing to contact Apple, make sure you take photographs of the cracked iPhone Duo screen. Include photos of the central crease, the entire inner screen, the outer screen, and the hinge from multiple angles. If you notice bright white or green lines, flickering, or dead pixels, photograph those symptoms too.

I would also record a short video if the display defect changes or flickers, as long as I can do so without repeatedly moving the hinge. Keep your purchase receipt, order confirmation, and any relevant service records.

When speaking with Apple Support, describe exactly what happened. For example, explain whether the crack appeared during normal use, whether you dropped the phone, or whether you heard a cracking noise from the hinge.

3. Back up your iPhone data

A cracked screen does not necessarily mean your phone will stop working right away. But internal damage might cause problems that make it hard to access your data.

If the screen is still usable, back up your iPhone Duo to iCloud or a compatible computer. Wait until the backup finishes before you send the phone in.

4. Avoid DIY repairs and screen protector removal

Even though Apple has published official iPhone Duo repair documentation, I wouldn’t recommend opening the device or attempting an inner-display repair.

First of all, foldable displays are especially fragile, and the hinge complicates things. Pulling at the display, inserting tools into the hinge, or pressing on the crease could turn a minor issue into a more expensive repair.

Do not peel off the inner display’s cover layer simply because it looks damaged. The protective layer is not the same thing as the underlying display. Also, keep the hinge away from sand and loose debris, and use a soft, lint-free cloth to clean accessible surfaces.

One thing to know: Apple says hinge issues don’t have software-based fixes, so restarting, updating, or restoring your iPhone won’t fix a mechanical hinge problem. If the display is cracked or the hinge appears damaged, arrange a professional inspection.

How to get your cracked iPhone Duo repaired or replaced

Contact Apple Support first rather than going straight to an independent repair shop. Explain the symptoms, when they started, and whether the phone has experienced any impact or unusual hinge behavior. Then follow their recommendations.

The next step is visiting either an Apple Store or an Apple Authorized Service Provider, depending on availability in your area. Ask the technician to inspect the inner display and hinge, and ask whether the device qualifies for warranty service or a replacement.

Will Apple replace a cracked iPhone Duo for free? It’s possible, but nothing is certain. Apple’s limited warranty generally covers qualifying manufacturing defects, while accidental damage is treated differently. The final decision depends on the inspection, the applicable warranty terms, and the cause of the failure.

Early reports indicate that some affected owners obtained replacement devices through Apple Stores, although other buyers had difficulty. If you bought the device through a mobile carrier or another retailer, contact AppleCare directly to get your device replaced.

How much does it cost to fix a cracked iPhone Duo display?

The cost is one of the biggest reasons to seek a proper diagnosis before authorizing a repair. According to Apple’s iPhone Duo out-of-warranty repair costs, the repair estimates are as follows:

The difference is substantial. An inner-display replacement costs $999 without AppleCare+, while the listed AppleCare+ service fee is $99 for qualifying damage. AppleCare+ is a separate paid plan ($19.99 a month, $199.99 a year, or $399 upfront for AppleCare+ with Theft and Loss in the US), so you should also consider its cost when comparing the total expense.

However, Apple says AppleCare+ is not required to have your iPhone Duo replaced for this problem

My advice is straightforward: if your iPhone Duo develops a crack during normal use, start with a warranty assessment. Paying nearly $1,000 for a replacement without determining the cause shouldn’t be the first step.

What should you do if the screen is not cracked but shows a white line?

A white line across the iPhone Duo display can be alarming, especially if the phone hasn’t been dropped. The problem may involve the display panel, its internal connections, or another hardware fault. A visible line alone is not enough to identify the cause.

Start by observing the symptom without repeatedly folding the phone. Check whether the line remains visible across different apps and screens. If the device is otherwise safe to use, a normal restart may help rule out a temporary software glitch.

If the line persists, grows, flickers, or appears alongside touch-response problems, arrange a professional inspection. If you also hear a snapping sound or notice unusual hinge movement, stop operating the hinge and contact Apple.

Most importantly, don’t wait for a white line to become a complete display failure before seeking help. Early documentation and a timely service assessment can make the next steps easier.

Final thoughts

The early iPhone Duo display failures are concerning, but I would not conclude that all devices have a faulty hinge based on a limited number of reports. The cause, scale, and long-term implications still need to be established.

If your iPhone Duo screen has cracked, stop folding it, document the damage, back up your data, and contact Apple before agreeing to a paid repair. With an out-of-warranty inner-display replacement listed at $999 in the US, getting the diagnosis right matters.

A premium folding phone should not leave its owner guessing whether normal use will damage the screen. Until Apple clarifies the reported failures, focus on protecting the device, preserving evidence, and seeking warranty options before spending another dollar.

mainEntity.name: How can I bypass the Activation Lock on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: You cannot legally bypass Activation Lock. Apple designed it as a security feature to prevent stolen devices from being used. The only way to remove it is by entering the original Apple Account and password. If you forgot your Apple Account, visit Apple's official recovery page.

mainEntity.name: Does factory resetting remove the Activation Lock?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Factory resetting does not remove the Activation Lock from an Apple device. Even if you erase the device, it will still ask for the previous owner’s Apple Account and password during setup. Activation Lock can only be disabled by turning off Find My iPhone before erasing the device.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Anime Ball Duels Codes on November 22, 2026

Anime Ball Duels is a Roblox experience that brings a unique twist to competitive gameplay. So, what’s so special about it? Well, it brings ball battles with your favorite anime characters. You’ll be going head-to-head against other players, relying on smart timing, quick movements, and special abilities to claim victory.

However, progressing through the game requires tons of resources, including Coins, Gems, Trait Crystals, and more. Luckily, we’ve gathered a list of all the working Anime Ball Duels codes that can get you these resources for free, and we update it regularly, so you never miss a new one!

All working Anime Ball Duels codes

  • SKILLSHUTDOWN: 5,000 Coins, 400 Gems, 25 Trait Crystals, 1,500 Raid Tokens, 5 Boss Tickets, 8 Spins (NEW)
  • AKATSUKI: 20,000 Coins, 1,500 Gems, 60 Trait Crystals, 1,500 Raid Tokens, 5 Boss Tickets, 8 Spins (NEW)
  • SKILLMODE: 15,000 Coins, 1,200 Gems, 50 Trait Crystals, 1,200 Raid Tokens, 4 Boss Tickets, 6 Spins (NEW)
  • SEASON3: 25,000 Coins, 2,000 Gems, 75 Trait Crystals, 2,000 Raid Tokens, 6 Boss Tickets, 10 Spins, and 1,500 Pass XP (NEW)
  • LBFIX: 7500 coins, 500 gems, 25 crystals, 2 boss tickets, 500 raid tokens, 3 spins (NEW)
  • CLANWARS: 20000 coins, 1500 gems, 60 crystals, 1500 raid tokens, 5 boss tickets, 8 spins
  • FUSIONBETA: 15000 coins, 1200 gems, 50 crystals, 1200 raid tokens, 4 boss tickets, 6 spins
  • SORRYFORDELAY: 25000 coins, 2000 gems, 75 crystals, 2000 raid tokens, 6 boss tickets, 10 spins
  • 16KLIKES: 10000 coins, 750 gems, 40 crystals, 4 boss tickets, 1000 raid tokens, 5 spins
  • 100KFAVORITES: 15000 coins, 1000 gems, 25 crystals, 5 boss tickets, 1500 raid tokens, 8 spins

As of now, these are the only active Anime Ball Duels codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired Anime Ball Duels codes

15KLIKES, 1MVISITS, 2VS2, 67PATHS, BATTLEPASS, BLACKFLASH, BUGFIXESSHUTDOWN, CHATSHUTDOWN, EXTENDED, HACKERSLOST, HALLOWEEN2026, HALLOWEENFINALE, KOKUSHIBONPCISHERE, LASTHALLOWEENSHUTDOWN, LASTLASTSHUTDOWN, LASTSHUTDOWN, NEWSHUTDOWN, PART2SHUTDOWN, RAIDGACHA, RANKEDSHUTDOWN, RANKEDSOON, RANKEDUPDATE, SECRETBOOSTERCODE1234, SORRYFORSHUTDOWN, SORRYSHUTDOWN, STANDS, TRADINGSHUTDOWN, TRADINGUPDATE, UPDATE1, VOID, WEAREBACK, WEWANTCANDYCORN

How to redeem Anime Ball Duels in Roblox

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. In order to use codes, you first need to complete the tutorial and play two quick matches. Once that’s done, here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Anime Ball Duels codes:

  1. Fire up Anime Ball Duels on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load and complete the short tutorial.
  3. Click the Codes button from the right menu.
  4. Paste a working code and hit Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the codes, the rewards should be added to your inventory automatically.

Why aren’t my Anime Ball Duels codes working?

If your Anime Ball Duels codes aren’t working, double-check that you’ve entered them exactly as listed above. Keep in mind that these codes are case-sensitive, so make sure there are no extra spaces before or after them. Also, the Codes button won’t appear until you’ve finished the tutorial and played two matches.

You can simply copy and paste the codes directly from our list. If a code still doesn’t work, it might have expired, or you may have already redeemed its rewards. SECRETBOOSTERCODE1234 will only work if you’re boosting the game’s Discord server.

How to get more Anime Ball Duels codes

The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new Anime Ball Duels codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, bug fixes, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Discord server: Visit the Anime Ball Duels Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
  • Follow the Roblox game page: Check the game’s official Roblox page and developer King Games TD’s community for updates, announcements, and potential code releases.
  • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new Anime Ball Duels codes become available, so you can easily find the latest rewards in one place.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Above The Rim codes, Destroy a Vault codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

How do you unlock new abilities in Anime Ball Duels?

You can unlock new abilities in Anime Ball Duels by pulling new anime balls with Coins and Gems and using the in-game unlock systems, such as trait rolls with Trait Crystals.

How do you win matches in Anime Ball Duels?

In order to win matches in Anime Ball Duels, you need to master your timing, dodge incoming attacks, and use your abilities strategically.

All working Above The Rim codes

How to redeem Above The Rim codes in Roblox

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Before you start, join the 5ivestar Games Roblox group, since codes won’t work without it. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Above The Rim codes:

  1. Fire up Above The Rim on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click the Ticket button at the top of the screen.
  4. Paste a working code and hit Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed a code, the rewards should be added to your inventory automatically.

Why aren’t my Above The Rim codes working?

If your Above The Rim codes aren’t working, double-check that you’ve entered them exactly as listed above. Keep in mind that these codes are case-sensitive, so make sure there are no extra spaces before or after them. You can simply copy and paste the codes directly from our list.

Also, make sure you’ve joined the 5ivestar Games Roblox group. If a code still doesn’t work, it might have expired, or you may have already redeemed its rewards.

How to get more Above The Rim codes

The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new Above The Rim codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Discord server: Visit the Above The Rim Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
  • Follow the Roblox game page: Check the game’s official Roblox page for updates, announcements, and potential code releases.
  • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new Above The Rim codes become available, so you can easily find the latest rewards in one place.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Anime Ball Duels codes, Destroy a Vault codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

Do you need to join the group to redeem codes?

Yes, you need to join the 5ivestar Games Roblox group before you can redeem Above The Rim codes. You can join it directly from the game when prompted.

What can you buy with Coins?

Coins can be used in Above The Rim to purchase in-game items, characters, and cosmetics that can add to your basketball experience.

Yes, Above The Rim codes are case-sensitive, so make sure you enter them exactly as listed above.

title.rendered: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5: New advancement, Packed Ice Bricks & more

content.rendered:
Mojang released Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 on October 20, 2026, bringing a bunch of new winter-themed content to Java Edition. But what makes this snapshot worth checking out? Well, not only does it bring new blocks, but it also adds a new advancement, ambient sounds, gameplay tweaks, technical changes, and plenty of other things for players to explore.

So, if you’re excited, here’s everything you need to know about Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5, including all the new features and how to install it safely.

What’s new in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5?

Packed Ice Bricks

The highlight of Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 is Packed Ice Bricks. This is a new building block that gives players more ways to decorate their builds. Unlike regular packed ice, these bricks aren’t slippery, which makes them quite useful for designing houses. You can craft them by putting down four Packed Ice blocks in a 2×2 crafting grid.

The set comes with four variants for you to use:

  • Packed Ice Brick Slab
  • Packed Ice Brick Stairs
  • Packed Ice Brick Wall
  • Chiseled Packed Ice

You can also make the slabs, stairs, walls and chiseled block in a Stonecutter. To collect them, use a pickaxe (no Silk Touch needed, unlike other ice blocks), or even your bare hands, though that’s slower. So, collecting them shouldn’t be much of a hassle.

New advancement: What goes around comes around

There’s also a new Adventure advancement called “What Goes Around Comes Around”. In order to obtain it, you need to kill a Frostbite with an Ice Ball. These projectiles can be easily obtained by defeating Frostbites, which spawn in ice caves and cold biomes. You can also encounter them when regular zombies get submerged in powder snow, which gives you another way to find these mobs.

Ice now has ambient sounds

Tired of Minecraft’s icy environments feeling a bit too quiet? Mojang has added ambient sounds for regular Ice blocks to make these areas feel even more alive. However, the sounds only have a chance of playing under certain conditions. An Ice block must have at least eight Ice blocks surrounding it horizontally, a Water block underneath, and an Air block right above it.

Mob projectiles can break blocks in Adventure mode

Mobs have also received a small change in Adventure mode. Their projectiles can now break certain blocks, including Decorated Pots, Chorus Flowers, and Speleothems. This could prove to be trouble if you’re trying to protect a build from hostile mobs. However, you can prevent this behavior by setting the mob_griefing gamerule to false.

You can also use Minecraft commands to adjust gameplay settings; see our guide to Minecraft cheats and commands.

New “Prefer DXGI Present” video setting (Windows)

Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 also introduces a new Prefer DXGI Present option, which can be found in the Video Settings menu. It’s available exclusively for Windows players, and it lets the game attempt to use DirectX to present the game. This means systems can benefit from better Variable Refresh Rate compatibility, improved IME support, and faster Alt+Tab switching when playing in fullscreen mode. Keep in mind that it’s off by default, Mojang labels it experimental, and not all hardware supports it.

Is Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 available on Bedrock?

Unfortunately, Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 is not available on Bedrock. Bedrock has its own separate testing track, with Preview 26.70.21 playable right now, which brings its own set of features and changes, including Packed Ice Bricks.

For a breakdown of how the two versions differ, see our guide to Minecraft Java vs. Bedrock Edition.

How to install Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 (Mac and Windows)

In order to install Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 on your Mac or Windows PC, you’ll first need Java Edition. Once that’s done, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Minecraft Launcher on your Mac or Windows PC and log in to your account.
  2. Head to the Installations tab at the top of the launcher and enable Snapshots.
  3. Click New Installation, enter a name for your build, and select 26.4-snapshot-5 from the version dropdown menu.
  4. Choose Create, select your installation, and press Play to launch the snapshot.

Once you hit Play, the launcher will automatically download the files needed to run the snapshot. However, make sure to back up your existing worlds before playing, as snapshots are experimental versions that can contain bugs or corrupt your existing worlds. Also, if you’re using the Vulkan renderer, avoid resizing the game window, as this snapshot has a known issue that can crash the game.

When will Minecraft 26.4 release?

As of now, there’s no exact release date for Minecraft 26.4. However, it’s expected that the update will arrive right before the end of 2026, as it’s being projected as the final game drop of the year. Until Mojang announces the official date, players need to wait for further snapshots and a pre-release version to get a better idea of when the next version will launch.

FAQs

Is Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 free?

Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 is free for players who already own a copy of Minecraft Java Edition. You can download and play it through the official launcher without paying anything extra.

Can I play snapshots on iPhone or iPad?

You can’t play Minecraft snapshots on iPhone or iPad. These builds are exclusive to Java Edition, which is available on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Do Packed Ice Bricks melt?

Packed Ice Bricks do not melt when exposed to light or warm conditions.

Can I use my old world?

You can use your existing world to explore Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5. However, as snapshots are experimental and can carry bugs, make sure to create a backup of your world first.

What’s the next snapshot?

There’s no official release date for Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 6 as of now.

aioseo_meta_data.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 adds Packed Ice Bricks and more
aioseo_meta_data.description: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 adds Packed Ice Bricks, ice sounds, a Frostbite advancement and a DXGI option. Here is what is new and how to install it.

blockGraphs.question: Is Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 free?
blockGraphs.answer: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 is free for players who already own a copy of Minecraft Java Edition. You can download and play it through the official launcher without paying anything extra.

blockGraphs.question: Can I play snapshots on iPhone or iPad?
blockGraphs.answer: You can’t play Minecraft snapshots on iPhone or iPad. These builds are exclusive to Java Edition, which is available on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

blockGraphs.question: Do Packed Ice Bricks melt?
blockGraphs.answer: Packed Ice Bricks do not melt when exposed to light or warm conditions.

blockGraphs.question: Can I use my old world?
blockGraphs.answer: You can use your existing world to explore Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5. However, as snapshots are experimental and can carry bugs, make sure to create a backup of your world first.

blockGraphs.question: What’s the next snapshot?
blockGraphs.answer: There’s no official release date for Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 6 as of now.

title.rendered: All 10 Safety In Numbers quests and rewards in Fortnite

content.rendered:
Fortnite’s community-developed maps might not be backed by the game dev wizards at Epic Games, but many of them are no slouch when it comes to drawing the attention of players. However, if you still haven’t explored the unofficial maps in Fortnite, the Safety in Numbers lineup of quests might just be the perfect excuse to change that, and to bring a friend along for the ride.

The Safety in Numbers quests in Fortnite require players to jump into Horror Creator-made Islands or maps with at least one friend in their party and earn XP doing various activities in them. This XP counts toward certain milestones, and completing them makes you eligible for a total of 5 different Safety in Numbers rewards. The quests are available until November 12, 2026, at 6 AM ET (3 AM PT), so you have a little over two weeks left to grind them.

Speaking of Horror Creator-made Islands, which is another name for community-made horror games in Fortnite, let’s check out how you can load them in Fortnite before we get to the Safety in Numbers quest and reward checklist.

How to play Horror Creator-made Fortnite Islands

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Discover tab.
  2. Then, scroll down until you reach the Game Collections section, and select the Thrills & Chills category.
  3. Next, select any map of your choice from the options that appear.
  4. Now, hit Select to switch to the desired map.
  5. Finally, select Play to launch the Horror Creator-made Fortnite Island.

Tip: The Safety in Numbers quests only show up in the Quests tab once a qualifying horror map is selected. If you can’t see them, select a horror island first, then check the Quests tab.

Safety In Numbers quests and rewards list

The Safety in Numbers quests are divided into 10 stages, each asking you to collect 80,000 XP in eligible Fortnite maps. Completing each stage gives you 10,000 XP as a reward, and every second stage also unlocks a cosmetic reward, as listed below.

Once you have unlocked any of these rewards, don’t forget to claim them in time. As soon as you claim an item, it will start appearing in your Locker tab and can be equipped for Fortnite matches.

Popular Horror Creator-made maps in Fortnite

If you are ready to jump into this challenge and unlock the quest rewards above, you may try some of the more popular Horror Creator-made Fortnite Islands. Here are the ones drawing noteworthy levels of player engagement, along with their codes:

  • Scale | Code: 7288-9515-0748
  • Hide Or Die | Code: 6386-2237-2556
  • Jump For Eggs | Code: 3501-7237-8602
  • Murder Mystery | Code: 5253-8468-3364
  • Trick, Treat, Die! | Code: 9279-9186-3094

All the aforementioned Fortnite maps offer XP that counts toward the Safety in Numbers questline. So, you can either mix and match between these maps to collect the required XP or grind one specific map of your choice. It adds to your quest progress either way.

Don’t miss these related reads:

  • Stalkboxes in Fortnite: What they do and how to find them
  • How to get the Jack-O’-Cat sidekick in Fortnite before it leaves
  • How to unlock and find Finger Guns in Fortnite
  • The Final Spritemare full schedule

Level up your gaming setup:

  • Logitech G Astro A10 Wired Gaming Headset
  • SteelSeries Aeon Pro Wireless Controller
  • CyberPowerPC Gaming PC (GeForce RTX 5060)
  • Razer Naga V3 Pro Gaming Mouse
  • Redragon Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

As an Amazon Associate, iGeeksBlog earns from qualifying purchases.

title.rendered: iPhone Duo screen cracks may be linked to hinge design, teardown reveals

content.rendered:
Apple’s first foldable iPhone is facing early durability concerns after reports of cracks and display failures on its inner screen appeared on Reddit within hours of the October 23 release. While early device failures can happen with major product launches, the consistency in how the inner display is cracking has raised concerns about a possible underlying issue.

Teardowns by repair specialists at iFixit and some YouTubers have identified potential problems with the hinge mechanism that could put excessive pressure on the delicate folding display. However, the exact cause remains unconfirmed, and the extent of the problem is still unclear.

Is the iPhone Duo hinge causing the screen cracks?

Videos, including testing by JerryRigEverything, and user reports show a recurring pattern: cracks often begin along the display’s crease and spread horizontally toward the edge. While this initially suggests that the screen itself is failing under bending stress, a separate investigation by YouTuber CuriousHagi points to a possible hinge defect.

During testing involving dirt and stress on the folding mechanism, CuriousHagi found that the iPhone Duo would not close properly. When he tried opening it again, a loud snap occurred, followed by a large white display defect extending from the crease toward the side.

After dismantling the damaged device, he discovered a sheared hinge component near an upper support plate. It looked thinner than other hinge components, which might make it more prone to breakage.

These observations suggest that a hinge component may have broken, struck the screen, and caused the crack. However, this remains a theory based on an individual teardown, not a confirmed explanation for every reported failure.

You may like to read: What to do immediately if your iPhone Duo display is cracked

iFixit teardown shows a similar hinge problem

According to iFixit, some reported display failures appear near the hinge, close to the opening through which a flex cable connects the phone’s two halves. Using teardown footage, Apple patents, and CT scans, the team created a 3D model of the hinge and identified two possible problems.

First, a central support bar might not retract far enough when the phone folds shut, potentially pressing against the inner display. Second, the curved rails guiding the hinge’s movement could rise above surrounding components during folding, creating pressure points that may damage the screen.

These are possible causes of “Crackgate,” but none has been proven. Repeated bending, dust particles, manufacturing defects, or broken electrical connections could also cause screen failure.

iFixit also gave the iPhone Duo a provisional 5/10 repairability score, but flagged the inner display and hinge as the hardest parts to fix. Apple charges $999 to replace the inner screen out of warranty.

Dust exposure raises additional concerns

The iPhone Duo has also struggled in durability testing. In JerryRigEverything’s test, dust reportedly entered the hinge through several openings and overwhelmed the magnets designed to hold the phone shut. During the subsequent bend test, a permanent green line appeared across the inner display before the screen became unresponsive.

Interestingly, iFixit’s separate fluorescent dust test also found particles entering the hinge and producing a crunching sound during operation. However, the iPhone Duo showed less visible dust around its hinge than the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and Pixel 11 Pro Fold in comparable tests.

The iPhone Duo carries an IP68 rating, which indicates protection against dust and water under specified test conditions. However, this does not guarantee that its moving components are immune to particles or mechanical wear.

Should owners be worried?

The reports do not establish that the iPhone Duo has a widespread design flaw. AppleInsider’s initial checks at seven Apple Store locations found no broken-screen cases, though a later check found one instance. These limited observations cannot determine the device’s overall failure rate.

For now, owners should keep debris away from the hinge and contact Apple if they hear odd noises or see cracks or any other signs of damage on their screens.

Ultimately, the teardown findings raise legitimate questions about the iPhone Duo’s long-term durability, but further investigations are needed to determine whether these incidents are isolated or indicate a broader problem.

title.rendered: Instagram launches Apple TV app with Reels, longer videos, and live shows

content.rendered:
Instagram has finally come to Apple TV, debuting a dedicated app for Apple’s streaming box. The new app brings Instagram Reels, longer videos, and live shows to the TV, letting users watch their favorite creators on a bigger screen and enjoy content with friends and family.

According to Apple’s TV-specific App Store release data, the app was first released on October 23, 2026, as version 66.0, with no official announcement from Meta. An archived listing from October 19 did not include Apple TV compatibility. The app needs at least tvOS 26.0 and can be downloaded from the Apple TV App Store.

Instagram comes to the big screen

The new Instagram app is designed primarily for watching video content rather than recreating every feature of the mobile experience. You can discover Reels, watch longer videos and shows, follow your favorite creators, and resume watching across supported screens.

According to Meta, the TV experience is positioned as a way to watch content together. Instead of passing a phone around, users can enjoy entertaining videos on their living room TV with friends and family.

The Apple TV launch follows Instagram’s broader expansion. The company began testing its TV experience on Amazon Fire TV devices in the United States in December 2025. It then expanded to Google TV in February 2026 and Samsung smart TVs in June.

Building on Instagram’s TV experience

In June 2026, Meta announced new features it was testing for Instagram for TV, including a dedicated home for horizontal videos, channels organized around your interests, and casting Reels from your phone to the TV. It also said it was exploring new formats such as longer creator videos, episodic series, and Live on TV. The Apple TV app’s listing already mentions longer videos and live shows, though Meta only confirmed casting for Google TV and Fire TV at the time.

However, the Apple TV app isn’t a complete substitute for Instagram on your iPhone. Its primary purpose is video discovery and playback, so you shouldn’t expect every feature from the mobile app to be available in the TV interface.

How to get Instagram on Apple TV

You can download Instagram directly from the Apple TV App Store. The app is free to download, although Instagram offers in-app purchases. To install it, you need an Apple TV running tvOS 26.0 or later, which covers the Apple TV HD and every Apple TV 4K model. The app is rated 13+ and includes parental controls, which is worth setting up on a shared family TV.

The launch gives Instagram another way to reach audiences beyond mobile devices. As Meta continues developing more viewing experiences, Apple TV could become an important part of its strategy to make Instagram a more social, living-room-friendly video platform.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

mainEntity.name: Do Packed Ice Bricks melt?

mainEntity.name: Can I use my old world?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can use your existing world to explore Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5. However, as snapshots are experimental and can carry bugs, make sure to create a backup of your world first.

acceptedAnswer.text: There’s no official release date for Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 6 as of now.
