title.rendered: Stalkboxes in Fortnite: What they do and how to find them

content.rendered:
Since their introduction in October 2025, Stalkboxes are starting to become a Fortnitemares staple and have proven useful for getting your hands on the Last Call mythic item. While they were more prominent in last year’s Halloween-themed event, this year they have been limited to a single map in Fortnite Reload: Nitemare Island.

Despite not being as prevalent in the game as last year, Stalkboxes are still an unskippable part of the “Reload: Nitemare Two” set of quests in Fortnite Reload. With that said, you can read more about what a Stalkbox does, where you can find one, and how you can tell if one’s nearby.

What does a Stalkbox do in Fortnite?

A Stalkbox is a telephone booth-like kiosk that your player character can use to acquire the Scream-inspired Last Call mythic item. This particular item is a weapon-cum-tracker of sorts, as it helps you mark nearby enemies for a brief period and slash through them using Ghost Face’s knife.

Notably, your appearance also changes into that of the iconic Scream antagonist whenever you switch to this item.

Besides giving you a gameplay advantage, using a Stalkbox also ticks off the “Pick up the phone at a Stalkbox” quest, which rewards you with 15,000 XP. Moreover, it counts towards the 26 Fortnitemares quests you must complete to unlock the Jack-A-Nape skin.

Where to find a Stalkbox in Fortnite?

Last year, Fortnite maps across different modes, including Battle Royale, were littered with Stalkboxes, and it was easy to find one. However, in Fortnitemares 2026, they are restricted to Nitemare Island in Fortnite Reload.

Since this mode features a map rotation that happens roughly every 20 minutes, and because there are three different Reload maps in the loop currently (Nitemare Island, Squid Grounds and Stranger Things), you may have to wait for some time before you can start your search for a Stalkbox.

Also note that the Nitemare Two quests stay locked until you complete at least one Reload: Nitemare One quest.

How to find Stalkboxes in Fortnite Reload’s Nitemare Island

This year, Stalkboxes seem to be spawning randomly on Nitemare Island, so there are no fixed locations where you can find them. But there are certain named POIs where they have been spotted more often, and there are certain cues you must pay attention to so you don’t miss a Stalkbox when it’s nearby.

Some of the recommended locations for encountering a Stalkbox are Terror Turrets, Retail Ruin, and Punishment Patch. More or less, these booths generally appear in denser areas such as residential neighborhoods instead of open spaces. Regardless of which POI you are in, if you are close to a Stalkbox, you will hear a loud phone-ringing sound, and the booth also has a flashing light. You can use that as an audio guide to close in on your target.

Rounding up

Even though Stalkboxes did return in Fortnitemares for a second consecutive year, this time they haven’t been incorporated into the game as much as last time. That’s mainly because their main purpose, which is to give the player the Last Call item, was made redundant by that very mythic weapon becoming a Loot Hack instead, a novel feature that didn’t exist when Stalkboxes and Last Call were first released.

Nevertheless, including Stalkboxes in one of the Fortnitemares quests was the devs’ move to keep the ominous-looking kiosk relevant, even if only by a bit. Keep in mind that the quest has to be completed before Fortnitemares ends on November 1. It will be interesting to see if this continues to be the case or if Stalkboxes return to their former glory next October, with Fortnitemares 2027.

FAQs

Are Stalkboxes in Fortnite Battle Royale in 2026?

No, Stalkboxes are not available in any of the Battle Royale modes outside Reload this year.

Do Stalkboxes appear in every Fortnite Reload match?

No, Stalkboxes don’t appear in every Fortnite Reload match. They only appear in matches where the Nitemare Island map is active. Moreover, they may not always spawn in the same spot on that map either.

Do I need to complete the Stalkbox quest for the Jack-A-Nape skin?

You don’t specifically need this particular quest completed to unlock Jack-A-Nape, since 27 quests are available against the 26 required. But since the quest becomes available rather early and is also quite easy, most players would have completed it to meet the objective.

title.rendered: Nikki from Obsession comes to Fortnite: Price, how to buy, bundle details

content.rendered:
After a long wait, Nikki from the 2026 horror hit Obsession has arrived in Fortnite, landing in the Item Shop on October 21 at 8 PM ET (5 PM PT). This comes a few months after the game’s official X handle first teased a collab with the film, way back in July. Recently, the One Wish Willow, an integral part of the movie’s plot, was added as a Fortnite Override sprite, which was also the first Obsession-themed content to drop.

The Nikki skin is available in the Item Shop for 1,500 V-Bucks, and it can also be purchased as part of the Obsession Bundle for 2,000 V-Bucks. All these Obsession-inspired cosmetic items will be up for grabs for a limited time, until October 31 at 8 PM ET (5 PM PT).

For those looking to add to their collection of movie IP characters in Fortnite, Obsession’s Nikki may be a tempting pick. In that case, you can do as shown in the images below to grab it from the in-game store.

How to get the Obsession Nikki skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, navigate to the Shop tab.
  2. Then, scroll down to the Obsession section and select the desired skin.
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to confirm your pick.

All Obsession cosmetics in Fortnite

1. Nikki outfit

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also available in: Obsession Bundle

2. Nikki’s Broken Bottle pickaxe

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also available in: Obsession Bundle

3. One Wish Willow back bling

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also available in: Obsession Bundle

4. No No No… emote

  • Price: 400 V-Bucks
  • Also available in: Obsession Bundle

Fortnite and its movie collaborations in 2026

So far this year, players have seen Fortnite roll out the red carpet for a plethora of popular movie collabs, especially with Hollywood flicks. While Obsession is the latest entry, major 2026 releases such as Spider-Man: Brand New Day, The Odyssey, and Street Fighter have been some other prominent inclusions. Not to mention, certain older films, ranging from A Nightmare on Elm Street to Rambo, have also made an appearance.

Given such a prolific cadence, it’s hard not to think there are more such Fortnite collabs to come in the final months. With Avengers: Doomsday yet to hit theaters on December 18, it seems almost certain that the game would partner with the Marvel Cinematic Universe, one of its biggest longtime collaborators, to bring another string of crossover content. More on that should become clear through the routine leaks next month.

With more entertainment franchises available for potential crossovers, players will likely continue watching for future collaborations. However, any upcoming movie tie-ins should be treated as speculation until Fortnite or the relevant rights holders confirm them.

FAQs

Is Bear from Obsession in Fortnite?

No, Bear hasn’t been released in the Item Shop. Nikki is the only Obsession character available for purchase in the game.

Is the Nikki skin in the Battle Pass?

No, the Nikki skin isn’t part of the Battle Pass. It’s an Item Shop exclusive that can only be bought with V-Bucks, either on its own or as part of the Obsession Bundle.

What does the Splatter style do?

The Splatter style toggle (part of the Nikki skin) adds dark stains on Nikki’s face and torso, a reference to her iconic bloody look in Obsession.

Can I refund the bundle?

Yes, you can cancel the purchase within 24 hours, as long as you haven’t equipped the items in a match. After that, you can still use one of your Return Tickets within 30 days of buying it.

Will Nikki come back?

While it can’t be said for sure if Nikki will return to Fortnite in the future, there have been many instances where the game has recycled past crossover content in the Item Shop. So, an eventual comeback is more likely to happen than not.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Destroy a Vault Codes on November 02, 2026

It’s fair to say that Destroy a Vault is easily one of the most entertaining Roblox games you can try out right now. Your main goal is to blast open valuable vaults with an army of tanks, grab as much gold as possible, and keep moving on to bigger vaults. As fun as that sounds, becoming a successful vault buster in this game isn’t as easy as it sounds, because you’ll need rare tanks and the right upgrades to get the job done.

You can obviously spend Robux to get your hands on these resources, but there’s a better way to get them without spending a dime. The developers regularly release codes that can reward you with free Gems, Cash, Admin Shards, and various other items. So, if you want to grab these freebies, here’s a list of the active Destroy a Vault codes you should redeem right away!

All working Destroy a Vault codes

  • COMMANDER: 1 Commander Crate (NEW)
  • ADMIN4: 1 Admin Crate (NEW)
  • FREEGEMS: Gems (NEW)
  • ADMINGEMS: Gems (NEW)
  • BASESKINS: 5 min Cash skip and 1 Dark Matter Ammo (NEW)
  • HALLOWEEN: 1k Candy (NEW)
  • 10KLIKES: $30,000
  • Halloween2025: 30 min Mastery Boost
  • 1M: 1h Mastery Boost
  • JACK: $50,000
  • MOREGEMS: 25,000 Gems
  • FIRSTAA: One Lucky Roll
  • BUGFIXES: 25,000 Gems
  • BOSS: 25,000 Gems
  • 1MILLION: One Lucky Roll

As of now, these are the only active Destroy a Vault codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired Destroy a Vault codes

BETA, DESTROY

How to redeem Destroy a Vault codes in Roblox

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Destroy a Vault codes:

  1. Fire up Destroy a Vault on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load and complete the short tutorial.
  3. Click the Settings (gear) icon in the top-right corner and scroll down to find the codes box.
  4. Paste a working code and hit Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the codes, the rewards should be added to your inventory automatically.

Why aren’t my Destroy a Vault codes working?

If your Destroy a Vault codes aren’t working, double-check that you’ve entered them exactly as listed above. Keep in mind that these codes are case-sensitive, so make sure there are no extra spaces before or after them.

You can simply copy and paste the codes directly from our list. Some codes, like BUGFIX2, only work after you finish the tutorial. If a code still doesn’t work, it might’ve expired, or you may have already redeemed its rewards.

How to get more Destroy a Vault codes

The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new Destroy a Vault codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Discord server: Visit the Destroy a Vault Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
  • Follow the Roblox game page: Check the game’s official Roblox page for updates, announcements, and potential code releases.
  • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new Destroy a Vault codes become available, so you can easily find the latest rewards in one place.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest The Company codes, Anime Dice codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

How do you get rewards in Destroy a Vault?

Players can get rewards in Destroy a Vault by breaking into vaults, collecting gold, redeeming codes, and claiming playtime rewards.

Can you upgrade your tanks in Destroy a Vault?

Yes. Players can upgrade their tanks in Destroy a Vault to increase their damage output. This helps them destroy vaults faster and earn more gold.

How do you progress faster in Destroy a Vault?

To progress faster in Destroy a Vault, focus on upgrading your army, collecting Cash, and unlocking stronger vaults.

  • Logitech G Astro A10 Wired Gaming Headset
  • SteelSeries Aeon Pro Wireless Controller
  • CyberPowerPC Gaming PC (GeForce RTX 5060)
  • Razer Naga V3 Pro Gaming Mouse
  • Redragon Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

title.rendered: Minecraft Brittle Ice: How to find, collect, and farm it

content.rendered:
One of the new additions in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4 (Java Edition) is Brittle Ice. So, what is it? Well, it’s a brand-new block that generates naturally in Ice Caves and starts cracking when a player or most mobs step on it (the Frostbite is one mob that can walk on it safely). Eventually, the block breaks, making it useful for creating parkour maps, traps, and survival challenges.

Since Brittle Ice only generates naturally as part of Ice Cave crevasses, you might think exploring these areas is the only way to get it. However, that’s not the case. You can also create Brittle Ice using Blue Ice and water. So, here’s a complete guide on how to find, collect, and farm Brittle Ice in Minecraft.

All materials needed to get Brittle Ice in Minecraft

Before you begin the process of obtaining Brittle Ice, there are a few items you’ll need to gather first:

I’d recommend getting a pickaxe with Silk Touch first. You’ll need this enchantment to collect Brittle Ice as a block, and it also helps you gather Blue Ice without destroying it.

How you can obtain brittle ice in Minecraft

The easiest way to obtain Brittle Ice in Minecraft is to head to the Ice Caves. However, not only can this get tiring, but it’s also quite dangerous, as you will run into various mobs before you manage to collect the resource. The better option is to build a Brittle Ice farm, as it allows you to generate and collect it right at your base without having to travel anywhere.

Once you’ve collected all the resources mentioned above, here’s what you’ll need to do:

  1. Dig a trench that’s five blocks long and one block deep.
  2. Place a Blue Ice block at one end of the trench.
  3. Head to the other end and empty your Water Bucket.
  4. The water will flow toward the Blue Ice block, and the water touching it will automatically turn into Brittle Ice.

After the Brittle Ice has been generated, use a Silk Touch pickaxe to mine and collect it. As long as you have a Blue Ice block at the end of the trench and you keep placing water at the other end, you can continue generating new Brittle Ice blocks.

Also Read: How to change gamemode in Minecraft

Wrapping up

Brittle Ice is a new block in Minecraft that you can find naturally in Ice Caves or create using Blue Ice and water. While exploring caves is a good way to discover it, building a small farm makes collecting more blocks much easier.

Beyond its decorative appeal, Brittle Ice can be useful for parkour maps, traps, and survival challenges because it cracks and breaks underfoot. Just remember to use a Silk Touch pickaxe when collecting it, and check that you’re playing a version that supports the feature, which right now means the Java Edition 26.4 snapshots.

FAQs

Can you walk on Brittle Ice in Minecraft?

You can walk on Brittle Ice in Minecraft, but it will start to crack under your feet and break if you stay on it for too long.

What is Brittle Ice used for in Minecraft?

Brittle Ice can be used for decoration, parkour maps, and survival challenges. As the block breaks when a player or mob steps on it, it can also be used to create traps.

Where does Brittle Ice spawn in Minecraft?

Brittle Ice blocks can be found naturally in Ice Caves in Minecraft, where they generate as part of crevasses. You can explore these areas to find the block.

title.rendered: How to use Wrist Flick on Apple Watch to dismiss notifications

content.rendered:
Notifications are useful, but they can also become a constant distraction—especially when you’re working out, carrying groceries, or in the middle of something. That’s where Wrist Flick comes in. Introduced in watchOS 26, this handy gesture lets you dismiss notifications, silence incoming calls, and stop timers with a quick wrist movement, without touching the display.

In watchOS 27, Wrist Flick remains a convenient way to control your Apple Watch hands-free. Here’s how to use the gesture in everyday life.

What is Wrist Flick on Apple Watch?

Wrist Flick is a one-handed gesture that lets you interact with your Apple Watch without tapping or swiping the screen. It uses the watch’s motion sensors and gesture recognition to detect a quick wrist turn. And when the watch recognizes the gesture, it dismisses the current notification or alert and returns you to the watch face.

Think of it as brushing away a distraction. It’s particularly useful when your other hand is occupied or when touching the screen isn’t convenient.

Wrist Flick debuted in watchOS 26, and Apple continues to support it in watchOS 27. It works alongside other hands-free features, including Double Tap and the newer single-tap gesture introduced in watchOS 27.

What can you do with Wrist Flick?

Once enabled, Wrist Flick lets you handle several common interruptions without touching your Apple Watch.

  • Dismiss notifications: Clear incoming messages, reminders, weather alerts, and other notifications from the screen.
  • Mute incoming calls: Silence an incoming call without reaching for the display.
  • Stop timers and silence alarms: Quickly dismiss timer and alarm alerts.
  • Return to the watch face: Clear the current screen and get back to your watch face.
  • Dismiss other alerts: Handle supported system alerts with the same quick wrist movement.

Wrist Flick is designed to make interacting with your watch easier, not to replace every on-screen control. Dismissing a notification doesn’t delete the underlying message or other content from its app. You can still open the relevant app to review information later.

Likewise, silencing an incoming call doesn’t mean you’ve answered it. You can still decide whether to answer or decline the call.

Compatible Apple Watch Models

Wrist Flick is supported on Apple Watch models with the required hardware and software.

Compatible models include:

  • Apple Watch Series 9
  • Apple Watch Series 10
  • Apple Watch Series 11
  • Apple Watch Series 12
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • Apple Watch SE 3

Wrist Flick requires a compatible watch running watchOS 26 or later. For the latest models, including the Series 12 and Ultra 4, watchOS 27 is the relevant software version.

Older models, such as Apple Watch Series 8 and the original Apple Watch Ultra, aren’t supported for Wrist Flick. Although these watches offer other ways to silence alerts, they don’t support this particular gesture.

How to use Wrist Flick on Apple Watch

Wrist Flick is enabled by default on compatible Apple Watch models. If it isn’t working as expected, check its setting before trying the gesture again.

  1. Open the Settings app on your Apple Watch.
  2. Go to Gestures.
  3. Toggle Wrist Flick on or off.

Perform the Wrist Flick gesture

  1. Wait for a notification, incoming call, timer, or other supported alert.
  2. Quickly turn your wrist away from you.
  3. Bring your wrist back toward you in one smooth movement.
  4. Wait for the watch to recognize the gesture and dismiss the alert.

You don’t need to make an exaggerated movement. A quick, deliberate wrist turn is usually enough. If the gesture doesn’t register, try again with a slightly more distinct movement and make sure the watch is fitted securely on your wrist.

With a little practice, Wrist Flick can become second nature, allowing you to manage interruptions without breaking your stride.

Here’s a quick video on how to use it:

Wrist Flick vs. Double Tap and the New Tap Gesture

Apple offers several gestures to make Apple Watch easier to use with one hand. Although Wrist Flick, Double Tap, and the new single-tap gesture all reduce the need to touch the screen, they serve different purposes.

  • Wrist Flick is primarily for dismissing notifications, silencing incoming calls, stopping timers, and returning to the watch face.
  • Double Tap involves tapping your index finger and thumb together twice. It supports actions such as answering calls, replying to messages, scrolling through the Smart Stack, and interacting with compatible apps.
  • The new Tap gesture in watchOS 27 involves bringing your index finger and thumb together once. It lets you select a highlighted Smart Stack widget and quickly access relevant information when your other hand is occupied.

These gestures complement one another.

Another useful option is Cover to Mute. Simply rest your palm over the watch display for at least three seconds to silence an alert. Unlike Wrist Flick, this gesture is primarily designed to mute an alert temporarily.

More useful features in watchOS 27

Wrist Flick is just one part of the Apple Watch experience. watchOS 27 also introduces refinements and features designed to make everyday interactions more convenient.

  • New Siri AI: A more capable Siri experience, with advanced Apple Intelligence integration for on-screen awareness, personal context, and cross-app actions.
  • A dedicated Siri app: Revisit conversations with Siri in one place.
  • A new Tap gesture: Select a highlighted Smart Stack widget with a single finger-and-thumb tap.
  • Smarter Smart Stack suggestions: Get more relevant widgets and contextual suggestions based on your routines and activities.
  • A dynamic app grid: Find and open apps through an updated app-launching experience.
  • Improved everyday interactions: Refinements across watchOS make it easier to access useful information and interact with your watch.

If you’re upgrading from watchOS 26, Wrist Flick itself won’t feel entirely new. The main benefit is that you can keep using this familiar gesture while taking advantage of other watchOS 27 improvements.

A small gesture that makes a big difference

Wrist Flick isn’t the flashiest Apple Watch feature, but it’s a practical example of how small software improvements can make a wearable easier to use. Instead of interrupting what you’re doing to tap away a notification or silence a call, you can handle it with a quick movement of your wrist.

On the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, Wrist Flick remains a simple, effective way to reduce distractions and interact with your watch hands-free. It’s easy to learn, enabled by default, and useful whenever your hands are busy.

If you haven’t tried it yet, give it a go. Once you get used to the movement, you’ll have one more convenient way to keep your attention where it belongs.

title.rendered: How to get the Slender Man skin in Fortnite: Price and bundle

content.rendered:
After several days of circulating rumors about its release date, Slender Man has finally rolled out in Fortnite. The faceless villain has joined an illustrious lineup of antagonists from third-party IPs featured in Fortnite this Halloween season. The skin, which is part of the wider Fortnite x Slender Man collab, was officially confirmed when it first appeared in the promotional art for Fortnitemares around late September, and it landed in the Item Shop on October 22 at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET.

The Slender Man skin is available in the Item Shop for 1,500 V-Bucks. It is also included in the namesake bundle, which goes for 2,000 V-Bucks (down from 2,700 V-Bucks) in the game. These cosmetics are only available to buy for a limited time, until November 1, 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET, the same day on which a new Fortnite season will also kick off.

Players who placed high enough in the Slender Man Cup on October 20 already unlocked the outfit and back bling for free, so the Item Shop is now the only way to get them.

If you are interested in purchasing the Slender Man skin in Fortnite, make sure to follow the steps shown below.

Steps to get the Slender Man skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab.
  2. Next, scroll down to the Slender Man section and select the desired skin.
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to confirm your decision.

All Slender Man cosmetics in Fortnite

1. The Slender Man (Outfit)

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: The Slender Man Bundle

2. Slender Tendrils (Pickaxe)

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: The Slender Man Bundle

3. Tentacles of the Slender Man (Back Bling)

  • Price: 400 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: The Slender Man Bundle

Popular horror characters in Fortnitemares 2026

This year’s rendition of Fortnitemares has been nothing short of exciting for players. From classic monsters to legendary Hollywood villains, we have seen a wide spectrum of bad guys emerge in the Item Shop throughout October. This list has included characters such as Frankenstein’s Monster, The Mummy, Freddy Krueger, Jason Voorhees, and the like.

Apart from Slender Man, Nikki from Obsession is another character that Fortnite has added as a skin, and she delivers a strong level of creepiness. Given that antagonists from yesteryear and the modern day are both part of this Halloween-themed event, it’s fair to say players have had a good range of choices for the Fortnitemares experience.

  • Logitech G Astro A10 Wired Gaming Headset
  • SteelSeries Aeon Pro Wireless Controller
  • CyberPowerPC Gaming PC (GeForce RTX 5060)
  • Razer Naga V3 Pro Gaming Mouse
  • Redragon Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
  • Ergonomic Gaming Chair (Adjustable Lumbar Support)

title.rendered: Aetheria map in Fortnite: What it is, how to play it, beginner tips

content.rendered:
Ever since Fortnite evolved from a game into a Roblox-like platform, a flurry of Fortnite Creative and UEFN maps by third parties has emerged, including Aetheria, one of the more popular maps from the lot. Developed by CooliSushi, Aetheria is an open-world RPG that first rolled out in November 2025 (island code 1314-6986-8879) and has attracted tens of thousands of players to date.

At the time of writing, Aetheria has been experiencing a daily concurrent player peak of around 2,502, per Fortnite.gg. Given its all-time peak of 6,559 players, it may not seem all that exciting on the surface. However, relative to other UEFN maps, it is reasonably notable in how well it holds onto its audience. It also currently sits near the top of Fortnite’s Adventure & RPG genre charts.

Below, you can learn more about Aetheria, its gameplay, the game objectives, and more. Apart from that, you can also check out its code and how you can play it within Fortnite.

What is Aetheria in Fortnite?

Aetheria is a fantasy RPG where you can go on quests, defeat untamed beasts, farm otherworldly creatures, and hunt for hidden chests, among other things. The game is playable as a single-player experience or with up to a total of six players.

From bustling markets crawling with human NPCs to monster-infested wilderness, and from lush green forests to snow-capped peaks, there’s a considerable amount of depth in Aetheria’s open world, which you can explore either on foot or by using fast travel points. As you talk to more NPCs and complete more quests, you unlock new parts of the map.

Like many fantasy RPGs, combat is an integral aspect of Aetheria’s gameplay. However, unlike most Fortnite maps, the arsenal at your disposal features a mix of melee weapons, such as a rapier, and ranged weapons, such as a musket.

Using these tools, you can go up against various enemies, ranging from grotesque goblins to giant crabs. As you progress through the game, you can collect XP and use it to upgrade weapons for taking on more challenging foes.

How to play Aetheria in Fortnite?

  1. In Fortnite, scroll down to the Discover section.
  2. Select the search bar near the top-right part of the screen.
  3. Type in the map code 1314-6986-8879.
  4. From the results, select Aetheria by CooliSushi.
  5. Hit Select to switch to this map.
  6. Finally, hit Play to launch Aetheria.

Tips to get started in the Aetheria map in Fortnite

One of the first things you should focus on in Aetheria is completing quests offered by the game’s characters. Explore the world, look for quest markers, and use the in-game guidance to find your next objective. You should also check your quest log regularly to track your progress and see what you need to do next.

Another useful tip is to open chests whenever you come across them. They can provide valuable rewards and help you progress. Keep an eye out for hidden chests while exploring, as they may offer useful items that support your adventure.

Better equipment can also make combat much easier. Take a break from quests and exploration now and then to review your gear and available upgrades. Improving your weapons and abilities before taking on tougher enemies or bosses can help you handle challenging encounters.

Finally, don’t rush through the world. Explore different areas, talk to NPCs, and experiment with the game’s combat mechanics. Taking the time to understand how quests, upgrades, and exploration work can make your early hours in Aetheria more enjoyable.

Rounding up

Fortnite maps built by third-party developers play an undeniable role in diversifying the experience on the platform, letting players jump into different adventures without ever leaving Epic’s hit multiplayer title. Aetheria is one such map that’s worth mentioning in this regard, and it scratches the itch for Fortnite players who also happen to be RPG enthusiasts.

Developed by CooliSushi, the map combines quests, creature battles, exploration, and character progression in one experience. Whether you’re playing solo or teaming up with friends, Aetheria offers an alternative to Fortnite’s traditional battle royale gameplay. Use the island code 1314-6986-8879 to jump in and start exploring.

title.rendered: Apple adds an AI assistant to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers that understands your work

content.rendered:
Apple is bringing a new AI assistant to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers that can help you write documents, create presentations, and analyze spreadsheets using natural language. Called Intelligent Assistant, the feature understands the content you’re working on and can make changes directly within each app.

The new assistant is rolling out in beta for Apple Creator Studio subscribers, according to Apple’s latest App Store release notes for Pages, Keynote, and Numbers.

What’s new in Pages, Keynote and Numbers

In Pages, you can ask the assistant to draft entire sections, rewrite existing text, adjust the tone, or reorganize your document. It can also generate images and shapes based on text instructions. Since the assistant understands the document’s contents, you can ask it to make changes using the context of what you’ve already written.

Keynote gets similar capabilities focused on presentations. The assistant can generate slides, create presenter notes, add images and shapes, and help refine existing slides. You can also ask it to add animations or improve a presentation without having to manually work through each element.

Numbers brings AI assistance to spreadsheets, including the ability to create complex formulas, generate tables, suggest charts, and find insights in existing data. For example, you can describe what you want to calculate in plain English and have the assistant help build the formula.

Across all three apps, Intelligent Assistant can search for up-to-date information and incorporate it into your document, presentation, or spreadsheet. It can also explain advanced features and guide users through unfamiliar tasks.

The update builds on AI features Apple has already introduced through Creator Studio, including image generation, automatic slide creation in Keynote, and Magic Fill in Numbers. Intelligent Assistant brings these capabilities into a more conversational interface that understands the project you’re editing.

There are some restrictions. Intelligent Assistant is currently available only in US English and requires an Apple Intelligence-compatible device running iOS 27 or iPadOS 27 or later. Apple’s Mac App Store listings have yet to receive the corresponding update.

The features also require an Apple Creator Studio subscription, which costs $12.99 per month or $129 per year in the US. Pages, Keynote, and Numbers remain free for regular document creation and editing.

Separately, Keynote is introducing a new open Interchange Format (.keyx) in beta. Available to all users, the format allows presentations to be imported and exported in a way that Apple says will make their contents easier to work with in other applications.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

acceptedAnswer.text: You can walk on Brittle Ice in Minecraft, but it will start to crack under your feet and break if you stay on it for too long.

acceptedAnswer.text: Brittle Ice can be used for decoration, parkour maps, and survival challenges. As the block breaks when a player or mob steps on it, it can also be used to create traps.

title.rendered: YouTube is moving Subscriptions out of the bottom bar on Android and iOS after nine years

content.rendered:
Since 2017, the videos from channels you follow have been one tap away at the bottom of YouTube’s mobile app. That’s about to change. YouTube is removing the Subscriptions tab from the bottom bar on Android and iOS. The tab is being renamed "Subs" and moved to a new row of feeds at the top of the Home tab.

Subscriptions used to be the fourth item in the bottom bar. Without it, the bar has four items: Home, Shorts, Create, and You. In the new layout, Subs is second in Home’s top bar, right after Home, with a red underline when you select it. The feed itself still shows uploads from the channels you follow. Getting to it now takes two steps: open Home, then reach up to the top of the screen.

That’s a step backward. On a tall phone, the top of the screen is the hardest spot to reach with one hand. The bottom bar is where an app puts the places you go most, and for a lot of people, that’s Subscriptions. It was also the one feed that showed only what you chose to follow. Now it sits in a row with feeds YouTube picks for you.

YouTube has been working toward this for months. In May, it tested a version that moved Subscriptions to a menu at the top of the screen and called it an experiment. That test is now the default design.

Subs now shares the top bar with Live, Music, and feeds you describe

After Subs, the top bar has feeds for Live and Music. A Movies & TV feed shows up only if you pay for something like Primetime Channels. The redesign also gets rid of the app’s slide-out navigation menu.

Custom feeds are launching at the same time. Tap the "+" at the top of Home and describe what you want to watch: a topic, a type of video, or a mood. YouTube then builds a feed that keeps filling with new videos. Each custom feed gets its own tab after Home and Subs. Free users can keep three at a time, and Premium members can keep eight. Your feeds sync between mobile and desktop, only you can see them, and they expire after 30 days if you don’t use them. Videos you watch in a custom feed count toward your regular watch history, so they can change what shows up on your main Home feed too.

Custom feeds are rolling out first in the US. You need to be signed in, be 13 or older, use YouTube in English, and have watch and search history turned on. YouTube says more countries will follow, and it calls these changes the start of "a series of updates to shape a more seamless Home experience." It hasn’t said when the new bottom bar will reach everyone.

  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

acceptedAnswer.text: You can walk on Brittle Ice in Minecraft, but it will start to crack under your feet and break if you stay on it for too long.

mainEntity.name: What is Brittle Ice used for in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brittle Ice can be used for decoration, parkour maps, and survival challenges. As the block breaks when a player or mob steps on it, it can also be used to create traps.

mainEntity.name: Where does Brittle Ice spawn in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brittle Ice blocks can be found naturally in Ice Caves in Minecraft, where they generate as part of crevasses. You can explore these areas to find the block.

title.rendered: Apple will label apps optimized for iPhone Duo with a new App Store badge

content.rendered:
Apple’s iPhone Duo introduces a new form factor to the iPhones, and many existing apps haven’t been optimized for its larger screen. Some older apps will appear with wide black bars on either side, leaving much of the 7.6-inch inner display unused. To help users find apps that properly support the foldable, Apple is introducing a “Made for iPhone Duo” badge on App Store listings as the phone launches on October 23.

The badge will appear on individual app pages, making it easier to identify apps designed to take advantage of the Duo’s larger display and folding design. Apple will also introduce dedicated App Store collections featuring optimized apps and games.

Looking for apps that make the most of the foldable display? See our picks for the best iPhone Duo apps.

Only apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK count as optimized

Apple’s developer documentation also states how an app appears on the Duo depends partly on the iOS SDK used to build it. Apps built with iOS 26 or earlier remain in a smaller window, while those built with iOS 27 fill most of the inner screen but leave some space unused near the status bar.

Apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK or later can use the entire display, with toolbars and navigation controls arranged vertically along the right edge. Developers can get the new badge displayed on their App Store listings by submitting iPhone Duo screenshots through App Store Connect.

Several popular apps have already been updated to take advantage of the new design. Netflix lets users browse short clips on the outer screen and continue watching on the larger inner display. Prime Video can play a movie on the upper half of the partially folded screen while showing cast information and other details below.

Zoom can display meeting participants alongside shared content, while Lyft shows a larger route map next to available ride options. Microsoft is also preparing updated versions of Word and Outlook that place documents, formatting tools, and emails side by side, with those updates expected in the coming weeks. Here are some examples Apple showcased on their site.

Apple says more apps will receive iPhone Duo optimizations throughout the year. With many developers still adapting their apps, the new badge should make it easier for users to find those that make proper use of the foldable screen.

Unlock more with Apple:

  • AirPods 5 Wireless Earbuds
  • Apple HomeView
  • Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
  • MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop
  • iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
  • MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip

acceptedAnswer.text: Brittle Ice can be used for decoration, parkour maps, and survival challenges. As the block breaks when a player or mob steps on it, it can also be used to create traps.

title.rendered: Best Halloween apps for iPhone and iPad: Get spooky the smart way

content.rendered:
Halloween season is creeping closer, and it’s officially time to turn your iPhone into a haunted playground. While most of us are busy decking out our homes with pumpkins and cobwebs, there’s another way to get in the Halloween spirit, through your phone!

This year, I’ve been testing out the best Halloween apps for iPhone and trust me, they’re the perfect mix of spooky, creative, and fun. Whether you want to decorate your phone with eerie wallpapers, play Halloween games with your kids, or discover haunted attractions near you, there’s an app for every kind of ghoul and ghost.

So, if you’re ready to level up your Halloween celebrations (digitally and IRL), keep scrolling, because this list will get you in the spooky spirit in no time.

Why you’ll love these Halloween apps

Before we jump into the list, let’s look at why downloading Halloween-themed apps this year is totally worth it.

Decor and Customization

  • Themes: Give your iPhone a Halloween makeover with spooky wallpapers, lock screen backgrounds, and icons that reflect your love for spooky season.
  • Decorations: You don’t need real cobwebs or pumpkins to set the mood. Several Halloween apps let you virtually decorate, from glowing jack-o’-lanterns to ghostly animations.

Entertainment

  • No Halloween is complete without creepy stories and chilling soundtracks. Many Halloween apps curate paranormal tales, haunted radio stations, and ghostly soundscapes to keep your evenings spine-tingling.

Costumes and Makeup

  • Half the fun of Halloween lies in dressing up! You’ll find plenty of apps that inspire costume ideas, guide you through Halloween makeup looks, or even apply digital face paint for your next selfie.

Trick-or-Treating

  • Maps: Some Halloween apps now help you plan the perfect trick-or-treat route, showing candy-friendly neighborhoods and spooky hotspots.
  • Planning: You can even strategize your trick-or-treat rounds with interactive maps, great for parents who want to keep things fun yet safe.

Social Sharing

  • Halloween Filters: Keep your Instagram and TikTok feeds festive with apps that offer ghostly filters, themed frames, and creative editing tools.
  • Sharing: Even if your loved ones are far away, many Halloween apps make it easy to share your creations and spooky selfies with a single tap.

Educational Fun

  • Learn About Halloween: For the curious little ones, some apps teach the history and traditions behind Halloween through interactive stories and mini-games.
  • Educational Gameplay: You’ll also find Halloween learning apps that make math, art, and logic fun for toddlers and young kids.

How we picked the best Halloween apps?

If you’re anything like the typical iGeeksBlog reader, you expect more than just a few cute stickers. You want functionality, creativity, and value – all rolled into one. That’s exactly how this list was curated.

  • Focus on the iGeeks Audience: These apps are handpicked for Apple enthusiasts who love smooth interfaces, great design, and unique experiences.
  • Spooky Aesthetic: Each app adds a Halloween vibe to your iPhone or iPad, from fonts and wallpapers to widgets and ringtones.
  • Variety: From kids’ games to social filters to haunted event maps, there’s something for everyone.
  • Quality Over Quantity: Every app here was chosen based on reviews, reliability, and real functionality, not just download counts.
  • Value for Money: Whether free or paid, each app offers something genuinely worth your time (and your coins).

Best Halloween photo and makeup apps

Give your Halloween selfies a spooky makeover or experiment with costume makeup before the big night. They can come in handy when you wish to be more experimental and make your seasonal photos stand out. 

1. Spooky Photo Video Maker Vody 

If your Halloween selfies look a little too ordinary, Spooky Photo Video Maker Vody offers a way to give them a horror-inspired makeover. The app gives your pictures and videos an eerie twist, featuring horror themes like ghosts, zombies, vampires, witches, or even werewolves.

It’s a fun option for anyone who wants to create something creepy for Instagram, TikTok, or a Halloween group chat without learning complicated editing software.

Pros

  • Offers a variety of horror-inspired transformations. 
  • Useful for creating Halloween photos and videos for social media. 
  • Free to download, with additional paid options. 

Cons

  • Generated effects may not always look exactly as expected. 
  • Some video credits and subscriptions cost extra. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $1.99) 

Download 

2. Halloween Makeup Editor 

Selecting the right Halloween costume is not enough; it’s the makeup that transforms an ordinary dress into something really interesting. Halloween Makeup Editor is worth exploring if you want to experiment with different spooky looks before applying real face paint.

I tried imagining myself as a vampire, a witch, and a frightening horror character before deciding which costume suits me best. It’s particularly useful if you’re short on inspiration or want to compare ideas with friends.

Pros

  • Helps you explore Halloween makeup ideas before committing to a look. 
  • Useful for planning individual or group costumes. 

Cons

  • Digital effects may not perfectly resemble real makeup. 
  • Results depend on photo quality and available editing options. 
  • The selection may feel limited if you want advanced photo-editing tools. 

Price: Free  

Download 

Best Halloween music and sound apps 

Set the mood with creepy sound effects and horror-inspired beats. Whether you’re hosting a party or creating a haunted atmosphere at home, these apps add an extra layer of Halloween fun. 

3. Spooky Beats Maker: Horror Mix

Want your Halloween party to sound as spooky as it looks? Spooky Beats Maker: Horror Mix is a music-making game which allows you to play around with beats, sounds, and animated characters, creating your own songs.

I suggest using it as a fun activity before a party, challenging friends to create the creepiest beat, or simply enjoying mixing sounds while getting into the Halloween mood.

Pros

  • Interactive music-making experience with spooky themes. 
  • Lets you experiment with different sound combinations. 
  • The simple interface is teen-friendly. 

Cons

  • May not offer the control of professional music-production software. 
  • Ads or paid features can interrupt the experience. 
  • The game-like format may not suit users looking for ready-made background music. 

Price: Free (Remove ads for $1.99) 

Download 

4. Spooky Halloween Sounds 

Sometimes, the right sound can do more for a Halloween atmosphere than an elaborate decoration. Spooky Halloween Sounds is an option for anyone who wants creepy audio to accompany a haunted-house setup, storytelling session, or Halloween party.

I would try the following combination at a Halloween party: lowering the lights, setting some artificial webs in the room and playing eerie sounds in the background while telling ghost stories.

Pros

  • Convenient for adding atmosphere to Halloween gatherings. 
  • Instant scares and long ambient music mixes. 
  • Includes mini games for fun. 

Cons

  • Repeated sound effects may become predictable. 
  • A separate speaker may be useful for larger gatherings. 

Price: Free 

Download 

Best Halloween games and scary entertainment apps

From relaxing coloring activities to intense horror games and paranormal-themed experiences, here are plenty of scary entertainment apps for all kinds of players. 

5. Halloween Color by Number Game 

Not everyone wants jump scares and terrifying monsters on Halloween. Sometimes, a relaxing activity is exactly what you need between decorating the house and preparing treats.

Halloween Color by Number Game offers a gentler way to enjoy the season through themed coloring, especially for your kids. The gameplay is simple: follow the color guide and gradually complete Halloween-themed illustrations.

Pros

  • Relaxing alternative to action and horror games. 
  • Easy-to-follow coloring format. 
  • Alternative seasonal themes for refreshment. 

Cons

  • Gameplay may feel repetitive for players who prefer action. 
  • Some pictures or features may require payment. 
  • Small coloring areas can be less comfortable on smaller screens. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $1.99) 

Download 

6. The Ghost – Multiplayer Horror 

Watching a horror movie with friends is fun, but trying to survive a frightening game together can make Halloween night even more memorable. You may give The Ghost – Multiplayer Horror a shot if you like dark environments, exploratory gameplay, and unpredictable multiplayer action.

I liked its suspicious sound and unexpected, intense encounters, perfect for a Halloween gaming session with friends who enjoy horror and cooperative challenges.

Pros

  • Combines horror-themed gameplay with multiplayer entertainment. 
  • Offers a shared experience for up to five friends. 
  • Different playing modes for new experiences. 

Cons

  • Horror themes may be too intense for younger players. 
  • Multiplayer sessions depend on compatible devices and connectivity. 
  • Players who prefer relaxed games may find the atmosphere stressful. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99) 

Download 

7. Horror Stories & Scary Stories 

Not everyone wants to spend Halloween playing action games. Sometimes, a creepy story shared with friends is enough to create the right atmosphere. Horror Stories & Scary Stories comes with an interactive survival game through frightening chats and stories.  

Your choice shapes the story. I prefer it when I want to enjoy horror at my own pace rather than dealing with sudden visual jump scares.

Pros

  • Offers a reading-based alternative to horror games. 
  • Suitable for solo reading or sharing stories with friends. 
  • Multiple endings to the same story with darker consequences. 

Cons

  • Story quality and variety may vary. 
  • Some content may be too disturbing for younger readers. 
  • Advertisements or paid content may affect the reading experience. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99) 

Download 

8. Spirit Board: Very Scary 

Looking for a spooky activity to make Halloween night more mysterious? Spirit Board brings the traditional Ouija board concept to your iPhone or iPad. It’s perfect for creating an interactive experience for paranormal-themed entertainment.  

The app lets you ask questions using your voice or text and displays responses through a moving planchette. However, treat it as entertainment rather than evidence of actual communication with spirits. 

Pros

  • Fits a paranormal-themed Halloween gathering. 
  • Offers an alternative to conventional horror games. 
  • Works as a conversation starter 

Cons

  • The experience may rely more on atmosphere than substantial gameplay. 
  • Supernatural themes may make some users uncomfortable. 

Price: Free (Unlock Pro features and remove ads for $2.99) 

Download 

Best apps for Halloween party planning and creativity 

Make your Halloween gathering easier to organize with creative invitations and seasonal activities. These apps can help you prepare for the party and give your guests a taste of the theme before they arrive. 

9. Invitation Maker – Cards & RSVP 

Planning a Halloween party is exciting until you have to message everyone individually, explain the theme, and work out who’s actually coming. Invitation Maker – Cards & RSVP can help with the invitation-design side of the process. 

Rather than sending a plain text message, it helps me create a more polished invitation that communicates the party’s mood before guests even arrive.

Pros

  • Helps create visually appealing party invitations. 
  • Useful for coordinating a Halloween event’s theme. 
  • Can reduce the effort involved in preparing invitations and organizing attendance. 

Cons

  • Some designs and customization options may cost extra. 
  • RSVP capabilities may differ from those of a full event-management service. 
  • Guest questions and last-minute changes still need to be managed. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99) 

Download 

10. Halloween All-in-One 

If you enjoy Halloween but don’t want to download a separate app for every little seasonal activity, Halloween All-in-One is worth investigating. You get Halloween-focused wallpaper, sound effects, music, countdown, and spooky stories, making it an interesting option for people who prefer seasonal entertainment gathered in one place. 

Ironically enough, I found the app’s greatest strength to also be its greatest weakness. While the app offered a bit of everything, it didn’t excel in any particular area. 

Pros

  • Has a Halloween-specific focus. 
  • Could be convenient for users who prefer a consolidated seasonal app. 
  • Completely free app. 

Cons

  • A multipurpose app may not match specialist tools in every category. 
  • The collection of wallpapers and sounds isn’t extensive. 

Price: Free 

Download 

Best apps for Halloween phone customization 

Get the Halloween theme to your iPhone screen through widgets, scary wallpapers, and countdowns. These apps are ideal for anyone who enjoys celebrating the season through their iPhone or iPad’s appearance. 

11. ThemeMate: DIY Themes & Widgets 

Your Halloween mood doesn’t have to stop at your costume or your front door. ThemeMate: DIY Themes & Widgets is here to personalize your iPhone’s appearance. Imagine unlocking your phone and seeing a coordinated Halloween-inspired design instead of your usual everyday layout.

I use it to get a more unified look, matching icons, widgets, and backgrounds. Moreover, the dynamic Live wallpapers bring the spooky right to your Lock Screen.

Pros

  • Appeals to users who enjoy personalizing their Home Screen. 
  • Offers a seasonal approach to phone customization. 
  • Virtual pets and charging effects make iPhone screen livelier. 

Cons

  • Setup may involve several customization steps. 
  • Some themes, widgets, or design packs may require payment.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $5.99) 

Download 

12. Crestwall: 4K Wallpapers 

Customizing the whole theme of your iPhone seems daunting? Then the easiest way to make your iPhone feel ready for Halloween is to change its wallpaper.

Crestwall: 4K Wallpapers provides high-resolution wallpapers and pictures in line with your holiday-themed needs. You may choose from a dramatic moonlit landscape, a dark minimalist design, or a creepy illustration that gives your Lock Screen a more mysterious feel.

Pros

  • Focuses on high-resolution wallpaper. 
  • Useful for seasonal Home Screen and Lock Screen refreshes. 
  • Pairs well with other customization tools. 

Cons

  • Halloween-specific content may be limited. 
  • Some wallpaper collections may require a subscription or purchase. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99) 

Download 

13. Halloween Countdown Live 2026 

For some people, Halloween excitement starts weeks before October 31. Halloween Countdown Live 2026 is worth considering if you enjoy watching the days tick down to the big night.

I like to add a countdown as it adds anticipation to my daily routine, especially when planning costumes, buying candy, decorating my home, or organizing a party. Rather than repeatedly checking the calendar, it offers a dedicated way to keep Halloween in mind.

Pros

  • Keeps Halloween preparations visible and exciting. 
  • Offers a simple way to track the approaching date. 
  • Multiple themes to match your mood. 

Cons

  • Its main purpose may become less useful after October 31. 
  • Widget and live-display functionality should be verified. 

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $2.99) 

Download 

Best apps for trick-or-treating and Halloween safety 

Halloween outings are more enjoyable when everyone knows the plan. Explore haunted attractions and seasonal destinations to find ideas for a memorable night out with friends or family. 

14. Life360: Family Safety GPS 

Though Halloween is fun for kids, sometimes it means a lot of hassle for parents who have to organize everything properly. Life360 is a family location-sharing and safety app that may help participating family members stay informed about one another’s whereabouts. 

For instance, if your kids are going to trick-or-treat in the evening and you plan to host some guests at home, agreed location sharing can make coordination easier. It can also be useful for arranging pickups or meeting at a particular location after an event.  

Pros

  • Supports family coordination during busy Halloween outings. 
  • Can help participating family members share locations and get place alerts. 
  • Useful beyond Halloween for everyday family logistics. 

Cons

  • Some features may require a paid subscription. 
  • Location tracking is not a substitute for supervision or agreed safety rules. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $7.99) 

Download 

15. FrightMaps: Haunt Finder 

If you are a real Halloween enthusiast, the most exciting part of October might be visiting a haunted house rather than staying home to watch horror movies. FrightMaps: Haunt Finder is designed to help users discover haunted attractions, making it a useful starting point when planning a spooky outing. 

Instead of relying on word of mouth, you can look for places to visit and build a Halloween itinerary. It could be handy for friends deciding where to spend a weekend evening or for a couple looking for something more memorable than another dinner out.  

Pros

  • Focuses on discovering haunted attractions and spooky outings. 
  • Useful as a starting point for Halloween trip planning. 
  • Know about the latest contests and spooky adventures nearby. 

Cons

  • Some features may require a paid subscription. 
  • Location tracking is not a substitute for supervision or agreed safety rules. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99) 

Download 

Final thoughts: Make this Halloween spook-tacular!

Halloween is the perfect time to get creative with your iPhone and iPad, and these apps make it easier to bring the spooky spirit to life. Whether you want to create creepy selfies, enjoy horror games, set the mood with eerie sounds, customize your Home Screen, or plan a fun Halloween outing, there’s something for everyone. You can even use family safety apps to make Halloween adventures easier to coordinate.

My advice is to choose the apps that match your Halloween plans rather than downloading them all. Try a photo editor for spooky selfies, a sound app for your Halloween party, or a customization app to give your iPhone a festive makeover. Which Halloween app are you excited to try this year? Let me know in the comments below, and have a spooktacular Halloween!

title.rendered: How to use Apple Watch Always On display and customize it

content.rendered:
I’m amazed by how much information my Apple Watch can pack into its small screen, especially when using the Modular watch face, which shows information from five different apps. And it gets even better, as I can check the watch face on my Apple Watch without having to wake up the display, thanks to the Always On feature.

On supported models, Always On is turned on by default. Here’s how to enable it on your Apple Watch if you disabled it previously and customize it to serve you better.

What is the Always On feature on the Apple Watch?

Always On is a feature that keeps the watch face on your Apple Watch visible at all times, so you can glance at important information without waking up the display.

When enabled, your Apple Watch shows a simplified version of your watch face whenever your wrist is down. This means essential information, such as the time, notifications, and complications, is visible but with decreased brightness and a lower refresh rate.

Then, as soon as you lift your wrist or tap the screen, your Apple Watch displays the regular watch face with all complication data at full brightness. You can then interact with the watch screen like you normally do.

Apple lets you configure what you want to see in Always On mode on your Apple Watch. Most complications refresh once a minute, whereas complications that display live data, such as Compass and Noise, won’t be active. Apple Watch Series 10 and later and Apple Watch Ultra 3 and later update more often while your wrist is down, and supported watch faces can even show a ticking seconds hand. However, the time is always shown in Always On mode.

Which Apple Watch models support Always On display?

Always On works on Apple Watch Series 5 and newer, Apple Watch SE 3, and every Apple Watch Ultra. The first- and second-generation Apple Watch SE don’t have it. Here’s the full list:

  • Apple Watch Series 5
  • Apple Watch Series 6
  • Apple Watch Series 7
  • Apple Watch Series 8
  • Apple Watch Series 9
  • Apple Watch Series 10
  • Apple Watch Series 11
  • Apple Watch Series 12
  • Apple Watch SE 3
  • Apple Watch Ultra
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4

watchOS 27 runs on Series 9 and later, SE 3, and Ultra 2 and later. Older models in the list above stay on an earlier watchOS, so their settings screens may look a little different from the steps below.

How to turn on or off the Always On display on an Apple Watch

There are two ways to enable or disable the Always On display feature on an Apple Watch. You can either enable it on the Apple Watch directly or use the Apple Watch app on your iPhone.

On the Apple Watch itself

  1. Open the Settings app.
  2. Select Display & Brightness.
  3. Tap Always On and turn on the toggle.

Using the Apple Watch app on an iPhone

  1. Open the Watch app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap My Watch, then select Display & Brightness.
  3. Select Always On and turn on the toggle on the following page.

You can repeat the above steps and disable the toggle to turn off Always On.

How to customize your Apple Watch’s Always On display

When your Apple Watch is in Always On mode, it displays notifications, complications, or the most recently active app by default. However, you can customize and control what you want to see. Plus, you can choose which apps can appear and display complications and notifications when your wrist is down.

This helps you control the information you see in Always On mode and keep it clutter-free. You can customize these settings on your Apple Watch or in the Apple Watch app on your iPhone.

On the Apple Watch itself

  1. Open Settings and select Display & Brightness.
  2. Tap Always On.
  3. Select Show Complication Data, Show Notifications, or Show Apps.

  4. Use the toggle to enable or disable their visibility on the Always On screen.

  5. In each menu, scroll down and use the toggle to turn off the apps you don’t want to display information on the Always On screen.

On the Watch App on an iPhone

  1. Open the Watch app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap My Watch, select Display & Brightness, and tap Always On.
  3. Select Show Complication Data, Show Notifications, or Show Apps.

  4. In each of these menus, you can choose which apps can display complications, notifications, or app content in Always On mode. Flip the toggle to enable or disable them.

How does Always On impact the battery life of your Apple Watch?

You might be wondering if enabling the Always On display affects the battery of your Apple Watch. It can be a valid concern if your Apple Watch is already old and struggles to last an entire day due to poor battery health.

The truth is, Always On does increase battery consumption. That’s expected of a feature that keeps the display on all the time. That said, the feature dims the display and lowers its refresh rate to optimize battery life. Further, the Always On display turns off automatically when you enable Low Power Mode or Theater Mode on your Apple Watch.

My Apple Watch lasts an entire day without Always On mode. When it is enabled, the battery is fully drained by late evening, so it lasts only about 75 percent of the day. However, this isn’t a standard estimate of the battery drain while using the Always On display. That depends on your model, your Apple Watch’s battery health, and your usage patterns. Based on your experience, you can decide whether to turn off the Always On display if it isn’t necessary or keep it on all the time.

Practical use cases of the Always On display feature on the Apple Watch

I keep the Always On display enabled at all times since I find it quite helpful in several scenarios in my everyday life. If it helps you decide how to use the feature, here are a few practical situations when you might want to enable Always On.

  • A sneak peek at the time: In the middle of a meeting or a long conversation, it may seem disrespectful to flick your wrist to check the time. Having Always On mode enabled helps me check the time without making it obvious.
  • Check workout stats: You wouldn’t want to raise your wrist while running or cycling, as it can be distracting. Always On is a huge blessing in such cases, and it lets me view my workout stats without having to wake the display.
  • Check health vitals during workouts: I always keep an eye on my heart rate and SpO2 levels during high-intensity workouts. Thanks to Always On mode on my Apple Watch, I can glance at such details easily.
  • Quickly view notifications: We all hate being distracted in the middle of a task. Checking notifications without having to raise my wrist off the keyboard is a great advantage. If it were the other way around, I’d check the notification, ponder over it, eventually pick up my iPhone, and then mindlessly use it for an hour.
  • Check timers while cooking: A timer is a cook’s best friend in the kitchen, ensuring you turn off all the knobs and switches at the right time. Always On mode lets me check the status of the timer complication without having to move my wrist or physically interact with my Apple Watch.
  • Check notifications during presentations: Always On lets me subtly check a notification during a presentation or a conversation that demands my focus. This helps me stay engaged and maintain the flow of the discussion without appearing distracted.
  • My Apple Watch looks better: I sometimes pair a watch face and a strap that look great together. So when the watch face is visible all the time, my Apple Watch looks visually appealing.

Wrapping up…

We hope this article helps you enable the Always On feature and check information without having to interact with your Apple Watch. Similarly, there’s another feature that lets you control your Apple Watch without having to touch the display. You can use a few hand gestures to perform actions on your Apple Watch. So do check that out as well!

FAQs

Why isn’t the Always On display working on my Apple Watch?

There could be several reasons. However, you can easily troubleshoot the Always On display when it’s not working on your Apple Watch to get it working again.

Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

Do all watch faces support Always On?

As mentioned earlier, the Always On feature simplifies the visuals of the watch face and displays essential information when it is idle. Therefore, in Always On mode, the watch face may not appear as it normally does.

title.rendered: How to change gamemode in Minecraft: Commands and F3 + F4 switcher

content.rendered:
Wondering how to change gamemode in Minecraft? Well, you’re in the right place, gamers! The sandbox game offers five different gamemodes to choose from, each providing a unique experience. You can switch between them with the /gamemode command or, on Java Edition, the F3 + F4 gamemode switcher, as long as cheats are enabled.

However, switching between them can be a bit difficult, as the game doesn’t clearly explain how to do so. But there’s no need to worry, as we’ve got you covered. So, let’s take a look at how to change gamemode in Minecraft and what each one brings to the table.

All gamemodes in Minecraft explained

As we’ve said before, there are five gamemodes in Minecraft to choose from: Survival, Creative, Adventure, Hardcore and Spectator. Let’s take a look at each of them in detail:

1. Survival mode

Survival Mode is where the real Minecraft journey begins. You’ll be heading out to explore the world, gather resources, craft tools, and fend off hostile mobs in order to stay alive. This won’t be an easy task, as you need to keep an eye on your hunger and health while making the most of the resources you find.

It’s all about starting with nothing, building yourself up, and eventually going up against the Ender Dragon.

2. Creative mode

Want to build your dream base without spending hours gathering materials? Creative Mode has you covered. You start the game with unlimited blocks and items and the ability to fly, and you don’t need to worry about hunger or damage.

You can break blocks instantly and experiment with different building ideas without any restrictions. It’s a perfect choice for players who want to unleash their creativity or simply have fun with friends.

3. Adventure mode

Adventure Mode is all about exploring custom maps, completing quests, and taking on challenges crafted by the Minecraft community. It seems like Survival mode on paper, but there are a few catches.

By default, you won’t be able to place or break blocks freely; what you can do depends on the permissions and tools set by the map’s creator.

4. Spectator mode

Don’t want to deal with mobs or obstacles? Consider switching to Spectator Mode. You can freely fly through blocks, explore underground caves, discover hidden structures, and observe other players without affecting their run.

However, you won’t be able to interact with the world. It’s a great way to explore the world or watch how other players approach the game. Bedrock players have had Spectator mode since the 1.19.50 update, so it’s no longer a Java-only feature.

5. Hardcore mode

Hardcore Mode is just like Survival Mode, but takes everything up a notch. It locks the difficulty to Hard, which means mobs hit like a truck, and staying alive becomes even more challenging. However, the biggest catch is that you only get one life. If you die, you won’t be able to respawn and continue your adventure as usual; you can only spectate the world. It’s a high-risk game mode that puts your Minecraft survival skills to the ultimate test.

However, you can’t switch a regular world into Hardcore mode, as it can only be chosen when creating a new world. Bedrock Edition got Hardcore as a full release with version 1.21.40, so it’s now available on both editions.

How to change gamemode in Minecraft

So, how do you change your gamemode in Minecraft? Well, you first need to enable cheats. If you’re creating a new world, just turn on the Allow Cheats (Java) or Cheats (Bedrock) toggle in the world settings. For an existing world:

  • Java Edition: Press Esc, select Open to LAN, switch Allow Cheats to ON, and click Start LAN World. This only enables cheats for as long as the world stays open to LAN, so you’ll need to repeat it each session.
  • Bedrock Edition: Pause the game, go to Settings > Game, and turn on Activate Cheats. Keep in mind that turning on cheats disables achievements in that world.

Once that’s done, you can switch between game modes using either of these two methods:

1. Use commands

Enter your world and open the chat window by pressing T on your keyboard or tapping the chat icon on your device. Now, type one of the following commands and hit Enter:

  • /gamemode survival
  • /gamemode creative
  • /gamemode adventure
  • /gamemode spectator

Looking for more ways to customize your world? Explore our full list of Minecraft cheats and commands.

On Bedrock, you can also change modes through the Personal Game Mode option in World Settings once cheats are on.

2. Use the gamemode switcher

On Java Edition, you can also use the built-in gamemode switcher to change modes without typing commands. Here’s how:

  • Hold F3 and press F4 to open the gamemode switcher.
  • Keep holding F3 and press F4 to cycle through Survival, Creative, Adventure, and Spectator mode.
  • Release F3 to choose the game mode you wish to play on.

If you’re on a laptop and nothing happens, try holding the Fn key as well, since F3 and F4 are often mapped to hardware controls.

Wrapping up

Minecraft offers five different game modes, each providing a unique experience for players. Whether you want to build freely, survive against mobs, or explore the world, there’s a game mode for every playstyle.

To switch between them, you’ll need to enable cheats or have the required permissions. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to choose your preferred playstyle and continue your adventure in Minecraft.

FAQs

Can you change gamemode in Minecraft without cheats?

No, you need to enable cheats in order to change gamemodes in Minecraft. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to do so.

What is the command to change gamemode in Minecraft?

The command to change gamemode in Minecraft is /gamemode, followed by the mode you wish to play. For instance, enter /gamemode creative to play Creative mode.

Can you change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer?

Yes, but you need operator (op) permissions, which can be granted by the server owner, to change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer. The F3 + F4 shortcut on Java servers also depends on those permissions.

mainEntity.name: Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

mainEntity.name: Do all watch faces support Always On?

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft without cheats?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you need to enable cheats in order to change gamemodes in Minecraft. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to do so.

mainEntity.name: What is the command to change gamemode in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: The command to change gamemode in Minecraft is /gamemode, followed by the mode you wish to play. For instance, enter /gamemode creative to play Creative mode.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but you need operator (op) permissions, which can be granted by the server owner, to change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer. The F3 + F4 shortcut on Java servers also depends on those permissions.
